cards.name: Vanguard Bannerman
cards.text: Allegiance: Grant other allies +1|+1.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Allegiance><style=Vocab>Allegiance</style></link>: Grant other allies +1|+1.
cards.flavor: "You must understand the weight of our banner. It flies for our king, our houses, our citizens. It is our unwavering belief in Demacia itself. Hold it high. Show them our pride." - Tianna Crownguard

cards.name: Tianna Crownguard
cards.text: When I'm summoned, Rally.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, <link=vocab.Rally><style=Vocab>Rally</style></link>.
cards.flavor: “Our House has bled for this realm. You’ll not throw away this family’s honor for a few tricks of light.”

cards.name: Laurent Bladekeeper
cards.text: Play: Grant an ally +2|+2.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Grant an ally +2|+2.
cards.flavor: "Yes, they are beautiful. But like any fine instrument, they only reveal their true beauty in the hands of a master."

cards.name: Silverwing Vanguard
cards.text: Play: Summon an exact copy of me.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Summon an exact copy of me.
cards.flavor: They fell from the clouds like silvery bolts of lightning, swift and sure as they dove toward their targets. Then, as suddenly as they appeared, they were gone.

cards.name: Vanguard Sergeant
cards.text: When I'm summoned, create a For Demacia! in hand.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>For Demacia!</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: "He leads our drills from morning to night, and he's the first to head into the fray. Hard as steel, steady as stone--couldn't choose a finer leader." - Demacian ensign

cards.name: Judgment
cards.text: A battling ally strikes all battling enemies.
cards.textHtml: A battling ally <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strikes</style></link> all battling enemies.
cards.flavor: Justice always comes full circle.

cards.name: Brightsteel Protector
cards.text: Play: Give an ally Barrier this round.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Give an ally <link=keyword.Barrier><sprite name=Barrier><style=Keyword>Barrier</style></link> this round.
cards.flavor: "We are a prosperous nation because each warrior's fate is a coin we will never be content to spend." - King Jarvan III

cards.name: Swiftwing Lancer
cards.text: Last Breath: Create a random Elite in hand.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>Last Breath</style></link>: Create a random Elite in hand.
cards.flavor: "It takes a bold heart to trust their life to a silverwing, locked in combat far above solid ground. Bold, and highly durable." - Garen

cards.name: Laurent Protege
cards.flavor: "He did WHAT? I entrusted him with Pierre de Guillard's priceless dual-balanced sabre! He said it was only to be used for training!" - Laurent Bladekeeper

cards.name: Garen
cards.text: When I'm summoned, give other allies +1|+1 this round.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, give other allies +1|+1 this round.
cards.levelup: I've struck twice.
cards.flavor: Training and resilience are the way of a soldier. Even in the face of great peril, we will not falter.

cards.name: Garen
cards.text:
When I'm summoned, give other allies +1|+1 this round.
Round Start: Rally.
cards.textHtml:
When I'm summoned, give other allies +1|+1 this round.
<link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: <link=vocab.Rally><style=Vocab>Rally</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "You think me rigid. Single-minded. Predictable. I am rigid, for nothing can sway me. I am single-minded, for I believe in Demacia. And I am predictable, for I will surely defeat you.”

cards.name: Garen's Judgment
cards.text:
A battling ally strikes all battling enemies.

cards.textHtml:
A battling ally <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strikes</style></link> all battling enemies.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Garen</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: Justice always comes full circle.

cards.name: Chain Vest
cards.text: Grant an ally Tough.
cards.textHtml: Grant an ally <link=keyword.Tough><sprite name=Tough><style=Keyword>Tough</style></link>.
cards.flavor: Demacian steel is known throughout the world for its superior strength. Its forging requires smiths of equal strength and repute.

cards.name: Reinforcements
cards.text: Summon 2 Dauntless Vanguards, then grant Elite allies +1|+1.
cards.textHtml: Summon 2 <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Dauntless Vanguards</style></link>, then grant Elite allies +1|+1.
cards.flavor:
"Our rivals know that to strike at any of us is to strike at all of us."
- The Vanguard's Code

cards.name: Radiant Guardian
cards.text: When I'm summoned, grant me Lifesteal and Tough if an ally died this round.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, grant me <link=keyword.Lifesteal><sprite name=Lifesteal><style=Keyword>Lifesteal</style></link> and <link=keyword.Tough><sprite name=Tough><style=Keyword>Tough</style></link> if an ally died this round.
cards.flavor: "Waves of cold undead hands pulled down her companions. Only she remained, a gleaming beacon of justice whose blade seemed to sing the names of the fallen with every swing." - Demacian ensign

cards.name: Dauntless Vanguard
cards.flavor: The Dauntless Vanguard are Demacia's most elite warriors, each a legend in their village or shire. But all of them seek to have their names known throughout the realm.

cards.name: Stand Alone
cards.text: If you have exactly 1 ally, grant it +3|+3.
cards.textHtml: If you have exactly 1 ally, grant it +3|+3.
cards.flavor: When others fail, it falls upon the shoulders of a true hero to find a path to victory.

cards.name: Radiant Strike
cards.text: Give an ally +1|+1 this round.
cards.textHtml: Give an ally +1|+1 this round.
cards.flavor: "Undead fight like they've got no tomorrow. We'll make sure they won’t get one." - Lucian

cards.name: Mobilize
cards.text: Reduce the cost of allies in hand by 1.
cards.textHtml: Reduce the cost of allies in hand by 1.
cards.flavor: "From the fields to the front in a fortnight. This is what we expect from each and every able body in Demacia." - Garen

cards.name: Vanguard Defender
cards.flavor: "We didn't know who or what those creatures were. But we knew the faces of our fellow soldiers by our sides, and that was all we needed."

cards.name: Relentless Pursuit
cards.text: Rally.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Rally><style=Vocab>Rally</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "Everyone's gotta face their fears. Lucky you, here I am." - Lucian

cards.name: Lucian
cards.levelup: I've seen 4+ allies or an allied Senna die.
cards.flavor: "I'll be alright, Senna, long as I've got you."

cards.name: Lucian
cards.text: Each round, the first time an ally dies, Rally.
cards.textHtml: Each round, the first time an ally dies, <link=vocab.Rally><style=Vocab>Rally</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "World's full of monsters. If you're lucky, they're the ones you can see. The worst are the ones that stay under your skin."

cards.flavor: "Everyone's gotta face their fears. Lucky you, here I am." - Lucian

cards.name: Mageseeker Investigator
cards.text: Create a Detain in hand once you've played a 6+ cost spell this game.
cards.textHtml: Create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Detain</style></link> in hand once you've played a 6+ cost spell this game.
cards.flavor: "Forgive the intrusion, but we will require your full cooperation. We have been notified of some... 'unusual happenings'..."

cards.name: Mageseeker Conservator
cards.text: Last Breath: Create in hand a random 6+ cost spell from a region other than Demacia.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>Last Breath</style></link>: Create in hand a random 6+ cost spell from a region other than Demacia.
cards.flavor:
"Arcane items have undeniable intrigue. But these objects of power are best left to the capable hands of our experts, and away from the well-meaning ignorance of our citizens."
- Mageseeker's Handbook

cards.name: Detain
cards.text: An ally Captures a unit.
cards.textHtml: An ally <link=keyword.Capture><sprite name=Capture><style=Keyword>Captures</style></link> a unit.
cards.flavor: "Submit to us. We are the law and you are its subject. There is nothing more." - Mageseeker Persuader

cards.name: Single Combat
cards.text: An ally and an enemy strike each other.
cards.textHtml: An ally and an enemy <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strike</style></link> each other.
cards.flavor: "Save your words; we speak with blades." - Fiora

cards.name: En Garde
cards.text: Give allies Challenger this round.
cards.textHtml: Give allies <link=keyword.Challenger><sprite name=Challenger><style=Keyword>Challenger</style></link> this round.
cards.flavor: "There's not a Demacian alive who would refuse a Laurent's lesson in swordsmanship. Or survived one, for that matter." - Fiora

cards.name: Vanguard Cavalry
cards.flavor: The Vanguard needed no drums, no music to keep time in their advance. Only the steady, even beat of hooves against soil.

cards.name: Fleetfeather Tracker
cards.text: When you summon another ally, grant me Challenger.
cards.textHtml: When you summon another ally, grant me <link=keyword.Challenger><sprite name=Challenger><style=Keyword>Challenger</style></link>.
cards.flavor: These relatives of the silverwing raptors have the predatory instincts of their cousins alongside a dogged unfamiliarity with their own comparatively diminutive size.

cards.name: Silverwing Diver
cards.flavor: Arrows rained down from the fortress walls in droves, but none could touch that fleck of silver darting through the sky.

cards.name: Dawnspeakers
cards.text: Round End: Grant other allies +1|+1 if an ally died this round.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.RoundEnd><style=Vocab>Round End</style></link>: Grant other allies +1|+1 if an ally died this round.
cards.flavor: "Evil has taken the hour, but it will not win the day. Remember our fallen, and wear their memories like armor!"

cards.name: Prismatic Barrier
cards.text: Give an ally Barrier this round.
cards.textHtml: Give an ally <link=keyword.Barrier><sprite name=Barrier><style=Keyword>Barrier</style></link> this round.
cards.flavor: "The world can turn its back on you when you're different. People say your differences make you weak--but they make us strong, compassionate. Even in the darkest times, I'll protect you!" - Lux

cards.name: Remembrance
cards.text: I cost 1 less for each ally that died this round. Summon a random 5 cost follower from Demacia.
cards.textHtml: I cost 1 less for each ally that died this round. Summon a random 5 cost follower from Demacia.
cards.flavor: "Today we rise to right the injustices that felled those before us. The sacrifices of our comrades were not in vain." - Radiant Guardian

cards.name: Battlesmith
cards.text: When you summon an Elite, grant it +1|+1.
cards.textHtml: When you summon an Elite, grant it +1|+1.
cards.flavor: Wars are won in the forge.

cards.name: For Demacia!
cards.text: Give allies +3|+3 this round.
cards.textHtml: Give allies +3|+3 this round.
cards.flavor: “It is our homes, our families, our comrades in arms. It is our pride, our honor, our strength. And so, today, as we fight for its defense and its very existence, let us shout its name: DEMACIA!" - Vanguard Sergeant

cards.name: Vanguard Squire
cards.text: When you summon an Elite, reduce my cost by 1.
cards.textHtml: When you summon an Elite, reduce my cost by 1.
cards.flavor: "Everyone I met, every journey I took taught me something new. But the more I learned and the stronger I became, the more I realized I had much further to go..." - Cithria, Vanguard Squire

cards.name: Riposte
cards.text: Give an ally +3|+0 and Barrier this round.
cards.textHtml: Give an ally +3|+0 and <link=keyword.Barrier><sprite name=Barrier><style=Keyword>Barrier</style></link> this round.
cards.flavor: "How appropriate--you fight like a poro!" - Fiora

cards.name: Senna, Sentinel of Light
cards.text: The first time an allied Lucian dies, grant me +1|+1 and Double Attack.
cards.textHtml: The first time an allied <link=card.luc1><style=AssociatedCard>Lucian</style></link> dies, grant me +1|+1 and <link=keyword.Double Strike><sprite name=DoubleStrike><style=Keyword>Double Attack</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "Our Sentinels are the first line of defense between the tide of restless undead and the realms of man. We hit first, hit hard, and NEVER back down when the lives of our companions are on the line."

cards.name: Cithria of Cloudfield
cards.flavor: "Each night before bed, my mother would tell me stories of Demacia's greatest heroes as she sharpened her sword. My dreams were full of adventures, and today I'll begin a story all my own."

cards.name: Mageseeker Persuader
cards.text: Grant me +1|+1 and Challenger once you've played a 6+ cost spell this game.
cards.textHtml: Grant me +1|+1 and <link=keyword.Challenger><sprite name=Challenger><style=Keyword>Challenger</style></link> once you've played a 6+ cost spell this game.
cards.flavor: "Citizens of Demacia, it is my honor to keep you safe. But we must demand your unwavering support, for even within our high walls, mages still walk among us!"

cards.name: Back to Back
cards.text: Give 2 allies +3|+3 this round.
cards.textHtml: Give 2 allies +3|+3 this round.
cards.flavor:
"Cover me, I'm going in!"
"Funny, I was about to say the same to you."
- Lorn and Dax of the Eastern Battalion

cards.name: Lux
cards.levelup: I've seen you play 6+ mana of spells. When I level up, create a Final Spark in hand.
cards.flavor: "I've always known there's something different about me... a light from within. I'm not sure what it is, but I have to find out!"

cards.name: Lux's Prismatic Barrier
cards.text:
Give an ally Barrier this round.
Create a Lux in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
Give an ally <link=keyword.Barrier><sprite name=Barrier><style=Keyword>Barrier</style></link> this round.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Lux</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "The world can turn its back on you when you're different. People say your differences make you weak--but they make us strong, compassionate. Even in the darkest times, I'll protect you!" - Lux

cards.name: Lux
cards.text: Each time you play 6+ mana of spells, create a Final Spark in hand.
cards.textHtml: Each time you play 6+ mana of spells, create a <link=card.warcry><style=AssociatedCard>Final Spark</style></link> in hand. <style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor: "No more holding back!"

cards.name: Final Spark
cards.text: Deal 4 to an enemy. If there are no enemies, deal 4 to the enemy Nexus instead.
cards.textHtml: Deal 4 to an enemy. If there are no enemies, deal 4 to the enemy Nexus instead.
cards.flavor: "I've hidden my light for my whole life. What would happen if they knew... if *I* knew what I could really do?" - Lux

cards.name: War Chefs
cards.text: Support: Give my supported ally +1|+1 this round.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Support><style=Keyword>Support</style></link>: Give my supported ally +1|+1 this round.
cards.flavor: No one in the Demacian army should be trifled with.

cards.name: Redoubled Valor
cards.text: Fully heal an ally, then double its Power and Health.
cards.textHtml: Fully heal an ally, then double its Power and Health.
cards.flavor: In Demacia, to be as good as two of the enemy isn't just a boast.

cards.name: Fiora
cards.levelup: I've killed 2 enemies.
cards.flavor: "From arena to tournament, training ground to battleground, I long for a worthy opponent. I will not rest until I know I am the greatest."

cards.name: Fiora
cards.text: When I've killed 4 enemies and survived, you win the game.
cards.textHtml: When I've killed 4 enemies and survived, you win the game. <style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor: "... and now I know."

cards.name: Fiora's Riposte
cards.text:
Give an ally +3|+0 and Barrier this round.
Create a Fiora in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
Give an ally +3|+0 and <link=keyword.Barrier><sprite name=Barrier><style=Keyword>Barrier</style></link> this round.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Fiora</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "How appropriate--you fight like a poro!" - Fiora

cards.name: Vanguard Lookout
cards.flavor: Just because it's quiet doesn't mean it's safe.

cards.name: Succession
cards.text: Summon a Dauntless Vanguard.
cards.textHtml: Summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Dauntless Vanguard</style></link>.
cards.flavor: Vestments of the Dauntless Vanguard are handed down from one soldier to the next, so that new recruits may feel the weight and pride of their responsibilities.

cards.name: Mageseeker Inciter
cards.text: Grant me +2|+2 once you've played a 6+ cost spell this game.
cards.textHtml: Grant me +2|+2 once you've played a 6+ cost spell this game.
cards.flavor: "Long ago, the wild magicks of the Rune Wars brought all Runeterra to its knees. Thus, our order was created to protect our kingdom by ridding it of magic, whether abroad or within." - Mageseeker's Handbook

cards.name: Plucky Poro
cards.flavor: "New recruit has the kind of endurance and courage shown by our finest soldiers. Will he make it to the Vanguard someday? He's... smaller than the rest, but we'll see." - Vanguard Sergeant

cards.name: Purify
cards.text: Silence a follower.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Silence><style=Vocab>Silence</style></link> a follower.
cards.flavor:
"Your petricite Graymark is your primary safeguard against magic, a symbol of our responsibilities, and a reminder to others of our authority. Honor it above all else."
- The Mageseekers' Handbook

cards.name: Cithria the Bold
cards.text: Attack: Give other attacking allies +1|+1 and Fearsome this round.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Give other attacking allies +1|+1 and <link=keyword.Fearsome><sprite name=Fearsome><style=Keyword>Fearsome</style></link> this round.
cards.flavor: "Legends, tales--they were never just fiction to me. They were adventure calling my name. I left Cloudfield to discover my own adventure, only to find I would have many. And they’re just beginning.”

cards.name: Brightsteel Formation
cards.text: When I'm summoned or Attack: Give allies Barrier this round.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned or <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Give allies <link=keyword.Barrier><sprite name=Barrier><style=Keyword>Barrier</style></link> this round.
cards.flavor: "This formation is the basis of our tactics. It requires the faith of each soldier in their shield, and in the shields of their companions. So long as they stand, so too shall our realm." - Garen

cards.name: Laurent Chevalier
cards.text: Strike: Create in hand another random Challenger follower from your regions.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>Strike</style></link>: Create in hand another random <link=keyword.Challenger><sprite name=Challenger><style=Keyword>Challenger</style></link> follower from your regions.
cards.flavor: "...Good grief." - Fiora

cards.name: Vanguard Redeemer
cards.text: When I'm summoned, draw a unit if an ally died this round.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, draw a unit if an ally died this round.
cards.flavor: "Our fallen shall be remembered in every battle cry, in every swing of our swords, and every crash of our shields! Today, we shall be victorious!"

cards.name: Laurent Duelist
cards.text: Play: Grant Challenger to an ally in hand.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Grant <link=keyword.Challenger><sprite name=Challenger><style=Keyword>Challenger</style></link> to an ally in hand.
cards.flavor: "He seemed a preening fop with an expensive blade--turns out he really knew how to swing that sword! I'd demand a rematch, but I missed his name with that ridiculous accent." - Demacian ensign

cards.name: Vanguard Firstblade
cards.text: Attack: Grant me +2|+2.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Grant me +2|+2.
cards.flavor: The battle cry sounds, and my feet are already turning over the soil. I need nothing but my lady's order to know my destiny and enact her will.

cards.name: Flash Freeze
cards.text: Frostbite an enemy.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Frostbite><sprite name=Frostbite><style=Keyword>Frostbite</style></link> an enemy.
cards.flavor: The cold strikes without warning, rendering even the strongest warrior helpless.

cards.name: Avarosan Sentry
cards.text: Last Breath: Draw 1.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>Last Breath</style></link>: Draw 1.
cards.flavor: "Once I sought my place on distant battlefields. Now, I've found it beside my kin, my homestead. My eyes are theirs, and their safety is in my hands."

cards.name: Elixir of Iron
cards.text: Give an ally +0|+2 this round.
cards.textHtml: Give an ally +0|+2 this round.
cards.flavor: "Rough out there, eh? Not to worry, the 'Owl serves up a special brew so strong it'll pull the chill outta y'bones 'n grow hair on the chest of a newborn!" - Kindly Tavernkeeper

cards.name: Battle Fury
cards.text: Grant an ally +8|+4.
cards.textHtml: Grant an ally +8|+4.
cards.flavor: “I've been told I have a... temper.” - Tryndamere

cards.name: Iceborn Legacy
cards.text: Grant an ally and all allied copies of it everywhere +2|+2.
cards.textHtml: Grant an ally and all allied copies of it <link=vocab.Everywhere><style=Vocab>everywhere</style></link> +2|+2.
cards.flavor: "We few are Iceborn, our bloodlines infused with the Freljord's magic. Our ancestors locked away an ancient evil, and now we few stand guard to defend against its return." - Gregor the Guardian

cards.name: Babbling Bjerg
cards.text: When I'm summoned, draw a unit with 5+ Power.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, draw a unit with 5+ Power.
cards.flavor: "Y-You've gotta believe me! It was huge, I tell you, HUUUGE!"

cards.name: Lonely Poro
cards.text: When I'm summoned, create another random 1 cost Poro in hand.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, create another random 1 cost Poro in hand.
cards.flavor: "A lifetime in the Freljord, and still nothin's more chillin' than the sight of this sad little fellow." - Poro Herder

cards.name: Jubilant Poro
cards.text: When I'm summoned, create another random 1 cost Poro in hand.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, create another random 1 cost Poro in hand.
cards.flavor: "Oho, there's a good lad! Even the coldest winter melts into spring." - Poro Herder

cards.name: Braum
cards.text: The first time I survive damage, summon a Mighty Poro.
cards.textHtml: The first time I survive damage, summon a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Mighty Poro</style></link>.
cards.levelup: I've survived 10+ total damage.
cards.flavor:
“Papa, tell the one about Braum and his door!”
"Or when his fall split a mountain in two!"
"Oh! Whattabout when he saved the tavern from the rampaging yeti?!"

cards.name: Braum
cards.text: When I survive damage, summon a Mighty Poro.
cards.textHtml: When I survive damage, summon a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Mighty Poro</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "Listen closely, 'n I'll tell you about Braum and the mightiest of his poros!" - Ingvar the Elder

cards.name: Braum's Take Heart
cards.text:
Grant a damaged ally +3|+3.
Create a Braum in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
Grant a damaged ally +3|+3.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Braum</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor:
"... Though his wounds were great, Braum threw back his head and laughed. For he knew that dire times are when heroes are made!"
- The Tale of Braum

cards.name: Bloodsworn Pledge
cards.text: Grant 2 allies +0|+3.
cards.textHtml: Grant 2 allies +0|+3.
cards.flavor: "I will be a torch in your heart, a shield at your side. Let me find strength to protect us and our kin, and may our lives flow together as the blood that seals this oath." - Tryndamere

cards.name: Icevale Archer
cards.text: Play: Frostbite an enemy.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: <link=keyword.Frostbite><sprite name=Frostbite><style=Keyword>Frostbite</style></link> an enemy.
cards.flavor: Avarosans take pride in their harsh seasons and icy lands. Their keen-eyed defenders even take it a step further.

cards.name: Catalyst of Aeons
cards.text: Get an empty mana gem and heal your Nexus 3.
cards.textHtml: Get an empty mana gem and heal your Nexus 3.
cards.flavor: Neither ruby nor sapphire surpass the luster of the aeon stone--a brilliant gem with legendary restorative properties.

cards.name: Scarmother Vrynna
cards.text: When I survive damage, grant me +3|+0.
cards.textHtml: When I survive damage, grant me +3|+0.
cards.flavor: "I would die shivering in the cold before sharing a hearth with Ashe's weaklings. But if they desire warmth, I will give it to them.”

cards.name: Yeti Yearling
cards.text: Last Breath: Create 2 Enraged Yetis in your deck.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>Last Breath</style></link>: Create 2 <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Enraged Yetis</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "It was so tiny and peaceful! Hard to believe it would grow up to be... well... a yeti." - Avarosan Trapper

cards.name: Poro Snax
cards.text: Grant Poro allies everywhere +1|+1.
cards.textHtml: Grant Poro allies <link=vocab.Everywhere><style=Vocab>everywhere</style></link> +1|+1.
cards.flavor: "They gobble 'em up, then look at you, tongues out, happy as sheared 'nuks in the thaw askin' for more! You try sayin' no." - Avarosan treatmaker

cards.name: Troop of Elnuks
cards.text: Play: For the top 6 cards in your deck, summon each Elnuk and place the rest into your deck.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: For the top 6 cards in your deck, summon each Elnuk and place the rest into your deck.
cards.flavor: "Avarosans are like elnuks--dull-eyed grass-eaters easily felled by the unscarred. It is by numbers alone that they stay alive." - Scarmother Vrynna

cards.name: Rimefang Wolf
cards.text: Strike: If I struck a unit with 0 Power, kill it.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>Strike</style></link>: If I struck a unit with 0 Power, kill it.
cards.flavor: Predators of the northern reaches have learned that the easiest prey are those already crippled by winter's bite.

cards.name: Winter's Breath
cards.text: Kill all enemies with 0 Power, then Frostbite all enemies.
cards.textHtml: Kill all enemies with 0 Power, then <link=keyword.Frostbite><sprite name=Frostbite><style=Keyword>Frostbite</style></link> all enemies.
cards.flavor: Warmother Winter is the first and last foe faced by any who would invade the Freljord. Her bloodsworn are the merciless wind and the biting frost.

cards.name: Avalanche
cards.text: Deal 2 to ALL units.
cards.textHtml: Deal 2 to ALL units.
cards.flavor: The soul of every avalanche is a pebble that would not stay put.

cards.name: Tarkaz the Tribeless
cards.text: Attack: Deal 1 to ALL battling units.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.AttackSkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Attack</style></link>: Deal 1 to ALL battling units.
cards.flavor: "Tarkaz fought harder and better than most. He took his defeat gracefully, I thought. Well, mostly..." - Tryndamere

cards.name: Tarkaz's Fury
cards.text: Deal 1 to ALL battling units.
cards.textHtml: Deal 1 to ALL battling units.
cards.flavor: "... Maybe not that gracefully after all." - Tryndamere

cards.name: Omen Hawk
cards.text: When I'm summoned, grant the top 2 allies in your deck +1|+1.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, grant the top 2 allies in your deck +1|+1.
cards.flavor: "Three times our reavers reached Avarosan gates, and three time they were met with ready bows. What trickery warns them of our attacks?" - Scarthane Steffen

cards.name: Warmother's Call
cards.text: Summon the top ally from your deck now and EACH Round Start.
cards.textHtml: Summon the top ally from your deck now and EACH <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>.
cards.flavor: There will come a day when an unmistakable call will resound through the Freljord. On that day, all will rise to answer it, for it announces that our ancient enemies have emerged once again.

cards.name: Anivia
cards.text:
Attack: Deal 1 to all enemies and the enemy Nexus.
Last Breath: Revive me transformed into Eggnivia.
cards.textHtml:
<link=keyword.Elemental Skill><sprite name=ElementalSkill><style=Keyword>Attack</style></link>: Deal 1 to all enemies and the enemy Nexus.
<link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>Last Breath</style></link>: Revive me transformed into <link=card.transform><style=AssociatedCard>Eggnivia</style></link>.
cards.levelup: You're Enlightened.
cards.flavor: "I was born from this hard land, and it is mine to safeguard. Time, war, even death itself will not stop my vigil."

cards.name: Anivia's Harsh Winds
cards.text:
Frostbite 2 enemies.
Create an Anivia in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
<link=keyword.Frostbite><sprite name=Frostbite><style=Keyword>Frostbite</style></link> 2 enemies.
Create an <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Anivia</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "You'd challenge me on my own lands? You're ill-prepared, little one." - Anivia

cards.name: Glacial Storm
cards.text: Deal 1 to all enemies and the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml: Deal 1 to all enemies and the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: The storm that comes before the calm.

cards.name: Anivia
cards.text:
Attack: Deal 2 to all enemies and the enemy Nexus.
Last Breath: Revive me transformed into Eggnivia.
cards.textHtml:
<link=keyword.Elemental Skill><sprite name=ElementalSkill><style=Keyword>Attack</style></link>: Deal 2 to all enemies and the enemy Nexus.
<link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>Last Breath</style></link>: Revive me transformed into <link=card.transform><style=AssociatedCard>Eggnivia</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "Cease your march and turn back your armies. The eye of winter has spied your conquest, and its icy claw closes tight about your treasonous hearts."

cards.name: Eggnivia
cards.levelup: Round Start: If you're Enlightened, transform me back into Anivia and Level Up.
cards.flavor: In the depths of winter's cold embrace, the Freljord's guardian awaits the hour of her return.

cards.name: Glacial Storm
cards.text: Deal 2 to all enemies and the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml: Deal 2 to all enemies and the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: The storm that comes before the calm.

cards.name: Poro Herder
cards.text: When I'm summoned, draw a Poro if you Behold a Poro.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, draw a Poro if you <link=vocab.Behold><style=Vocab>Behold</style></link> a Poro.
cards.flavor: A herd needs just two things: love, and company. Anything else is just fluff.

cards.name: Alpha Wildclaw
cards.flavor: The power of a warhorse, the thoughtless savagery of a cat.

cards.name: Bull Elnuk
cards.flavor: Avarosan folk tales speak of "Old Uncle Elnuk", a stubborn old grouch who wanted nothing more than a warm patch of grass and an argument to dig his heel into.

cards.name: Enraged Yeti
cards.flavor: Yetis? I just don't think they exi--AUGHHH!

cards.name: Entreat
cards.text: Draw a champion.
cards.textHtml: Draw a champion.
cards.flavor: "Reavers approach! Sound the call and light the fires, we'll need all the help we can muster!" - Avarosan Sentry

cards.name: Brittle Steel
cards.text: Frostbite an enemy with 3 or less Health.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Frostbite><sprite name=Frostbite><style=Keyword>Frostbite</style></link> an enemy with 3 or less Health.
cards.flavor: "Chilly? Ha! Let us hope that your spirits are sturdier than your summerland steel!" - Braum

cards.name: Ancient Yeti
cards.text: Round End: Reduce my cost by 1.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.RoundEnd><style=Vocab>Round End</style></link>: Reduce my cost by 1.
cards.flavor: "What was that? Sounded like a sneeze. Do glaciers... sneeze?" - Bjerg the Wanderer

cards.name: Starlit Seer
cards.text: When you play a spell, grant the top ally in your deck +1|+1.
cards.textHtml: When you play a spell, grant the top ally in your deck +1|+1.
cards.flavor: "Grant them keen ears to hear the wind's approach, light feet to cross the coming snows, and sharp eyes to see beyond the veil of winter."

cards.name: Wyrding Stones
cards.text: Round Start: Get an extra mana gem this round.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Get an extra mana gem this round.
cards.flavor: "These ancient cairns are reminders that we are but the latest in a long line of tribes to brave these untamed lands." - Ashe

cards.name: They Who Endure
cards.text: When I'm summoned, grant me +1|+1 for each ally that has died.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, grant me +1|+1 for each ally that has died. <style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor: "Ah, old Bjerg's been through a bit. Lost his crew up north, returned pale an' gibberin' months later. Now, it's just "giant beasts" this and "huge claws" that. That poor man..." - Kindly Tavernkeeper

cards.name: Unscarred Reaver
cards.text: When I survive damage, grant me +3|+0.
cards.textHtml: When I survive damage, grant me +3|+0.
cards.flavor: "Avarosans nurture their young to grow old, soft, and unprepared for the heat of battle. Ours are born in the fires of war itself." - Scarmother Vrynna

cards.name: Avarosan Marksman
cards.text: Play: Deal 1 to an enemy.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.PlaySkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Play</style></link>: Deal 1 to an enemy.
cards.flavor: In the Freljord you can hunt, or you can starve.

cards.name: Bullseye
cards.text: Deal 1 to an enemy.
cards.textHtml: Deal 1 to an enemy.
cards.flavor: Gotcha.

cards.name: Avarosan Outriders
cards.text: Allegiance: Grant the top ally in your deck +3|+3 and Overwhelm.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Allegiance><style=Vocab>Allegiance</style></link>: Grant the top ally in your deck +3|+3 and <link=keyword.Overwhelm><sprite name=Overwhelm><style=Keyword>Overwhelm</style></link>.
cards.flavor: As the rows of reinforcements crested the ridge, the Outriders bowed their heads to the warmother. For with her--their Avarosa in the flesh, their queen Ashe--came the promise of peace.

cards.name: Ashe
cards.text: Attack: Frostbite the strongest enemy.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: <link=keyword.Frostbite><sprite name=Frostbite><style=Keyword>Frostbite</style></link> the <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> enemy.
cards.levelup: You've reduced the Power of 5+ enemies to 0. When I level up, create a Crystal Arrow on top of deck.
cards.flavor: "When I look out over my home, I see what it is, but also what it could be. Prosperous and plentiful, not only for my people, but for all those who seek peace. The Freljord, united."

cards.name: Ashe's Flash Freeze
cards.text:
Frostbite an enemy.
Create an Ashe in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
<link=keyword.Frostbite><sprite name=Frostbite><style=Keyword>Frostbite</style></link> an enemy.
Create an <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Ashe</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: The cold strikes without warning, rendering even the strongest warrior helpless.

cards.name: Ashe
cards.text:
Attack: Frostbite the strongest enemy.
Enemies with 0 Power can't block.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: <link=keyword.Frostbite><sprite name=Frostbite><style=Keyword>Frostbite</style></link> the <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> enemy.
Enemies with 0 Power can't block.
cards.flavor: "You are not our enemy. Our true foe is the long, lawless winter. We are all people of the Freljord, and this land belongs to all of us!"

cards.name: Crystal Arrow
cards.text: Frostbite an enemy and all other enemies with 3 or less Health. Draw 1.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Frostbite><sprite name=Frostbite><style=Keyword>Frostbite</style></link> an enemy and all other enemies with 3 or less Health. Draw 1.
cards.flavor: "All the world on one arrow." - Ashe

cards.name: Tryndamere
cards.levelup: If I would die, I Level Up instead.
cards.flavor: "Do not die for your cause. Live for it..."

cards.name: Tryndamere's Battle Fury
cards.text:
Grant an ally +8|+4.
Create a Tryndamere in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
Grant an ally +8|+4.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Tryndamere</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: “I've been told I have a... temper.” - Tryndamere

cards.name: Tryndamere
cards.flavor: "...And make THEM die for it."

cards.name: Rimetusk Shaman
cards.text: Round Start: Frostbite the strongest enemy.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: <link=keyword.Frostbite><sprite name=Frostbite><style=Keyword>Frostbite</style></link> the <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> enemy.
cards.flavor: "To become one with the wild we must not hide from the cold, but revel in its savagery."

cards.name: Avarosan Hearthguard
cards.text: When I'm summoned, grant allies in your deck +1|+1.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, grant allies in your deck +1|+1.
cards.flavor: "Many tribes under one banner! Perhaps one day all the Freljord will fight side by side."

cards.name: Harsh Winds

cards.flavor:

"Long ago, raiders attacked Avarosa's village. Her forces were few--all seemed lost. But a poro appeared and offered Avarosa its help..."

"... At first she didn't know what the little ones could do. But then another appeared, and another, 'til the hall was full of them! And every poro gathered--" 
"Bedtime! If you two aren't asleep in five minutes...!"

cards.textHtml: When I survive damage, grant me +3|+0.

- The Tale of Braum

cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Enlightened><style=Keyword>Enlightened</style></link>: I have +4|+4.

- Saga of the First Lands

cards.name: Emerald Awakener
cards.text: Enlightened: I have +4|+4.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Enlightened><style=Keyword>Enlightened</style></link>: I have +4|+4.
cards.flavor: "War is fostered by our basest instincts. But instinct has no power over our highest virtues: trust, patience, and contemplation."

cards.name: Insight of Ages
cards.text:
Create in hand another random spell from your regions.
Enlightened: Create 2 instead.
cards.textHtml:
Create in hand another random spell from your regions.
<link=keyword.Enlightened><style=Keyword>Enlightened</style></link>: Create 2 instead.
cards.flavor: “When your hope wavers, know that you are never alone. The past is always by our side. It has known myriad tomorrows and all the hope that they bring.” - Karma

cards.name: Ki Guardian
cards.text:
Grant Barrier to an ally in hand. 
Draw 1.
cards.textHtml:
Grant <link=keyword.Barrier><sprite name=Barrier><style=Keyword>Barrier</style></link> to an ally in hand. 
Draw 1.
cards.flavor: "Those who keep the balance shall know the protection of the Kinkou." - Shen

cards.name: Yone, Windchaser
cards.text: Play: Stun 2 enemies.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.PlaySkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Play</style></link>: <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> 2 enemies.
cards.flavor: "When I was a child, I asked my brother: 'Does the wind flee, or does it follow?' He followed me then for guidance. I follow him now for justice."

cards.name: Staggering Strikes
cards.text: Stun 2 enemies.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> 2 enemies.
cards.flavor: "Stand aside. I have come for the Unforgiven." - Yone, Windchaser

cards.name: Shadow Assassin
cards.text: When I'm summoned, draw 1.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, draw 1.
cards.flavor:
Gracefully she glides
Noiseless steps in the shadows
Claws the only trace.

cards.name: Decimate
cards.text: Deal 4 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml: Deal 4 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: "Sometimes, it takes tactical genius to break a fortress. Sometimes, you just have to hit it harder." - Darius

cards.name: Arena Bookie
cards.text: Round Start: Discard your lowest cost card to draw 1.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Discard your lowest cost card to draw 1.
cards.flavor: "...you bet on Shiraza as SOLE SURVIVOR, and that Ionian kid--sure he's missing an arm--but he ain't dead. Makes him a survivor, see? 'Course, you could always double down..."

cards.name: Culling Strike
cards.text: Kill a unit with 3 or less Power.
cards.textHtml: Kill a unit with 3 or less Power.
cards.flavor: Everyone dies. The weak just die faster.

cards.name: Crimson Aristocrat
cards.text: Play: Deal 1 to an ally and grant it +1|+0 and Overwhelm
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Deal 1 to an ally and grant it +1|+0 and <link=keyword.Overwhelm><sprite name=Overwhelm><style=Keyword>Overwhelm</style></link>
cards.flavor: "Ah, you too? To the Reveler's B--" "How am I to tolerate mine?" "Respectfully, my dear, my father would disown me. ...perhaps we should wear matching dresses."

cards.name: Vladimir
cards.text: Play: Deal 1 to any number of allies to deal that much to an enemy.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.PlaySkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Play</style></link>: Deal 1 to any number of allies to deal that much to an enemy.
cards.levelup: You've had 5+ allies survive damage.
cards.flavor:
Vicious. Cold. Cruel. Intriguing. Perceptive. Charming.
Irresistible...

cards.name: Vladimir
cards.text:
Play: Deal 1 to any number of allies to deal that much to an enemy.
Attack: For each attacking ally on my right, deal 1 to it and drain 1 from the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml:
<link=keyword.PlaySkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Play</style></link>: Deal 1 to any number of allies to deal that much to an enemy.
<link=keyword.AttackSkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Attack</style></link>: For each attacking ally on my right, deal 1 to it and <link=keyword.Drain><style=Keyword>drain</style></link> 1 from the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: "Do you find my little fête banal, darling? Then let me give you a real show."

cards.name: Crimson Pact
cards.text: Deal 1 to any number of allies to deal that much to an enemy.
cards.textHtml: Deal 1 to any number of allies to deal that much to an enemy.
cards.flavor: "Delicious." - Vladimir

cards.name: Vladimir's Transfusion
cards.text:
Deal 1 to an ally and give another ally +2|+2 this round.

cards.textHtml:
Deal 1 to an ally and give another ally +2|+2 this round.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Vladimir</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "It's give and take, my dear. You give, and I take." - Vladimir

cards.name: Crimson Pact
cards.text: For each attacking ally on Vladimir's right, deal 1 to it and drain 1 from the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml: For each attacking ally on <link=card.vlad><style=AssociatedCard>Vladimir</style></link>'s right, deal 1 to it and <link=keyword.Drain><style=Keyword>drain</style></link> 1 from the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: "Delicious." - Vladimir

cards.name: Arena Battlecaster
cards.text: Attack: Give other attacking allies +1|+0 this round.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Give other attacking allies +1|+0 this round.
cards.flavor: He roared with glee. For a moment, the heart of the arena pulsed in time with his and the excitement of the assembled masses was clutched in his triumphant hand.

cards.name: Basilisk Rider
cards.text: Allegiance: Grant me +1|+1 and Overwhelm.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Allegiance><style=Vocab>Allegiance</style></link>: Grant me +1|+1 and <link=keyword.Overwhelm><sprite name=Overwhelm><style=Keyword>Overwhelm</style></link>.
cards.flavor: This particular unit does use horses, just not for riding. The beasts find them delicious.

cards.name: Crowd Favorite
cards.text: When I'm summoned, grant me +1|+1 for each other ally you have.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, grant me +1|+1 for each other ally you have.
cards.flavor: Some reckoners are adored for their charisma. Others, for their swift technique. Vessid possesses neither, but no one turns a rival to splatter with more efficiency.

cards.name: Legion General
cards.text: When I'm summoned, grant me +1|+1 for each unit you've Stunned or Recalled this game.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, grant me +1|+1 for each unit you've <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stunned</style></link> or <link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recalled</style></link> this game. <style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor: All Noxians know the three Principles of Strength, but if a soldier is to rise through the ranks, they must learn to master them.

cards.name: Whirling Death
cards.text: A battling ally strikes a battling enemy.
cards.textHtml: A battling ally <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strikes</style></link> a battling enemy.
cards.flavor: "I have the best job." - Draven

cards.name: Legion Rearguard
cards.flavor: In Noxus, where soldiers are revered for their audacity on the battlefield, rearguard duty is nothing short of a punishment.

cards.name: Decisive Maneuver
cards.text: Stun an enemy. Give all allies +2|+0 this round.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> an enemy. Give all allies +2|+0 this round.
cards.flavor: "Any fool can throw overwhelming force at the enemy. It takes vision to conceal that force until the decisive moment." - Swain

cards.name: Shiraza the Blade
cards.text: I deal double damage to the Nexus.
cards.textHtml: I deal double damage to the Nexus.
cards.flavor: "He said what?! That man has bricks for brains. Can't fault those shoulders, though..."

cards.name: Precious Pet
cards.flavor: She loves them all. She just loves this one more.

cards.name: Trifarian Hopeful
cards.text: When I'm summoned, grant me +2|+0 if you have another Noxus ally.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, grant me +2|+0 if you have another Noxus ally.
cards.flavor: "You'll earn the title when your axe is blunt with battle and your boots're sopped with blood." - Legion Veteran

cards.name: Legion Drummer
cards.text: Support: Give my supported ally Quick Attack this round.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Support><style=Keyword>Support</style></link>: Give my supported ally <link=keyword.Quick Strike><sprite name=QuickStrike><style=Keyword>Quick Attack</style></link> this round.
cards.flavor: The Legion spread the empire's reach with every beat of her drum. Nothing could stop them. Nothing did.

cards.name: Might
cards.text: Give an ally +3|+0 and Overwhelm this round.
cards.textHtml: Give an ally +3|+0 and <link=keyword.Overwhelm><sprite name=Overwhelm><style=Keyword>Overwhelm</style></link> this round.
cards.flavor: "When I say subtlety is overrated, that doesn't mean it isn't good. It's just overrated." - Darius

cards.name: Draven
cards.text: When I'm summoned or strike: Create a Spinning Axe in hand.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned or <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strike</style></link>: Create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Spinning Axe</style></link> in hand.
cards.levelup: I've struck with 2+ total Spinning Axes.
cards.flavor: "You want an autograph? Get in line, pal."

cards.name: Spinning Axe
cards.text:
To play, discard 1.
Give an ally +1|+0 this round.
cards.textHtml:
To play, discard 1.
Give an ally +1|+0 this round.
cards.flavor: "Yeah, his brother'd win one-on-one, but you see those axes spiraling... it's art, it is. Art." - Arena regular

cards.name: Draven's Whirling Death
cards.text:
A battling ally strikes a battling enemy.
Create a Draven in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
A battling ally <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strikes</style></link> a battling enemy.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Draven</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "I have the best job." - Draven

cards.name: Draven
cards.text: When I'm summoned or strike: Create 2 Spinning Axes in hand.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned or <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strike</style></link>: Create 2 <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Spinning Axes</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: "WHAT'S MY NAME?"

cards.name: Legion Marauder
cards.text: Attack: Grant allied Legion Marauders everywhere +1|+1.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Grant allied Legion Marauders <link=vocab.Everywhere><style=Vocab>everywhere</style></link> +1|+1.
cards.flavor: The Trifarian Legion is trailed by opportunistic brigands who prey on the weak and injured in its wake.

cards.name: Noxian Guillotine
cards.text: Kill a damaged unit to create a Fleeting Noxian Guillotine in hand.
cards.textHtml: Kill a damaged unit to create a <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> <link=card.me><style=AssociatedCard>Noxian Guillotine</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: To Darius, mercy is a deft blow.

cards.name: Arachnoid Host
cards.text: When I'm summoned, grant other Spider allies +2|+0.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, grant other Spider allies +2|+0.
cards.flavor: A single glance and you're hers. A single bite and you're theirs.

cards.name: Kato The Arm
cards.text: Support: Give my supported ally +3|+0 and Overwhelm this round.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Support><style=Keyword>Support</style></link>: Give my supported ally +3|+0 and <link=keyword.Overwhelm><sprite name=Overwhelm><style=Keyword>Overwhelm</style></link> this round.
cards.flavor: "Shiraza is a great girlfriend--I mean friend--and we are in no way dating. But if we were, I would like her to know that I wish her a happy anniversary. Thank you, no more questions."

cards.name: Brothers' Bond
cards.text: Grant 2 allies +2|+0.
cards.textHtml: Grant 2 allies +2|+0.
cards.flavor: "Bonds forged in war are just as strong as those of kinship. Indeed, blood is shared in both." - Legion Veteran

cards.name: Reckless Trifarian
cards.flavor: "Recklessness is a fault. Tempered by the Legion, it becomes a tool." - Swain

cards.name: Elixir of Wrath
cards.text: Give an ally +3|+0 this round.
cards.textHtml: Give an ally +3|+0 this round.
cards.flavor:
"When the open hand is declined, there's always the fist."
- Noxian axiom

cards.name: Legion Veteran
cards.text: When another ally survives damage, grant it +1|+0.
cards.textHtml: When another ally survives damage, grant it +1|+0.
cards.flavor: He returned from the war on the brink of death, restored only by his husband's touch and the apothecary's balms. Noxus spared no expense to ensure his expert counsel, long after his fighting years.

cards.name: Crimson Disciple
cards.text: When I survive damage, deal 1 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml: When I survive damage, deal 1 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: "Edvin! There you are, handsome. I was just thinking of you!" "Each of us can go, now…" "Escort me. I'll make it fun." "Or nothing at all?"

cards.name: Trifarian Gloryseeker
cards.flavor: Earning a place in the Trifarian Legion is good enough for most, but not all.

cards.name: Crimson Awakener
cards.text: When I'm summoned, deal 1 to all other allies.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, deal 1 to all other allies.
cards.flavor: "Even if I said 'no', you'd drag me along. So... sure."

cards.name: Trifarian Assessor
cards.text: When I'm summoned, draw 1 for each 5+ Power ally you have.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, draw 1 for each 5+ Power ally you have.
cards.flavor: "It takes a ruthlessly discerning eye to select those worthy enough to become part of the Trifarian Legion, but she can sort the wolves from the sheep a mile away." - Legion General

cards.name: Affectionate Poro
cards.flavor: "Noxus has no room for... for weakn--Will someone get this DAMNED THING OFF ME?!" - Darius

cards.name: Draven's Biggest Fan
cards.text: When I'm summoned, move Draven to the top of your deck if you don't have him in hand or in play.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, move <link=card.dravenRef><style=AssociatedCard>Draven</style></link> to the top of your deck if you don't have him in hand or in play.
cards.flavor: "You want an autograph? Get... Get in line, pal!"

cards.name: Minotaur Reckoner
cards.text: Round Start: Stun the weakest enemy.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> the <link=keyword.Weakest><style=Keyword>weakest</style></link> enemy.
cards.flavor: "I don't care who wronged you or what they did. You need me to make it right in the pit, you pay up front. There's no discount for sad stories."

cards.name: Legion Grenadier
cards.text: Last Breath: Deal 1 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>Last Breath</style></link>: Deal 1 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: Every Noxian is taught that a life spent in service to the empire is well spent, but few spend their lives as spectacularly as the Legion's grenadiers.

cards.name: Darius
cards.levelup: I see the enemy Nexus has half of its starting Health or less.
cards.flavor: "An iron will and a titan's strength. There is no finer general to lead the Trifarian Legion." - Swain

cards.name: Darius' Decimate
cards.text:
Deal 4 to the enemy Nexus.
Create a Darius in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
Deal 4 to the enemy Nexus.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Darius</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "Sometimes, it takes tactical genius to break a fortress. Sometimes, you just have to hit it harder." - Darius

cards.name: Darius
cards.flavor: "Stand in our way and I'll cut you down myself!"

cards.name: Vision
cards.text: When played or discarded, grant allies +1|+0.
cards.textHtml: When played or discarded, grant allies +1|+0.
cards.flavor: "Those who cannot see the future have no place in it." - Jericho Swain

cards.name: Legion Saboteur
cards.text: Attack: Deal 1 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.AttackSkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Attack</style></link>: Deal 1 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: "Our Shieldbreakers can split a man in two. But the Legion has other talents at its disposal when it requires a more... discreet touch." - Swain

cards.name: Sabotage
cards.text: Deal 1 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml: Deal 1 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: "Boom." - Legion Saboteur

cards.name: Trifarian Shieldbreaker
cards.flavor: "I don't have the patience for a siege. Send the Shieldbreakers." - Darius

cards.name: Katarina
cards.text: When I'm summoned, create a Fleeting Blade's Edge in hand.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, create a <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Blade's Edge</style></link> in hand.
cards.levelup: I've struck once. When I level up, Recall me.
cards.flavor: "Nothing like a little Demacian target practice to sharpen the senses..."

cards.name: Katarina's Death Lotus
cards.text:
Deal 1 to ALL battling units.
Create a Katarina in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
Deal 1 to ALL battling units.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Katarina</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "Dance with me!" - Katarina

cards.name: Katarina
cards.text:
When I'm summoned, Rally and create a Fleeting Blade's Edge in hand. It costs 0.
Strike: Recall me.
cards.textHtml:
When I'm summoned, <link=vocab.Rally><style=Vocab>Rally</style></link> and create a <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Blade's Edge</style></link> in hand. It costs 0.
<link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>Strike</style></link>: <link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recall</style></link> me.
cards.flavor: "No sir! Just a flash of red. Next thing I know, I look up and it... it was like a slaughterhouse in there." - Demacian border guard

cards.name: Blade's Edge
cards.text: Deal 1 to anything.
cards.textHtml: Deal 1 to anything.
cards.flavor: "In the right hands, a blade can cut through anything... and I do mean anything." - Katarina

cards.name: Battering Ram
cards.text: Attack: Grant me +4|+0.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Grant me +4|+0.
cards.flavor:
"Sir, they're refusing to open their gates. They've demanded to speak with Darius, but he's two days' ride away. Should we send riders?"
"Oh, that won't be necessary."

cards.name: Savage Reckoner
cards.flavor: "Next up, CLAWS! Last time was a BLOODY takedown versus the Psycho Five... now the Psycho Three. Allllright! Takin' bets on today's victim! Four to one!" - Karl, Arena Bookie

cards.name: Arachnoid Sentry
cards.text: Play: Stun an enemy.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.PlaySkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Play</style></link>: <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> an enemy.
cards.flavor: "Oh, how she captivates me! Her endless legs, voice of paralyzing sweetness, and eyes red as the rose. To think, she chose to dine with me tonight!" - Hapless Aristocrat

cards.name: Paralyzing Bite
cards.text: Stun an enemy.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> an enemy.
cards.flavor: It was not the kiss he had in mind.

cards.name: Transfusion
cards.text: Deal 1 to an ally to give another ally +2|+2 this round.
cards.textHtml: Deal 1 to an ally to give another ally +2|+2 this round.
cards.flavor: "It's give and take, my dear. You give, and I take." - Vladimir

cards.name: Crimson Curator
cards.text: When I survive damage, create a random Crimson unit in hand.
cards.textHtml: When I survive damage, create a random Crimson unit in hand.
cards.flavor: "Beloved companions!" "Were you? Well I received an invitation." "--Reveler's Ball! Yes!" "Then we must! I shall present my family." "Starters before dessert, my dear. And you, Kye? Will you attend?"

cards.name: Guile
cards.text: Stun an enemy.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> an enemy.
cards.flavor: "Allow your enemies enough rope to hang themselves and you'll save yourself the effort." - LeBlanc

cards.name: Death Lotus
cards.text: Deal 1 to ALL battling units.
cards.textHtml: Deal 1 to ALL battling units.
cards.flavor: "Dance with me!" - Katarina

cards.name: Captain Farron
cards.text: When I'm summoned, create 2 Decimates in hand.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, create 2 <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Decimates</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: Deep in Zaun's Sump, young Benn Farron was labeled a menace. Unstable. Unacceptable. In the ranks of Noxus he was embraced. Awarded. Unstoppable.

cards.name: Blood for Blood
cards.text: Deal 1 to an allied follower. If it survives, create a copy of it in hand.
cards.textHtml: Deal 1 to an allied follower. If it survives, create a copy of it in hand.
cards.flavor: Nothing is messier than a hemomancer's first lesson.

cards.name: Reckoning
cards.text: If you have a 5+ Power ally, kill ALL units with 4 or less Power.
cards.textHtml: If you have a 5+ Power ally, kill ALL units with 4 or less Power.
cards.flavor: "WHO'S READY TO REEEEEECKONNNNNN?!" - Arena Battlecaster

cards.name: Intimidating Roar
cards.text: Stun all enemies with 4 or less Power.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> all enemies with 4 or less Power.
cards.flavor: “He’s taking a deep breath - we might get a - yes, there we have it, folks! That’s Thunder’s famous war cry! We’re all shaking in our boots out here, Thuuuunder!” - Arena Battlecaster

cards.name: House Spider
cards.text: When I'm summoned, summon a Spiderling.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Spiderling</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "My spiders love company. Shame that company never feels the same." - Elise

cards.name: Shunpo
cards.text: Deal 2 to an enemy, then Rally.
cards.textHtml: Deal 2 to an enemy, then <link=vocab.Rally><style=Vocab>Rally</style></link>.
cards.flavor: By the time you've seen the blade, it's far too late.

cards.name: Rummage
cards.text: To play, discard up to 2 cards. Draw 1 for each card you discarded.
cards.textHtml: To play, discard up to 2 cards. Draw 1 for each card you discarded.
cards.flavor: "Oooooh, boy--FIVE ENFORCERS AND A GOLEM? Waitaminute! I have just the thing! Soooooomewhere..." - Jinx

cards.name: Back Alley Barkeep
cards.text: When I'm summoned, create in hand a random card for each Back Alley Barkeep you've summoned this game.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, create in hand a random card for each <link=card.me><style=AssociatedCard>Back Alley Barkeep</style></link> you've summoned this game. <style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor: "Yeah mate, it's got a slight kick the same way the Sump's got a slight smell. Bucket's by the songspinner."

cards.name: Assembly Bot
cards.text: When you play a spell, grant me +1|+1.
cards.textHtml: When you play a spell, grant me +1|+1.
cards.flavor: "Any simpleton can build a machine, but it takes extraordinary acumen to infuse a mechanized mind with TRUE progress! Soon enough those damned bureaucrats will come crawling back..." - Klas Henwick

cards.name: Trueshot Barrage
cards.text: Deal 3 to an enemy or the enemy Nexus, 2 to another, and 1 to another.
cards.textHtml: Deal 3 to an enemy or the enemy Nexus, 2 to another, and 1 to another.
cards.flavor: "When you've got talent, there's no such thing as a lucky shot." - Ezreal

cards.name: Hextech Transmogulator
cards.text: Transform a follower into an exact copy of another follower.
cards.textHtml: Transform a follower into an exact copy of another follower.
cards.flavor:
"YOU KEPT SAYING YOU WANTED TO LOSE WEIGHT."
"SO YOU TURNED ME INTO A YORDLE?!"
"YOU LOST WEIGHT!"
"...I'M ALSO A YORDLE!"

cards.name: Plaza Guardian
cards.text: I cost 1 less for each spell you've played this game.
cards.textHtml: I cost 1 less for each spell you've played this game.
cards.flavor: You have twenty seconds to comply.

cards.name: Parade Electrorig
cards.text: Support: Create 4 copies of the supported ally in your deck.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Support><style=Keyword>Support</style></link>: Create 4 copies of the supported ally in your deck.
cards.flavor: The boom of the cannons drew crowds toward the plaza, eager to see the show. It would take them weeks to wash the last of the confetti from their hair.

cards.name: Teemo
cards.text: Nexus Strike: Plant 5 Poison Puffcaps on random cards in the enemy deck.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.NexusStrike><style=Vocab>Nexus Strike</style></link>: Plant 5 <link=card.shuffle><style=AssociatedCard>Poison Puffcaps</style></link> on random cards in the enemy deck.
cards.levelup: You've planted 15+ Poison Puffcaps.
cards.flavor: "Bandle Scout Rule 154: Never fear the unknown! Rule 276: Denizens of the woodlands are our friends! Rule 354: If it's fuzzy, it might be safe to pet but certainly isn't safe to eat! Rule 417..."

cards.name: Teemo's Mushroom Cloud
cards.text:
Plant 5 Poison Puffcaps in the enemy deck.
Create a Teemo in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
Plant 5 <link=card.shuffle><style=AssociatedCard>Poison Puffcaps</style></link> in the enemy deck.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Teemo</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: First, the soft thump as the puffcap pops. Next, searing, debilitating pain. Finally, the distant sound of giggles...

cards.name: Teemo
cards.text: Nexus Strike: Double the Poison Puffcaps in the enemy deck (plants 5 minimum).
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.NexusStrike><style=Vocab>Nexus Strike</style></link>: Double the <link=card.shuffle><style=AssociatedCard>Poison Puffcaps</style></link> in the enemy deck (plants 5 minimum).
cards.flavor: "... make sure you're out of the blast zone!"

cards.name: Amateur Aeronaut
cards.flavor: "Personal flying machines? A pipe dream! I just had my apprentice throw the latest prototype out, in fact. Now, where is he?" - Piltovan engineer

cards.name: Mushroom Cloud
cards.text: Plant 5 Poison Puffcaps in the enemy deck.
cards.textHtml: Plant 5 <link=card.shuffle><style=AssociatedCard>Poison Puffcaps</style></link> in the enemy deck.
cards.flavor: First is the soft thump as the puffcap pops. Next, searing, debilitating pain. Finally, the distant sound of giggles...

cards.name: Flame Chompers!
cards.text: When I'm discarded, summon me.
cards.textHtml: When I'm discarded, summon me.
cards.flavor: "GET 'EM, CHOMPIES!" - Jinx

cards.name: Augmented Experimenter
cards.text: Play: Discard your hand. Draw 3. Deal 3 to an enemy.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.PlaySkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Play</style></link>: Discard your hand. Draw 3. Deal 3 to an enemy.
cards.flavor: His dreams cost him his hands, yet he persisted. Nothing would stand in his way.

cards.name: Reckless Research
cards.text: Discard your hand. Draw 3. Deal 3 to an enemy.
cards.textHtml: Discard your hand. Draw 3. Deal 3 to an enemy.
cards.flavor: Progress, whatever the price.

cards.name: Unlicensed Innovation
cards.text: Summon an Illegal Contraption.
cards.textHtml: Summon an <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Illegal Contraption</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "Their mishaps come in countless flavors: tremors from distant explosions, putrid fumes from the fissures. Soon enough, one of those fools will tear our city down." - Piltovan philanthropist

cards.name: Illegal Contraption
cards.flavor: "Absolutely NOT regulation hardware." - Safety Inspections Officer, Piltovan Bureau of Safety Inspections

cards.name: T-Hex
cards.flavor:
"IT'S FINALLY COMPLETE! SIX-HUNDRED AND FIFTY-TWO FEET OF ROTARY-TEMPERED, HEX-PLATED, QUADRANIUM-CELL-POWERED STOMPING!!! My finest work, if I daresaysomyself."
- Heimerdinger's Lab Notes, Vol. 8

cards.name: Flash of Brilliance
cards.text:
Create in hand a random 6+ cost spell from your regions.
Refill your spell mana.
cards.textHtml:
Create in hand a random 6+ cost spell from your regions.
Refill your spell mana.
cards.flavor: It only takes one epiphany to launch a legacy.

cards.name: Used Cask Salesman
cards.text: When I'm summoned, summon 2 Caustic Casks.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, summon 2 <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Caustic Casks</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "Ziel sent ya? I told him, what's his is his. Can't refund somethin' I ain't ever seen before, can I? But, as it happens, I just received a batch of new casks I could be persuaded to part with..."

cards.name: Academy Prodigy
cards.flavor: How does she aim? That's an excellent question.

cards.name: Eager Apprentice
cards.text: When I'm summoned, refill 2 spell mana.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, refill 2 spell mana.
cards.flavor: Not everyone is cut out to further progress in Piltover immediately. Some need a little guidance--those who look at invention through the wrong lens, for instance.

cards.name: Daring Poro
cards.flavor: Her first launch was pure accident: she slipped inside a Progress Day cannon while preening herself. Now she's the toast of Piltover, arcing across the sky to the adoring gasps of the crowds below.

cards.name: Midenstokke Henchmen
cards.text: Nexus Strike: Summon an exact copy of me.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.NexusStrike><style=Vocab>Nexus Strike</style></link>: Summon an exact copy of me.
cards.flavor:
"Mr. Berz, we found you asleep INSIDE the vault, covered in golden cogs and clutching the safe's broken door."
"Weren't me. Jus' some fella wot look like me."
"You're still holding the door."
"Prove it."

cards.name: Poison Puffcap
cards.text: Deal 1 to your Nexus.
cards.textHtml: Deal 1 to your Nexus.
cards.flavor:
"Pop goes the puffcap, pop goes the puffcap,
Ow ow ow, ow ow ow!
Pop goes the puffcap, pop goes the puffcap,
Down we go, down we go!"
- Zaunite nursery rhyme

cards.name: Professor von Yipp
cards.text: When you summon a 1 cost ally, grant it +2|+2.
cards.textHtml: When you summon a 1 cost ally, grant it +2|+2.
cards.flavor: "Today I present to the committee my newest invention, as demonstrated by my esteemed colleague..."

cards.name: Unstable Voltician
cards.text: Grant me +4|+0 and Quick Attack once you've played a 6+ cost spell this game.
cards.textHtml: Grant me +4|+0 and <link=keyword.Quick Strike><sprite name=QuickStrike><style=Keyword>Quick Attack</style></link> once you've played a 6+ cost spell this game.
cards.flavor: Name: Klas Henwick, Age: 51, License Type: Class 2 Conditional, Status: Revoked, Comments: Ignored repeated warnings to reduce output following lab explosion (Case 13X764NM). DO NOT PERMIT ENTRY.

cards.name: Puffcap Peddler
cards.text: When you play a spell, plant 3 Poison Puffcaps in the enemy deck.
cards.textHtml: When you play a spell, plant 3 <link=card.shuffle><style=AssociatedCard>Poison Puffcaps</style></link> in the enemy deck.
cards.flavor:
"These any good?"
"Of course! They're all top notch! Spoke to them myself!"
"Okay hand em--wait what?"
"Mmhmm! Getting married, this one!"
"How many have you had...?"
"--to a barnacle!"

cards.name: Sumpworks Map
cards.text: Grant an ally Elusive.
cards.textHtml: Grant an ally <link=keyword.Elusive><sprite name=Elusive><style=Keyword>Elusive</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "Pilties always think they know everything, but their maps only show the places we told 'em about! Nothing like local knowledge. Which you can have... for a price." - Ajuna Lem, Sumpsnipe Scavenger

cards.name: Thermogenic Beam
cards.text:
To play, spend all your mana.
Deal that much to a unit.
cards.textHtml:
To play, spend all your mana.
<style=Variable>Deal that much to a unit.</style>
cards.flavor: "We've exhausted both our time and funds, and though the beam works, we haven't been able to regulate its energy consumption." - Zaunite experimenter

cards.name: Jury-Rig
cards.text: When played or discarded, summon a Scrap Scuttler.
cards.textHtml: When played or discarded, summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Scrap Scuttler</style></link>.
cards.flavor: With a handful of scrap and mere moments left, the young inventor recalled an unusual source of inspiration: a creature she once saw scuttling along the rivers of a distant jungle.

cards.name: Eminent Benefactor
cards.text: Play: Manifest an Epic card from your regions.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: <link=vocab.Manifest><style=Vocab>Manifest</style></link> an Epic card from your regions.
cards.flavor: "I was an angry man, then, and broke my competitors as I accrued money and fame. I now direct my fortune toward altruism, and hope that my penitent winter will absolve me of my misdeeds."

cards.name: Shady Character
cards.text: Play: Pick a follower. Transform me into an exact copy of it.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.PlaySkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Play</style></link>: Pick a follower. Transform me into an exact copy of it.
cards.flavor: "Hello, fellow Chem-Barons!"

cards.name: Impersonate
cards.text: Pick a follower. Transform me into an exact copy of it.
cards.textHtml: Pick a follower. Transform me into an exact copy of it.
cards.flavor: Definitely not a pair of yordles in a suit.

cards.name: Statikk Shock
cards.text:
Deal 1 to an enemy or the enemy Nexus, and 1 to another.
Draw 1.
cards.textHtml:
Deal 1 to an enemy or the enemy Nexus, and 1 to another.
Draw 1.
cards.flavor: "And that's how we discovered arc discharge! Of course, my predecessor had hypothesized such an event, but underestimated the arc's reach. Poor fellow..." - Heimerdinger

cards.name: Scrap Scuttler
cards.flavor: Everyone tries to chase it down. Poor little thing just wants to play in puddles!

cards.name: Purrsuit of Perfection
cards.text: If you've played 20 new cards this game, summon Catastrophe.
cards.textHtml: If you've played <style=Variable>20</style> new cards this game, summon <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Catastrophe</style></link>. <style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor: "In the end, all of us who worked toward von Yipp's vision were deceived. We knew not what we wrought--what terrible power we would unleash." - Piltovan Project engineer

cards.name: Catastrophe
cards.flavor: Your end is MEOW.

cards.name: Sumpsnipe Scavenger
cards.text: Allegiance: Create a Sumpworks Map in hand. It costs 0 this round.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Allegiance><style=Vocab>Allegiance</style></link>: Create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Sumpworks Map</style></link> in hand. It costs 0 this round.
cards.flavor: The Zaunite kids soon started exploring the old mining tunnels and deeper levels of the Lanes. What a world they discovered. What friends they found.

cards.name: Jae Medarda
cards.text: When I'm targeted, draw 1.
cards.textHtml: When I'm targeted, draw 1.
cards.flavor: Heir apparent to Piltover's prestigious Clan Medarda, Jae preferred hunting ancient artifacts over managing the family business... much to his father's chagrin.

cards.name: Ezreal
cards.text: Nexus Strike: Create a Fleeting Mystic Shot in hand.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.NexusStrike><style=Vocab>Nexus Strike</style></link>: Create a <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Mystic Shot</style></link> in hand.
cards.levelup: You've targeted enemies 8+ times.
cards.flavor: "Goggles? Check. Scarf? Check. Awesome gauntlet-with-magical-properties-that-I-totally understand? Check, check, aaaand check!"

cards.name: Ezreal
cards.text:
Nexus Strike: Create a Fleeting Mystic Shot in hand.
When you play a spell, deal 1 to the enemy Nexus. If it targeted an enemy, deal 2 to the enemy Nexus instead.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.NexusStrike><style=Vocab>Nexus Strike</style></link>: Create a <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Mystic Shot</style></link> in hand.
When you play a spell, deal 1 to the enemy Nexus. If it targeted an enemy, deal 2 to the enemy Nexus instead.
cards.flavor: "Impossible is my favorite kind of possible!"

cards.name: Ezreal's Mystic Shot
cards.text:
Deal 2 to anything.
Create an Ezreal in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
Deal 2 to anything.
Create an <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Ezreal</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "I. Never. Miss. But I have been known to fire a warning shot or two..." - Ezreal

cards.name: Sump Dredger
cards.text: Play: Discard a card to draw 1.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Discard a card to draw 1.
cards.flavor: In the Sump, waste is never wasted.

cards.name: Get Excited!
cards.text:
To play, discard 1.
Deal 3 to anything.
cards.textHtml:
To play, discard 1.
Deal 3 to anything.
cards.flavor: "FIRE IN THE CABOODLE!" - Jinx

cards.name: Jinx
cards.levelup: I see your hand is empty.
cards.flavor:
"What'samatter, Fishbones?"
"I'm worried about you, Jinx! Every time you get bored, you..."
"...want to blow something up! Great idea, Fishbones!"

cards.name: Jinx
cards.text:
Round Start: Draw 1.
Each round, the first time I level up or you empty your hand, create a Super Mega Death Rocket! in hand.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Draw 1.
Each round, the first time I level up or you empty your hand, create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Super Mega Death Rocket!</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: "It's all just fun and games until something gets blown up - then it's a PARTY!"

cards.name: Super Mega Death Rocket!
cards.text: Deal 3 to the enemy Nexus and 1 to all enemies.
cards.textHtml: Deal 3 to the enemy Nexus and 1 to all enemies.
cards.flavor: "See ya!" - Jinx

cards.name: Jinx's Get Excited!
cards.text:
To play, discard 1. Deal 3 to anything.
Create a Jinx in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
To play, discard 1. Deal 3 to anything.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Jinx</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "FIRE IN THE CABOODLE!" - Jinx

cards.name: Intrepid Mariner
cards.text: Support: Give my supported ally Elusive this round.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Support><style=Keyword>Support</style></link>: Give my supported ally <link=keyword.Elusive><sprite name=Elusive><style=Keyword>Elusive</style></link> this round.
cards.flavor: For many Piltovans, the great unknown is explored through science and invention, safe within their City of Progress. But a handful embark for the horizon to discover a much greater unknown: the world.

cards.name: Chempunk Pickpocket
cards.text: Nexus Strike: Create in hand an exact copy of a random spell from the enemy deck.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.NexusStrike><style=Vocab>Nexus Strike</style></link>: Create in hand an exact copy of a random spell from the enemy deck.
cards.flavor: Those cast below the City of Progress were expected to turn on each other. But instead they bonded, found their feet as one, and created a new home. It wasn't much, but it was theirs. Zaun.

cards.name: Chempunk Shredder
cards.text: Play: Deal 1 to all enemies.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.PlaySkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Play</style></link>: Deal 1 to all enemies.
cards.flavor: "...his solo quickly plunges through a harmonic minor scale before arpeggiating--yes that's a word--into the bridge's transposition. You likely can't even comprehend his work." - Max Bliff, gatekeeper

cards.name: Face-Melter
cards.text: Deal 1 to all enemies.
cards.textHtml: Deal 1 to all enemies.
cards.flavor: "Let the show begin!" - Chempunk Shredder

cards.name: Zaunite Urchin
cards.text: Play: Discard a card to draw 1.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Discard a card to draw 1.
cards.flavor:
"You'd think the sumprats would look after their own."
"Too busy basking in their self-pity, brother."
"Shame. Ah... have you seen my purse?"

cards.name: Counterfeit Copies
cards.text: Pick a card in hand. Create 4 exact copies of it in your deck.
cards.textHtml: Pick a card in hand. Create 4 exact copies of it in your deck.
cards.flavor: Imitation is the sincerest form of thievery.

cards.name: Caustic Cask
cards.text: Last Breath: Deal 1 to EACH Nexus.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>Last Breath</style></link>: Deal 1 to EACH Nexus.
cards.flavor: “I’d tell ya to wear a suit, but it gets muggy as a whump’s armpit down there. Gloves though, eh? An’ if you get that gunk on ya’, pray it don’t touch nothin’ important.” - Ziel, Zaunite foreman

cards.name: Corina Veraza
cards.text: Play: Obliterate the top 5 cards of your deck to deal 1 to all enemies and the enemy Nexus for each spell obliterated.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.PlaySkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Play</style></link>: <link=vocab.Obliterate><style=Vocab>Obliterate</style></link> the top 5 cards of your deck to deal 1 to all enemies and the enemy Nexus for each spell obliterated.
cards.flavor: "The narrow-minded Piltovans know only gears and metal, and cannot appreciate the delicate art in every stem, every petal, every cell of my cultivair. I will craft them an undeservedly graceful doom."

cards.name: Magnum Opus
cards.text: Obliterate the top 5 cards of your deck to deal 1 to all enemies and the enemy Nexus for each spell obliterated.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Obliterate><style=Vocab>Obliterate</style></link> the top 5 cards of your deck to deal 1 to all enemies and the enemy Nexus for each spell obliterated.
cards.flavor: "I told them that every achievement had its cost. I didn't tell them who would pay it." - Corina Veraza
