cards.name: Progress Day!
cards.text: Draw 3, then reduce those cards' costs by 1.
cards.textHtml: Draw 3, then reduce those cards' costs by 1.
cards.flavor:
PROGRESS DAY!
Celebrate at the PLAZA OF THE SUN GATES!
See HEXTECH WONDERS!
Gasp at the DARING PORO!
Hear the MAN OF TOMORROW speak on the STATE OF TODAY!
FREE entry! 
Piltovan children welcome!

cards.name: Rising Spell Force
cards.text: Give an ally +4|+0 and Quick Attack this round.
cards.textHtml: Give an ally +4|+0 and <link=keyword.Quick Strike><sprite name=QuickStrike><style=Keyword>Quick Attack</style></link> this round.
cards.flavor: "It kinda tickles when it starts to glow. That's normal... right?" - Ezreal

cards.name: Funsmith
cards.text: All of your spells and Skills deal 1 extra damage.
cards.textHtml: All of your spells and <link=keyword.Skill><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Skills</style></link> deal 1 extra damage.
cards.flavor: "You want extra boom, do ya? Well, you've come to the right place!"

cards.name: Mystic Shot
cards.text: Deal 2 to anything.
cards.textHtml: Deal 2 to anything.
cards.flavor: "I. Never. Miss. But I have been known to fire a warning shot or two..." - Ezreal

cards.name: Clump of Whumps
cards.text: When I'm summoned, create a Mushroom Cloud in hand.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Mushroom Cloud</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: "Mhm, that's right! Clumps of 'em, sneakin' around! They SEEM crazy, but you just don't see. Not like me! They've big plans! Big plans. Puffcaps. Cheese... sorbet. Where was I?" - Puffcap Peddler

cards.name: Boomcrew Rookie
cards.text: Attack: Deal 2 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.AttackSkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Attack</style></link>: Deal 2 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor:
"You sure about this?"
"Nope."
"You were supposed to say 'yes'."
"You weren't supposed to ask."

cards.name: Undermine
cards.text: Deal 2 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml: Deal 2 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: "Time to go!" - Boomcrew Rookie

cards.name: Astute Academic
cards.text: When you draw a card, give me +1|+0 this round.
cards.textHtml: When you draw a card, give me +1|+0 this round.
cards.flavor: Imagination is the spark of great invention. Yet, it is research that makes the spark a conflagration.

cards.name: Heimerdinger
cards.text: When you play a spell, create a Fleeting Turret in hand with equal cost. It costs 0.
cards.textHtml: When you play a spell, create a <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> Turret in hand with equal cost. It costs 0.
cards.levelup: I've seen you summon 12+ Power of Tech allies.
cards.flavor: "Mad scientist? Pft! I'm clearly a very-stable-if-slightly-disorganized-and-eclectic scientist, thank you very much!"

cards.name: Mk0: Windup Shredder
cards.flavor:
"TODAY I EMBARK UPON A NEW SCIENTIFIC ADVENTURE: AUTOMATONS! As the saying goes, it takes a great mind to create great things! Who said that, you ask? Why, ME!"
- Heimerdinger's Lab Notes, Preface

cards.name: Mk5: Rocket Blaster
cards.flavor:
"After a few production issues--propulsion and guidance, predominantly--I am ready to unveil my PROPELLED COMBUSTIBLES! ...must work on a better name."
- Heimerdinger's Lab Notes, Vol. 5

cards.name: Heimerdinger's Progress Day!
cards.text:
Draw 3, then reduce those cards' costs by 1.
Create a Heimerdinger in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
Draw 3, then reduce those cards' costs by 1.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Heimerdinger</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor:
PROGRESS DAY!
Celebrate at the PLAZA OF THE SUN GATES!
See HEXTECH WONDERS!
Gasp at the DARING PORO!
Hear the MAN OF TOMORROW speak on the STATE OF TODAY!
FREE entry! 
Piltovan children welcome!

cards.name: Mk1: Wrenchbot
cards.flavor:
"It occurred to me earlier that--with only two hands--I can only maximally operate two wrenches! My solution: MORE HANDS. Oho! I jest. A WRENCHBOT!"
- Heimerdinger's Lab Notes, Vol. 1

cards.name: Mk7: Armored Stomper
cards.flavor:
"I dreamt of a great mechanical beast, obeying my every command! I MUST realize this vision. First, stability tests, then ordnance and armor evaluation..."
- Heimerdinger's Lab Notes, Vol. 7

cards.name: Mk6: Floor-B-Gone
cards.flavor:
"I seem to have misplaced my latest work. And my mezzanine. I'm concerned about my bot, but the shrieking from the ceramics research laboratory gives me hope!"
- Heimerdinger's Lab Notes, Vol. 6

cards.name: Mk2: Evolution Turret
cards.flavor:
"Safety precautions for the laboratory! Recent postings have mentioned young Jayce's workshop was raided by thieves. Ha--local intruders, beware!"
- Heimerdinger's Lab Notes, Vol. 2

cards.name: Mk3: Apex Turret
cards.flavor:
"Ah, the sweet smell of science! I have successfully upgraded my turrets! I must say... this model's appearance sends hypothermic waves through my vertebrae! Brr!"
- Heimerdinger's Lab Notes, Vol. 3

cards.name: Mk4: Stormlobber
cards.flavor:
"PROGRESS CONTINUES! I have finally found a way to combine the raw power of hexenergy with my ball tosser! I present, the STORMLOBBER! Now to sleep."
- Heimerdinger's Lab Notes, Vol. 4

cards.name: Heimerdinger
cards.text: When you play a spell, create a Fleeting Turret in hand with equal cost. Grant it +1|+1 and it costs 0.
cards.textHtml: When you play a spell, create a <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> Turret in hand with equal cost. Grant it +1|+1 and it costs 0.
cards.flavor: "PROGRESSSSS!"

cards.name: Scrapdash Assembly
cards.text: Summon 2 Scrap Scuttlers.
cards.textHtml: Summon 2 <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Scrap Scuttlers</style></link>.
cards.flavor: Two gentle creatures, once separated by an impassable lane of land, were finally brought together in the tepid waters of the Sump.

cards.name: Chump Whump
cards.text: When I'm summoned, create 2 Mushroom Clouds in hand.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, create 2 <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Mushroom Clouds</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: "Seen a big 'un, mmhmm! She's heavy as a horse and crafty as a krug. Gotta keep yer eye on her, I tells ya. That ol’ tomato’s the queen of the clump for a reason!" - Puffcap Peddler

cards.name: Golden Crushbot
cards.flavor: KILL. CRUSH. DESTROY. REPEAT.

cards.name: Accelerated Purrsuit
cards.text: If you've played 15 new cards this game, summon Catastrophe.
cards.textHtml: If you've played <style=Variable>15</style> new cards this game, summon <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Catastrophe</style></link>. <style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor: "In the end, all of us who worked toward von Yipp's vision were deceived. We knew not what we wrought--what terrible power we would unleash." - Piltovan project engineer

cards.name: Vengeance
cards.text: Kill a unit.
cards.textHtml: Kill a unit.
cards.flavor: The betrayed invoke Kalista on their dying breath, hoping her spear brings them vengeance.

cards.name: Spiderling
cards.flavor: "What are you afraid of? It's just ONE little spider." - Lord Sassen, Hapless Aristocrat

cards.name: The Harrowing
cards.text: Revive the 6 strongest allies that died this game and grant them Ephemeral.
cards.textHtml: Revive the 6 <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> allies that died this game and grant them <link=keyword.Ephemeral><sprite name=Ephemeral><style=Keyword>Ephemeral</style></link>.
cards.flavor: On certain nights, a tide of hungry spirits swells the Black Mist. It carries them across the seas to prey on the living, and feed the growing darkness with foul new unlife.

cards.name: Darkwater Scourge
cards.flavor: Some fleeing the Ruination tried diving beneath the waves, believing the corruption wouldn't seep into the depths. They were wrong.

cards.name: Scuttlegeist
cards.text: I cost 1 less for each ally that died this game.
cards.textHtml: I cost 1 less for each ally that died this game.
cards.flavor: Once a beast of burden for a kingdom long forgotten, this monster now scavenges across forgotten battlefields, adding scrap to its shell, and the souls of the dead to its core.

cards.name: Possession
cards.text: Steal an enemy follower this round. (Can't play if you have 6 allies or landmarks already.)
cards.textHtml: Steal an enemy follower this round. (Can't play if you have 6 allies or landmarks already.)
cards.flavor: He woke to find his hands glistening red and the camp unusually quiet.

cards.name: Haunted Relic
cards.text: Summon 3 Unleashed Spirits.
cards.textHtml: Summon 3 <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Unleashed Spirits</style></link>.
cards.flavor: These ancient artifacts are treasured both by the living hungry to claim them, and the dead desperate to retain them.

cards.name: Unleashed Spirit
cards.flavor: ...each spirit another victim of the relic's allure. They seethe in silence as they await the arrival of the next greedy fool.

cards.name: Stirred Spirits
cards.text: Support: Grant my supported ally +2|+0 and Ephemeral.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Support><style=Keyword>Support</style></link>: Grant my supported ally +2|+0 and <link=keyword.Ephemeral><sprite name=Ephemeral><style=Keyword>Ephemeral</style></link>.
cards.flavor: Some look at the Ruination and only see the destruction and misery. Others see the glass half full.

cards.name: Onslaught of Shadows
cards.text: Summon 2 Spectral Riders.
cards.textHtml: Summon 2 <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Spectral Riders</style></link>.
cards.flavor: They live now as they died then: loyal 'til the very end.

cards.name: Ravenous Butcher
cards.text: To play me, kill an ally.
cards.textHtml: To play me, kill an ally.
cards.flavor: You are what you eat.

cards.name: Oblivious Islander
cards.text: Play: Grant an ally in hand Ephemeral and reduce its cost by 1.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Grant an ally in hand <link=keyword.Ephemeral><sprite name=Ephemeral><style=Keyword>Ephemeral</style></link> and reduce its cost by 1.
cards.flavor: Oh, the poor lad...

cards.name: Mistwraith
cards.text: When I'm summoned, grant other allied Mistwraiths everywhere +1|+0.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, grant other allied <link=card.mist><style=AssociatedCard>Mistwraiths</style></link> <link=vocab.Everywhere><style=Vocab>everywhere</style></link> +1|+0.
cards.flavor: These specters of the Isles shed their identities long ago to become amalgamations of pure, unappeasable hunger.

cards.name: The Ruination
cards.text: Kill ALL units.
cards.textHtml: Kill ALL units.
cards.flavor: To think something so pure as love could cause something so cruel and inescapable.

cards.name: Wraithcaller
cards.text: Allegiance: Summon a Mistwraith.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Allegiance><style=Vocab>Allegiance</style></link>: Summon a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Mistwraith</style></link>.
cards.flavor: She appears without a sound. The terrors that follow her are far less subtle.

cards.name: Scribe of Sorrows
cards.text: When I'm summoned, create a copy in hand of an ally that died this game.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, create a copy in hand of an ally that died this game.
cards.flavor: "Little did our author know that soon the Ruinatio--the Ruin--no, no, no, that's not right, the ink's spilled again! Little did our author--no, no, no!"

cards.name: The Box
cards.text: Deal 3 to each enemy that was summoned this round.
cards.textHtml: Deal 3 to each enemy that was summoned this round.
cards.flavor: "Nobody escapes." - Thresh

cards.name: The Rekindler
cards.text: When I'm summoned, revive the strongest dead allied champion.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, revive the <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> dead allied champion.
cards.flavor: What use does a dying candle have, other than to light its successor?

cards.name: Shark Chariot
cards.text: Last Breath: The next time an Ephemeral ally attacks, revive me attacking.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>Last Breath</style></link>: The next time an <link=keyword.Ephemeral><sprite name=Ephemeral><style=Keyword>Ephemeral</style></link> ally attacks, revive me attacking.
cards.flavor: "She saw what? I see. Madness is a cruel mistress, apothecary. At least the others make some degree of sense." - Demacian surgeon

cards.name: Mark of the Isles
cards.text: Grant an ally +2|+2 and Ephemeral.
cards.textHtml: Grant an ally +2|+2 and <link=keyword.Ephemeral><sprite name=Ephemeral><style=Keyword>Ephemeral</style></link>.
cards.flavor: Power, but at what cost?

cards.name: Soul Shepherd
cards.text: When you summon an Ephemeral ally, grant it +1|+1.
cards.textHtml: When you summon an <link=keyword.Ephemeral><sprite name=Ephemeral><style=Keyword>Ephemeral</style></link> ally, grant it +1|+1.
cards.flavor: Only the fallen knew that she did not walk alone. Only they could see the countless companions she led down the path to lands beyond.

cards.name: Spectral Rider
cards.flavor: No longer bound by flesh, rider and beast became one, determined to race mindlessly into battles they no longer understood.

cards.name: Atrocity
cards.text: Kill an ally to deal damage equal to its Power to anything.
cards.textHtml: Kill an ally to deal damage equal to its Power to anything.
cards.flavor: Killing means nothing to those who cannot know death.

cards.name: Warden's Prey
cards.text: Last Breath: Create in hand another random Last Breath follower that costs 3 or less.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>Last Breath</style></link>: Create in hand another random <link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>Last Breath</style></link> follower that costs 3 or less.
cards.flavor: He held his breath as best he could, praying the warden would move on. Little did he know, this pursuit would just be the beginning of Thresh's delighted torments…

cards.name: Fresh Offerings
cards.text: If 3+ allies have died this round, summon Vilemaw.
cards.textHtml:
If 3+ allies have died this round, summon <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Vilemaw</style></link>.
<style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor: "Kneel before your fanged god. Better yet, die before it." - Elise

cards.name: Vilemaw
cards.text: Other Fearsome allies have +1|+0.
cards.textHtml: Other <link=keyword.Fearsome><sprite name=Fearsome><style=Keyword>Fearsome</style></link> allies have +1|+0.
cards.flavor: "Who is your god? What can your god do? Will he let you wither and die defending him? Or will he give you life and vitality like no mortal has ever known? Why serve a god who won't serve you?" - Elise

cards.name: Splinter Soul
cards.text: Summon an exact copy of an ally. It's Ephemeral and 1|1.
cards.textHtml: Summon an exact copy of an ally. It's <link=keyword.Ephemeral><sprite name=Ephemeral><style=Keyword>Ephemeral</style></link> and 1|1.
cards.flavor: "I lifted the body from the water to identify the poor soul. As I laid my hand upon its shoulder, it turned and showed its face. It was... me?" - Arie Wrence, Demacian soldier

cards.name: Withering Wail
cards.text: Deal 1 to all enemies. Heal your Nexus 3.
cards.textHtml: Deal 1 to all enemies. Heal your Nexus 3.
cards.flavor: That which kills us makes them stronger.

cards.name: Kalista
cards.levelup: I've seen 3+ allies die.
cards.flavor: In life, she was a general, a protector, a hero. But as flesh gave way, she was left with naught but the blazing fires of retribution--an undying spirit of vengeance.

cards.name: Kalista's Black Spear
cards.text:
If an ally died this round, deal 4 to a unit.
Create a Kalista in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
If an ally died this round, deal 4 to a unit.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Kalista</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "Our spear sings for the fallen." - Kalista

cards.name: Kalista
cards.text: Each round, the first time I attack revive an attacking Ephemeral copy of the strongest dead allied follower. This round, we're bonded and it takes damage for me.
cards.textHtml: Each round, the first time I attack revive an attacking <link=keyword.Ephemeral><sprite name=Ephemeral><style=Keyword>Ephemeral</style></link> copy of the <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> dead allied follower. This round, we're bonded and it takes damage for me.
cards.flavor: "The wronged shall have their vengeance!"

cards.name: Iron Harbinger
cards.text: Attack: Grant me +1|+0 for each Ephemeral ally you have.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Grant me +1|+0 for each <link=keyword.Ephemeral><sprite name=Ephemeral><style=Keyword>Ephemeral</style></link> ally you have.
cards.flavor: In death, as in life, he bellows the twisted, dark command. And in death, as in life, Hecarim's loyal knights answer, charging forth to slaughter.

cards.name: Chronicler of Ruin
cards.text: Play: Kill an ally, then revive it.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Kill an ally, then revive it.
cards.flavor: There was a time when she sat with her father--a lord curator--as he studied the dusty tomes. He hoped one day she would take on the mantle. But not like this.

cards.name: Commander Ledros
cards.text:
Play: Deal damage to the enemy Nexus equal to half its Health, rounded up.
Last Breath: Return me to hand.
cards.textHtml:
<link=keyword.PlaySkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Play</style></link>: Deal damage to the enemy Nexus equal to half its Health, rounded up.
<link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>Last Breath</style></link>: Return me to hand.
cards.flavor: Most spirits lost themselves as the passing years eroded their memories. But anguish anchored Ledros to his past. Some things, even time cannot absolve.

cards.name: Blade of Ledros
cards.text: Deal damage to the enemy Nexus equal to half its Health, rounded up.
cards.textHtml: <style=Variable>Deal damage to the enemy Nexus equal to half its Health, rounded up.</style>
cards.flavor: Half a blade for half a man. A weapon broken as its wielder's vow, broken as the king it was sworn to protect, broken as the kingdom of shadow that once was blessed.

cards.name: Black Spear
cards.text: If an ally died this round, deal 4 to a unit.
cards.textHtml: If an ally died this round, deal 4 to a unit.
cards.flavor: "Our spear sings for the fallen." - Kalista

cards.name: Rhasa the Sunderer
cards.text: Play: Kill the 2 weakest enemies if an ally died this round.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.PlaySkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Play</style></link>: Kill the 2 <link=keyword.Weakest><style=Keyword>weakest</style></link> enemies if an ally died this round.
cards.flavor: "We were told... they called it a legend's journey. We were going to... for Demacia's future. We sailed with such hope. But all... all those lives... for what?" - Arie Wrence, Demacian soldier

cards.name: Night Harvest
cards.text: Kill the 2 Weakest enemies if an ally died this round.
cards.textHtml: Kill the 2 <link=keyword.Weakest><style=Keyword>Weakest</style></link> enemies if an ally died this round.
cards.flavor: Thin the herd.

cards.name: Crawling Sensation
cards.text: If an ally died this round, summon 2 Spiderlings.
cards.textHtml: If an ally died this round, summon 2 <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Spiderlings</style></link>.
cards.flavor: That creeping feeling on your skin isn't nearly as unsettling as the one underneath it.

cards.name: Sinister Poro
cards.flavor: I mean, there are worse ways to die.

cards.name: Phantom Prankster
cards.text: When another ally dies, deal 1 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml: When another ally dies, deal 1 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: Her cruelest trick wasn't slaughtering the soldiers who trusted the cries of a little girl, but sowing doubt in the survivors who returned home and ignored the pleas of their daughters.

cards.name: Arachnoid Horror
cards.flavor: Some malevolent spirits take inspiration from local fauna, twisting the familiar into the nightmarish.

cards.name: Vile Feast
cards.text: Drain 1 from a unit to summon a Spiderling.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Drain><style=Keyword>Drain</style></link> 1 from a unit to summon a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Spiderling</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "My... my lady! I didn't realize you were such an... an arachnophile! Could you perhaps call them away from me? L-Lady Elise? Please?" - Lord Sassen, Hapless Aristocrat

cards.name: The Undying
cards.text: Last Breath: Revive me at the next Round Start and grant me +1|+1 for each time I've died.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>Last Breath</style></link>: Revive me at the next <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link> and grant me +1|+1 for each time I've died. <style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor: The old martyr remembered rallying his comrades to their doom. But it had been years since he could remember why...

cards.name: Hecarim
cards.text: Attack: Summon 2 attacking Spectral Riders.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Summon 2 attacking <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Spectral Riders</style></link>.
cards.levelup: You've attacked with 7+ Ephemeral allies.
cards.flavor: That's not thunder. The Shadow of War is on the horizon.

cards.name: Hecarim
cards.text:
When I level up, grant your Nexus "Ephemeral allies have +3|+0".
Attack: Summon 2 attacking Spectral Riders.
cards.textHtml:
When I level up, grant your Nexus "<link=keyword.Ephemeral><sprite name=Ephemeral><style=Keyword>Ephemeral</style></link> allies have +3|+0".
<link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Summon 2 attacking <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Spectral Riders</style></link>.
cards.flavor: Listen. Hear him ride. The trampling of hooves. The creak of armor, long-worn and rusted. The ghostly cries of soldiers, echoes of the past. The resounding silence that follows.

cards.name: Hecarim's Onslaught of Shadows
cards.text:
Summon 2 Spectral Riders.
Create a Hecarim in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
Summon 2 <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Spectral Riders</style></link>.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Hecarim</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: They live now as they died then: loyal 'til the very end.

cards.name: Hapless Aristocrat
cards.text: Last Breath: Summon a Spiderling.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>Last Breath</style></link>: Summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Spiderling</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "L-Lady Elise? Where... where did you go?"

cards.name: Spectral Matron
cards.text: Play: Pick an ally in hand. Summon an exact copy of it. It's Ephemeral.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Pick an ally in hand. Summon an exact copy of it. It's <link=keyword.Ephemeral><sprite name=Ephemeral><style=Keyword>Ephemeral</style></link>.
cards.flavor: The Ruination corrupted all those caught in its path. The kind became cruel. The brave became brutal. Reason gave way to resentment.

cards.name: Absorb Soul
cards.text: Drain 4 from an ally.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Drain><style=Keyword>Drain</style></link> 4 from an ally.
cards.flavor: "What kills you only makes me stronger." - Thresh

cards.name: Mist's Call
cards.text: Revive a random ally that died this round.
cards.textHtml: Revive a random ally that died this round.
cards.flavor: "The Mist severs spirit from flesh, leaving behind a foul parody of life. I have seen it corrupt my lands, so I go now to those cursed isles, to end this." - Arie Wrence, Dauntless vindicator

cards.name: Fading Memories
cards.text: Pick a follower. Create an Ephemeral copy of it in hand.
cards.textHtml: Pick a follower. Create an <link=keyword.Ephemeral><sprite name=Ephemeral><style=Keyword>Ephemeral</style></link> copy of it in hand.
cards.flavor: For a moment, she remembered. Dappled sunlight dancing across her skin, plump dewberries bursting between her teeth, and the glade’s fragile melody drifting over her on the breeze. Then... it was gone.

cards.name: Cursed Keeper
cards.text: Last Breath: Summon an Escaped Abomination.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>Last Breath</style></link>: Summon an <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Escaped Abomination</style></link>.
cards.flavor: Madness and time. Never was there a more terrible pair.

cards.name: Escaped Abomination
cards.flavor: Time may have stopped, but madness remains.

cards.name: Glimpse Beyond
cards.text: Kill an ally to draw 2.
cards.textHtml: Kill an ally to draw 2.
cards.flavor: "I have erred. We were not meant to peer beyond the pale curtain. Whatever insight lingers there comes at far too great a cost." - Arie Wrence, Dauntless vindicator

cards.name: Brood Awakening
cards.text: Summon 3 Spiderlings, then grant Spider allies +1|+0.
cards.textHtml: Summon 3 <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Spiderlings</style></link>, then grant Spider allies +1|+0.
cards.flavor: They're hungriest when they hatch.

cards.name: Tortured Prodigy
cards.text: When another ally dies, or Last Breath: Refill your spell mana.
cards.textHtml: When another ally dies, or <link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>Last Breath</style></link>: Refill your spell mana.
cards.flavor: He toiled night and day, perfecting his composition. Then, in the blink of an eye, a dark silence blew through him. Others screamed and ran for their lives. He noticed nothing.

cards.name: Thresh
cards.levelup: I've seen 6+ units die.
cards.flavor:
"Cling clang, go the chains, someone's out to find you,
Cling clang, oh the chains, the Warden's right behind you..."

cards.name: Thresh
cards.text: The first time I attack this game, summon another attacking champion from your deck or hand.
cards.textHtml: The first time I attack this game, summon another attacking champion from your deck or hand.
cards.flavor: "You're mine. Forever."Cling clang, oh the chains, the Warden's right behind you...

cards.name: Thresh's The Box
cards.text:
Deal 3 to each enemy that was summoned this round.
Create a Thresh in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
Deal 3 to each enemy that was summoned this round.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Thresh</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "Nobody escapes." - Thresh

cards.name: Elise
cards.text: Attack: Summon an attacking Spiderling.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Summon an attacking <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Spiderling</style></link>.
cards.levelup: Round Start: You have 3+ other Spiders.
cards.flavor: Once the head of a powerful Noxian house, Elise's dark ties to the Shadow Isles granted her unnatural youth and beauty in exchange for a few unwitting souls offered in sacrifice. An easy decision.

cards.name: Elise's Crawling Sensation
cards.text:
If an ally died this round, summon 2 Spiderlings.
Create an Elise in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
If an ally died this round, summon 2 <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Spiderlings</style></link>.
Create an <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Elise</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: That creeping feeling on your skin isn't nearly as unsettling as the one underneath it.

cards.name: Spider Queen Elise
cards.text: Other Spider allies have Challenger and Fearsome.
cards.textHtml: Other Spider allies have <link=keyword.Challenger><sprite name=Challenger><style=Keyword>Challenger</style></link> and <link=keyword.Fearsome><sprite name=Fearsome><style=Keyword>Fearsome</style></link>.
cards.flavor: Beauty is in the many eyes of the beholder.

cards.name: Grasp of the Undying
cards.text: Drain 3 from a unit.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Drain><style=Keyword>Drain</style></link> 3 from a unit.
cards.flavor: The dead want nothing more than to silence the ceaseless pulse of the living.

cards.name: Soulgorger
cards.flavor: "As our ships near those haunted lands, I ponder this: did those nightmarish creations originate on these twisted shores? Did they ever truly live?" - Arie Wrence, Demacian soldier

cards.name: Frenzied Skitterer
cards.text: When I'm summoned, give other Spider allies +1|+0 and enemies -1|-0 this round.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, give other Spider allies +1|+0 and enemies <nobr>-1|-0</nobr> this round.
cards.flavor: "They can spin a web the size of a man in less than a minute... would you like a demonstration?" - Elise

cards.name: Ancient Crocolith
cards.text: To play me, kill 2 allies.
cards.textHtml: To play me, kill 2 allies.
cards.flavor:
"Put 'em in the cage, tum-te-dum... 
Pluck up every soul, one by one...
Never let ‘em go, no! No sir…
Else them spirits make quite a stir..."

cards.name: Ethereal Remitter
cards.text: Play: Kill an ally to summon a random follower that costs 2 more.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Kill an ally to summon a random follower that costs 2 more.
cards.flavor: Spirits, lend your voices to mine! Together, we will call down a darkness unending!

cards.name: Ye Been Warned
cards.text: Give an enemy Vulnerable this round. If it dies this round, draw 1.
cards.textHtml: Give an enemy <link=keyword.Vulnerable><sprite name=Vulnerable><style=Keyword>Vulnerable</style></link> this round. If it dies this round, draw 1.
cards.flavor: "Keep yer chin up and yer spirits high, boy! If the cap'n sees ya saggin', he'll hoist ya up, cut y'open, an' feed ya to the gulls. Now, move yer arse!" - Dreadway deckhand

cards.name: The Dreadway
cards.text:
When I'm summoned, draw Gangplank. 
Double all damage dealt by your spells, Skills and allies.
cards.textHtml:
When I'm summoned, draw <link=card.champ1><style=AssociatedCard>Gangplank</style></link>. 
Double all damage dealt by your spells, <link=keyword.Skill><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Skills</style></link> and allies.
cards.flavor:
"Ohhhh, best say yer farewells and draw down the sails,
For the Dreadway's a-comin'.
We're off to the deep, where graves're replete,
'Cuz the Dreadway's a-comin'!" - "The Dreadway's a-Comin'"

cards.name: Strong-arm
cards.text: Plunder: Recall ANY follower into your hand.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Plunder><style=Keyword>Plunder</style></link>: <link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recall</style></link> ANY follower into your hand.
cards.flavor: "Yer workin' fer us now!" - Petty Officer

cards.name: Dreadway Deckhand
cards.text: When I'm summoned, summon a Powder Keg.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Powder Keg</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "Aye, we could fight 'em at dawn, when their crew's awake and their cannons are primed. Or we could leave 'em a gift tonight, nice and quiet-like..."

cards.name: Hired Gun
cards.text: When I'm summoned, grant the strongest enemy Vulnerable.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, grant the <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> enemy <link=keyword.Vulnerable><sprite name=Vulnerable><style=Keyword>Vulnerable</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "This your picture? Oof, you're even rougher on the eyes than advertised--let's hope your head's worth my while."

cards.name: Mystifying Magician
cards.text: Play: Transform an ally into a random 5 cost follower.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Transform an ally into a random 5 cost follower.
cards.flavor:
"Marvolio? Where... Where are my hands?"
"I will-a now make-a them appear! Tadaa! Ahem. Ta... daa...!"
"...WHERE ARE MY HANDS?!"
"OKAY, TIME-A TO GO! THANK-A YOU ALL SO VERY MUCH!"

cards.name: Brash Gambler
cards.text:
To play me, discard 2.
Attack: Draw 2 and grant them Fleeting.
cards.textHtml:
To play me, discard 2.
<link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Draw 2 and grant them <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "Ain't nothing to it, most o' the time. Tables are full of fools too busy singing 'emselves hoarse to focus on the game. Not that I mind none. Coin's coin, and it's better in my pocket than theirs."

cards.name: Petty Officer
cards.text: Play: Summon a Powder Keg or a random 1 cost follower.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Powder Keg</style></link> or a random 1 cost follower.
cards.flavor: Few things, he learned, could motivate a slacking sailor as promptly as a lit fuse.

cards.name: Petty Officer
cards.text: Play: Summon a Powder Keg.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Powder Keg</style></link>.
cards.flavor: Few things, he learned, could motivate a slacking sailor as promptly as a lit fuse.

cards.name: Petty Officer
cards.text: Play: Summon a random 1 cost follower.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Summon a random 1 cost follower.
cards.flavor: Few things, he learned, could motivate a slacking sailor as promptly as a lit fuse.

cards.name: Pool Shark
cards.text: When I'm summoned, draw 1 at the next Round Start and grant it Fleeting.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, draw 1 at the next <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link> and grant it <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "It don't make no sense to me. I was knocking 'em in easy, but the last one just... wouldn't go. Not my day, I s'pose..." - Brash Gambler

cards.name: Plunder Poro
cards.text: Plunder: Grant me 2 random keywords.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Plunder><style=Keyword>Plunder</style></link>: Grant me 2 random keywords.
cards.flavor: "His picture's been on the Bounty Board longer'n most, for he's a greedy, ruthless devil that won't let anyone or anything stand in his way. Worst of all? He's... He's cute, damn it." - Gangplank

cards.name: Yordle Grifter
cards.text: Allegiance: Nab 1 and create a Warning Shot in hand.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Allegiance><style=Vocab>Allegiance</style></link>: <link=keyword.Nab><style=Keyword>Nab</style></link> 1 and create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Warning Shot</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: "Y'know, friends love to help friends out. And you? I like the shine in your eye and the glint on your cutlass! It is a really, really nice cutlass."

cards.name: More Powder!
cards.text: Summon 2 Powder Kegs.
cards.textHtml: Summon 2 <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Powder Kegs</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "Barrel!" - Gangplank

cards.name: Prowling Cutthroat
cards.flavor: "...and the idiot said I had hips that 'rolled like the waves'. I told him to cut the flattery, or I'd cut out his tongue."

cards.name: Coral Creatures
cards.text: When I'm summoned, create in hand a random 1 cost spell from your regions.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, create in hand a random 1 cost spell from your regions.
cards.flavor: Most shallows teem with all kinds of marine life, but none compare to the reefs of the Azure Way. The Way is a magical, otherworldly place, full of wonder.

cards.name: The Syren
cards.text:
When I'm summoned, draw Miss Fortune.
While I'm attacking, all your spells and Skills deal 1 extra damage.
cards.textHtml:
When I'm summoned, draw <link=card.champ1><style=AssociatedCard>Miss Fortune</style></link>.
While I'm attacking, all your spells and <link=keyword.Skill><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Skills</style></link> deal 1 extra damage.
cards.flavor: There's no mistaking the Syren. Her broad pearly sails and polished woodwork leave her as sleek and decorated as the captain at her helm.

cards.name: Slotbot
cards.text: When I'm summoned or Round Start: Grant me +0|+1 for each card you drew last round, then shuffle my stats.
cards.textHtml:
When I'm summoned or <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Grant me +0|+1 for each card you drew last round, then shuffle my stats.
<style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor: One prototype spun three bombs and then exploded. Later models had this early "feature" removed.

cards.name: Citrus Courier
cards.text: Plunder: Heal allies and your Nexus 3, then Rally.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Plunder><style=Keyword>Plunder</style></link>: Heal allies and your Nexus 3, then <link=vocab.Rally><style=Vocab>Rally</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "All sailors think they so tough! Grr this. Yarr that. Yes yes. Very good. But you still need orange! Make skin pretty, make teeth stay, and make me happy. So you eat, or you swim. Easy."

cards.name: Parrrley
cards.text:
Deal 1 to anything.
If this kills it, deal 1 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml:
Deal 1 to anything.
If this kills it, deal 1 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: Gangplank's version of mediation is often brief, and always bloody.

cards.name: Bubble Bear
cards.flavor: Lively currents of magic weave through Serpent Isles' reefs, nourishing the sea's extraordinary inhabitants.

cards.name: Warning Shot
cards.text: Deal 1 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml: Deal 1 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: "Yer supposed to fire w' the rest of us, lad! That's what a salvo is!" - Petty Officer

cards.name: Razorscale Hunter
cards.text: Play: Grant an enemy Vulnerable.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Grant an enemy <link=keyword.Vulnerable><sprite name=Vulnerable><style=Keyword>Vulnerable</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "I've heard he'll swim miles to find his mark, 'n when he finds 'em, he never misses his shot. Not sure if he's a man or a fish, but it's clear he knows these waters far better'n we do." - Jagged Butcher

cards.name: Miss Fortune
cards.text: When allies attack, deal 1 to all battling enemies and the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml: When allies attack, deal 1 to all battling enemies and the enemy Nexus.
cards.levelup: I've seen you attack 4 times.
cards.flavor: "'Miss' Fortune? Out here, you call me 'Captain'."

cards.name: Love Tap
cards.text: Deal 1 to all battling enemies and the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml: Deal 1 to all battling enemies and the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: "A little something to remember me by." - Miss Fortune

cards.name: Miss Fortune
cards.text: When allies attack, deal 1 three times to all battling enemies and the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml: When allies attack, deal 1 three times to all battling enemies and the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: "Most people don't get close enough to see the craftsmanship on these guns. Lucky you."

cards.name: Miss Fortune's Make it Rain
cards.text:
Deal 1 to three different randomly targeted enemies or the enemy Nexus.
Create a Miss Fortune in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
Deal 1 to three different randomly targeted enemies or the enemy Nexus.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Miss Fortune</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "Guns blazin'!" - Miss Fortune

cards.name: Bullet Time
cards.text: Deal 1 three times to all battling enemies and the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml: Deal 1 three times to all battling enemies and the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: Even if you fail to hear the bawdy cries of her crew, there's no way you'll miss her laughter...

cards.name: Lure of the Depths
cards.text:
Reduce the cost of Sea Monster allies everywhere by 1.
Draw a Sea Monster.
cards.textHtml:
Reduce the cost of Sea Monster allies <link=vocab.Everywhere><style=Vocab>everywhere</style></link> by 1.
Draw a Sea Monster.
cards.flavor: Sailors speak in hushed tones of dark days to come; when the seas churn and boil, and unspeakable horrors rise from the waves.

cards.name: Double Trouble
cards.text: Summon 2 random 1 cost followers.
cards.textHtml: Summon 2 random 1 cost followers.
cards.flavor:
"Oi, Gav--ain't that the fella we're after? Looks like he found a friend."
"Is that... Is that a shark-man, Baz?"
"It's also a bunch more gold, mate. Come on..." - Baz and Gav, aspiring bounty hunters

cards.name: Chum the Waters
cards.text: Grant an enemy Vulnerable and summon Longtooth.
cards.textHtml: Grant an enemy <link=keyword.Vulnerable><sprite name=Vulnerable><style=Keyword>Vulnerable</style></link> and summon <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Longtooth</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "Shark!" - Fizz

cards.name: Twisted Fate
cards.text: Play: Play a Destiny Card.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.PlaySkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Play</style></link>: Play a Destiny Card.
cards.levelup: I've seen you draw 9 cards.
cards.flavor: "Now, watch the hands, count the cards, and try to keep up. And just remember..."

cards.name: Twisted Fate's Pick a Card
cards.text:
To play, place a card from hand into your deck.
Draw 2 at the next Round Start and grant them Fleeting.
Create a Twisted Fate in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
To play, place a card from hand into your deck.
Draw 2 at the next <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link> and grant them <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link>.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Twisted Fate</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "I make my own luck." - Twisted Fate

cards.name: Blue Card
cards.text:
Refill 1 spell mana.
Draw 1.
cards.textHtml:
Refill <style=Variable>1</style> spell mana.
Draw <style=Variable>1</style>.
cards.flavor: "Blue as the Serpentine." - Twisted Fate

cards.name: Twisted Fate
cards.text: Each round, the first 3 times you play a card, I play a Destiny Card.
cards.textHtml: Each round, the first 3 times you play a card, I play a Destiny Card.
cards.flavor: "...it ain't gamblin' if you can't lose."

cards.name: Red Card
cards.text: Deal 1 to all enemies and the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml: Deal 1 to all enemies and the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: "Somethin' for everyone." - Twisted Fate

cards.name: Gold Card
cards.text: Deal 2 and Stun the strongest enemy.
cards.textHtml: Deal 2 and <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> the <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> enemy.
cards.flavor: "All that glitters..." - Twisted Fate

cards.name: Hunting Fleet
cards.text: When I'm summoned, your opponent summons a Golden Narwhal.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, your opponent summons a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Golden Narwhal</style></link>.
cards.flavor: The gold that glitters beneath the waves is neither coin nor ingot, but the lustrous horn of the Slaughter Fleet captain's clever adversary.

cards.name: Riptide Rex
cards.text: Plunder: Play Cannon Barrage 7 times on randomly targeted enemies.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Plunder><style=Keyword>Plunder</style></link>: Play <link=card.cast><style=AssociatedCard>Cannon Barrage</style></link> 7 times on randomly targeted enemies.
cards.flavor:
"Sail past the sailors, sail past the wreck,
The battle's already over.
The smoke's cleared the water, their captain's met Rex,
And their ship's ripped an' torn timber." - "Home With You, Sally"

cards.name: Cannon Barrage
cards.text:
Deal 2 to a unit.
If it's dead or gone, deal 1 to the enemy Nexus instead.
cards.textHtml:
Deal 2 to a unit.
If it's dead or gone, deal 1 to the enemy Nexus instead.
cards.flavor: Gangplank's cruelty doesn't end with those who wrong him. To make an enemy of the Saltwater Scourge is to bring death upon everyone you hold dear.

cards.name: Salvage
cards.text:
Toss 2.
Draw 2.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Toss><style=Vocab>Toss</style></link> 2.
Draw 2.
cards.flavor: Flotsam doesn't stay afloat for long. Any seafarer worth their salt has to be able to quickly discern valuable cargo from common junk...

cards.name: Shipwreck Hoarder
cards.text: When I'm summoned, Toss 2 and create 2 Treasures in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
When I'm summoned, <link=vocab.Toss><style=Vocab>Toss</style></link> 2 and create 2 Treasures in your deck.
<style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor: "These days, there's more treasure 'neath the waves than above 'em, I wager. Would be easy enough pickins, if 'tweren't for her." - Jagged Butcher

cards.name: Treasure Trove
cards.text:
Create 5 random cards in hand. They cost 0 and are Fleeting.
If I'm Tossed, draw me instead.
cards.textHtml:
Create 5 random cards in hand. They cost 0 and are <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link>.
If I'm <link=vocab.Toss><style=Vocab>Tossed</style></link>, draw me instead.
cards.flavor: Captain Finn roared out "Ye earned this, boys! Told ye the Tithe was nothin' but coward feed!" Some cheered, but not all. The waters seemed to still, save for the bubbles around the Rancour's hull.

cards.name: Keelbreaker
cards.text:
If I'm Tossed, draw me instead.
Deal 5 to ALL units.
cards.textHtml:
If I'm <link=vocab.Toss><style=Vocab>Tossed</style></link>, draw me instead.
Deal 5 to ALL units.
cards.flavor: The deckhands roared as one and hauled the chains, their treasure now just below the calm waters. Little did they know the Seascraw's legendary cannon had one final act in store.

cards.name: Platewyrm Egg
cards.text:
If I'm Tossed, draw me instead.
Summon 3 Vicious Platewyrms.
cards.textHtml:
If I'm <link=vocab.Toss><style=Vocab>Tossed</style></link>, draw me instead.
Summon 3 <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Vicious Platewyrms</style></link>.
cards.flavor: The grizzled captain held his shining quarry aloft and roared out "This'll keep us fer life!" Heady cheers rang out from the crew, while around their brig, the waters began to churn...

cards.name: Vicious Platewyrm
cards.text: <style=Variable></style>
cards.textHtml: <style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor: The terrifying beasts burst through the waves and split the hull with vice-like jaws. Though the sailors begged the Bearded Lady for mercy, their captain's greed had already sealed their fate.

cards.name: Double Up
cards.text:
Deal 2 to an enemy.
If this kills it, deal 4 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml:
Deal 2 to an enemy.
If this kills it, deal 4 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: "I always shoot first." - Miss Fortune

cards.name: Gangplank
cards.text: When I'm summoned, summon a Powder Keg.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Powder Keg</style></link>.
cards.levelup: You've damaged the enemy Nexus in 5+ different rounds.
cards.flavor: "Don't stare too long, lest he catches you lookin'. And don't speak ill of him, for he hears all Bilgewater's whispers. Here he comes. Chin low. Eyes lower." - Dreadway deckhand

cards.name: Powder Keg
cards.text:
Powder Kegs stack.
All of your spells and Skills deal 1 extra damage.
Destroy me when your spell or skill damages enemies or the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml:
Powder Kegs stack.
All of your spells and <link=keyword.Skill><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Skills</style></link> deal <style=Variable>1</style> extra damage.
Destroy me when your spell or skill damages enemies or the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: "Where there's a keg, there's a way." - Bilgewater saying

cards.name: Gangplank's Parrrley
cards.text:
Deal 1 to anything.
If this kills it, deal 1 to the enemy Nexus.
Create a Gangplank in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
Deal 1 to anything.
If this kills it, deal 1 to the enemy Nexus.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Gangplank</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: Gangplank's version of mediation is often brief, and always bloody.

cards.name: Gangplank
cards.text:
When I'm summoned or Round Start: Summon a Powder Keg.
Attack: Deal 1 to all enemies and the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml:
When I'm summoned or <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Powder Keg</style></link>.
<link=keyword.AttackSkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Attack</style></link>: Deal 1 to all enemies and the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: "Seen his eyes enough to know. Ain't nothin' but pure anger there. Someday, the boss'll do to Bilgewater what it did to him." - Petty Officer

cards.name: Powderful Explosion
cards.text: Deal 1 to all enemies and the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml: Deal 1 to all enemies and the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: "Blow 'em to the depths!" - Gangplank

cards.name: Black Market Merchant
cards.text:
When you draw an enemy card, reduce its cost by 1.
Plunder: Nab 1.
cards.textHtml:
When you draw an enemy card, reduce its cost by 1.
<link=keyword.Plunder><style=Keyword>Plunder</style></link>: <link=keyword.Nab><style=Keyword>Nab</style></link> 1.
cards.flavor: "If you want it, I've got it! Even got some 'special stock'.... Just remember, you didn't get it from me!"

cards.name: Monkey Idol
cards.text: Round Start: Deal 2 to me and summon a Powder Monkey.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Deal 2 to me and summon a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Powder Monkey</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "This one's a... souvenir. The crew nabbed it from a crazy old rival of mine. Turns out the fool's ramblings about 'ancient, mysterious powers' weren't too far from the truth..." - Miss Fortune

cards.name: Powder Monkey
cards.text: Last Breath: Deal 1 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>Last Breath</style></link>: Deal 1 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: "Mischievous little scamps, ain't they? More help than they seem, but word is they've got explosive tempers..." - Syren deckhand

cards.name: Sheriff Lariette Rose
cards.text: When I'm summoned, grant all enemies Vulnerable.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, grant all enemies <link=keyword.Vulnerable><sprite name=Vulnerable><style=Keyword>Vulnerable</style></link>.
cards.flavor: There may be no law in Bilgewater, yet a handful of brave souls within the city's boisterous walls are unafraid of enforcing their own idea of justice.

cards.name: Golden Narwhal
cards.flavor: Legends say a pale, horned whale once stole from the Bearded Lady. As punishment, the Lady covered the greedy creature in glittering gold, so it would forever tempt the avarice of others.

cards.name: Abyssal Eye
cards.text: Nexus Strike: Draw 1.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.NexusStrike><style=Vocab>Nexus Strike</style></link>: Draw 1.
<style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor:
"Aye aye, they cried, and set off away,
To see to trouble in fair Nashramae,
But nature, she turned, and many did die,
An' the rest are off to see the all-seein' eye!" - "The All-Seeing Eye"

cards.name: Zap Sprayfin
cards.text: When I'm summoned, draw a spell that costs 3 or less from your deck.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, draw a spell that costs 3 or less from your deck.
cards.flavor: Zap once completed the Azure Way circuit in just under three minutes. She even had to dodge the Jilldaw's shattered hull near the end! The currents that day were AWESOME.

cards.name: Jaull Hunters
cards.text: When I'm summoned, create a random Sea Monster in hand.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, create a random Sea Monster in hand.
cards.flavor: The lure of fortune pulls countless crews out beyond the shallows. Those poor souls soon discover how terrifying the waters can be, and why so few return.

cards.name: Shellshocker
cards.flavor: "MY GRATEST STRENF IS PREBABLE MY COMAND OF DA COMON PEEPUL AN ALSO APPARENLY MY SPELING IS RELLY GUD TO" - Note scribbled in sand

cards.name: The Beast Below
cards.text: <style=Variable></style>
cards.textHtml: <style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor:
"Fear not the blasted beast ye know,
For some survive their thunder,
But what of them that broke the bow,
An' took them poor souls under?" - Found scratched into a Bilgewater tavern beam

cards.name: Mind Meld
cards.text: This round, grow allies' Power and Health to the number of other spells you've played this game.
cards.textHtml: This round, grow allies' Power and Health to the number of other spells you've played this game. <style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor: The currents and tides around Bilgewater are rightly feared for their strength and sudden turns. But no sailor knows the true power within those waters.

cards.name: Pick a Card
cards.text:
To play, place a card from hand into your deck.
Draw 2 at the next Round Start and grant them Fleeting.
cards.textHtml:
To play, place a card from hand into your deck.
Draw 2 at the next <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link> and grant them <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "I make my own luck." - Twisted Fate

cards.name: Jettison
cards.text: Toss 4.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Toss><style=Vocab>Toss</style></link> 4.
cards.flavor: "If it ain't worth its weight, it goes over. Same goes for you lot, 'n all. Now back ta work!" - Petty Officer

cards.name: Make it Rain
cards.text: Deal 1 to three different randomly targeted enemies or the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml: Deal 1 to three different randomly targeted enemies or the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: "Guns blazin'!" - Miss Fortune

cards.name: Fizz
cards.text: When you play a spell, stop all enemy spells and Skills targeting me and give me Elusive this round.
cards.textHtml: When you play a spell, stop all enemy spells and <link=keyword.Skill><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Skills</style></link> targeting me and give me <link=keyword.Elusive><sprite name=Elusive><style=Keyword>Elusive</style></link> this round.
cards.levelup: You've played 6+ spells.
cards.flavor: Of all Bilgewater's legendary figures, Fizz is the most mercurial. Some sailors curse him for the countless brutal wrecks littering the coast...

cards.name: Fizz's Playful Trickster
cards.text:
Remove an attacking ally from combat to Rally.
Create a Fizz in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
Remove an attacking ally from combat to <link=vocab.Rally><style=Vocab>Rally</style></link>.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Fizz</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "One jump ahead of you!" - Fizz

cards.name: Longtooth
cards.flavor: Though there may be ambiguity surrounding Fizz's temperament and intentions, there's absolutely none when it comes to Longtooth.

cards.name: Fizz
cards.text:
When you play a spell, stop all enemy spells and Skills targeting me and give me Elusive this round.
Nexus Strike: Create a Chum the Waters in hand.
cards.textHtml:
When you play a spell, stop all enemy spells and <link=keyword.Skill><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Skills</style></link> targeting me and give me <link=keyword.Elusive><sprite name=Elusive><style=Keyword>Elusive</style></link> this round.
<link=vocab.NexusStrike><style=Vocab>Nexus Strike</style></link>: Create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Chum the Waters</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: ...while others insist he's just a playful child who safeguards others on their journeys home.

cards.name: Dreg Dredgers
cards.text: When I'm summoned, Toss 3.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, <link=vocab.Toss><style=Vocab>Toss</style></link> 3.
cards.flavor: It takes a special sort to make complete garbage of perfectly seaworthy gear. But if there's one thing they're good at, it's that. Just that.

cards.name: Jailbreak
cards.text: Summon a random 1 cost follower.
cards.textHtml: Summon a random 1 cost follower.
cards.flavor:
"Whatcha think, Baz? He don't look so tough."
"Ya sure, Gav? He broke out of prison..."
"Means he's wily, not tough. Come on!" - Baz and Gav, aspiring bounty hunters

cards.name: Pilfered Goods
cards.text:
Nab 1.
Plunder: Nab 1 more.
cards.textHtml:
<link=keyword.Nab><style=Keyword>Nab</style></link> 1.
<link=keyword.Plunder><style=Keyword>Plunder</style></link>: <link=keyword.Nab><style=Keyword>Nab</style></link> 1 more.
cards.flavor: What's mine is mine, and what's yours is... also mine.

cards.name: Smooth Soloist
cards.text: Plunder: Reduce the cost of allies in hand and deck by 2.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Plunder><style=Keyword>Plunder</style></link>: Reduce the cost of allies in hand and deck by 2.
cards.flavor: "Come with us on a musical journey! Enjoy tunes from across Runeterra! Just remember--coin's required for entry, and tips are deeply appreciated..." - Show promoter

cards.name: Playful Trickster
cards.text: Remove an attacking ally from combat to Rally.
cards.textHtml: Remove an attacking ally from combat to <link=vocab.Rally><style=Vocab>Rally</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "One jump ahead of you!" - Fizz

cards.name: Nautilus
cards.levelup: When you are Deep.  When I level up, copy Tossed allies that cost 4+ into your deck.
cards.flavor: "'Twas an anchor what broke the Rancour. Pulled Finn down, an' all. Just a handful of us left now, but night's coming... and the cold. I'm sorry, Ma. You were right. The Titan lives." - Recovered note

cards.name: Nautilus
cards.text: Sea Monster allies cost 4 less.
cards.textHtml: Sea Monster allies cost 4 less.
cards.flavor: All pay the tithe, one way or another.

cards.name: Nautilus' Riptide
cards.text:
Stun an enemy.
Place that unit into the enemy deck if you have a Nautilus.
Create a Nautilus into your deck.
cards.textHtml:
<link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> an enemy.
Place that unit into the enemy deck if you have a <link=card.champCheck><style=AssociatedCard>Nautilus</style></link>.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Nautilus</style></link> into your deck.
cards.flavor: "Drag them down..." - Nautilus

cards.name: Riptide
cards.text:
Stun an enemy.
Place that unit into the enemy deck if you have a Nautilus.
cards.textHtml:
<link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> an enemy.
Place that unit into the enemy deck if you have a <link=card.champCheck><style=AssociatedCard>Nautilus</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "Drag them down..." - Nautilus

cards.name: Jagged Taskmaster
cards.text: Plunder: Grant 1 cost allies everywhere +1|+0.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Plunder><style=Keyword>Plunder</style></link>: Grant 1 cost allies <link=vocab.Everywhere><style=Vocab>everywhere</style></link> +1|+0.
cards.flavor: Once she fires, the Hooks have to move fast. Blood in the water brings all manner of company... and none of it is welcome.

cards.name: Devourer of the Depths
cards.text: Play: Obliterate an enemy with less Health than me.
cards.textHtml:
<link=keyword.PlaySkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Play</style></link>: <link=vocab.Obliterate><style=Vocab>Obliterate</style></link> an enemy with less Health than me.
<style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor:
"I was sailing just the other day,
Out beyond Bilgewater Bay,
When, from the depths, she came my way,
the Wing-Eared Sunken Lady..." - "Ballad of the Wing-Eared Sunken Lady"

cards.name: Devour
cards.text: Obliterate an enemy with less Health than me.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Obliterate><style=Vocab>Obliterate</style></link> an enemy with less Health than me.
cards.flavor:
"She swallowed me whole, me skiff and me soul,
So I'm singin' this song in her belly,
And now I must wait 'til I meet my fate,
In the Wing-Eared Sunken Lady." - "Ballad of the Wing-Eared Sunken Lady"

cards.name: Slippery Waverider
cards.flavor: "Swear I seen the strangest things over them reefs, Cap'n. Wha's that lunk put in 'em oranges? Tha's what I wanna know..." - Petty Officer

cards.name: Jagged Butcher
cards.text: Plunder: Grant me +1|+1.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Plunder><style=Keyword>Plunder</style></link>: Grant me +1|+1.
cards.flavor: Entry into the Jagged Hooks is a bloody affair. Sailors must prove they know their way around a ship, a fight, and a butcher's block. The most unsavory candidates hit all three marks in a single scrap.

cards.name: Scrapshot
cards.text:
Toss 3.
Deal 7 to a unit.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Toss><style=Vocab>Toss</style></link> 3.
Deal 7 to a unit.
cards.flavor: "If it sinks 'em, it was worth it." - Bilgewater saying

cards.name: Crackshot Corsair
cards.text: When allies attack, deal 1 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml: When allies attack, deal 1 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: "Being short gives you a surprising advantage in a fight. Turns out, nobody ever thinks to look down."

cards.name: Crackshot
cards.text: Deal 1 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml: Deal 1 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: "Captain's orders: bullet to the face!" - Crackshot Corsair

cards.name: Pocket Aces
cards.text:
When drawn, I cost 1 less this round.
Grant an ally +2|+1.
cards.textHtml:
When drawn, I cost 1 less this round.
Grant an ally +2|+1.
cards.flavor: "Ain't nothin' like a hot streak to keep the chips comin'." - Twisted Fate

cards.name: Island Navigator
cards.text: When I'm summoned, summon a random 1 cost follower and grant it Scout.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, summon a random 1 cost follower and grant it <link=keyword.Scout><sprite name=Scout><style=Keyword>Scout</style></link>.
cards.flavor:
"Lift the light from Mother Serpent
To the clouds, up from the waves.
The sky looks down, with gray eyes earnest,
A calm reflection of her gaze.
She smiles, is at peace..."
- prayer to Nagakaborous

cards.name: Sleight of Hand
cards.text: Plunder: Draw a random non-champion card from the enemy hand.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Plunder><style=Keyword>Plunder</style></link>: Draw a random non-champion card from the enemy hand.
cards.flavor: "Cards ain't about luck. It's about people. You get the folks across the table to doubt themselves? Might as well take all they've got there and then." - Twisted Fate

cards.name: Concerted Strike
cards.text: Pick an enemy. 2 allies strike it one after another.
cards.textHtml: Pick an enemy. 2 allies <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strike</style></link> it one after another.
cards.flavor: "With me, as one!" - Greenfang Warden

cards.name: Blinding Assault
cards.text: Summon Valor.
cards.textHtml: Summon <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Valor</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "He's in my hair! HE'S IN MY HAIR!" - Legion Marauder

cards.name: Loyal Badgerbear
cards.flavor: It's true what they say--pets look like their owners.

cards.name: Greenfang Warden
cards.flavor: "I swore an oath to protect this forest, and all who seek shelter within it."

cards.name: Unyielding Spirit
cards.text: Grant an ally "I can't take damage or die".
cards.textHtml: Grant an ally "I can't take damage or die".
cards.flavor: Ignoring the pain of her wounded leg, the ranger stood once more, sword aloft. It was not just her own resolve that kept her standing, but the resolve of Demacia itself.

cards.name: Quinn
cards.text: When I'm summoned, summon Valor.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, summon <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Valor</style></link>.
cards.levelup: I've seen you attack 4 times.
cards.flavor: "She's always been a fearless ranger-knight, our Quinn--and with Valor by her side and in the skies, the two are unstoppable." - Genevieve Elmheart, ranger-knight

cards.name: Quinn
cards.text: Attack: Summon Valor Challenging the strongest enemy.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Summon <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Valor</style></link> <link=keyword.Challenger><sprite name=Challenger><style=Keyword>Challenging</style></link> the <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> enemy.
cards.flavor: "I'll follow your lead, Valor!"

cards.name: Valor
cards.flavor: Those who meet him swear they see a glimmer of something more in those sharp eyes, a shrewd intelligence that far surpasses any ordinary bird of prey.

cards.name: Quinn's Blinding Assault
cards.text:
Summon Valor.
Create a Quinn in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
Summon <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Valor</style></link>.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Quinn</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "He's in my hair! HE'S IN MY HAIR!" - Legion Marauder

cards.name: Ranger's Resolve
cards.text: Give allies Tough this round.
cards.textHtml: Give allies <link=keyword.Tough><sprite name=Tough><style=Keyword>Tough</style></link> this round.
cards.flavor: "When the enemy draws near, do not let fear into your hearts, for the trees themselves protect us." - Greenfang Warden

cards.name: Greathorn Companion
cards.flavor: A ranger recruit spends months in the forest with their companions, learning to predict their stag's every move. They must be patient, but once the two have bonded, nothing can come between them.

cards.name: Grizzled Ranger
cards.text: Last Breath: Summon a Loyal Badgerbear.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>Last Breath</style></link>: Summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Loyal Badgerbear</style></link>.
cards.flavor: Betrand got his start in the Bandle Scouts. He got all the badges except for 'Cheerful Demeanor'."

cards.name: Genevieve Elmheart
cards.text: When I'm summoned, give other allies +1|+1 this round.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, give other allies +1|+1 this round.
cards.flavor: To see the rangers of Demacia in battle is inspiring. They fight as one--human and animal, side by side, fiercely determined and utterly inseparable.

cards.name: Ember Maiden
cards.text: Round Start: Deal 1 to EVERYTHING.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Deal 1 to EVERYTHING.
cards.flavor:
"They will till their fruitful fields,
They will weakly sow their seeds.
We will set 'most all aflame, 
Winter's Claw takes what it please!" - a Winter's Claw children's rhyme

cards.name: Sejuani
cards.text: Play: Give an enemy Frostbite and Vulnerable this round.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Give an enemy <link=keyword.Frostbite><sprite name=Frostbite><style=Keyword>Frostbite</style></link> and <link=keyword.Vulnerable><sprite name=Vulnerable><style=Keyword>Vulnerable</style></link> this round.
cards.levelup: You've damaged the enemy Nexus in 5+ different rounds.
cards.flavor: While her flail of True Ice is formidable, Sejuani herself is the weapon--forged in the bitter cold of the Freljord and tested against the freezing climes.

cards.name: Sejuani's Fury of the North
cards.text:
Give an ally +3|+4 this round.
Create a Sejuani in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
Give an ally +3|+4 this round.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Sejuani</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "Embrace the beast within!" - Sejuani

cards.name: Sejuani
cards.text:
Play: Give an enemy Frostbite and Vulnerable this round.
Each round, the first time you damage the enemy Nexus, Frostbite all enemies.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Give an enemy <link=keyword.Frostbite><sprite name=Frostbite><style=Keyword>Frostbite</style></link> and <link=keyword.Vulnerable><sprite name=Vulnerable><style=Keyword>Vulnerable</style></link> this round.
Each round, the first time you damage the enemy Nexus, <link=keyword.Frostbite><sprite name=Frostbite><style=Keyword>Frostbite</style></link> all enemies.
cards.flavor: "Lay them low! Show them the Freljord belongs to the Winter's Claw!"

cards.name: Aurora Porealis
cards.text: Create 2 random Poros and 2 Poro Snax in hand.
cards.textHtml: Create 2 random Poros and 2 <link=card.snaxRef><style=AssociatedCard>Poro Snax</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor:
"When you wish upon a poro,
An' look at da night sky,
You'll see da snax among da stars,
All sparkly in our eyes" - Ingvar the Younger

cards.name: Caught in the Cold
cards.text: Give an enemy Frostbite and Vulnerable this round.
cards.textHtml: Give an enemy <link=keyword.Frostbite><sprite name=Frostbite><style=Keyword>Frostbite</style></link> and <link=keyword.Vulnerable><sprite name=Vulnerable><style=Keyword>Vulnerable</style></link> this round.
cards.flavor: "These warmbloods wouldn't last a single day in the Freljord!" - Sejuani

cards.name: Ursine Spiritwalker
cards.text: Plunder: I transform into Stormclaw Ursine.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Plunder><style=Keyword>Plunder</style></link>: I transform into <link=card.transform><style=AssociatedCard>Stormclaw Ursine</style></link>.
cards.flavor: The Ursine begin as humans, but give up the familiar trappings of their mortal lives for the feral, savage power granted by the great spirit of the Volibear.

cards.name: Stormclaw Ursine
cards.text: Other allies with 5+ Power have Overwhelm.
cards.textHtml: Other allies with 5+ Power have <link=keyword.Overwhelm><sprite name=Overwhelm><style=Keyword>Overwhelm</style></link>.
cards.flavor: Fully unleashed, the Ursine shed their humanity and take on the power of the storm. They tear across the frozen steppes, their roars echoing like peals of thunder.

cards.name: Ruthless Raider
cards.flavor: The Winter's Claw has no equal in the Freljord, and all know the ferocity of these merciless raiders. Once their bloodlust takes over, one can only pray for a quick death.

cards.name: Fury of the North
cards.text: Give an ally +3|+4 this round.
cards.textHtml: Give an ally +3|+4 this round.
cards.flavor: "Embrace the beast within!" - Sejuani

cards.name: The Tuskraider
cards.text:
When I'm summoned, Draw Sejuani.
Plunder: Double the Power and Health of allies in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
When I'm summoned, Draw <link=card.champ1><style=AssociatedCard>Sejuani</style></link>.
<link=keyword.Plunder><style=Keyword>Plunder</style></link>: Double the Power and Health of allies in your deck.
cards.flavor: "When Spring brings weather just warm enough for us to plant, it also brings longboats... and the grain that started plentiful grows sparse." - Avarosan Hearthguard

cards.name: Wolfrider
cards.text: Plunder: Get an empty mana gem.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Plunder><style=Keyword>Plunder</style></link>: Get an empty mana gem.
cards.flavor: The young riders of the Winter's Claw are given a wolf pup the moment they can hold a weapon. Their upbringing is devoted entirely to battle--the wolf trained to savage and maim, and the rider to pillage and steal.

cards.name: Shared Spoils
cards.text:
Grant the top 3 units in your deck +1|+1.
Plunder: Draw 1 of them.
cards.textHtml:
Grant the top 3 units in your deck +1|+1.
<link=keyword.Plunder><style=Keyword>Plunder</style></link>: Draw 1 of them.
cards.flavor: "Share and share alike." - Ruthless Raider

cards.name: Claws of the Dragon
cards.text: While I'm in hand, summon me when you play 2 spells in a round.
cards.textHtml: While I'm in hand, summon me when you play 2 spells in a round. <style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor: "A student must listen with focus, for the Dragon roared the first sounds, and blessed our young spirits with the gift of magic." - Teachings of the Dragon

cards.name: Scales of the Dragon
cards.text: When I'm summoned, create a Dragon's Protection in hand.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Dragon's Protection</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: "A student must act with compassion, for the Dragon nurtured the First Lands, and graced them with warmth and life." - Teachings of the Dragon

cards.name: Dragon's Protection
cards.text: Grant an ally +0|+3.
cards.textHtml: Grant an ally +0|+3.
cards.flavor: "The Dragon will keep you safe." - Scales of the Dragon

cards.name: Eye of the Dragon
cards.text: Round Start: Flow: Summon a Dragonling.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: <link=vocab.Flow><style=Vocab>Flow</style></link>: Summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Dragonling</style></link><style=Variable></style>.
cards.flavor:
"A student must think with clarity, for the Dragon draws the sun across our skies, and reveals the world around us."
- Teachings of the Dragon

cards.name: Dragonling
cards.flavor: "The spirit gives to those who listen." - Eye of the Dragon

cards.name: Horns of the Dragon
cards.flavor: "A student must strive with all their might, for the Dragon pulled the earth from beneath the waves, and gave us a land to call home." - Teachings of the Dragon

cards.name: Concussive Palm
cards.text: Stun an enemy to summon a Tail of the Dragon.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> an enemy to summon a <link=card.cardRef><style=AssociatedCard>Tail of the Dragon</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "You did not see me leave, nor will you see me return." - Tail of the Dragon

cards.name: Tail of the Dragon
cards.text: When I'm Recalled, transform me into Concussive Palm.
cards.textHtml: When I'm <link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recalled</style></link>, transform me into <link=card.cardRef><style=AssociatedCard>Concussive Palm</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "A student must move with grace, for the Dragon's breath created the wind and waves which brought motion to our world." - Teachings of the Dragon

cards.name: Lee Sin
cards.text:
When you play a spell, give me Challenger this round.
If you play another, give me Barrier this round.
cards.textHtml:
When you play a spell, give me <link=keyword.Challenger><sprite name=Challenger><style=Keyword>Challenger</style></link> this round.
If you play another, give me <link=keyword.Barrier><sprite name=Barrier><style=Keyword>Barrier</style></link> this round.
cards.levelup: You've played 8+ spells.
cards.flavor: "The Dragon aids the worthy. To the weary, it gives vigor. To the sick, comfort. To the lost, light. To the shaken, balance..."

cards.name: Lee Sin
cards.text:
When you play a spell, give me Challenger this round.
If you play another, give me Barrier this round.
I Dragon's Rage enemies that I Challenge.
cards.textHtml:
When you play a spell, give me <link=keyword.Challenger><sprite name=Challenger><style=Keyword>Challenger</style></link> this round.
If you play another, give me <link=keyword.Barrier><sprite name=Barrier><style=Keyword>Barrier</style></link> this round.
I <link=card.attackSpell><style=AssociatedCard>Dragon's Rage</style></link> enemies that I <link=keyword.Challenger><sprite name=Challenger><style=Keyword>Challenge</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "...But for the tyrant, the Dragon breathes fire."

cards.name: Dragon's Rage
cards.text:
An ally kicks an enemy into the enemy Nexus, striking both.
If the enemy survives, Recall it.
cards.textHtml:
An ally kicks an enemy into the enemy Nexus, <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>striking</style></link> both.
If the enemy survives, <link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recall</style></link> it.
cards.flavor: "The Dragon must be unleashed, or it will consume me from within." - Lee Sin

cards.name: Dragon's Rage
cards.text:
An ally kicks an enemy into the enemy Nexus, striking the enemy then the enemy Nexus.
If the enemy survives, Recall it.
cards.textHtml:
An ally kicks an enemy into the enemy Nexus, <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>striking</style></link> the enemy then the enemy Nexus.
If the enemy survives, <link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recall</style></link> it.
cards.flavor: "The Dragon must be unleashed, or it will consume me from within." - Lee Sin

cards.name: Sonic Wave
cards.text:
Give an ally Challenger this round.
Create a Fleeting Resonating Strike in hand.
cards.textHtml:
Give an ally <link=keyword.Challenger><sprite name=Challenger><style=Keyword>Challenger</style></link> this round.
Create a <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> <link=card.secondSpell><style=AssociatedCard>Resonating Strike</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: "Master yourself..." - Lee Sin

cards.name: Resonating Strike
cards.text: Give an ally +2|+0 this round.
cards.textHtml: Give an ally +2|+0 this round.
cards.flavor: "...master the enemy." - Lee Sin

cards.name: Deep Meditation
cards.text:
Flow: I cost 2 less.
Draw 2 other spells.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Flow><style=Vocab>Flow</style></link>: I cost 2 less.
Draw 2 other spells.
cards.flavor: Meditation is a journey with no destination--a path that can only be followed by getting lost along the way.

cards.name: Retreat
cards.text: Recall an ally to create a Fleeting Return in hand.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recall</style></link> an ally to create a <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> <link=card.secondSpell><style=AssociatedCard>Return</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: The first Noxians to set foot on the Ionian beaches found a weak and unprepared enemy. Countless were slaughtered, but a handful managed to make their way to safety...

cards.name: Return
cards.text: Summon an ally that costs 3 or less from hand.
cards.textHtml: Summon an ally that costs 3 or less from hand.
cards.flavor: ...and how they rallied. The survivors soon gathered their forces, found their center, and showed the invaders the resilient spirit of the First Lands.

cards.name: Lee Sin's Sonic Wave
cards.text:
Give an ally Challenger this round.
Create a Fleeting Resonating Strike in hand.
Create a Lee Sin in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
Give an ally <link=keyword.Challenger><sprite name=Challenger><style=Keyword>Challenger</style></link> this round.
Create a <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> <link=card.secondSpell><style=AssociatedCard>Resonating Strike</style></link> in hand.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Lee Sin</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "Master yourself..." - Lee Sin

cards.name: The Leviathan
cards.text:
When I'm summoned, draw Swain.
Round Start: Deal 1 to the enemy Nexus twice.
cards.textHtml:
When I'm summoned, draw <link=card.champ1><style=AssociatedCard>Swain</style></link>.
<link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Deal 1 to the enemy Nexus twice.
cards.flavor: When the Ionian locals saw it looming on the horizon, they thought it a monster. They were not far from the truth--the steel warship is terrifying, the greatest feat of Noxian naval engineering yet.

cards.name: Aurok Glinthorn
cards.text: Attack: Stun all damaged enemies.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> all damaged enemies.
cards.flavor: “For generations, we have been subjugated. It was not until Noxus took our lands that we finally understood true freedom. That is why I fight for the empire.”

cards.name: Noxian Fervor
cards.text: Deal 3 to an ally to deal 3 to anything.
cards.textHtml: Deal 3 to an ally to deal 3 to anything.
cards.flavor: "Sacrifices must be made." - Jericho Swain

cards.name: Imperial Demolitionist
cards.text: Play: Deal 1 to an ally to deal 2 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.PlaySkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Play</style></link>: Deal 1 to an ally to deal 2 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: "Quick and quiet, 'til the boom."

cards.name: Black Powder Grenade
cards.text: Deal 1 to an ally to deal 2 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml: Deal 1 to an ally to deal 2 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: The hazards of using black powder are a small price to pay for tactical victory.

cards.name: Iron Ballista
cards.flavor: "A siege is easy, if you've the tools. The 'breakers bring 'em out, and the ballistae bring 'em down." - Siege Engineer

cards.name: Citybreaker
cards.text: Round Start: Deal 1 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Deal 1 to the enemy Nexus.
