cards.flavor: The elder’s voice was surprisingly calm. “What, pray tell,” he inquired, “is the point of gathering stones to build higher walls, when the Noxians always manage to toss them back over?”

cards.name: Swain
cards.text: Nexus Strike: Deal 3 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.NexusStrike><style=Vocab>Nexus Strike</style></link>: Deal 3 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.levelup: You've dealt 14+ non-combat damage.
cards.flavor: "A power beyond mortal understanding gave me the vision to see what most cannot. I peer through the darkness others fear."

cards.name: Swain's Ravenous Flock
cards.text:
Deal 4 to a unit if it's damaged or Stunned.
Create a Swain in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
Deal 4 to a unit if it's damaged or <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stunned</style></link>.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Swain</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: Listen. Can you hear them? The thunder of a thousand beating wings.

cards.name: Swain
cards.text:
When you deal non-combat damage to the enemy Nexus, Stun the strongest backrow enemy.
Nexus Strike: Deal 3 to all enemies and the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml:
When you deal non-combat damage to the enemy Nexus, <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> the <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> backrow enemy.
<link=vocab.NexusStrike><style=Vocab>Nexus Strike</style></link>: Deal 3 to all enemies and the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: "No sacrifice is too great to see my vision for Noxus fulfilled."

cards.name: Death's Hand
cards.text: Deal 2 to an enemy and 1 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml: Deal 2 to an enemy and 1 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: "Try to die with dignity." - Swain

cards.name: Ravenous Flock
cards.text: Deal 4 to a unit if it's damaged or Stunned.
cards.textHtml: Deal 4 to a unit if it's damaged or <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stunned</style></link>.
cards.flavor: Listen. Can you hear them? The thunder of a thousand beating wings.

cards.name: Armored Tuskrider
cards.text: Enemies with 4 or less Power cannot damage me.
cards.textHtml: Enemies with 4 or less Power cannot damage me.
cards.flavor: "There's no stopping a warbeast once it's in motion--best just to get out of the way." - Basilisk Rider

cards.name: Subpurrsible
cards.text:
When I'm summoned, draw 1.
Then, if you've played at least 10 other new cards this game, grant me +4|+0.
cards.textHtml:
When I'm summoned, draw 1.
Then, if you've played at least 10 other new cards this game, grant me +4|+0. <style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor: Nothing could stop his escape from those simpering humans. Not even a little water...

cards.name: Chief Mechanist Zevi
cards.text: When you draw a card, grant it Fleeting and create an exact copy of it in hand.
cards.textHtml: When you draw a card, grant it <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> and create an exact copy of it in hand.
cards.flavor: At age five, she made the world's first multi-frequency sonic knife. While not very practical (she mostly used it to slice sandwiches), it set her on her way to the Wardens' elite Armaments Department.

cards.name: Suit Up!
cards.text:
When drawn, I cost 2 less this round.
Grow an ally to 4|4.
cards.textHtml:
When drawn, I cost 2 less this round.
Grow an ally to 4|4.
cards.flavor: "Trouble at the docks! Take these, and give them my regards." - Chief Mechanist Zevi

cards.name: Vault Breaker
cards.text:
Give an ally +2|+0 this round.
Create a Fleeting Vault Breaker in hand.
cards.textHtml:
Give an ally +2|+0 this round.
Create a <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> <link=card.selfRef><style=AssociatedCard>Vault Breaker</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: "I let my hands do the talking." - Vi

cards.name: Patrol Wardens
cards.text: When I'm drawn, I cost 1 less this round.
cards.textHtml: When I'm drawn, I cost 1 less this round.
cards.flavor: Warden Mir's sprinting technique was a running joke among the other enforcers. Warden Kepple didn't get it.

cards.name: Gotcha!
cards.text:
When drawn, I cost 2 less this round.
Deal 3 to a unit.
cards.textHtml:
When drawn, I cost 2 less this round.
Deal 3 to a unit.
cards.flavor:
"Mind trying on these handcuffs, Mr. Berz?"
"What's in it for me?"
"You can keep them."
"...A'right then."
"You're under arrest. Take him away!"

cards.name: Insightful Investigator
cards.text: When you play a 2 cost card, draw 1 and grant it Fleeting.
cards.textHtml: When you play a 2 cost card, draw 1 and grant it <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "All detectives respond, but a good detective anticipates, and an exemplary detective prevents." - The Warden's Handbook

cards.name: Vi
cards.text: While I'm in play or in hand, grant me +1|+0 when you play another card (max +8|+0).
cards.textHtml: While I'm in play or in hand, grant me +1|+0 when you play another card (max +8|+0). <style=Variable></style>
cards.levelup: I've struck for 10+ damage in one strike.
cards.flavor: "Enforcer Vi, please! Think of the people! The collateral damage! The PAPERWORK FOR INJURY CLAIMS!" - Insightful Investigator

cards.name: Vi's Vault Breaker
cards.text:
Give an ally +2|+0 this round.
Create a Fleeting Vault Breaker in hand.
Create a Vi in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
Give an ally +2|+0 this round.
Create a <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> <link=card.selfRef><style=AssociatedCard>Vault Breaker</style></link> in hand.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Vi</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "I let my hands do the talking." - Vi

cards.name: Vi
cards.text: When I strike a unit while attacking, deal 5 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml: When I <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strike</style></link> a unit while attacking, deal 5 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: "So! Looks like your buddies are all tuckered out. You wanna tell me where you hid the hextech, or d'ya wanna make friends with the wall, too?"

cards.name: Trail of Evidence
cards.text: Create in hand a random 2 cost card from your regions. It costs 2 less this round.
cards.textHtml: Create in hand a random 2 cost card from your regions. It costs 2 less this round.
cards.flavor: "And thus," Officer Harknor announced, "the trail leads us to..."

cards.name: Veteran Investigator
cards.text: When I'm summoned, ALL players draw 1.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, ALL players draw 1.
cards.flavor: Some officers rely on their instincts to crack a case. Others lean on their contacts. But Officer J.S. Harknor's strength is pure diligence, and paperwork. Lots and lots of paperwork.

cards.name: Neverglade Collector
cards.text: When another ally dies, drain 1 from the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml: When another ally dies, <link=keyword.Drain><style=Keyword>drain</style></link> 1 from the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: "Bumped into Niven this... the new ferryman! He rowed us... to... He can certainly hold a tune! Before... must invite him to supper soon." - Recovered journal

cards.name: Overgrown Snapvine
cards.text: When you play a follower, kill it to summon an Overgrown Snapvine.
cards.textHtml: When you play a follower, kill it to summon an <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Overgrown Snapvine</style></link>.
cards.flavor:
"Today... another remarkable... surfaced around... children quite scared. But... posed no threat. Nuzzled... quite a trusting creature. Must forage them more berries!"
- Recovered journal

cards.name: Terror of the Tides
cards.text:
Sea Monster allies have Fearsome. 
Attack: Give enemies -2|-0 this round.
cards.textHtml:
Sea Monster allies have <link=keyword.Fearsome><sprite name=Fearsome><style=Keyword>Fearsome</style></link>. 
<link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Give enemies -2|-0 this round.
<style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor: They realized the danger too late. The titanic beast opened its gaping maw and surged toward them. The hunters could only wait for death as the endless teeth slowly crunched through their ship.

cards.name: Blighted Caretaker
cards.text: Play: Kill an ally to summon 2 Saplings.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Kill an ally to summon 2 <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Saplings</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "Every heart is a garden where roots may take hold!"

cards.name: Sap Magic
cards.text:
Toss 3.
Heal allies 3.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Toss><style=Vocab>Toss</style></link> 3.
Heal allies 3.
cards.flavor: "These Isles will be cleansed." - Maokai

cards.name: Barkbeast
cards.text: The first time an ally dies, grant me +2|+2.
cards.textHtml: The first time an ally dies, grant me +2|+2.
cards.flavor: The creatures of the Shadow Isles shed sentimentality long ago. They all must eat.

cards.name: Thorny Toad
cards.text: Last Breath: Toss 2 and heal your Nexus 2.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>Last Breath</style></link>: <link=vocab.Toss><style=Vocab>Toss</style></link> 2 and heal your Nexus 2.
cards.flavor: "...remarkable species… same creature I found as a child... not a day older! I wonder… next town. Perhaps these wonderful fellows will live forever!" - Recovered journal

cards.name: Maokai
cards.text: Each round, the first time you summon another ally, Toss 2 and summon a Sapling.
cards.textHtml: Each round, the first time you summon another ally, <link=vocab.Toss><style=Vocab>Toss</style></link> 2 and summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Sapling</style></link>.
cards.levelup: Your units have died or your cards have been Tossed 25+ times.
cards.flavor: These cursed lands would not break Maokai. The treant's commitment ran too deep, and his fury burned too bright, for anything to stand in his way.

cards.name: Maokai's Sap Magic
cards.text:
Toss 3.
Heal allies 3.
Create a Maokai in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Toss><style=Vocab>Toss</style></link> 3.
Heal allies 3.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Maokai</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "These Isles will be cleansed." - Maokai

cards.name: Maokai
cards.text:
When I level up, Obliterate the enemy deck, leaving 4 non-champions.
Round Start: Summon a Sapling.
cards.textHtml:
When I level up, <link=vocab.Obliterate><style=Vocab>Obliterate</style></link> the enemy deck, leaving 4 non-champions.
<link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Sapling</style></link>.
cards.flavor: He would destroy the blight within these isles, and restore its long-lost life.

cards.name: Sapling
cards.flavor: "Life here… so effortless. Verdant forests... to sprout overnight… quite exquisite. What a treasure this land is. Must preserve… generations." - Recovered journal

cards.name: Sapling Toss
cards.text: Summon a Sapling at the next Round Start.
cards.textHtml: Summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Sapling</style></link> at the next <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "Wheeeeeeee!" - Sapling

cards.name: Deadbloom Wanderer
cards.text: When I'm summoned, Toss 3.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, <link=vocab.Toss><style=Vocab>Toss</style></link> 3.
cards.flavor: "The great treant has continued showing... creatures. This one... to spread life as she wanders... remarkable such... here. These are Blessed Isles indeed!" - Recovered journal

cards.name: The Slaughter Docks
cards.text: Round Start: Toss 1. If you are Deep, destroy me to summon a random Sea Monster.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: <link=vocab.Toss><style=Vocab>Toss</style></link> 1. If you are <link=keyword.Deep><sprite name=Deep><style=Keyword>Deep</style></link>, destroy me to summon a random Sea Monster. <style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor: Every day, locals wander through the Slaughter Docks to see the horrors Bilgewater's hunters have hauled up from the depths. The beasts are usually dead. Usually.

cards.name: Lounging Lizard
cards.text: Round Start: Deal 2 to me.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Deal 2 to me.
cards.flavor: "Ah, people are stupid! Give them cold drink and warm chair, and they tell all kinds of secrets to friendly faces. And who has friendlier face than young Leonard, hmm?" - Fortune Croaker

cards.name: Wise Fry
cards.text: Play: Deal 1 to all other allies and grant me +1|+0 for each of them.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Deal 1 to all other allies and grant me +1|+0 for each of them.
cards.flavor: The rise to power is often a violent business... but it's not normally this freakin' sloppy.

cards.name: Tahm Kench
cards.text: When I'm summoned or Round Start: Create an An Acquired Taste in hand.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned or <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Create an <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>An Acquired Taste</style></link> in hand.
cards.levelup: I've Captured 3+ units. When I level up, Obliterate my Captured enemies and release my allies.
cards.flavor: "My friend, I know that expression. I can see you feelin' like the cards you're holdin' ain't the ones you deserve. You got a desire for the finer things, don'tcha? Perhaps you'll allow me to satisfy your hunger, let you savor all that you ever desired. All I need is your name, scratched on my paper... and you, my friend, will be satisfied for life."

cards.name: An Acquired Taste
cards.text: Tahm Kench swallows an enemy unit. It strikes him, then he Captures it.
cards.textHtml: <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Tahm Kench</style></link> swallows an enemy unit. It <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strikes</style></link> him, then he <link=keyword.Capture><sprite name=Capture><style=Keyword>Captures</style></link> it.
cards.flavor: "You had a chance to walk away. Instead, you're the fool who let me in..." - Tahm Kench

cards.name: Tahm Kench
cards.text:
When I'm summoned or Round Start: Create an An Acquired Taste in hand.
Attack: Obliterate my Captured enemies and release my allies.
cards.textHtml:
When I'm summoned or <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Create an <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>An Acquired Taste</style></link> in hand.
<link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: <link=vocab.Obliterate><style=Vocab>Obliterate</style></link> my <link=keyword.Capture><sprite name=Capture><style=Keyword>Captured</style></link> enemies and release my allies.
cards.flavor: "You struck a deal, my friend, and though you will undoubtedly bask in its benefits, remember... there will be a time when I get my fill, too."

cards.name: Tahm Kench's Bayou Brunch
cards.text:
An ally Captures another ally and gains the captured ally's stats.
Create a Tahm Kench in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
An ally <link=keyword.Capture><sprite name=Capture><style=Keyword>Captures</style></link> another ally and gains the captured ally's stats.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Tahm Kench</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "Step inside, friend, and all that you desire shall be yours in perpetuity." - Tahm Kench

cards.name: Sunk Cost
cards.text: Place a unit or landmark into its deck.
cards.textHtml: Place a unit or landmark into its deck.
cards.flavor: "Now, I delivered to you exactly what you wanted, friend. I never said it would last forever." - Tahm Kench

cards.name: Jack, the Winner
cards.text: Round Start: Create a Sleep with the Fishes in hand.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Sleep with the Fishes</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: Years in the boxing ring taught Jack valuable lessons. He learned that if his opponent can bleed, they can fear. He learned the power of a silent stare. He learned the power of uncontrolled violence.

cards.name: Sleep with the Fishes
cards.text: Deal 2 to an ally to deal 2 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml: Deal 2 to an ally to deal 2 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: "Daub 'em with your blood, and set the sharks loose." - Jack, the Winner

cards.name: Boxtopus
cards.text: Play: Deal 3 to me.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Deal 3 to me.
cards.flavor: "Sure, Pablo might be in a bit of a 'dry patch'--heh--and, yeah, he's taken his fair share of punches... but ya know what? Ain't nobody else around here getting octokills, pal." - Wise Fry

cards.name: Fortune Croaker
cards.text: Play: Deal 1 to me and an ally to draw 1.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Deal 1 to me and an ally to draw 1.
cards.flavor: "Ol' Babs has had a few mishaps. Killed a few locals in her time, but I s'pose it helps lend her an air of authenticity." - Lounging Lizard

cards.name: Shakedown
cards.text: Deal 2 to an ally to grant 2 enemies Vulnerable.
cards.textHtml: Deal 2 to an ally to grant 2 enemies <link=keyword.Vulnerable><sprite name=Vulnerable><style=Keyword>Vulnerable</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "You gonna tell me where you got those 'extra kegs', Slim? Huh? Otherwise, we could play a lil' tug-of-war between your tongue and Jimbo's arm. And buddy... I ain't bettin' on you." - Wise Fry

cards.name: Bayou Brunch
cards.text: An ally Captures another ally and gains the captured ally's stats.
cards.textHtml: An ally <link=keyword.Capture><sprite name=Capture><style=Keyword>Captures</style></link> another ally and gains the captured ally's stats.
cards.flavor: "Step inside, friend, and all that you desire shall be yours in perpetuity." - Tahm Kench

cards.name: Monkey Business
cards.text:
Summon a Powder Monkey.
Plunder: Summon another at the next Round Start.
cards.textHtml:
Summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Powder Monkey</style></link>.
<link=keyword.Plunder><style=Keyword>Plunder</style></link>: Summon another at the next <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "Aw... d'ye think they're cute? WELL, THEY'RE NOT. They get into everything, they're messier than a seasick courier, an' THEY WON'T BLOODY SHUT UP. NO MONKEYS ON THE SHIP. THAT'S THE END OF IT." - Petty Officer

cards.name: Crusty Codger
cards.text: Play: Deal 2 to me.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Deal 2 to me.
cards.flavor: "RING THE BELL, WILL YA?! AH'LL SHOW THAT POINTY FART WHY AH'VE GOT ALL MA NICKNAMES, AYE. 'EIGHT PUNCH PABLO', 'THE CRACKIN' KRAKEN', 'THE TENTACLED TERROR'! YOUR WEE STINGER'S GONNA BE CRYING FOR YA MAMMIE BY THE TIME AH'M DONE WI' YA!" - Boxtopus

cards.name: Boomship
cards.text:
Deal 1 to a unit.
Summon Powder Kegs equal to the amount of damage dealt.
cards.textHtml:
Deal 1 to a unit.
Summon <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Powder Kegs</style></link> equal to the amount of damage dealt.
cards.flavor: "Young Gerent raised the alarm right afore the first one blew. Our hull rocked, the jib caught flame, but the Jilldaw held. Thought that was that, but as I followed Gerent's gaze out to sea, I saw me four more rowboats comin' our way, all loaded with powder." - Jilldaw survivor

cards.name: Wiggly Burblefish
cards.text:
I cost 1 less for each spell you've played this game.
When I'm summoned, create in hand a random 1 cost spell from your regions.
cards.textHtml:
I cost 1 less for each spell you've played this game.
When I'm summoned, create in hand a random 1 cost spell from your regions.
cards.flavor: "Stand stwait, noobie! Your mishun is to infiltrate behind emenee lines, plant as many bubbels as you can, an' tell us evewythin' you SEE! E-VE-WEE-THIN'. DO YOU UNNASTAN'?!" - Admiwal Shelly, Shellshocker

cards.name: Powder Pandemonium
cards.text: Summon a Powder Monkey for each time you've activated Plunder this game.
cards.textHtml: Summon a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Powder Monkey</style></link> for each time you've activated <link=keyword.Plunder><style=Keyword>Plunder</style></link> this game. <style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor: "Oh, those little sootballs aren't so bad. Here's a tip for you--they like fireworks. So, you take out an enemy's gunpowder stores, and the monkeys, well, they'll do the rest." - Miss Fortune

cards.name: Confront
cards.text:
Grant an ally Challenger.
If it's a Dragon, draw 1.
cards.textHtml:
Grant an ally <link=keyword.Challenger><sprite name=Challenger><style=Keyword>Challenger</style></link>.
If it's a Dragon, draw 1.
cards.flavor: "None shall escape us!" - Shyvana

cards.name: Strafing Strike
cards.text: An ally and an enemy strike each other. Then, if the ally is a Dragon, heal it 5.
cards.textHtml: An ally and an enemy <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strike</style></link> each other. Then, if the ally is a Dragon, heal it 5.
cards.flavor: When knight and dragon separated, panting and wounded, the latter seemed reinvigorated. It smelled blood, and was eager for more.

cards.name: Dragonguard Lookout
cards.text: When I'm summoned, if you Behold a Dragon, Rally.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, if you <link=vocab.Behold><style=Vocab>Behold</style></link> a Dragon, <link=vocab.Rally><style=Vocab>Rally</style></link>.
cards.flavor:
"There in the distance! Is that...?"
"Looks like it."
"How can you be sure?"
"Oh, there's no mistaking them. Cover your ears. This will be loud." - Anden and Yessenia

cards.name: Captain Arrika
cards.text: Play: Capture a unit or landmark.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.PlaySkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Play</style></link>: <link=keyword.Capture><sprite name=Capture><style=Keyword>Capture</style></link> a unit or landmark.
cards.flavor: As a child, Arrika saw firsthand the devastation Noxus could inflict as it laid waste to her home. When she enlisted in the military, she vowed never to let the Noxian flag fly over Demacian land, or leave another child orphaned.

cards.name: Claim
cards.text: Capture a unit or landmark.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Capture><sprite name=Capture><style=Keyword>Capture</style></link> a unit or landmark.
cards.flavor: "Take back what is ours!" - Captain Arrika

cards.name: Egghead Researcher
cards.text: When I'm summoned, create a random Dragon in hand.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, create a random Dragon in hand.
cards.flavor:
Dragon Egg (Screeching Dragon, Draco Murmurationis) 
Location: Recovered by researcher Anden Mayne on Expedition. 
Notes: Gestation period unknown. Incubation continued. Recent movement observed within shell. Egg responds to heat, light, hammer. Current studies inconclusive. 
- Notes of Anden Mayne, Egghead Researcher

cards.name: Screeching Dragon
cards.flavor: All creatures are fiercely protective of their young, but few are as well equipped to deal with would-be threats as a dragon.

cards.name: Kadregrin the Infernal
cards.text: When I'm summoned, grant other Dragon allies everywhere +4|+4.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, grant other Dragon allies <link=vocab.Everywhere><style=Vocab>everywhere</style></link> +4|+4.
cards.flavor: When Demacia underwent a sudden spate of dragon attacks, Shyvana knew that Kadregrin the Infernal was to blame. Other dragons, inspired by his bold nature and powerful flame, drove the Demacians to fear.

cards.name: Dragonguard Lieutenant
cards.text: When I'm summoned, if you Behold a Dragon, grant me Challenger.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, if you <link=vocab.Behold><style=Vocab>Behold</style></link> a Dragon, grant me <link=keyword.Challenger><sprite name=Challenger><style=Keyword>Challenger</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "When I lost my comrades in arms at Wrenwall, I thought I had also lost my resolve... but it turns out there is nothing that a fight can't stir up in an old soldier."

cards.name: The Grand Plaza
cards.text: When an ally is summoned, give it +1|+1 and Challenger this round.
cards.textHtml: When an ally is summoned, give it +1|+1 and <link=keyword.Challenger><sprite name=Challenger><style=Keyword>Challenger</style></link> this round.
cards.flavor: Tianna looked out over the assembly, assessing the gathered ranks. The only sound in the square was her banner snapping in the breeze. She gave a curt nod of approval, then lifted the banner with a shout. "Who among you is ready to fight for Demacia?" The resounding cry from all those assembled shook the very mountains.

cards.name: Shyvana
cards.text: Attack: Give me +1|+1 this round.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Give me +1|+1 this round.
cards.levelup: Dragon allies have dealt 16+ damage.
cards.flavor:
"On the one hand, she is, by her very nature, our most hated foe, her kind having historically brought only anguish to Demacia. On the other, she is trusted by the Prince, and seems to have all the makings of a determined soldier and valuable ally. I only hope that she does not betray the trust we have placed in her."
- Page from Lieutenant Jerik's account on Wrenwall

cards.name: Dragon Shyvana
cards.text: Attack: Give me +2|+2 this round and create a Fleeting 2 cost Strafing Strike in hand.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Give me +2|+2 this round and create a <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> 2 cost <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Strafing Strike</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor:
"The first time I witnessed her transformation, I beheld her with revulsion. There was Yvva, replete in fire and fury! If only I had known then what I know now--that she would become our sister in arms, an exemplary soldier... and my dear, dear friend."
- Page from Lieutenant Jerik's account on Wrenwall

cards.name: Shyvana's Confront
cards.text:
Grant an ally Challenger. 
If it's a Dragon, draw 1.
Create a Shyvana in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
Grant an ally <link=keyword.Challenger><sprite name=Challenger><style=Keyword>Challenger</style></link>. 
If it's a Dragon, draw 1.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Shyvana</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "None shall escape us!" - Shyvana

cards.name: For The Fallen
cards.text:
When you summon an Elite, reduce my cost by 1.
For each ally that died this round, summon a Dauntless Vanguard.
cards.textHtml:
When you summon an Elite, reduce my cost by 1.
For each ally that died this round, summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Dauntless Vanguard</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "If a soldier falls, another must take their place. Our banner must never fall." - Garen

cards.name: Stalking Broodmother
cards.flavor: "Careful, soldiers! If we tread carefully and don't disturb the nest, we can keep the mother dragon on the defensive. If we rile her up any further... Well, you'll want to be ready to run." - Anden Mayne, Egghead Researcher

cards.name: Sharpsight
cards.text: Give an ally +1|+2 and Sharpsight this round.
cards.textHtml: Give an ally +1|+2 and <link=keyword.Sharpsight><sprite name=BlockElusive><style=Keyword>Sharpsight</style></link> this round.
cards.flavor: Any who would dare breach Demacia's walls will find a full company awaiting them--forewarned and heavily armed.

cards.name: Stony Suppressor
cards.text: ALL spells cost 1 more.
cards.textHtml: ALL spells cost 1 more.
cards.flavor: What begins as a shapeless, rough-hewn block of petricite quickly becomes something more under the clever hands of its sculptor. That is when a piece truly starts to come to life.

cards.name: Molten Breath
cards.text: An ally with Fury strikes the 2 weakest enemies one after another.
cards.textHtml: An ally with <link=keyword.Fury><sprite name=Fury><style=Keyword>Fury</style></link> <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strikes</style></link> the 2 <link=keyword.Weakest><style=Keyword>weakest</style></link> enemies one after another.
cards.flavor: For centuries, the Demacians only knew of a dragon's fury through legend. Wrenwall changed that.

cards.name: Troll Chant
cards.text: Give an ally +0|+2 to give an enemy -2|-0 this round.
cards.textHtml: Give an ally +0|+2 to give an enemy -2|-0 this round.
cards.flavor: Troll chants are highly varied. They differ from group to group, and are often incomprehensible. They are all, however, terrifying to witness.

cards.name: It That Stares
cards.text: Play: Obliterate ALL landmarks or deal 3 to ALL other units.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.PlaySkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Play</style></link>: <link=vocab.Obliterate><style=Vocab>Obliterate</style></link> ALL landmarks or deal 3 to ALL other units.
cards.flavor: "There was no time to gather our things or warn the others. We could only run for the forest and watch as it leveled our homes." - Avarosan Hearthguard

cards.name: Destructive Ray
cards.text: Obliterate ALL landmarks.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Obliterate><style=Vocab>Obliterate</style></link> ALL landmarks.
cards.flavor: The earth shall break.

cards.name: Extinguishing Ray
cards.text: Deal 3 to ALL other units.
cards.textHtml: Deal 3 to ALL other units.
cards.flavor: The people shall perish.

cards.name: Revitalizing Roar
cards.text:
Pick a unit in hand to reveal. Heal your Nexus equal to its Power.
Enlightened: Reduce its cost to 0.
cards.textHtml:
Pick a unit in hand to reveal. Heal your Nexus equal to its Power.
<link=keyword.Enlightened><style=Keyword>Enlightened</style></link>: Reduce its cost to 0.
cards.flavor: "Fully grown trolls have thick hides and dense bones that heal quickly, making them terrible, tenacious foes. Cut them down quickly, lest they recover to fight again another day." - Avarosan Marksman

cards.name: Troll Ravager
cards.text: When I'm summoned, if you Behold an 8+ cost card, grant me Regeneration.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, if you <link=vocab.Behold><style=Vocab>Behold</style></link> an 8+ cost card, grant me <link=keyword.Regeneration><sprite name=Regeneration><style=Keyword>Regeneration</style></link>.
cards.flavor: Once they were among the Avarosan huts, they called Hgar forward. With a laugh, she raised Snowsunder, ready to use the weapon to batter the wooden homes into little more than splinters.

cards.name: Trundle
cards.text: When I'm summoned, create an Ice Pillar in hand.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, create an <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Ice Pillar</style></link> in hand.
cards.levelup: I've seen you play Ice Pillar.
cards.flavor:
One by one, torches lit along the pass, throwing the scene into sharp relief. There were dozens of trolls, maybe hundreds, each one hulking, massive, and deadly.
"I'll ask one more time," Trundle snarled, hefting Boneshiver over one shoulder. "Are you gonna give up, or am I gonna have to break your skulls?"

cards.name: Ice Pillar
cards.text:
Play: Refill 8 mana.
Play and Round Start: Give the strongest enemy Vulnerable this round.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Refill 8 mana.
<link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link> and <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Give the <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> enemy <link=keyword.Vulnerable><sprite name=Vulnerable><style=Keyword>Vulnerable</style></link> this round.
cards.flavor: "Haha! You didn't see that coming!" - Trundle

cards.name: Trundle
cards.text:
When I'm summoned, create an Ice Pillar in hand.
Attack: Grant me +1|+0 for each 8+ cost card you Behold.
cards.textHtml:
When I'm summoned, create an <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Ice Pillar</style></link> in hand.
<link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Grant me +1|+0 for each 8+ cost card you <link=vocab.Behold><style=Vocab>Behold</style></link>.
cards.flavor: The Avarosans refused. Trundle gestured, and, like an avalanche, the trolls descended with such momentum that it carried them on for miles afterward, deep into the Avarosan tribelands, battering and breaking everything in their path without reserve.

cards.name: Trundle's Icequake
cards.text:
Give ALL units -3|-0 this round. Deal 3 to ALL units.
Create a Trundle in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
Give ALL units -3|-0 this round. Deal 3 to ALL units.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Trundle</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "Bury 'em alive!" - Trundle

cards.name: Troll Scavenger
cards.text: When I'm summoned, if you Behold an 8+ cost card, grant me +3|+0.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, if you <link=vocab.Behold><style=Vocab>Behold</style></link> an 8+ cost card, grant me +3|+0.
cards.flavor:
The scout knelt by a tattered edge of cloth hidden in the snow, where the scent of human sweat and fire smoke lingered in the cold air.
He pulled the material free and saw at one end, a talisman dangled, dull under the stormy sky. Avarosan.

cards.name: Icequake
cards.text: Give ALL units -3|-0 this round. Deal 3 to ALL units.
cards.textHtml: Give ALL units -3|-0 this round. Deal 3 to ALL units.
cards.flavor: "Bury 'em alive!" - Trundle

cards.name: The Howling Abyss
cards.text: Round Start: Create in hand a random level 2 champion that's not in hand, deck, or play.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Create in hand a random level 2 champion that's not in hand, deck, or play.
cards.flavor: Heroes come to the bridge, called to it by something from the unknown. They brave its bitter cold and crumbling deck to see what lies beyond--victory, or death.

cards.name: Faces of the Old Ones
cards.text: Round Start: If you Behold an 8+ cost card, get an extra mana gem this round.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: If you <link=vocab.Behold><style=Vocab>Behold</style></link> an 8+ cost card, get an extra mana gem this round.
cards.flavor:
"Rise, Old Ones, rise,
Rule of ice, break the sky.
Rise, Old Ones, rise,
Bring us strength, them demise."
- Troll chant

cards.name: Uzgar the Ancient
cards.flavor:
They felt it before they heard it, the ground trembling beneath their feet, but it quickly became audible, like distant thunder drawing closer.
Meyrick lifted his head, eyes wide, listening.
"What is it?" Anya whispered urgently, drawing her bow, but Meyrick was already sprinting back toward the path. 
"RUN!"

cards.name: Augur of the Old Ones
cards.text: Play: If you Behold an 8+ cost card, grant an ally Overwhelm and Regeneration.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: If you <link=vocab.Behold><style=Vocab>Behold</style></link> an 8+ cost card, grant an ally <link=keyword.Overwhelm><sprite name=Overwhelm><style=Keyword>Overwhelm</style></link> and <link=keyword.Regeneration><sprite name=Regeneration><style=Keyword>Regeneration</style></link>.
cards.flavor: It is said that very few trolls are taught the chants of the Old Ones, and that those who know them can call on their forebears to imbue their brethren with exceptional strength.

cards.name: Call the Wild
cards.text: For the top 4 cards in your deck, draw each Yeti, Poro, and Elnuk. Then place the rest into your deck.
cards.textHtml: For the top 4 cards in your deck, draw each Yeti, Poro, and Elnuk. Then place the rest into your deck.
cards.flavor: "...an' then a BIIIIG HUUUGE ELNUK came FLYIN' out of the trees with a teeny lil' poro on his back an' there was a FRIENDLY YETI as well because he wanted to play with his friends an' they all ran down the mountain goin' RAAAAAWRRRR an' then..." - Ingvar the Younger

cards.name: Voices of the Old Ones
cards.text:
Get 2 empty mana gems.
For the top 5 cards in your deck, draw each card that costs 8+. Then place the rest into your deck.
cards.textHtml:
Get 2 empty mana gems.
For the top 5 cards in your deck, draw each card that costs 8+. Then place the rest into your deck.
cards.flavor: For generations, Avarosan settlers heard strange, inexplicable sounds within the tumult of winter storms. Eventually, when they ventured much farther north, they finally discovered the source--ancient troll monoliths whispering in long-lost tongues as the wind swept through their yawning maws.

cards.name: The Scargrounds
cards.text: When an ally survives damage, grant it +1|+0 and Tough.
cards.textHtml: When an ally survives damage, grant it +1|+0 and <link=keyword.Tough><sprite name=Tough><style=Keyword>Tough</style></link>.
cards.flavor: There are many places of honor among the Winter's Claw, but one of the greatest is The Scargrounds, where damaged war vessels that have returned from raids are repurposed as gathering halls for warriors and their kin. These ships embody the tribe that built them--resilient and adaptable.

cards.name: Feel The Rush
cards.text: Summon 2 different, random champions from your hand and deck. Grow their stats up to 10|10.
cards.textHtml: Summon 2 different, random champions from your hand and deck. Grow their stats up to 10|10.
cards.flavor:
"We got it all in our hands now
So can you handle what we're all about?"
- Ahri, 'POP/STARS'

cards.name: Troll Gifts
cards.text: Grant an ally Regeneration. If they already have it, grant them +2|+2 instead.
cards.textHtml: Grant an ally <link=keyword.Regeneration><sprite name=Regeneration><style=Keyword>Regeneration</style></link>. If they already have it, grant them +2|+2 instead.
cards.flavor: Pity those who see the promise of victory in a troll's blood.

cards.name: Flower Child
cards.text: When I'm supported, grant me +2|+0.
cards.textHtml: When I'm supported, grant me +2|+0.
cards.flavor: Everyone wants a familiar, but no one's prepared for the responsibility. You've gotta take them on walkies, make sure they're eating a balanced diet... house-train them. It's a lot of work.

cards.name: Lulu
cards.text: Support: My supported ally grows up to 4|4 this round.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Support><style=Keyword>Support</style></link>: My supported ally grows up to 4|4 this round.
cards.levelup: Allies have been supported 3+ times.
cards.flavor: "Don't you worry, Pix! We're gonna get outta the Glade, and we're gonna adoribus ALL THE THINGS! Are you ready?!"

cards.name: Lulu
cards.text:
Round Start: Create a Fleeting Help, Pix! in hand.
Support: My supported ally grows up to 5|5 this round.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Create a <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Help, Pix!</style></link> in hand.
<link=keyword.Support><style=Keyword>Support</style></link>: My supported ally grows up to 5|5 this round.
cards.flavor: "Oooh! Look, Pix! It's a whole different world out here! Now let's give it lots of colors!"

cards.name: Help, Pix!
cards.text: Give an ally Barrier or an enemy Vulnerable this round.
cards.textHtml: Give an ally <link=keyword.Barrier><sprite name=Barrier><style=Keyword>Barrier</style></link> or an enemy <link=keyword.Vulnerable><sprite name=Vulnerable><style=Keyword>Vulnerable</style></link> this round.
cards.flavor: Pix protec... or Pix attac...?

cards.name: Lulu's Whimsy!
cards.text: Transform a follower into a 1|1 Squirrel and Silence it this round. Create a Lulu in your deck.
cards.textHtml: Transform a follower into a 1|1 <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Squirrel</style></link> and <link=vocab.Silence><style=Vocab>Silence</style></link> it this round. Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Lulu</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "Adoribus!" - Lulu

cards.name: Fae Guide
cards.text: Play: Grant an ally Elusive.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Grant an ally <link=keyword.Elusive><sprite name=Elusive><style=Keyword>Elusive</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "Shh! This way! We've gotta make a sharp left after the walking treehouse, then go straight past the talking flowers. Lu, you listening to me? Lu? Lu! LULU! Do. NOT. Feed them. Do not do that."

cards.name: Homecoming
cards.text: Recall an ally unit or landmark to Recall an enemy unit or landmark.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recall</style></link> an ally unit or landmark to <link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recall</style></link> an enemy unit or landmark.
cards.flavor: "Trevvvvorrrrrr, come baaaack..." - Trevor's house

cards.name: Monastery of Hirana
cards.text: Round Start: Create a Sanctuary in hand.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Sanctuary</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: The Ionian mountains hide a handful of sanctuaries for those looking to center themselves and gather their spirits.

cards.name: Trevor Snoozebottom
cards.text: Support: Create an attacking Mumblesprite with my supported ally's stats.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Support><style=Keyword>Support</style></link>: Create an attacking <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Mumblesprite</style></link> with my supported ally's stats.
cards.flavor: You're supposed to follow your dreams, not manifest them through inadvertent muttered conjuration as you sleep-float through an ancient magical forest. I mean SHEESH.

cards.name: Mumblesprite
cards.flavor: Another mumblesprite burst out, its eyes full of devilish mischief. "No more cheese for Trevor!" Bri announced. The others all nodded.

cards.name: Whimsy!
cards.text: Transform a follower into a 1|1 Squirrel and Silence it this round.
cards.textHtml: Transform a follower into a 1|1 <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Squirrel</style></link> and <link=vocab.Silence><style=Vocab>Silence</style></link> it this round.
cards.flavor: "Adoribus!" - Lulu

cards.name: Squirrel
cards.flavor: A fae flash knocked him to the floor! Newly keen ears heard a yordle's fading laughter, and he looked down to see furry paws, attached to furry arms...

cards.name: Tasty Faefolk
cards.flavor: Energy: 104kJ (25 kcal), Carbohydrates: 5.88g, Sugars: 3.53g, Dietary Fiber: 3g, Fat: 0.18g, Protein: 0.98g, Water: 92g...

cards.name: Young Witch
cards.text: Support: Give my supported ally Quick Attack and +1|+0 this round.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Support><style=Keyword>Support</style></link>: Give my supported ally <link=keyword.Quick Strike><sprite name=QuickStrike><style=Keyword>Quick Attack</style></link> and +1|+0 this round.
cards.flavor: Sir Ribery Montague left home hoping to complete some great quest or curry favor with a notable house. But fate led him to a hidden bandlewood, where young Bri quickly transformed Sir Ribery into a frog, and yanked him off on HER adventures. Poor Rib!

cards.name: Swole Squirrel
cards.text: Strike: Double my Power.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>Strike</style></link>: Double my Power.
cards.flavor: His secret is acorn powder shakes, four times a day.

cards.name: Sanctuary
cards.text: Recall an ally.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recall</style></link> an ally.
cards.flavor: "The monastery welcomes all who seek refuge." - Elder Souma

cards.name: Pix!
cards.text: Support: Give my supported ally +2|+1 this round.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Support><style=Keyword>Support</style></link>: Give my supported ally +2|+1 this round.
cards.flavor:
"Pix is AWESOME, he's small and cool and wholesome,
His favorite things are possums, and he likes to... hrmhmhmhrmthrossom!" - Lulu

cards.name: Fuzzy Caretaker
cards.text:
When I'm supported, give me +0|+3 this round.
Support: Give my supported ally +3|+0 this round.
cards.textHtml:
When I'm supported, give me +0|+3 this round.
<link=keyword.Support><style=Keyword>Support</style></link>: Give my supported ally +3|+0 this round.
cards.flavor: The purple faefolk are sweet little creatures, and cared for by all those who encounter them. Well, almost all.

cards.name: Singular Will
cards.text: Pick an ally. Recall ALL other units and landmarks.
cards.textHtml: Pick an ally. <link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recall</style></link> ALL other units and landmarks.
cards.flavor: "I walk my path alone." - Solitary Monk

cards.name: Nopeify!
cards.text: Stop a Fast or Slow spell that costs 3 or less.
cards.textHtml: Stop a <link=keyword.Fast><sprite name=Fast><style=Keyword>Fast</style></link> or <link=keyword.Slow><sprite name=Slow><style=Keyword>Slow</style></link> spell that costs 3 or less.
cards.flavor: "Don't do that, you silly smufflefloof! You might hurt the antylopes!" - Lulu

cards.name: Go Get It
cards.text: Recall an ally to summon an exact Ephemeral copy in its place. Reduce its cost to 0 this round.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recall</style></link> an ally to summon an exact <link=keyword.Ephemeral><sprite name=Ephemeral><style=Keyword>Ephemeral</style></link> copy in its place. Reduce its cost to 0 this round.
cards.flavor:
"More
Know I got it,
So here you go,
You look like you could use some more."
- Akali, 'MORE'

cards.name: Flurry of Fists
cards.text: Grant an ally +1|+0 and Quick Attack. If it already has it, grant it Double Attack instead.
cards.textHtml: Grant an ally +1|+0 and <link=keyword.Quick Strike><sprite name=QuickStrike><style=Keyword>Quick Attack</style></link>. If it already has it, grant it <link=keyword.Double Strike><sprite name=DoubleStrike><style=Keyword>Double Attack</style></link> instead.
cards.flavor: "Hit often, hit fast, and hit hard." - Horns of the Dragon

cards.name: Sneaky Zeebles
cards.text: Play: Stun enemies with 2 or less Power.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.PlaySkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Play</style></link>: <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> enemies with 2 or less Power.
cards.flavor: Through the crystalline silence of the mountainside came the tinkling sounds of falling ice and, far above them, what the travelers could have sworn was... laughter.

cards.name: Mischief
cards.text: Stun enemies with 2 or less Power.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> enemies with 2 or less Power.
cards.flavor: "Hahahaha, lookit 'em GO! They're just. So. Fast! Is your head spinning too?!" - Zoe

cards.name: The Skies Descend
cards.text: I cost 2 less for each Dragon or Celestial ally you have. Deal 15 to all enemies.
cards.textHtml: I cost 2 less for each Dragon or Celestial ally you have. Deal 15 to all enemies.
cards.flavor: "When the time comes, I think I'll make an example of Runeterra. Perhaps I'll drag its smoldering husk around with me for all eternity. Like a toy. A dead, worthless toy. I don't know. I've not really thought about it much." - Aurelion Sol

cards.name: Dragon's Clutch
cards.text: Draw 2 different Dragons or grant Dragon allies +1|+1 and Overwhelm.
cards.textHtml: Draw 2 different Dragons or grant Dragon allies +1|+1 and <link=keyword.Overwhelm><sprite name=Overwhelm><style=Keyword>Overwhelm</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "Their cry sounds like a raspy cat. If you ever hear it, you're to turn tail, and find the nearest guard. You hear? Because where there's dragon eggs, there's dragons." - Targonian forager

cards.name: Hatched Egg
cards.text: Draw 2 different Dragons.
cards.textHtml: Draw 2 different Dragons.
cards.flavor:
Dragon egg (Screeching Dragon, Draco murmurationis)
Notes: Shell weakened on last turning. Increased movement inside. Cracks on surface superficial?
Scribbled Notes: EGG HATCHING!
- Notes of Anden Mayne, Egghead Researcher

cards.name: Crushed Egg
cards.text: Grant Dragon allies +1|+1 and Overwhelm.
cards.textHtml: Grant Dragon allies +1|+1 and <link=keyword.Overwhelm><sprite name=Overwhelm><style=Keyword>Overwhelm</style></link>.
cards.flavor:
Dragon egg (Screeching Dragon, Draco murmurationis)
Notes: Shell weakened on last turning. Increased movement inside. Cracks on surface superficial?
Scribbled Notes: EGG HATCHING!
- Notes of Anden Mayne, Egghead Researcher

cards.name: Moonsilver
cards.text: Reduce the cost of a card in hand by 1.
cards.textHtml: Reduce the cost of a card in hand by 1.
cards.flavor: "Each full moon bathes our world in Her silver glow, revealing paths not yet trod, stories not yet told." - Lunari Priestess

cards.name: Divergent Paths
cards.text: Draw a landmark or destroy a landmark.
cards.textHtml: Draw a landmark or destroy a landmark.
cards.flavor: Targon is a capricious place, where the unbreakable is broken, and the broken made whole.

cards.name: Path of Discovery
cards.text: Draw a landmark.
cards.textHtml: Draw a landmark.
cards.flavor: Beyond each summit loomed yet another, but their spirits pushed them onward. They would surmount the peaks of Targon.

cards.name: Path of Destruction
cards.text: Destroy a landmark.
cards.textHtml: Destroy a landmark.
cards.flavor: Each summit gave way before them, emboldening their climb and filling their hearts with determination. They would scale Targon.

cards.name: Inviolus Vox
cards.text: Each round, when an ally with Fury kills an enemy for the first time, create a random Dragon follower in hand.
cards.textHtml: Each round, when an ally with <link=keyword.Fury><sprite name=Fury><style=Keyword>Fury</style></link> kills an enemy for the first time, create a random Dragon follower in hand.
cards.flavor: "Look to the heavens, and see as I do! First the signals, for by night they shine. Then the fury, for by day all burns. You will see! We will all see!" - Herald of Dragons

cards.name: Fledgling Stellacorn
cards.flavor: "Like any fledgling, young stellacorns must eventually take their first faltering flight. In this, they are just like other stars in the night sky, for they fall just as readily. Luckily, we are here to catch them, and when they are ready, return them." - Lidari, Keeper of the Stars

cards.name: Wish
cards.text: Fully heal damaged allies.
cards.textHtml: Fully heal damaged allies.
cards.flavor: "For life!" - Soraka

cards.name: Zoe
cards.text: Nexus Strike: Create a Supercool Starchart in hand or, if you have one, reduce its cost by 1.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.NexusStrike><style=Vocab>Nexus Strike</style></link>: Create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Supercool Starchart</style></link> in hand or, if you have one, reduce its cost by 1.
cards.levelup: I've seen you play 10 cards with different names.
cards.flavor: "Hey hiiiiiii! Whatcha doin'? Is that a CARD GAME? Can I play too? What?! I'M in YOUR game? Ha! What a silly dimension..."

cards.name: Zoe
cards.text:
When I level up, grant your Nexus "When you summon an ally, grant its keywords to all allies."
Nexus Strike: Create a Behold the Infinite that costs 0 in hand.
cards.textHtml:
When I level up, grant your Nexus "When you summon an ally, grant its keywords to all allies."
<link=vocab.NexusStrike><style=Vocab>Nexus Strike</style></link>: Create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Behold the Infinite</style></link> that costs 0 in hand.
cards.flavor: "Ah, the vastness of space and a myriad realities stretched, squished, and squeezed out before us! Maaaaaybe we'll even see my favorite space doggy!"

cards.name: Zoe's Sleepy Trouble Bubble
cards.text:
Stun an enemy. Create a Fleeting Paddle Star in hand.
Create a Zoe in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
<link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> an enemy. Create a <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Paddle Star</style></link> in hand.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Zoe</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "Naptime for you! One sparklefly, twoooo sparklefly, thre-- Hey, what'sthatoverthere?!" - Zoe

cards.name: The Destroyer
cards.text: When I'm summoned, grant me +1|+0 for each Celestial card you played this game.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, grant me +1|+0 for each Celestial card you played this game. <style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor: "To safeguard the spaces between land and sky, a horned guardian was placed in the stars over the mountains. Sturdy and swift, it traverses the night sky in search of intruders, whom it greets with an impact that sends shudders through earth and sky alike." - The Minotaur Histories

cards.name: Crescent Strike
cards.text: Stun 2 enemies.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> 2 enemies.
cards.flavor: "Even the moon's glow can be blinding." - Diana

cards.name: Arbiter of the Peak
cards.text: I cost 1 less for each time you've targeted or supported allies this game.
cards.textHtml: I cost 1 less for each time you've targeted or supported allies this game.
cards.flavor: The Arbiter is the mountain's final test, for only the guardian sees beyond the climber's deeds, and into their spirit.

cards.name: Moonlight Affliction
cards.text:
Silence 2 enemy units this round.
Nightfall: They can't block this round.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Silence><style=Vocab>Silence</style></link> 2 enemy units this round.
<link=keyword.Nightfall><style=Keyword>Nightfall</style></link>: They can't block this round.
cards.flavor: "Those unaccustomed to the moonlight must learn to see by it, or they will see nothing at all." - Diana

cards.name: Herald of Dragons
cards.text: Dragon allies cost 1 less.
cards.textHtml: Dragon allies cost 1 less.
cards.flavor: The clouds twisted around their massive forms, and the sky itself seemed to shake with their keening wails. She knew what was to come, and yet felt not fear but the warm embrace of destiny.

cards.name: Behold the Infinite
cards.text: Invoke.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Invoke><style=Keyword>Invoke</style></link>.
cards.flavor: The heavens hang over you, a tapestry of black lit with twinkling stars. You are small and dim against its vastness. Where will you turn your gaze first?

cards.name: Startled Stomper
cards.flavor: "Aww, big Stomper don't wanna go through the wittle portal? That's okay, we can-- HAHAHAHA! Just kidding. OUTYOUGO!" - Zoe

cards.name: Messenger's Sigil
cards.text: Create 5 The Messengers in your deck.
cards.textHtml: Create 5 <link=card.shuffle><style=AssociatedCard>The Messengers</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "Time passes, skies turn--the Serpent moves aside and the Messenger takes its place overhead. A season of abundance awaits..." - Lunari Priestess

cards.name: The Messenger
cards.text: When I'm summoned, draw 1.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, draw 1.
cards.flavor:
"As leaves unfurl from barren branches, the Lady of Spring sends her messenger to inform the Lord of Winter of the changing season. The messenger's bark startles the stars into new places in the sky, while his loyal heart warms the land." 
- Song of the Seasons

cards.name: Bastion
cards.text: Grant an ally +1|+1 and SpellShield.
cards.textHtml: Grant an ally +1|+1 and <link=keyword.SpellShield><sprite name=SpellShield><style=Keyword>SpellShield</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "Honor the mountain." - Taric

cards.name: Resplendent Stellacorn
cards.text: Play: Heal an ally and your Nexus 3.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Heal an ally and your Nexus 3.
cards.flavor: "See that star moving across the night sky? That's a grown stellacorn. While the young ones lend us their healing magic until they can be returned to the sky, grown stellacorns can wield that power on their own. It is considered very lucky to see one and know it for what it is. Luckier still to care for one." - Lidari, Keeper of the Stars

cards.name: The Infinite Mindsplitter
cards.text:
Play: Pick 2 enemies.
Round Start: Stun them.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Pick 2 enemies.
<link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> them.
cards.flavor: Travelers who lock eyes with the creature are said to be struck by a knowledge so profound, an insight so awesome, that their minds crumble beneath its gaze.

cards.name: The Great Beyond
cards.text: When I'm summoned, grant me +1|+0 for each Celestial card you played this game.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, grant me +1|+0 for each Celestial card you played this game. <style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor: "Oh yes, my favorite constellation. I like to think it will be the first to rain down upon this forsaken mountain." - Aurelion Sol

cards.name: Sunburst
cards.text:
Deal 6 to a unit.
Daybreak: Instead, Silence it this round and deal 6 to it.
cards.textHtml:
Deal 6 to a unit.
<link=keyword.Daybreak><style=Keyword>Daybreak</style></link>: Instead, <link=vocab.Silence><style=Vocab>Silence</style></link> it this round and deal 6 to it.
cards.flavor: Few things survive a gaze as unflinching as the sun's.

cards.name: Supernova
cards.text: Obliterate 2 enemy units or landmarks.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Obliterate><style=Vocab>Obliterate</style></link> 2 enemy units or landmarks.
cards.flavor: Dying stars create explosions so bright and powerful that even other stars, still lively and burning, are easily outshone.

cards.name: Shards of the Mountain
cards.text: Fill your hand with Gems.
cards.textHtml: Fill your hand with <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Gems</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "Turn a gem just so, and it glimmers in the light. Like mortal lives, each has its own inner fire." - Taric

cards.name: Rahvun, Daylight's Spear
cards.text:
Daybreak: Create a random Daybreak card in hand.
It's always Day for us.
cards.textHtml:
<link=keyword.Daybreak><style=Keyword>Daybreak</style></link>: Create a random <link=keyword.Daybreak><style=Keyword>Daybreak</style></link> card in hand.
It's always Day for us.
cards.flavor: "Keep your faith, Ra-Horak, and our light shall never falter!"

cards.name: Zenith Blade
cards.text:
Grant an ally +1|+2. Give it Overwhelm this round.
Daybreak: Draw a Zenith Blade.
cards.textHtml:
Grant an ally +1|+2. Give it <link=keyword.Overwhelm><sprite name=Overwhelm><style=Keyword>Overwhelm</style></link> this round.
<link=keyword.Daybreak><style=Keyword>Daybreak</style></link>: Draw a <link=card.me><style=AssociatedCard>Zenith Blade</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "Let the sun imbue you with Her strength!" - Solari Priest

cards.name: Solari Shieldbearer
cards.text: Daybreak: Give me +0|+4 this round.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Daybreak><style=Keyword>Daybreak</style></link>: Give me +0|+4 this round.
cards.flavor:
"Foolish, not to come under the cover of night." The Shieldbearer straightened. "Lay down your arms, and come peacefully."
The Lunari crouched in silence, readying her curved blades once more. 
So be it. 
The Solari readied herself in turn, lifting her shield to reflect the rays of the rising sun.

cards.name: Star Shepherd
cards.text: When you heal a damaged ally, grant me +2|+0.
cards.textHtml: When you heal a damaged ally, grant me +2|+0.
cards.flavor: "Ever since I first saw one streak across the night sky, I've loved stellacorns. If only I'd known then that I'd meet so many!"

cards.name: Stargazer
cards.text: When you heal a damaged ally, give it Elusive this round.
cards.textHtml: When you heal a damaged ally, give it <link=keyword.Elusive><sprite name=Elusive><style=Keyword>Elusive</style></link> this round.
cards.flavor: "Stars stay with us for only so long. Once they have been tended to, I return them to the sky in a sudden blaze of starlight... and flailing hooves."

cards.name: Written in Stars
cards.text: Draw a champion. Reduce its cost by 1 and grant it +2|+2.
cards.textHtml: Draw a champion. Reduce its cost by 1 and grant it +2|+2.
cards.flavor: "The vastness of the night sky represents the gulf between humanity below and the divine above. But there are some mortals who strive to achieve a higher purpose, and if the mountain deems them worthy, they may rise to become one with the stars themselves." - Mountain Scryer

cards.name: Grandfather Rumul
cards.text: Play: Grant 2 allies +0|+4.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Grant 2 allies +0|+4.
cards.flavor: "Listen, Osu. Do you hear that? Bells! Grandfather's back!" - Illi, Star Shepherd

cards.name: The Serpent
cards.flavor:
"During Targon's first equinox, the people of the mountain attempted their first truce. But as their leaders laid their weapons down, one suddenly cried out in pain! Soldiers drew their spears, and all thoughts of peace were lost. Little did they know the true betrayer was a serpent hidden beneath their feet, forevermore a sign of violent times." 
- Targonian folk tale

cards.name: Pale Cascade
cards.text:
Give an ally +1|+1 this round.
Nightfall: Draw 1.
cards.textHtml:
Give an ally +1|+1 this round.
<link=keyword.Nightfall><style=Keyword>Nightfall</style></link>: Draw 1.
cards.flavor: "Under cover of night, watched over by a pale moon." - Diana

cards.name: Blessing of Targon
cards.text: Grant an ally +3|+3.
cards.textHtml: Grant an ally +3|+3.
cards.flavor: "A little something from Targon." - Taric

cards.name: The Scourge
cards.text:
When I'm summoned, grant me +1|+0 for each Celestial card you played this game. 
Attack: Give other allies +2|+2 and Overwhelm this round.
cards.textHtml:
When I'm summoned, grant me +1|+0 for each Celestial card you played this game. <style=Variable></style>
<link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Give other allies +2|+2 and <link=keyword.Overwhelm><sprite name=Overwhelm><style=Keyword>Overwhelm</style></link> this round.
cards.flavor: Legends speak of a Scourge that lurks at the furthest reaches of the Celestial Realm. Here, it awaits the time-at-the-end-of-time, when it will wield the power of the stars to shatter the foundations of the world.

cards.name: Whiteflame Protector
cards.flavor: It was the children of Targon who first befriended the younger, more peaceful dragons. Perhaps these juvenile creatures could sense the children's innocent curiosity, and chose, instead of causing them harm, to offer them protection.

cards.name: Porofly
cards.flavor: In space, no one can hear you squee.

cards.name: Sparklefly
cards.flavor: "Hope is a delicate thing that flies ever higher, and should never be caught." - Lunari Priestess

cards.name: Mentor of the Stones
cards.text:
Support: Grant my supported ally +2|+2.
Last Breath: Create 3 Gems in hand.
cards.textHtml:
<link=keyword.Support><style=Keyword>Support</style></link>: Grant my supported ally +2|+2.
<link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>Last Breath</style></link>: Create 3 <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Gems</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor:
"Did you catch anything he said in there?"
"Not a word. Seemed nice, though."
- Emir and Haley, Mountain Sojourners

cards.name: Spell Thief
cards.text: Manifest an enemy spell played this game.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Manifest><style=Vocab>Manifest</style></link> an enemy spell played this game.
cards.flavor: "Oh, that was uh-MAZING! But how much better would it be if I did it instead? 'Kaythanksbyeeee!" - Zoe

cards.name: Falling Comet
cards.text: Obliterate a unit or landmark.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Obliterate><style=Vocab>Obliterate</style></link> a unit or landmark.
cards.flavor: "I will drive the stars themselves through this insufferable place. It will be GLORIOUS." - Aurelion Sol

cards.name: Sun Guardian
cards.text: Daybreak or when you activate another Daybreak: Grant me +1|+1.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Daybreak><style=Keyword>Daybreak</style></link> or when you activate another <link=keyword.Daybreak><style=Keyword>Daybreak</style></link>: Grant me +1|+1.
cards.flavor: "Shining guardian, your wrath burns like the noonday sun. Come forth and punish those who would trespass on this sacred place." - Sun Guardian's inscription

cards.name: Astral Protection
cards.text: Heal an ally 4 and grant it +0|+4.
cards.textHtml: Heal an ally 4 and grant it +0|+4.
cards.flavor: "You thought you'd beaten us? Ha! We're just getting started." - Broadbacked Protector

cards.name: Cygnus the Moonstalker
cards.text: Nightfall: Give an ally Elusive this round.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Nightfall><style=Keyword>Nightfall</style></link>: Give an ally <link=keyword.Elusive><sprite name=Elusive><style=Keyword>Elusive</style></link> this round.
cards.flavor: The Lunari waited for nightfall and the safety it assured. The path ahead seemed deserted, but Cygnus knew the Solari camp lay just beyond. He gestured, and the others quietly fell in line behind him.

cards.name: Gift Giver
cards.text: When I'm summoned, create a Gem in hand.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Gem</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: "They say the Protector blessed these gems. Wear them, and he shall be with you in spirit."

cards.name: Meteor Shower
cards.text: Deal 4 to an enemy and 1 to another.
cards.textHtml: Deal 4 to an enemy and 1 to another.
cards.flavor: "Forging stars is a messy business, I'm afraid. You never know where those little rocks will land. I am so terribly, terribly sorry if they happen to fall on you. And crush you. Oh so violently." - Aurelion Sol

cards.name: The Warrior
cards.flavor: The strongest star in the night's sky, they say, is that of the warrior. An ancient being, thought immortal, who descends from the stars to prove his worth in combat. Never has he been beaten, but all stories must end, and all stars must die.

cards.name: Guiding Touch
cards.text: Heal an ally or your Nexus 2. Draw 1.
cards.textHtml: Heal an ally or your Nexus 2. Draw 1.
cards.flavor: Stellacorns shine brightest when they are happy.

cards.name: Star Spring
cards.text: Round End: Heal damaged allies 1. Then, if I've seen you heal 22+ damage from allies, win the game.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.RoundEnd><style=Vocab>Round End</style></link>: Heal damaged allies 1. Then, if I've seen you heal 22+ damage from allies, win the game. <style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor:
"Up to the sacred falling flow,
Deep into pools, the healing springs
Shining light, water all aglow,
Listen to how the river sings,
High on the crystal mountain."
- Ottrani verse

cards.name: Moonglow
cards.text: Grant an ally +0|+2 and SpellShield.
cards.textHtml: Grant an ally +0|+2 and <link=keyword.SpellShield><sprite name=SpellShield><style=Keyword>SpellShield</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "Bathe in Her gentle glow and receive Her blessing." - Lunari Priestess

cards.name: Leona
cards.text: Daybreak: Stun the strongest enemy.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.PlaySkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword></style></link><link=keyword.Daybreak><style=Keyword>Daybreak</style></link>: <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> the <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> enemy.
cards.levelup: You've activated Daybreak 5+ times.
cards.flavor: She stood amidst them as she prepared for battle--radiating light, bedecked in crimson and gold, her eyes like embers. As the rising sun crowned her head in light, each Solari present lowered their eyes, not in shame, but in deference to their shining leader.

cards.name: Leona
cards.text: Daybreak or when you activate another Daybreak: Stun the strongest enemy and give me Barrier this round.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.PlaySkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword></style></link><link=keyword.Daybreak><style=Keyword>Daybreak</style></link> or when you activate another <link=keyword.Daybreak><style=Keyword>Daybreak</style></link>: <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> the <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> enemy and give me <link=keyword.Barrier><sprite name=Barrier><style=Keyword>Barrier</style></link> this round.
cards.flavor: This was what Leona had prepared for. She knew she would find Diana fleeing down the mountain, retreating before the light of the sun. She breathed deeply to still her fluttering heartbeat, willing it silent with grim resolve. This time upon their meeting, she had the upper hand; this time, she would face her old friend head-on.

cards.name: Leona's Morning Light
cards.text:
Give allies +1|+1 this round.
Activate an ally's Daybreak effect.
Create a Leona in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
Give allies +1|+1 this round.
Activate an ally's <link=keyword.Daybreak><style=Keyword>Daybreak</style></link> effect.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Leona</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor:
"She is our unflinching leader in the heavens, the blinding flash of our weapons at noon, and the unquenchable fire that burns in our hearts." 
- Solari Priestess

cards.name: Solar Flare
cards.text: Stun the strongest enemy.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> the <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> enemy.
cards.flavor: "The closer they stretch toward the heavens, the more the sun will burn them." - Leona

cards.name: Soraka
cards.text: Support: Heal me and my supported ally 4.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Support><style=Keyword>Support</style></link>: Heal me and my supported ally 4.
cards.levelup: You've healed damaged allies 4+ times.
cards.flavor: "Healing is, by its very essence, selfless. You need not draw the power from them; they give it willingly. Show them compassion, and you will see how they shine."

cards.name: Soraka
cards.text:
Each round, the first time you heal a damaged ally, draw 1.
Support: Fully heal me and my supported ally.
cards.textHtml:
Each round, the first time you heal a damaged ally, draw 1.
<link=keyword.Support><style=Keyword>Support</style></link>: Fully heal me and my supported ally.
cards.flavor: "What you give of yourself to help others will be returned to you a hundredfold. This is the power of giving. Generosity is a gift that heals the giver as well, in mind, body, and spirit."

cards.name: Soraka's Wish
cards.text:
Fully heal damaged allies.
Create a Soraka in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
Fully heal damaged allies.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Soraka</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "For life!" - Soraka

cards.name: Diana
cards.text: Nightfall or when you activate another Nightfall: Give me Challenger this round.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Nightfall><style=Keyword>Nightfall</style></link> or when you activate another <link=keyword.Nightfall><style=Keyword>Nightfall</style></link>: Give me <link=keyword.Challenger><sprite name=Challenger><style=Keyword>Challenger</style></link> this round.
cards.levelup: You've activated Nightfall 4+ times.
cards.flavor: She stood amidst them as she prepared for battle--radiating light, bedecked in silver and blue, her eyes like stars. As the moon rose and shone down on her, each of the Lunari gathered there closed their eyes in silent prayer for her safety, and in gratitude.

cards.name: Diana
cards.text: Nightfall or when you activate another Nightfall: Give me +2|+0 and Challenger this round.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Nightfall><style=Keyword>Nightfall</style></link> or when you activate another <link=keyword.Nightfall><style=Keyword>Nightfall</style></link>: Give me +2|+0 and <link=keyword.Challenger><sprite name=Challenger><style=Keyword>Challenger</style></link> this round.
cards.flavor: Diana raced down the mountain, sword drawn and coated with duskpetal dust. She knew Leona would find her--she was counting on it. Her heart fluttered with anxious anticipation, and she breathed deeply to still it. This time upon their meeting, she would have the upper hand; this time, she would face her old friend head-on.

cards.name: Diana's Pale Cascade
cards.text:
Give an ally +1|+1 this round.
Nightfall: Draw 1.
Create a Diana in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
Give an ally +1|+1 this round.
<link=keyword.Nightfall><style=Keyword>Nightfall</style></link>: Draw 1.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Diana</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "Under cover of night, watched over by a pale moon." - Diana

cards.name: Solari Sunforger
cards.text: Daybreak: Give me Lifesteal this round.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Daybreak><style=Keyword>Daybreak</style></link>: Give me <link=keyword.Lifesteal><sprite name=Lifesteal><style=Keyword>Lifesteal</style></link> this round.
cards.flavor: The Sunforger held up his focus as light streamed into the room. The Solari artifact harnessed the sun's brilliant rays into a powerful enchantment for his weapon.

cards.name: Taric
cards.text: Support: Give me and my supported ally Tough this round. Copy the last spell you played on only me this round onto that ally (It can't be copied again).
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Support><style=Keyword>Support</style></link>: Give me and my supported ally <link=keyword.Tough><sprite name=Tough><style=Keyword>Tough</style></link> this round. Copy the last spell you played on only me this round onto that ally (It can't be copied again).
cards.levelup: I've seen you target or support allies 7+ times.
cards.flavor: "Taric's gentle kindness inspires all who meet him, galvanizing them to find the warmth within to bolster themselves on even the coldest of nights." - Mountain Scryer

cards.name: Taric
cards.text: Support: My supported ally and I can't take damage or die this round. Copy the last spell you played on only me this round onto that ally (It can't be copied again).
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Support><style=Keyword>Support</style></link>: My supported ally and I can't take damage or die this round. Copy the last spell you played on only me this round onto that ally (It can't be copied again).
cards.flavor: "Why should Taric show his fellow man kindness? Well, he came to Targon a broken man, intent on climbing the mountain to atone for his sins... and he succeeded. Nobody knows better that all broken things can be made beautiful again." - Mountain Scryer

cards.name: Taric's Blessing of Targon
cards.text:
Grant an ally +3|+3.
Create a Taric in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
Grant an ally +3|+3.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Taric</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "A little something from Targon." - Taric

cards.name: The Golden Sister
cards.text: When I'm summoned, summon The Silver Sister.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, summon <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>The Silver Sister</style></link>.
cards.flavor:
"From the heavens
Two beings came:
One was robed in silver's glow,
The other clad in golden flame..."
- Hymn of the Hours

cards.name: The Silver Sister
cards.flavor:
"...Though both were formed of cosmic light,
They fought, for they were too alike.
And so these two split night from day,
So each could always have their way..."
- Hymn of the Hours

cards.name: Broadbacked Protector
cards.text: Round Start: Heal your Nexus 3. Deal damage to me equal to the amount healed.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Heal your Nexus 3. Deal damage to me equal to the amount healed.
cards.flavor: "Nobody knows the paths of Targon like I do, so I get stuck with some of the, uh, willful stellacorns. Good thing they've got me to look after them!"

cards.name: Giddy Sparkleologist
cards.text: Play: If you Behold a Celestial card, grant an ally +1|+1 and SpellShield.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: If you <link=vocab.Behold><style=Vocab>Behold</style></link> a Celestial card, grant an ally +1|+1 and <link=keyword.SpellShield><sprite name=SpellShield><style=Keyword>SpellShield</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "...and then a sparklefly is like stardust that falls down to the ground and then flies back up and they're amazing and I saw one last night that was so pretty and I'm hungry and it flew up all the way to the STARS and then..."

cards.name: Moondreamer
cards.text:
Play: Invoke.
Nightfall: Reduce that card's cost by 1.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: <link=keyword.Invoke><style=Keyword>Invoke</style></link>.
<link=keyword.Nightfall><style=Keyword>Nightfall</style></link>: Reduce that card's cost by 1.
cards.flavor: "Look at all our friends out in the sky tonight! See that extra bright star? That's the Messenger's eye staring down at us! That dim cluster way out there? It is the Trickster hiding behind clouds! And that one over--KULUN, SHH! You cannot paw those down...!"

cards.name: Targon's Peak
cards.text: Round Start: Reduce the cost of a random card in ALL players' hands to 0 this round.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Reduce the cost of a random card in ALL players' hands to 0 this round.
cards.flavor: Standing watch at the gate to the Celestial Realm is Targon's crystalline guardian. Things fall away in it's presence - hope, doubt, fear. Its trials strip all mortal concerns, and lays bare the essence of the climber's soul. It is on this that they are judged, for the guardian is the great arbiter.

cards.name: Equinox
cards.text: Silence a follower.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Silence><style=Vocab>Silence</style></link> a follower.
cards.flavor: In the space between the stars, there is absolute silence.

cards.name: Cosmic Inspiration
cards.text: Grant allies everywhere +2|+2.
cards.textHtml: Grant allies <link=vocab.Everywhere><style=Vocab>everywhere</style></link> +2|+2.
cards.flavor: "Look to the night sky. Take in the stars' brilliance, and let them suffuse you with their healing light." - Soraka

cards.name: Crystal Ibex
cards.text: Play: Grant an ally Overwhelm.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Grant an ally <link=keyword.Overwhelm><sprite name=Overwhelm><style=Keyword>Overwhelm</style></link>.
cards.flavor: Those seeking to scale Targon would do well to befriend the local fauna. No creature is more familiar with Targon's perilous gauntlet, and none can travel more swiftly across its icy terrain.

cards.name: The Traveler
cards.text: Play: Invoke.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: <link=keyword.Invoke><style=Keyword>Invoke</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "We were always one and the same--we were separated only by the mountain, the journey, and a sea of stars."

cards.name: Tyari the Traveler
cards.text: Support: Grant my supported ally +0|+2.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Support><style=Keyword>Support</style></link>: Grant my supported ally +0|+2.
cards.flavor: In traveling, you must be open to the journey, which will inevitably change you. In traveling, you take something new with you... and you leave something of your old self behind.

cards.name: Fused Firebrand
cards.flavor: Countless challenges await those climbing Mount Targon. Some, like the endless ascent, slowly sap the aspirants' strength. Others are much more immediate.

cards.name: Lunari Duskbringer
cards.text: When I'm summoned, create a Duskpetal Dust in hand.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Duskpetal Dust</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: "Duskpetals bloom at night, and then only under a full moon. A proud symbol of the Lunari, we have used their dust for centuries, as only we know how to harvest them safely."

cards.name: Duskpetal Dust
cards.text: The next card with Nightfall you play this round costs 1 less.
cards.textHtml: The next card with <link=keyword.Nightfall><style=Keyword>Nightfall</style></link> you play this round costs 1 less.
cards.flavor: The fragrance of the duskpetal is like none other. Sweet and strange, but fleeting, it is delicate as moonlight itself.

cards.name: Sleepy Trouble Bubble
cards.text: Stun an enemy. Create a Fleeting Paddle Star in hand.
