cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> an enemy. Create a <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Paddle Star</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: "Naptime for you! One sparklefly, twoooo sparklefly, thre-- Hey, what'sthatoverthere?!" - Zoe

cards.name: Lunari Priestess
cards.text: Nightfall: Invoke.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Nightfall><style=Keyword>Nightfall</style></link>: <link=keyword.Invoke><style=Keyword>Invoke</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "Oh, stars above, journeying like many pilgrims through the night's expanse--stay with us a moment, tell us what you've seen." - The Paeans of Evening

cards.name: Mountain Scryer
cards.text:
Your Celestial cards cost 1 less.
Allegiance: Invoke.
cards.textHtml:
Your Celestial cards cost 1 less.
<link=vocab.Allegiance><style=Vocab>Allegiance</style></link>: <link=keyword.Invoke><style=Keyword>Invoke</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "There is much to learn from the stars, from their guidance. For us, they are a constant, a way to chart our path."

cards.name: Living Legends
cards.text: Fill your hand with random Fleeting Celestial cards. Refill your mana to full.
cards.textHtml: Fill your hand with random <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> Celestial cards. Refill your mana to full.
cards.flavor: "They say that some constellations were once mortals whose exceptional exploits earned them a place amongst the stars." - Mountain Scryer

cards.name: Cosmic Rays
cards.text: Obliterate enemies with 3 or less Power.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Obliterate><style=Vocab>Obliterate</style></link> enemies with 3 or less Power.
cards.flavor: In the dark beginning, a spark of creation rippled through the universe. What sound it made, what light it shone, we will never know, for there were not yet then words to describe, nor yet ears or eyes to perceive it.

cards.name: Starry Scamp
cards.text: If you Behold a Celestial card, I cost 2 less.
cards.textHtml: If you <link=vocab.Behold><style=Vocab>Behold</style></link> a Celestial card, I cost 2 less.
cards.flavor: "Adults are LAME. The only cool kids around here are Zoe and her buddies. I learn a lot from them, y'know? Not like that stupid high radiance priestess lady. I mean UGHHHH."

cards.name: Spring Guardian
cards.text: When I'm summoned, create a Spring Gifts in hand.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, create a <link=card.spell><style=AssociatedCard>Spring Gifts</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: "Mostly, I mind the springs, but a shepherd's responsibility is first and foremost to their flock. Priorities have been known to collide."

cards.name: Spring Gifts
cards.text: Fully heal an ally.
cards.textHtml: Fully heal an ally.
cards.flavor: "Let the springs soothe that which ails you." - Spring Guardian

cards.name: Mountain Sojourners
cards.text: Support: Grant my supported ally +2|+2. If it has Support, grant its supported ally +2|+2 and continue for each supported ally in succession.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Support><style=Keyword>Support</style></link>: Grant my supported ally +2|+2. If it has <link=keyword.Support><style=Keyword>Support</style></link>, grant its supported ally +2|+2 and continue for each supported ally in succession.
cards.flavor: Every person who braves Mount Targon has their reason to climb. Some do it to prove themselves in the eyes of their peers. Others, to prove something to themselves.

cards.name: Morning Light
cards.text:
Give allies +1|+1 this round.
Activate an ally's Daybreak effect.
cards.textHtml:
Give allies +1|+1 this round.
Activate an ally's <link=keyword.Daybreak><style=Keyword>Daybreak</style></link> effect.
cards.flavor: "We rise with the dawn! March into the light!" - Leona

cards.name: The Immortal Fire
cards.text:
When I'm summoned, grant me +1|+0 for each Celestial card you played this game. 
The first time I would die, fully heal me instead.
cards.textHtml:
When I'm summoned, grant me +1|+0 for each Celestial card you played this game. <style=Variable></style>
The first time I would die, fully heal me instead.
cards.flavor: "For ages, the Immortal Fire flew alone, till one day she saw a young bird with fiery golden wings like hers. She rejoiced, for she had never known another like herself. But as years passed, the young bird grew old and flickered out. The Immortal Fire grieved, for she had never known death. And so she wept sparks and sighed herself ablaze, till she emerged, renewed in body but burdened with knowledge." - Shuriman folk tale

cards.name: Starshaping
cards.text: Invoke a Celestial card that costs 7 or more, then heal an ally or your Nexus 5.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Invoke><style=Keyword>Invoke</style></link> a Celestial card that costs 7 or more, then heal an ally or your Nexus 5.
cards.flavor: "Look to the stars. If you're lucky, I'll look back." - Aurelion Sol

cards.name: Hush
cards.text: Silence a unit this round.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Silence><style=Vocab>Silence</style></link> a unit this round.
cards.flavor: "They will know serenity." - Soraka

cards.name: Spacey Sketcher
cards.text: Play: Discard 1 to Invoke a Celestial card that costs 3 or less.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Discard 1 to <link=keyword.Invoke><style=Keyword>Invoke</style></link> a Celestial card that costs 3 or less.
cards.flavor: "This one's my favorite! I call it 'Metaphysical Identity of the Conscious Psyche'. Unless you tilt your head like this... then it kinda looks like two spoons."

cards.name: Aurelion Sol
cards.text:
Play: Invoke a Celestial card that costs 7 or more.
Round Start: Create a random Celestial card in hand.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: <link=keyword.Invoke><style=Keyword>Invoke</style></link> a Celestial card that costs 7 or more.
<link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Create a random Celestial card in hand.
cards.levelup: Round End: Your allies have 20+ total Power.
cards.flavor: "I don't care what you write about me, you middling creature! Just make sure I'm described as handsome. And magnificent. And also very, very intelligent. Can you spell that?"

cards.name: Aurelion Sol
cards.text:
Play: Invoke a Celestial card that costs 7 or more.
Round Start: Create a random Celestial card in hand.
Your Celestial cards cost 0.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: <link=keyword.Invoke><style=Keyword>Invoke</style></link> a Celestial card that costs 7 or more.
<link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Create a random Celestial card in hand.
Your Celestial cards cost 0.
cards.flavor: Aurelion Sol is handsome. And magnificent. And also very, very inteligent.

cards.name: Aurelion Sol's The Skies Descend
cards.text:
I cost 2 less for each Dragon or Celestial ally you have. Deal 15 to all enemies.
Create an Aurelion Sol in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
I cost 2 less for each Dragon or Celestial ally you have. Deal 15 to all enemies.
Create an <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Aurelion Sol</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "When the time comes, I think I'll make an example of Runeterra. Perhaps I'll drag its smoldering husk around with me for all eternity. Like a toy. A dead, worthless toy. I don't know. I've not really thought about it much." - Aurelion Sol

cards.name: Solari Soldier
cards.text: Daybreak: Give me +1|+1 this round.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Daybreak><style=Keyword>Daybreak</style></link>: Give me +1|+1 this round.
cards.flavor: As the sun warmed him, he stood watch at the heretic's prison, ignoring the soft pleas that quickly turned to bitter silence.

cards.name: Crescent Guardian
cards.text: Nightfall: Grant me +2|+0.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Nightfall><style=Keyword>Nightfall</style></link>: Grant me +2|+0.
cards.flavor: "Stoic guardian, the gentle touch of the full moon restores your strength. Awaken and safeguard us from those who would trespass upon this sacred place." - Crescent Guardian's inscription

cards.name: The Charger
cards.flavor: "The gold of the sun adorns his horns, and its fire lights his heart. Let the thunder of our shields ring out like the thunder of his hooves across the horizon!" - Solari battle prayer

cards.name: Supercool Starchart
cards.text: Invoke a Celestial card that costs 3 or less.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Invoke><style=Keyword>Invoke</style></link> a Celestial card that costs 3 or less.
cards.flavor: "And these three EXTRA sparkly stars I call... 'The Celestial Jump Rope'! Or is it more of an upside down happy face?" - Zoe

cards.name: Mountain Goat
cards.text: Strike: Create a Gem in hand.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>Strike</style></link>: Create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Gem</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: The goats of Mount Targon are even more dangerous than their ordinary cousins, for the gems that make up their horns embed painful shards upon impact.

cards.name: Gem
cards.text: Heal an ally 1 and grant it +1|+0.
cards.textHtml: Heal an ally 1 and grant it +1|+0.
cards.flavor: "You don't need to see to believe. Just have a little faith." - Tyari the Traveler

cards.name: Paddle Star
cards.text: Deal 5 to an enemy that attacked this round or is Stunned.
cards.textHtml: Deal 5 to an enemy that attacked this round or is <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stunned</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "KaBOOMey!" - Zoe

cards.name: Lunari Shadestalker
cards.text: Nightfall: Grant me Elusive.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Nightfall><style=Keyword>Nightfall</style></link>: Grant me <link=keyword.Elusive><sprite name=Elusive><style=Keyword>Elusive</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "Let us cast our eyes toward the heavens, toward the sun, toward our lady's li-- Wait... What...? What is that...?" - Solari Priest

cards.name: The Trickster
cards.flavor: "So, there I was going 'bout my day, when in struts this fella packed to the gills with gold. Easy mark, eh? I sidle over, amp up the charm, and amp up the price. It's only when I put my coins away I realize the little scamp's paid me with my OWN money! The Trickster was shining bright that night, I tell ya." - Yordle Grifter

cards.name: Solari Priestess
cards.text: Daybreak: Invoke a Celestial card that costs 4, 5, or 6.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Daybreak><style=Keyword>Daybreak</style></link>: <link=keyword.Invoke><style=Keyword>Invoke</style></link> a Celestial card that costs 4, 5, or 6.
cards.flavor: The Solari look to the stars for guidance as much as any other Targonian, for the star dearest to their faith is the sun.

cards.name: Sunblessed Vigor
cards.text: Grant an ally +0|+2.
cards.textHtml: Grant an ally +0|+2.
cards.flavor: "Our shield is our conviction, our resolve, our trust in the light!" - Solari Shieldbearer

cards.name: Eclipse Dragon
cards.text:
Daybreak: The next Dragon or Celestial unit you play costs 2 less.
Nightfall: Create a random Dragon and Celestial follower in hand.
cards.textHtml:
<link=keyword.Daybreak><style=Keyword>Daybreak</style></link>: The next Dragon or Celestial unit you play costs 2 less.
<link=keyword.Nightfall><style=Keyword>Nightfall</style></link>: Create a random Dragon and Celestial follower in hand.
cards.flavor:
Dragon scale (Eclipse Dragon, Draco Obscuratus)
Notes: Scale has incredible optical properties. Highly reflective under direct sunlight.
Scribbled: IT ALSO GLOWS AT NIGHT!
- Notes of Anden Mayne, Egghead Researcher

cards.name: Out Of The Way
cards.text: For the rest of the game, allied "this round" buffs (except Barrier) are permanent. Draw 1.
cards.textHtml: For the rest of the game, allied "this round" buffs (except <link=keyword.Barrier><sprite name=Barrier><style=Keyword>Barrier</style></link>) are permanent. Draw 1.
cards.flavor:
"You know I mean everything that I say
When you see me coming get out of the way
I came to slay I came to slay
Back and I’m better and ready to stay."
- Kai'Sa, 'THE BADDEST'

cards.name: The Flight
cards.text: Nexus Strike: Draw 1 and place me into the top 3 cards of your deck.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.NexusStrike><style=Vocab>Nexus Strike</style></link>: Draw 1 and place me into the top 3 cards of your deck.
cards.flavor:
"Mother Moon, gift me confidence,
Fill me with The Flight's conviction,
Set me on my path."
- Lunari Prayer

cards.name: Gifts From Beyond
cards.text: Pick a Moon Weapon to create in hand.
cards.textHtml: Pick a Moon Weapon to create in hand.
cards.flavor: "Reach out, Aphelios..." - Alune

cards.name: The Sky Shadows
cards.text: When I'm summoned, refill 2 spell mana if you Behold a Nightfall card.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, refill 2 spell mana if you <link=vocab.Behold><style=Vocab>Behold</style></link> a <link=keyword.Nightfall><style=Keyword>Nightfall</style></link> card.
cards.flavor:
"Mother Moon, allow me to remember,
That though I stand in solitude,
Your children dance above,
And I am not alone."
- Lunari Prayer

cards.name: Aphelios
cards.text:
Nightfall: Pick a Moon Weapon to create in hand.
Each round, the first time you play 2 other cards, create the Phased Moon Weapon in hand if you don't already have one.
cards.textHtml:
<link=keyword.Nightfall><style=Keyword>Nightfall</style></link>: Pick a Moon Weapon to create in hand.
Each round, the first time you play 2 other cards, create the <link=vocab.Phase><style=Vocab>Phased</style></link> Moon Weapon in hand if you don't already have one.<style=Variable></style>
cards.levelup: You've played 4+ Moon Weapons.
cards.flavor: "With every conflict, we show the Solari we are worthy of respect. We have taught them that the moon's light is equal to their sun's, we have taught them not to disregard that which they did not know. And of the lessons they are yet to learn..." - Lunari wanespeaker

cards.name: Calibrum
cards.text: Deal 3 to a follower. Phase Severum or Gravitum.
cards.textHtml: Deal 3 to a follower. <link=vocab.Phase><style=Vocab>Phase</style></link> <link=card.Severum><style=AssociatedCard>Severum</style></link> or <link=card.Gravitum><style=AssociatedCard>Gravitum</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "Move sure as the moon, Brother." - Alune

cards.name: Severum
cards.text: Give an ally +1|+2 and Lifesteal this round. Phase Gravitum or Infernum.
cards.textHtml: Give an ally +1|+2 and <link=keyword.Lifesteal><sprite name=Lifesteal><style=Keyword>Lifesteal</style></link> this round. <link=vocab.Phase><style=Vocab>Phase</style></link> <link=card.Gravitum><style=AssociatedCard>Gravitum</style></link> or <link=card.Infernum><style=AssociatedCard>Infernum</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "From darkness, light." - Alune

cards.name: Crescendum
cards.text: Summon a random 2 cost follower from your regions. Phase Calibrum or Severum.
cards.textHtml: Summon a random 2 cost follower from your regions. <link=vocab.Phase><style=Vocab>Phase</style></link> <link=card.Calibrum><style=AssociatedCard>Calibrum</style></link> or <link=card.Severum><style=AssociatedCard>Severum</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "A crescent path opens before us." - Alune

cards.name: Aphelios' Gifts From Beyond
cards.text:
Pick a Moon Weapon to create in hand.
Create an Aphelios in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
Pick a Moon Weapon to create in hand.
Create an <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Aphelios</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "Reach out, Aphelios..." - Alune

cards.name: Gravitum
cards.text: Stun an enemy. If it's a follower, Stun it again at the next Round Start. Phase Infernum or Crescendum.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> an enemy. If it's a follower, <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> it again at the next <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>. <link=vocab.Phase><style=Vocab>Phase</style></link> <link=card.Infernum><style=AssociatedCard>Infernum</style></link> or <link=card.Crescendum><style=AssociatedCard>Crescendum</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "Doubt weighs heavy on their minds." - Alune

cards.name: Aphelios
cards.text:
Nightfall: Pick a Moon Weapon to create in hand.
Each round, the first time you play 2 other cards or Round Start: Create the Phased Moon Weapon in hand if you don't already have one.
Your Moon Weapons cost 1 less.
cards.textHtml:
<link=keyword.Nightfall><style=Keyword>Nightfall</style></link>: Pick a Moon Weapon to create in hand.
Each round, the first time you play 2 other cards or <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Create the <link=vocab.Phase><style=Vocab>Phased</style></link> Moon Weapon in hand if you don't already have one.<style=Variable></style>
Your Moon Weapons cost 1 less.
cards.flavor: "...it is Aphelios and Alune who will best teach them.." - Lunari wanespeaker

cards.name: Infernum
cards.text: Give an ally +2|+1 and Overwhelm this round. Phase Crescendum or Calibrum.
cards.textHtml: Give an ally +2|+1 and <link=keyword.Overwhelm><sprite name=Overwhelm><style=Keyword>Overwhelm</style></link> this round. <link=vocab.Phase><style=Vocab>Phase</style></link> <link=card.Crescendum><style=AssociatedCard>Crescendum</style></link> or <link=card.Calibrum><style=AssociatedCard>Calibrum</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "The moon grows in flame." - Alune

cards.name: Starbone
cards.text: If you Behold a Celestial, create The Messenger in your deck and grant Celestial allies everywhere +1|+1.
cards.textHtml: If you <link=vocab.Behold><style=Vocab>Behold</style></link> a Celestial, create <link=card.behold><style=AssociatedCard>The Messenger</style></link> in your deck and grant Celestial allies <link=vocab.Everywhere><style=Vocab>everywhere</style></link> +1|+1.
cards.flavor:
"May the Messenger play,
And with his joy,
Light the stars."
- Lunari Prayer

cards.name: The Veiled Temple
cards.text: Each round, the first time you play 2 other cards, refill 2 mana and grant your strongest ally +1|+0.
cards.textHtml: Each round, the first time you play 2 other cards, refill 2 mana and grant your <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> ally +1|+0. <style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor: It is here, in the Spirit Realm, that Alune communes with her brother Aphelios. It is she who speaks words of comfort to the silent assassin, and who reaches through the veil to hand him his weapons of retribution.

cards.name: The Cloven Way
cards.text: Nightfall: Stun an enemy. If it's a follower, Stun it again at the next Round Start.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.PlaySkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword></style></link><link=keyword.Nightfall><style=Keyword>Nightfall</style></link>: <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> an enemy. If it's a follower, <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> it again at the next <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>.
cards.flavor:
"Mother Moon, our night is set,
May we halt those who would harm us,
And teach them regret."
- Lunari Prayer

cards.name: Sky Charge
cards.text: Stun an enemy. If it's a follower, Stun it again at the next Round Start.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> an enemy. If it's a follower, <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> it again at the next <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>.
cards.flavor: The Solari did not believe that another light could blind--a lesson the Lunari would readily teach.

cards.name: The Fangs
cards.text: Play: Invoke a Celestial card that costs 3 or less.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: <link=keyword.Invoke><style=Keyword>Invoke</style></link> a Celestial card that costs 3 or less.
cards.flavor:
"Mother Moon, show me the way,
Tear the sky open,
Show me beyond."
- Lunari Prayer

cards.name: Runeweaver
cards.text: When I'm summoned, Reforge.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, <link=vocab.Reforge><style=Vocab>Reforge</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "Most weapons are crude tools, no better than the hands that wield them. But a weapon infused with runic magic is so much more than mere steel."

cards.name: Arrel the Tracker
cards.text: Round End: If you played a spell on me this round, I strike the weakest enemy.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.RoundEnd><style=Vocab>Round End</style></link>: If you played a spell on me this round, I <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strike</style></link> the <link=keyword.Weakest><style=Keyword>weakest</style></link> enemy.
cards.flavor:
"Hide, we will find you. 
Breathe, we will hear you.
Run, we will kill you."

cards.name: Blade Squire
cards.text: Last Breath: Reforge.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>Last Breath</style></link>: <link=vocab.Reforge><style=Vocab>Reforge</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "Like the huntresses said--a hundred days and nights. A hundred blisters on these feet, a hundred bugs in my breakfast, a hundred 'blade'-this and 'vengeance' that. And well more than a hundred brow-beatings from those three, I'll tell you..."

cards.name: Noxkraya Arena
cards.text: Round End: Your strongest ally and the weakest enemy strike each other.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.RoundEnd><style=Vocab>Round End</style></link>: Your <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> ally and the <link=keyword.Weakest><style=Keyword>weakest</style></link> enemy <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strike</style></link> each other.
cards.flavor: "Hey there, rrrrreckoner fans, are you ready for a night of scorchin' hot THRILLS in the RING OF FIRE?! Wuh-oh, looks like Tiny Trik drew the SHORT straw today. He's up against the mighty, fight-y, GRANAAAAK the Great! Get those medics ringside, it's gonna be a quick one!" - Arena Battlecaster

cards.name: Brutal Hunter
cards.text: When I'm summoned, give me Quick Attack this round.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, give me <link=keyword.Quick Strike><sprite name=QuickStrike><style=Keyword>Quick Attack</style></link> this round.
cards.flavor: "There you are. We KNEW you wouldn't come without a fight! Or so we hoped."

cards.name: Weapon Hilt
cards.text: Give an ally +2|+0 this round. Reforge.
cards.textHtml: Give an ally +2|+0 this round. <link=vocab.Reforge><style=Vocab>Reforge</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "To know your enemy, first know their weapon. It will tell you how they move, how they think, when they'll strike. It is the purest expression of its wielder." - Arrel the Tracker

cards.name: Riven
cards.text: When I'm summoned, if you have the attack token, or when you gain the attack token, Reforge.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, if you have the attack token, or when you gain the attack token, <link=vocab.Reforge><style=Vocab>Reforge</style></link>.
cards.levelup: You've created Blade of the Exile.
cards.flavor: "I will not run from what I was. I made a promise to mend what I have broken..."

cards.name: Riven
cards.text:
When I'm summoned, if you have the attack token, or when you gain the attack token, Reforge.
Each round, the first time you increase my Power, grant me that much Power.
cards.textHtml:
When I'm summoned, if you have the attack token, or when you gain the attack token, <link=vocab.Reforge><style=Vocab>Reforge</style></link>.
Each round, the first time you increase my Power, grant me that much Power.
cards.flavor: "...and I will not run from those who would break me."

cards.name: Riven's Weapon Hilt
cards.text:
Give an ally +2|+0 this round. Reforge.
Create a Riven in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
Give an ally +2|+0 this round. <link=vocab.Reforge><style=Vocab>Reforge</style></link>.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Riven</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "To know your enemy, first know their weapon. It will tell you how they move, how they think, when they'll strike. It is the purest expression of its wielder." - Arrel the Tracker

cards.name: Heavy Blade Fragment
cards.text: Give an ally Overwhelm this round.
cards.textHtml:
Give an ally <link=keyword.Overwhelm><sprite name=Overwhelm><style=Keyword>Overwhelm</style></link> this round.
<style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor: "A warrior must know the weight of their weapon, burdened heavy with guilt." - Riven

cards.name: Wrathful Rider
cards.flavor: "There is nothing like hunting another soldier. To track them, you must think and feel as they do. To catch them, you must fear them as they fear you. It is a bond that few will know, but one I savor above all others."

cards.name: Keen Blade Fragment
cards.text: Give an ally Quick Attack this round.
cards.textHtml:
Give an ally <link=keyword.Quick Strike><sprite name=QuickStrike><style=Keyword>Quick Attack</style></link> this round.
<style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor: "A warrior must know the sharpness of their blade, an edge that cuts both friends and foes." - Riven

cards.name: Blade of the Exile
cards.text: Grant an ally +2|+0, Overwhelm, and Quick Attack.
cards.textHtml: Grant an ally +2|+0, <link=keyword.Overwhelm><sprite name=Overwhelm><style=Keyword>Overwhelm</style></link>, and <link=keyword.Quick Strike><sprite name=QuickStrike><style=Keyword>Quick Attack</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "But a warrior is more than their weapon alone. They must know power, but also consequence, forgiveness, and redemption." - Riven

cards.name: Glinting Blade Fragment
cards.text: Give an ally +2|+0 this round.
cards.textHtml:
Give an ally +2|+0 this round.
<style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor: "A warrior must know their weapon's history... every bloody piece." - Riven

cards.name: Scorched Earth
cards.text: Kill a damaged unit or destroy a landmark.
cards.textHtml: Kill a damaged unit or destroy a landmark.
cards.flavor: "The drakehounds have the scent. They will find her, and we will finish this. There is no other way." - Arrel the Tracker

cards.name: Sharpened Resolve
cards.text: Give an ally +3|+2 this round.
cards.textHtml: Give an ally +3|+2 this round.
cards.flavor: "Yeah, I'll mend your weapons, and tend to the mounts, and cook your bloody food. What else am I good for, eh?" - Erath, Blade Squire

cards.name: Survival Skills
cards.text:
Allies can't drop below 1 health this round.
When discarded, your strongest ally can't drop below 1 health this round.
cards.textHtml:
Allies can't drop below 1 health this round.
When discarded, your <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> ally can't drop below 1 health this round.
cards.flavor: "The drakehounds have the scent. They will find her, and we will finish this. There is no other way." - Arrel the Tracker

cards.name: Gouge
cards.text: Deal 1 to an ally and an enemy 4 times.
cards.textHtml: Deal 1 to an ally and an enemy 4 times.
cards.flavor: "It's not the sharpness of the claws you've got to look out for, it's the appetite of the beast that's grown 'em." - Basilisk trainer

cards.name: Basilisk Bloodseeker
cards.text: Play: Deal 1 to an ally and an enemy 4 times.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.PlaySkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Play</style></link>: Deal 1 to an ally and an enemy 4 times.
cards.flavor: The basilisk trainers withhold live food from the beasts in the days leading up to battle. By the time the creatures are unleashed, they do not distinguish friend from foe, and are utterly indomitable.

cards.name: Apprehend
cards.text:
Stun an enemy.
If you have a Darius, Rally.
cards.textHtml:
<link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> an enemy.
If you have a <link=card.champ1><style=AssociatedCard>Darius</style></link>, <link=vocab.Rally><style=Vocab>Rally</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "I'll handle this myself." - Darius

cards.name: Hunt the Weak
cards.text: Your opponent discards the weakest follower from hand.
cards.textHtml: Your opponent discards the <link=keyword.Weakest><style=Keyword>weakest</style></link> follower from hand.
cards.flavor: "The frail have no place in this world. Each day brings them new torment, another turn of the vise. I do not deal in death, I deal in mercy." - Arrel the Tracker

cards.name: Wild Claws
cards.text: An ally strikes an enemy. If it has Overwhelm, deal excess damage to the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml: An ally <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strikes</style></link> an enemy. If it has <link=keyword.Overwhelm><sprite name=Overwhelm><style=Keyword>Overwhelm</style></link>, deal excess damage to the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: "Oooh the wildman's looking EXTRA savage today! Stay clear of those claws, folks!" - Arena Battlecaster

cards.name: The University of Piltover
cards.text: Round Start: Discard your hand. Create 3 random cards in hand and grant them Fleeting.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Discard your hand. Create 3 random cards in hand and grant them <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link>.
cards.flavor: The inventions of Professor Cecil B. Heimerdinger made him famous, but it was his animated lectures and notoriously unpredictable classroom demonstrations that earned him a lasting impression on Piltover's brightest minds.

cards.name: Nyandroid
cards.flavor: "I clawed my way through years of Piltovan academia only to have my technologies deemed 'too dangerous' and my very presence dismissed as 'too cute'! Meow to Zaun, where I know at least one great mind shares my ambitions..."

cards.name: Viktor
cards.text: When I'm summoned or Round Start: Create a Hex Core Upgrade in hand.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned or <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Create a <link=card.upgrade><style=AssociatedCard>Hex Core Upgrade</style></link> in hand.
cards.levelup: You've played 7+ created cards.
cards.flavor: "Zaun, you have seen your share of tragedies, and the time has come for change. And, as with all great advancements, it must start within you."

cards.name: Viktor
cards.text:
Your created cards cost 1 less.
When I'm summoned or Round Start: Create a Hex Core Upgrade in hand.
cards.textHtml:
Your created cards cost 1 less.
When I'm summoned or <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Create a <link=card.upgrade><style=AssociatedCard>Hex Core Upgrade</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: "Ah, Piltover. As a boy, I looked up to you, the shining 'City of Progress'. But as a man, I see its corrupt foundations, built atop the suffering of our home, Zaun. Today, we herald a new era of Zaunite innovation--and you will be the first to witness our rise!"

cards.name: Hex Core Upgrade
cards.text: Grant Viktor a random keyword.
cards.textHtml: <style=Variable>Grant Viktor a random keyword.</style>
cards.flavor: Humanity is destined to break free from the confines of flesh. We must become more. We must augment. We must evolve!" - Viktor

cards.name: Viktor's Death Ray - Mk 1
cards.text:
Deal 1 to a unit. Create a Death Ray - Mk 2 in the top 3 cards of your deck.
Create a Viktor in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
Deal 1 to a unit. Create a <link=card.upgrade><style=AssociatedCard>Death Ray - Mk 2</style></link> in the top 3 cards of your deck.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Viktor</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor:
"Today, I have successfully demonstrated that radiant energy can be focused into a single powerful beam! With the right improvements, this ray could be a tool of unmatched precision, but there is still much to do."
- Viktor's design annotations

cards.name: Death Ray - Mk 1
cards.text: Deal 1 to a unit. Create a Death Ray - Mk 2 in the top 3 cards of your deck.
cards.textHtml: Deal 1 to a unit. Create a <link=card.upgrade><style=AssociatedCard>Death Ray - Mk 2</style></link> in the top 3 cards of your deck.
cards.flavor:
"Today, I have successfully demonstrated that radiant energy can be focused into a single powerful beam! With the right improvements, this ray could be a tool of unmatched precision, but there is still much to do."
- Viktor's design annotations

cards.name: Death Ray - Mk 2
cards.text: Deal 2 to a unit. Create a Death Ray - Mk 3 in the top 3 cards of your deck.
cards.textHtml: Deal 2 to a unit. Create a <link=card.upgrade><style=AssociatedCard>Death Ray - Mk 3</style></link> in the top 3 cards of your deck.
cards.flavor:
"Altered beam transmission medium, adjusted lenses to optimal focal distances, internal mirrors polished and positioned. Intensity increased tenfold. But it must improve. I MUST IMPROVE!"
- Viktor's design annotations

cards.name: Death Ray - Mk 3
cards.text: Deal 3 to a unit.
cards.textHtml: Deal 3 to a unit.
cards.flavor:
"The beam melts flesh and metal alike with exceptional speed! I have since eagerly integrated it onto my machine body. To see, feel, and dissect the world with such CLARITY... This is the great potential of the human mind unburdened by flesh! A truly glorious evolution!" 
- Viktor's design annotations

cards.name: Ballistic Bot
cards.text: Round Start: Create an Ignition in hand.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Create an <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Ignition</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor:
Subject requested that we keep only his mind intact, stating "That's where I've stored all my grudges."
- Augmentor's log, entry 1011

cards.name: Mechanized Mimic
cards.text: Attack: Grant me all keywords on allies.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Grant me all keywords on allies.
cards.flavor: "I'm just like you, only better."

cards.name: Aftershock
cards.text: Deal 3 to a unit or destroy a landmark.
cards.textHtml: Deal 3 to a unit or destroy a landmark.
cards.flavor: "This ray of light will guide our march to Piltover. Nothing will stand in the way of our Glorious Evolution!" - Viktor

cards.name: Armed Gearhead
cards.flavor: "Alright! New arm! Always wanted one of those. What've we got next? Gravwheels for legs? Electrobelts? METAL TEETH? Actually, leave my face. I like my face."

cards.name: Iterative Improvement
cards.text: Pick a follower. Create a copy of it in hand with +1|+1.
cards.textHtml: Pick a follower. Create a copy of it in hand with +1|+1.
cards.flavor: "Self-improvement is a game where you are the hero and the villain. You will struggle. You may even think you've won. But in the end, you will always be left standing in your own way." - Mechanized Mimic

cards.name: Calculated Creations
cards.text: Create an Armed Gearhead, Ballistic Bot, or Nyandroid in hand and grant it +1|+1.
cards.textHtml: Create an <link=card.create1><style=AssociatedCard>Armed Gearhead</style></link>, <link=card.create2><style=AssociatedCard>Ballistic Bot</style></link>, or <link=card.create3><style=AssociatedCard>Nyandroid</style></link> in hand and grant it +1|+1.
cards.flavor: "Rationality and choice separate humanity from its base animal instincts." - Viktor

cards.name: Ignition
cards.text: Deal 1 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml: Deal 1 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor:
"If they do not choose to add metal to their bodies, I will deliver metal to them instead. That was a humorous remark. Ha."
- Ballistic Bot

cards.name: Tri-beam Improbulator
cards.text: Deal 1 to a unit. Summon a random 1 cost follower. While I'm in hand, increase both by 1 when you play a 3 cost card.
cards.textHtml: Deal 1 to a unit. Summon a random <style=Variable>1</style> cost follower. While I'm in hand, increase both by 1 when you play a 3 cost card.
cards.flavor: "...and in one, two, and THREE!!! Oh. Oh, my word... Yet another unforeseen outcome?!" - Heimerdinger

cards.name: Poro Cannon
cards.text:
To play, discard 1.
Create 2 Daring Poros in hand.
cards.textHtml:
To play, discard 1.
Create 2 <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Daring Poros</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: Two downy shapes arced gracefully over the adoring crowd, leaving a cloud of fluff and the faint scent of baked goods in their wake.

cards.name: Patched Porobot
cards.text: While in hand, I have a random keyword that changes each round. When I'm summoned, grant me this keyword.
cards.textHtml: While in hand, I have a random keyword that changes each round. When I'm summoned, grant me this keyword.
cards.flavor: It's not quite as cuddly as the real thing, but it IS just as cute.

cards.name: Hexcore Foundry
cards.text: Round Start: ALL players draw 1.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: ALL players draw 1.
cards.flavor: "Let them say what they will about my methods. They cannot deny progress--the light of my knowledge is shining like a beacon through the darkness of ignorance!" - Viktor

cards.name: Give It All
cards.text:
Grow all allies' Power and Health to the highest Power or Health among allies.
Grant all allies allied keywords.
cards.textHtml:
Grow all allies' Power and Health to the highest Power or Health among allies.
Grant all allies allied keywords.
cards.flavor:
"I know I know
You want some more
If you ready let’s go
Giving it all"
- Seraphine, 'MORE'

cards.name: Stress Testing
cards.text: Remove Fleeting from all cards in hand. When I'm discarded, draw 1 Fleeting.
cards.textHtml: Remove <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> from all cards in hand. When I'm discarded, draw 1 <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "It's simple stuff, really. I replaced the steel frame with a more durable alloy I invented, and rerouted the circuitry away from the hinges to stop the systems from shorting out. Easy peasy." - Chief Mechanist Zevi

cards.name: Evershade Stalker
cards.text: Nightfall: Create a copy of me in hand.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Nightfall><style=Keyword>Nightfall</style></link>: Create a copy of me in hand.
cards.flavor: "It was just a pair of eyes at first, and a lone voice chittering in the shadows. More every time I looked back. Angrier. Louder. Soon as I saw the Tooth, I ran." - Whale's Tooth looter

cards.name: Unspeakable Horror
cards.text:
Drain 1 from anything.
Nightfall: Create a random Nightfall card in hand.
cards.textHtml:
<link=keyword.Drain><style=Keyword>Drain</style></link> 1 from anything.
<link=keyword.Nightfall><style=Keyword>Nightfall</style></link>: Create a random <link=keyword.Nightfall><style=Keyword>Nightfall</style></link> card in hand.
cards.flavor:
"Every passing day saps my spirit, pulls from me the vigor that compelled me to find this place. The Whale's Tooth is full of haggard folk, seemingly lost to all endeavor, and I fear the longer I stay, the more like them I become."
- Notes of Jens Tommen, historian

cards.name: Stygian Onlooker
cards.text: Nightfall: Give me +2|+0 and Fearsome this round.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Nightfall><style=Keyword>Nightfall</style></link>: Give me +2|+0 and <link=keyword.Fearsome><sprite name=Fearsome><style=Keyword>Fearsome</style></link> this round.
cards.flavor: As the sun melts into pitch, the terrors of this place wake, watch, and wait.

cards.name: Stalking Shadows
cards.text:
Pick a follower from the top 4 cards in your deck.
Draw it, place the rest into your deck, then create an exact Ephemeral copy in hand.
cards.textHtml:
Pick a follower from the top 4 cards in your deck.
Draw it, place the rest into your deck, then create an exact <link=keyword.Ephemeral><sprite name=Ephemeral><style=Keyword>Ephemeral</style></link> copy in hand.
cards.flavor: "Go... surround them..." - Nocturne

cards.name: Nocturne
cards.text: Nightfall: Grant an enemy Vulnerable and give enemies -1|-0 this round.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Nightfall><style=Keyword>Nightfall</style></link>: Grant an enemy <link=keyword.Vulnerable><sprite name=Vulnerable><style=Keyword>Vulnerable</style></link> and give enemies <nobr>-1|-0</nobr> this round.
cards.levelup: You've attacked with 5+ Nightfall or Fearsome allies.
cards.flavor:
"It appears that, once enough souls have been shaken, it breaches our world. Only hope can send the monstrosity back to its realm... but hope died here long ago, on a queen's final breath, and with a king's eternal scream."
- Notes of Jens Tommen, historian

cards.name: Nocturne
cards.text:
Nightfall: Grant an enemy Vulnerable and give enemies -1|-0 this round.
Other allies have Fearsome.
When you summon another ally, give enemies -1|-0 this round.
cards.textHtml:
<link=keyword.Nightfall><style=Keyword>Nightfall</style></link>: Grant an enemy <link=keyword.Vulnerable><sprite name=Vulnerable><style=Keyword>Vulnerable</style></link> and give enemies <nobr>-1|-0</nobr> this round.
Other allies have <link=keyword.Fearsome><sprite name=Fearsome><style=Keyword>Fearsome</style></link>.
When you summon another ally, give enemies <nobr>-1|-0</nobr> this round.
cards.flavor:
"My dreams grow more vivid with each passing night. I see a creature of pure evil, writhing in the dark, twisting its way toward me. Though I was to be stationed here for another week, I have just paid for transport to Fossbarrow this evening. Plainly, I cannot stand this place."
- Notes of Jens Tommen, historian

cards.name: Nocturne's Unspeakable Horror
cards.text:
Drain 1 from anything. Create a Nocturne in your deck.
Nightfall: Create a random Nightfall card in hand.
cards.textHtml:
<link=keyword.Drain><style=Keyword>Drain</style></link> 1 from anything. Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Nocturne</style></link> in your deck.
<link=keyword.Nightfall><style=Keyword>Nightfall</style></link>: Create a random <link=keyword.Nightfall><style=Keyword>Nightfall</style></link> card in hand.
cards.flavor:
"Every passing day saps my spirit, pulls from me the vigor that compelled me to find this place. The Whale's Tooth is full of haggard folk, seemingly lost to all endeavor, and I fear the longer I stay, the more like them I become."
- Notes of Jens Tommen, historian

cards.name: Doombeast
cards.text: Nightfall: Drain 2 from the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.PlaySkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword></style></link><link=keyword.Nightfall><style=Keyword>Nightfall</style></link>: <link=keyword.Drain><style=Keyword>Drain</style></link> 2 from the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: With each passing night, the travelers grew more weary. Their slumber was restless, and their dreams vivid. Sleep no longer gave respite, and instead pulled the life from their bones.

cards.name: Torment
cards.text: Drain 2 from the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Drain><style=Keyword>Drain</style></link> 2 from the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: What knows you better than your own mind? What can torment you more exquisitely than your own dreams?

cards.name: Shroud of Darkness
cards.text: The next time you summon an ally this round, give it +1|+0 and SpellShield this round.
cards.textHtml: The next time you summon an ally this round, give it +1|+0 and <link=keyword.SpellShield><sprite name=SpellShield><style=Keyword>SpellShield</style></link> this round.
cards.flavor: "Soon as you step outside the Tooth, you'll feel 'em. Fingertips on your nape, light as rain. Them creatures don't budge when you come at 'em, neither. Ain't afraid of my blade or my torch. Nothin'. Awful things." - Whale's Tooth looter

cards.name: Crumble
cards.text: Kill an ally to kill a unit or destroy a landmark.
cards.textHtml: Kill an ally to kill a unit or destroy a landmark.
cards.flavor: Nothing lasts on these haunted isles. All will end.

cards.name: Vaults of Helia
cards.text: Round Start: If you can, kill your most expensive ally to summon an ally from your deck that costs 1 more.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: If you can, kill your most expensive ally to summon an ally from your deck that costs 1 more.
cards.flavor: What could better lure a soul to this wretched place than the promise of eternal life, and endless riches?

cards.name: Duskrider
cards.text: Nightfall: Grant me +1|+0 for each time we've activated Nightfall this game.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Nightfall><style=Keyword>Nightfall</style></link>: Grant me +1|+0 for each time we've activated <link=keyword.Nightfall><style=Keyword>Nightfall</style></link> this game. <style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor: With every setting sun, the night unfurls its dark wings, and blots out the day's last remnants of hope.

cards.name: Passage Unearned
cards.text: Obliterate all units that were summoned, but not played, this round.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Obliterate><style=Vocab>Obliterate</style></link> all units that were summoned, but not played, this round.
cards.flavor:
"Of course, death is present in Demacia. We see it take our loved ones and know that, someday, it will come for us. But on these isles... I can almost taste death. I feel it in my lungs as I breathe, I hear it whisper in my ear. It is not some abstract notion. It sits with me here. Now. And it will have us all."
- Notes of Jens Tommen, historian

cards.name: Risen Mists
cards.text: Summon a Mistwraith.
cards.textHtml: Summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Mistwraith</style></link>.
cards.flavor: The mistwraiths move through planes unseen by mortal eyes, appear without warning, and inflict misery on all they encounter.

cards.name: Encroaching Shadows
cards.text: Grant ALL allies in your deck and hand +2|+2 and Ephemeral.
cards.textHtml: Grant ALL allies in your deck and hand +2|+2 and <link=keyword.Ephemeral><sprite name=Ephemeral><style=Keyword>Ephemeral</style></link>.
cards.flavor:
"Mind or body, I fear that the nightmares of the Shadow Isles will break us all eventually, and insanity will reign forever."
- Notes of Jens Tommen, historian

cards.name: Pesky Specter
cards.text: Last Breath: Create 2 copies of me in the enemy deck.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>Last Breath</style></link>: Create 2 copies of me in the enemy deck.
cards.flavor: Most of the spirits on the Shadow Isles are utterly terrifying and morbid creatures. A small handful are... well... just really, really annoying.

cards.name: Go Hard
cards.text:
Drain 1 from a unit.
Create 2 copies of Go Hard in your deck. Every third time this happens, transform all copies of me everywhere into Pack Your Bags.
cards.textHtml:
<link=keyword.Drain><style=Keyword>Drain</style></link> 1 from a unit.
Create 2 copies of <link=card.gohard><style=AssociatedCard>Go Hard</style></link> in your deck. Every third time this happens, transform all copies of me <link=vocab.Everywhere><style=Vocab>everywhere</style></link> into <link=card.transform><style=AssociatedCard>Pack Your Bags</style></link>. <style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor:
"We go hard, 'til we get it, get it
We go hard, we so in it, in it
We Pop Stars (Pop Stars), only winning, winning now
Ain't nobody bringing us down, down, down, down"
- Evelynn, 'POP/STARS'

cards.name: Pack Your Bags
cards.text: Deal 5 to all enemies and the enemy Nexus. Transform all copies of me everywhere back to Go Hard.
cards.textHtml: Deal 5 to all enemies and the enemy Nexus. Transform all copies of me <link=vocab.Everywhere><style=Vocab>everywhere</style></link> back to <link=card.transform><style=AssociatedCard>Go Hard</style></link>.
cards.flavor:
"Sorry for the bad news sorry I’m so bad
Only took a minute for me to get all you had
Sorry for the bad news know it makes you sad
I’ll be here for a minute baby you should pack your bags"
- Evelynn, 'THE BADDEST'

cards.name: Gluttony
cards.text: Kill an ally with Last Breath to summon a follower from your deck that costs 1 more.
cards.textHtml: Kill an ally with <link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>Last Breath</style></link> to summon a follower from your deck that costs 1 more.
cards.flavor: "SUPPAH TIIIIME!" - Ravenous Butcher

cards.name: Redfin Hammersnout
cards.text: Play: Grant an enemy Vulnerable.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Grant an enemy <link=keyword.Vulnerable><sprite name=Vulnerable><style=Keyword>Vulnerable</style></link>.
cards.flavor: When a hammersnout breaks a ship's keel, it seems to do it for sheer entertainment. They rarely devour the crew they stranded, instead leaving a feast for the creatures that follow.

cards.name: Bone Skewer
cards.text: An ally strikes an enemy, then moves to the top of your deck.
cards.textHtml: An ally <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strikes</style></link> an enemy, then moves to the top of your deck.
cards.flavor: "Little parting gift..." - Pyke

cards.name: Snapjaw Swarm
cards.text: Play: I start a free attack.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: I start a free attack.
cards.flavor:
"Drip, drop, drip, drop, the blood splashes down,
Swim, swim, comes the swarm, better now to drown,
Snip, snap, go the teeth, and we all scream,
To the deep, off we sleep, for forever dreams!"
- Bilgewater nursery rhyme

cards.name: Bloodbait
cards.text: Create a Snapjaw Swarm on top of your deck.
cards.textHtml: Create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Snapjaw Swarm</style></link> on top of your deck.
cards.flavor: "If it were up ta me, I'd have a jaull-fish take me afore them bloody things. Sooner go fast than be left screamin' fer me mates to stick me while I'm eaten alive." - Jagged Butcher

cards.name: Pyke
cards.text: When I Lurk, transform me into Death From Below.
cards.textHtml: When I <link=keyword.Lurker><sprite name=Lurker><style=Keyword>Lurk</style></link>, transform me into <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Death From Below</style></link>.
cards.levelup: Allied Pykes have dealt 15+ damage.
cards.flavor:
"...the visions are back again. I see his desperate eyes looking up at me whilst the jaull-fish closed its maw around him. We tried pulling, but the ship was too small, and the beast too big. I had no choice. I had to cut his line. I had to."
- Blood-soaked letter

cards.name: Pyke's Bone Skewer
cards.text:
An ally strikes an enemy, then moves to the top of your deck.
Create a Pyke in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
An ally <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strikes</style></link> an enemy, then moves to the top of your deck.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Pyke</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "Little parting gift..." - Pyke

cards.name: Pyke
cards.text:
When I Lurk, transform me into Death From Below.
When I kill an enemy, I strike the weakest enemy.
cards.textHtml:
When I <link=keyword.Lurker><sprite name=Lurker><style=Keyword>Lurk</style></link>, transform me into <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Death From Below</style></link>.
When I kill an enemy, I <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strike</style></link> the <link=keyword.Weakest><style=Keyword>weakest</style></link> enemy.
cards.flavor: First he came for his old crew, then other captains, then cheaters, gamblers, and drunkards. Pyke's craving for revenge slowly gave way to a newfound lust for murder. Now, instead of only listing those who once wronged him, his growing manifest only illustrates what Pyke has become.

cards.name: Death From Below
cards.text: Summon Pyke striking an enemy.
cards.textHtml: Summon <link=card.pykeL1><style=AssociatedCard>Pyke</style></link> <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>striking</style></link> an enemy.
cards.flavor: "Breach!" - Pyke

cards.name: The List
cards.text: Grant an enemy Vulnerable. If it's already Vulnerable, the strongest ally starts a free attack Challenging it.
cards.textHtml: Grant an enemy <link=keyword.Vulnerable><sprite name=Vulnerable><style=Keyword>Vulnerable</style></link>. If it's already <link=keyword.Vulnerable><sprite name=Vulnerable><style=Keyword>Vulnerable</style></link>, the <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> ally starts a free attack <link=keyword.Challenger><sprite name=Challenger><style=Keyword>Challenging</style></link> it.
cards.flavor: "You've got a name, and I've got a list." - Pyke

cards.name: Jaull-fish
cards.text: Play: Each Lurker ally strikes a random enemy.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.PlaySkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Play</style></link>: Each Lurker ally <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strikes</style></link> a random enemy.
cards.flavor: "Ain't nothin' like a jaull-fish to show you who you can trust, and who you can kill." - Pyke

cards.name: Frenzied Feast
cards.text: Each Lurker ally strikes a random enemy.
cards.textHtml: Each Lurker ally <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strikes</style></link> a random enemy.
cards.flavor: "They hurt. I know." - Pyke

cards.name: Lost Riches
cards.text: Draw a Treasure. If there aren't any to draw, create 2 Treasures in your deck instead.
cards.textHtml: Draw a Treasure. If there aren't any to draw, create 2 Treasures in your deck instead.
cards.flavor: "We're rich!" - Jagged Butcher

cards.name: Ripper's Bay
cards.text: When allies attack, before activating Lurk, grant the top ally in your deck Lurk and it becomes a Lurker.
cards.textHtml: When allies attack, before activating <link=keyword.Lurker><sprite name=Lurker><style=Keyword>Lurk</style></link>, grant the top ally in your deck <link=keyword.Lurker><sprite name=Lurker><style=Keyword>Lurk</style></link> and it becomes a Lurker.
cards.flavor: Bilgewater's more treacherous coves soon became home to all manner of sea beasts. There they lie, waiting for the next foolhardy crew to ignore the harbormaster's warnings.

cards.name: Monster Harpoon
cards.text:
Plunder: I cost 2 less.
Deal 5 to a unit.
cards.textHtml:
<link=keyword.Plunder><style=Keyword>Plunder</style></link>: I cost 2 less.
Deal 5 to a unit.
cards.flavor: "The beast's been stuck already, lads! Now stick it again 'til it stops thrashin' and the waters've lost their blue!" - Jagged Taskmaster

cards.name: Loaded Dice
cards.text: Next round, when you damage the enemy Nexus, Nab 1.
cards.textHtml: Next round, when you damage the enemy Nexus, <link=keyword.Nab><style=Keyword>Nab</style></link> 1.
cards.flavor: "So, what are you willin' to wager, friend?" - Tahm Kench

cards.name: Reaver's Row
cards.text:
When I count down, summon a random 1 cost follower.
Countdown 2: Grant 1 cost allies +2|+1 and Fearsome.
cards.textHtml:
When I count down, summon a random 1 cost follower.
<link=vocab.Countdown><style=Vocab>Countdown 2</style></link><style=Variable></style>: Grant 1 cost allies +2|+1 and <link=keyword.Fearsome><sprite name=Fearsome><style=Keyword>Fearsome</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "Ye think ye've got what it takes to call yourself a Hook, do ye? We'll see, ye tyke. By the time we're done with ye, ye'll either be worth yer weight, or ye'll be weighed down below the waves, bait fer the beasts!" - Petty Officer

cards.name: Line 'Em Up
cards.text:
Summon a Powder Keg.
Create a Knock 'Em Down in hand.
cards.textHtml:
Summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Powder Keg</style></link>.
Create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Knock 'Em Down</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: "Done as you asked, Cap'n. Give 'er a little spark and she'll kick back alright." - Dreadway Deckhand

cards.name: Knock 'Em Down
cards.text: Deal 1 to anything.
cards.textHtml: Deal 1 to anything.
cards.flavor: "A little spark, eh? I've just the thing..." - Gangplank

cards.name: Sharkling
cards.flavor: "Might not look much, aye, but they're eager for blood. And if you let 'em at you, they'll know where to find it when they're bigger. Best wear yer gloves." - Jaull Hunters

cards.name: Ruined Rex
cards.text: Play: Play Cannon Barrage on randomly targeted enemies for each card you've drawn this round, up to 6 times.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.PlaySkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Play</style></link>: Play <link=card.cast><style=AssociatedCard>Cannon Barrage</style></link> on randomly targeted enemies for each card you've drawn this round, up to 6 times. <style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor: "...Rex?" - Petty Officer

cards.name: Honored Lord
cards.text: The first time I Challenge an enemy, give me Barrier this round.
cards.textHtml: The first time I <link=keyword.Challenger><sprite name=Challenger><style=Keyword>Challenge</style></link> an enemy, give me <link=keyword.Barrier><sprite name=Barrier><style=Keyword>Barrier</style></link> this round.
cards.flavor: After learning of his son's disappearance, King Jarvan III tasked his trusted friend Lord Barrett Buvelle with organizing a search party. The prince returned safe and well. Lord Buvelle, to the king's eternal regret, did not.

cards.name: Golden Aegis
cards.text:
Give an ally Barrier this round.
Rally.
cards.textHtml:
Give an ally <link=keyword.Barrier><sprite name=Barrier><style=Keyword>Barrier</style></link> this round.
<link=vocab.Rally><style=Vocab>Rally</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "Once more, soldier of Demacia!" - Jarvan IV

cards.name: Cataclysm
cards.text: An ally starts a free attack Challenging an enemy.
cards.textHtml: An ally starts a free attack <link=keyword.Challenger><sprite name=Challenger><style=Keyword>Challenging</style></link> an enemy.
cards.flavor: "For the king!" - Jarvan IV

cards.name: Ardent Tracker
cards.text: When you summon an Elite, reduce my cost by 1.
cards.textHtml: When you summon an Elite, reduce my cost by 1.
cards.flavor: Though the Noxians had laid their trap well, still no-one knew the woods better than Demacia's scouts. Every snapped branch, every footprint was a clue that led them closer to their prince.

cards.name: Cithria, Lady of Clouds
cards.text: When I'm summoned, double other allies' Power and Health and grant them Challenger.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, double other allies' Power and Health and grant them <link=keyword.Challenger><sprite name=Challenger><style=Keyword>Challenger</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "Who else could Demacia send to save her prince than the Lady of Clouds herself?" - King Jarvan III

cards.name: Battlefield Prowess
cards.text: Grant an ally +1|+1.
cards.textHtml: Grant an ally +1|+1.
cards.flavor: "I could teach you a thing or two." - Lord Buvelle

cards.name: Penitent Squire
cards.text: When I'm summoned, if you Behold an Elite, create a Tattered Banner in hand.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, if you <link=vocab.Behold><style=Vocab>Behold</style></link> an Elite, create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Tattered Banner</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: Only when she reached the city's walls did her legs finally give way. The Dauntless Vanguard would carry her message to the king, and the king would save the prince. Thus would her wrong be righted, and her honor preserved.

cards.name: Tattered Banner
cards.text: The next time you summon an ally this round, grant it Challenger.
cards.textHtml: The next time you summon an ally this round, grant it <link=keyword.Challenger><sprite name=Challenger><style=Keyword>Challenger</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "Form up, on me!" - Silverwing Vanguard

cards.name: Jarvan IV
cards.text: When you attack, pay my cost to summon me Challenging the strongest enemy.
cards.textHtml: When you attack, pay my cost to summon me <link=keyword.Challenger><sprite name=Challenger><style=Keyword>Challenging</style></link> the <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> enemy.
cards.levelup: Allies have survived 3+ strikes from enemy blockers.
cards.flavor: The Noxians knew where Prince Jarvan's hunt would take him. They knew how many Demacians would be by his side, and they knew that his honor wouldn't permit him to flee. The trap was set.

cards.name: Jarvan IV
cards.text:
When you attack, pay my cost to summon me Challenging the strongest enemy.
Round Start: Create a Fleeting Cataclysm in hand.
When I Challenge an enemy, give me Barrier this round.
cards.textHtml:
When you attack, pay my cost to summon me <link=keyword.Challenger><sprite name=Challenger><style=Keyword>Challenging</style></link> the <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> enemy.
<link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Create a <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Cataclysm</style></link> in hand.
When I <link=keyword.Challenger><sprite name=Challenger><style=Keyword>Challenge</style></link> an enemy, give me <link=keyword.Barrier><sprite name=Barrier><style=Keyword>Barrier</style></link> this round.
cards.flavor: But the Noxians did fail to account for the young prince's sheer strength and uncompromising will. They paid for this miscalculation in blood.

cards.name: Jarvan IV's Cataclysm
cards.text:
An ally starts a free attack Challenging an enemy.
Create a Jarvan IV in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
An ally starts a free attack <link=keyword.Challenger><sprite name=Challenger><style=Keyword>Challenging</style></link> an enemy.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Jarvan IV</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "For the king!" - Jarvan IV

cards.name: Gallant Rider
cards.text: The first time I Challenge an enemy, transform me into Vanguard Cavalry.
cards.textHtml: The first time I <link=keyword.Challenger><sprite name=Challenger><style=Keyword>Challenge</style></link> an enemy, transform me into <link=card.transform><style=AssociatedCard>Vanguard Cavalry</style></link>.
cards.flavor: Once the call was made, every Demacian soldier was summoned to aid in the search for the prince. Expediency, more than anything, was key.

cards.name: King Jarvan III
cards.text:
When I'm summoned, draw Jarvan IV. 
If he's already in play, instead give allies Challenger and Scout this round.
cards.textHtml:
When I'm summoned, draw <link=card.champ1><style=AssociatedCard>Jarvan IV</style></link>. 
If he's already in play, instead give allies <link=keyword.Challenger><sprite name=Challenger><style=Keyword>Challenger</style></link> and <link=keyword.Scout><sprite name=Scout><style=Keyword>Scout</style></link> this round.
cards.flavor: "What, pray tell, would a father sacrifice to save his son? Better yet, what would a king?" - LeBlanc

cards.name: Field Promotion
cards.text: The next time you play a unit this round, grant it Scout. It's now an Elite.
cards.textHtml: The next time you play a unit this round, grant it <link=keyword.Scout><sprite name=Scout><style=Keyword>Scout</style></link>. It's now an Elite.
cards.flavor: When Demacians' mettle is tested, they rise to the occasion.

cards.name: Towering Stonehorn
cards.text: I don't take damage from enemy spells or Skills.
cards.textHtml: I don't take damage from enemy spells or <link=keyword.Skill><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Skills</style></link>.
cards.flavor: The great Stonehorns are reputed to have come from the time the petricite forest was young, their spreading antlers made of a material similar to those now-ancient trees.

cards.name: Dragon Chow
cards.text: When you play a Dragon, it strikes me and you draw 1.
cards.textHtml: When you play a Dragon, it <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strikes</style></link> me and you draw 1.
cards.flavor: "That shriek you hear from way up high? That's no bird, my boy. That's the cry of a hunting dragon." - Demacian farmer

cards.name: Swiftwing Flight
cards.text:
Play: Create a Silverwing Vanguard, Blinding Assault, or Fleetfeather Tracker in hand.
Attack: Give other Challenging allies +1|+1 this round.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Create a <link=card.create1><style=AssociatedCard>Silverwing Vanguard</style></link>, <link=card.create2><style=AssociatedCard>Blinding Assault</style></link>, or <link=card.create3><style=AssociatedCard>Fleetfeather Tracker</style></link> in hand.
<link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Give other <link=keyword.Challenger><sprite name=Challenger><style=Keyword>Challenging</style></link> allies +1|+1 this round.
cards.flavor: The very sight of the Swiftwing flight inspires Demacian soldiers on fields far below. Upon seeing them descend through the clouds, those on the ground are reinvigorated, and ready to continue the fight.

cards.name: Kadregrin the Ruined
cards.text: Play: Grant an ally Challenger and +1|+1.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Grant an ally <link=keyword.Challenger><sprite name=Challenger><style=Keyword>Challenger</style></link> and +1|+1.
cards.flavor: Kadregrin sowed chaos and fear long before the Black Mist reached Demacia. Under Viego's command, however, his skills would bolster all of the Ruined King's forces.

cards.name: Ruined Dragonguard
cards.text: When an ally with Fury kills a unit, grant it an additional +1|+1.
cards.textHtml: When an ally with <link=keyword.Fury><sprite name=Fury><style=Keyword>Fury</style></link> kills a unit, grant it an additional +1|+1.
cards.flavor: The Mist warped Gregem's mind, forcing him to relive Wrenwall, over and over. Stoked by long-buried bitterness and rage, he turned against the comrades who once stood with him.

cards.name: Frozen Thrall
cards.text: Countdown 9: Summon a Frostguard Thrall.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Countdown><style=Keyword>Countdown 9</style></link><style=Variable></style>: Summon a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Frostguard Thrall</style></link>.
cards.flavor: Certainly, there were enough half-witted warriors within the ranks of Trundle's disorderly army to use as front-line fodder, but Lissandra desired something much more loyal, something that served her, and her alone...

cards.name: Frostguard Thrall
cards.flavor: Freed from its icy tomb, the corrupted troll knew one thing, and one thing only - it must do as its dark mistress commanded.

cards.name: Lissandra
cards.text: When I'm summoned, summon a Frozen Thrall and advance it 2.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, summon a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Frozen Thrall</style></link> and <link=vocab.Advance><style=Vocab>advance</style></link> it 2.
cards.levelup: You've summoned 2+ allies that cost 8+. When I level up, create a Watcher in hand.
cards.flavor: "The Watchers lurk just beyond these walls, suspended in ice, frozen in time... and while they wait, I have plans that must be set in motion..."

cards.name: Lissandra
cards.text:
Your Nexus is Tough.
When I'm summoned, summon a Frozen Thrall and advance it 2.
Round Start: Create a Fleeting 0 cost Ice Shard in hand.
cards.textHtml:
Your Nexus is <link=keyword.Tough><sprite name=Tough><style=Keyword>Tough</style></link>.
When I'm summoned, summon a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Frozen Thrall</style></link> and <link=vocab.Advance><style=Vocab>advance</style></link> it 2.
<link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Create a <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> 0 cost <link=card.cast><style=AssociatedCard>Ice Shard</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: Few know what Lissandra sacrificed in order to gain power, her ambitions too great to be stymied by mortal trappings.

cards.name: Lissandra's Entomb
cards.text:
Obliterate a unit to summon a Frozen Tomb in place with the unit stored inside.
Create a Lissandra in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Obliterate><style=Vocab>Obliterate</style></link> a unit to summon a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Frozen Tomb</style></link> in place with the unit stored inside.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Lissandra</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "Kneel, or freeze." - Lissandra

cards.name: Watcher
cards.text:
I cost 0 if you've summoned 5+ allies that cost 8+ this game. 
Attack: Obliterate the enemy deck, leaving 3 non-champions.
cards.textHtml:
I cost 0 if you've summoned 5+ allies that cost 8+ this game. <style=Variable></style>
<link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: <link=vocab.Obliterate><style=Vocab>Obliterate</style></link> the enemy deck, leaving 3 non-champions.
cards.flavor: "This is the end. As it was foretold -- as I promised. Sisters... forgive me." - Lissandra

cards.name: Draklorn Inquisitor
cards.text:
When I'm summoned, summon a Frozen Thrall.
Round End: If the Countdown of any of your Frozen Thralls is 4 or less, advance them to 0.
cards.textHtml:
When I'm summoned, summon a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Frozen Thrall</style></link>.
<link=vocab.RoundEnd><style=Vocab>Round End</style></link>: If the <link=keyword.Countdown><style=Keyword>Countdown</style></link> of any of your <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Frozen Thralls</style></link> is 4 or less, <link=vocab.Advance><style=Vocab>advance</style></link> them to 0.
cards.flavor: "My lady appears to me in dreams, her voice near a whisper. 'Follow,' she bids me. This command I dare not disobey."

cards.name: Entomb
cards.text: Obliterate a unit to summon a Frozen Tomb in place with the unit stored inside.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Obliterate><style=Vocab>Obliterate</style></link> a unit to summon a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Frozen Tomb</style></link> in place with the unit stored inside.
cards.flavor: "Kneel, or freeze." - Lissandra

cards.name: Frozen Tomb
cards.text: Countdown 2: Summon exact copies of the units and landmarks stored inside.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Countdown><style=Vocab>Countdown 2</style></link><style=Variable></style>: Summon exact copies of the units and landmarks stored inside.
cards.flavor: "Our lady will bury this world and all you know in ice." - Draklorn Inquisitor

cards.name: Ice Shard
cards.text: Deal 1 to EVERYTHING.
cards.textHtml: Deal 1 to EVERYTHING.
cards.flavor: "I will bury the world in ice." - Lissandra

cards.name: Three Sisters
cards.text: Create a Fleeting Flash Freeze, Fury of the North, or Entomb in hand.
cards.textHtml: Create a <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> <link=card.create1><style=AssociatedCard>Flash Freeze</style></link>, <link=card.create2><style=AssociatedCard>Fury of the North</style></link>, or <link=card.create3><style=AssociatedCard>Entomb</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: The Freljordian sisters Avarosa, Serylda, and Lissandra bore tremendous power, though chose to wield it in different ways - each one distinctly merciful, martial, or malicious.

cards.name: Succumb to the Cold
cards.text:
Frostbite an enemy.
Summon a Frozen Thrall.
cards.textHtml:
<link=keyword.Frostbite><sprite name=Frostbite><style=Keyword>Frostbite</style></link> an enemy.
Summon a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Frozen Thrall</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "The cold elicits many reactions. Let us find out yours." - Lissandra

cards.name: Buried in Ice
cards.text: Obliterate each enemy to summon a Frozen Tomb in place with the enemy stored inside.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Obliterate><style=Vocab>Obliterate</style></link> each enemy to summon a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Frozen Tomb</style></link> in place with the enemy stored inside.
cards.flavor: "The cold overcomes all, eventually." - Lissandra

cards.name: Cold Resistance
cards.text: Get an empty mana gem and grant an ally +0|+2.
cards.textHtml: Get an empty mana gem and grant an ally +0|+2.
cards.flavor: "Beware the ice... and more importantly... beware what lies within!" - Scrawled on a Freljord inn wall

cards.name: Blighted Ravine
cards.text:
When I'm summoned, heal your Nexus 2.
Countdown 1: Deal 2 to ALL units.
cards.textHtml:
When I'm summoned, heal your Nexus 2.
<link=keyword.Countdown><style=Keyword>Countdown 1</style></link><style=Variable></style>: Deal 2 to ALL units.
cards.flavor: Bizarre forms made of dark ice sprout from every surface along the ravine, their outward-facing spikes deterring any would-be intruders.

cards.name: Fabled Poro
cards.text: When I'm summoned, grant Poro allies a random keyword.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, grant Poro allies a random keyword.
cards.flavor: There is one figure said to be legendary to all porokind. It is said that, as he travels, he bestows his deserving furry friends with all manner of magical forged gifts.

cards.name: Spoils of War
cards.text:
Grant an ally +1|+2.
Plunder: Grant +2|+4 instead.
cards.textHtml:
Grant an ally +1|+2.
<link=keyword.Plunder><style=Keyword>Plunder</style></link>: Grant +2|+4 instead.
cards.flavor: "You Avarosans only grow weak and plump in your fertile fields. So rest tonight, you pitiful weaklings, and while you dream of tomorrow's bounty, we will take it." - Scarmother Vrynna

cards.name: Ancestral Boon
cards.text:
Grant the top ally in your deck +2|+2.
Enlightened: Instead, grant all allies in your deck +2|+2.
cards.textHtml:
Grant the top ally in your deck +2|+2.
<link=keyword.Enlightened><style=Keyword>Enlightened</style></link>: Instead, grant all allies in your deck +2|+2.
cards.flavor: The Freljord's unrelenting cold and punishing storms kill most who enter its barren lands. But those who survive find within themselves an inner strength that spurs them onward through the rest of their lives.

cards.name: Abominable Guardian
cards.text:
While I'm in hand, Round Start: If you have 2+ Yetis, summon me and create a copy of me in your deck.
Play: Draw a Yeti.
cards.textHtml:
While I'm in hand, <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: If you have 2+ Yetis, summon me and create a copy of me in your deck.
<link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Draw a Yeti.
cards.flavor: "...and they're sneaky, too! Last time I was out there, I had found shelter in a cave, only to find yearlings in there, fast asleep. Tried to keep my distance, but then one of the big 'uns returned, tall as a mountain, and covered in ice! Now you listen to me, because..." - Babbling Bjerg

cards.name: Rimefang Denmother
cards.text: When I'm summoned, summon a Rimefang Pack.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Rimefang Pack</style></link>. <style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor: The rimefang wolves circled the drüvask, crouched low, wary. The stench of death clung tightly to it, pungent and overwhelming.

cards.name: Rimefang Pack
cards.text: I have +1|+0 for each time you've Frostbitten enemies this game.
cards.textHtml: I have +1|+0 for each time you've <link=keyword.Frostbite><sprite name=Frostbite><style=Keyword>Frostbitten</style></link> enemies this game.
cards.flavor: The young wolves were the most nervous, but were quickly emboldened as they saw their mother lunge for the boar's throat, icy fangs flashing.

cards.name: Field Musicians
cards.text: Each round, once you've summoned 3 other allies, refill your spell mana and draw 1.
cards.textHtml: Each round, once you've summoned 3 other allies, refill your spell mana and draw 1. <style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor: For some, music is a shared refuge from hardship and violence. For others, music is resistance.

cards.name: Zinneia, Steel Crescendo
cards.text:
When you Blade Dance, I attack with the Blades.
Play: Blade Dance 1.
cards.textHtml:
When you <link=vocab.BladeDance><style=Vocab>Blade Dance</style></link>, I attack with the <link=card.blade><style=AssociatedCard>Blades</style></link>.
<link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: <link=vocab.BladeDance><style=Vocab>Blade Dance</style></link> 1.
cards.flavor: "Gather round, my darlings. Today our feet will glide 'cross the ground that nourished us, with the movements our families taught us. We are children of Ionia, and today we dance for art, for freedom, for each other!"

cards.name: Vanguard's Edge
cards.text: Pick an ally to attack alongside the Blades, then Blade Dance 3.
cards.textHtml: Pick an ally to attack alongside the <link=card.blade><style=AssociatedCard>Blades</style></link>, then <link=vocab.BladeDance><style=Vocab>Blade Dance</style></link> 3.
cards.flavor: "Stop their retreat! The Noxians started this war, but we will end it." - Irelia

cards.name: Blossoming Blade
cards.text: Play: Blade Dance 2.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: <link=vocab.BladeDance><style=Vocab>Blade Dance</style></link> 2.
cards.flavor:
"There are those who think a flower is a fragile, delicate thing. They forget how much strength it takes to hold fast to the humble earth and inspire hope with every bloom."
- Zinneia, Steel Crescendo

cards.name: Irelia
cards.text: When I'm summoned or Round Start: If you have the attack token, create a Flawless Duet in hand.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned or <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: If you have the attack token, create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Flawless Duet</style></link> in hand.
cards.levelup: You've attacked with 14+ allies.
cards.flavor: "Once we studied art and beauty, and our hearts soared. But when they broke our walls and spilled our blood, we fell back down to earth..."

cards.name: Irelia's Vanguard's Edge
cards.text:
Pick an ally to attack alongside the Blades, then Blade Dance 3.
Create an Irelia in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
Pick an ally to attack alongside the <link=card.blade><style=AssociatedCard>Blades</style></link>, then <link=vocab.BladeDance><style=Vocab>Blade Dance</style></link> 3.
Create an <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Irelia</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "Stop their retreat! The Noxians started this war, but we will end it." - Irelia

cards.name: Irelia
cards.text:
When I'm summoned or Round Start: If you have the attack token, create a Flawless Duet in hand.
When allies attack, create a Bladesurge in hand.
cards.textHtml:
When I'm summoned or <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: If you have the attack token, create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Flawless Duet</style></link> in hand.
When allies attack, create a <link=card.create2><style=AssociatedCard>Bladesurge</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: "...Though our hearts are heavy, we are full of purpose, and return to dance once more."

cards.name: Bladesurge
cards.text: Swap Irelia with an ally.
cards.textHtml: Swap <link=card.parentRef><style=AssociatedCard>Irelia</style></link> with an ally.
cards.flavor: "Follow my lead!" - Irelia

cards.name: Flawless Duet
cards.text: Blade Dance 2.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.BladeDance><style=Vocab>Blade Dance</style></link> 2.
cards.flavor: "There is no song more perfect than that of two voices entwined in harmony..." - Blossoming Blade

cards.name: Coastal Defender
cards.text: When you summon another ally, give me +2|+0 this round.
cards.textHtml: When you summon another ally, give me +2|+0 this round.
cards.flavor:
My dearest Kay, 
They arrived this morning in a line of ships that broke the horizon and blotted out the sunrise. Their machines set fire to the Silver Plains, and now a thick smoke crawls through the summer air. We can stand by no longer. Rake or shovel, scythe or sword, today we must go to meet our destiny. 
Know that I love you and our home more than I have words to write.
- Charred letter

cards.name: Syncopation
cards.text: Swap 2 allies.
cards.textHtml: Swap 2 allies.
cards.flavor: "To dance is to move in harmony with the motions of all things." - Zinneia, Steel Crescendo

cards.name: Defiant Dance
cards.text:
Recall a unit.
Blade Dance 1.
cards.textHtml:
<link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recall</style></link> a unit.
<link=vocab.BladeDance><style=Vocab>Blade Dance</style></link> 1.
cards.flavor: "Fall back! It's time for another to take center stage!" - Zinneia, Steel Crescendo

cards.name: Ribbon Dancer
cards.text: Play: Blade Dance 1.
