cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: <link=vocab.BladeDance><style=Vocab>Blade Dance</style></link> 1.
cards.flavor: "What a shame, boys! All that power and just no rhythm to match it? We can't ALL be stars, I guess...!"

cards.name: Blade
cards.text: Obliterate me when I leave combat.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Obliterate><style=Vocab>Obliterate</style></link> me when I leave combat.
cards.flavor: "Keep your skills sharp--it is not only the blade that strikes, but the hand behind it." - Irelia

cards.name: Lead and Follow
cards.text: Recall an ally to create a Flawless Duet in hand.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recall</style></link> an ally to create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Flawless Duet</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: "Our performance will be... unforgettable." - Zinneia, Steel Crescendo

cards.name: Shadows of the Past
cards.text: Recall each ally and summon a Living Shadow in its place.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recall</style></link> each ally and summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Living Shadow</style></link> in its place.
cards.flavor: "Let them strike at shadows, where their weapons will find no purchase." - Zed

cards.name: Sacred Protector
cards.text:
Play: Give an ally Barrier this round and draw a Shen.
Allies with Barrier have Double Attack.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Give an ally <link=keyword.Barrier><sprite name=Barrier><style=Keyword>Barrier</style></link> this round and draw a <link=card.champ1><style=AssociatedCard>Shen</style></link>.
Allies with <link=keyword.Barrier><sprite name=Barrier><style=Keyword>Barrier</style></link> have <link=keyword.Double Strike><sprite name=DoubleStrike><style=Keyword>Double Attack</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "Just as we fight to protect the land, the land itself rises up to defend us. We draw strength from the earth's wrath and drive out our enemies. And so, balance remains." - Ionian Priest

cards.name: Shadow Apprentice
cards.text: When you summon an Ephemeral ally, give me +1|+0 this round.
cards.textHtml: When you summon an <link=keyword.Ephemeral><sprite name=Ephemeral><style=Keyword>Ephemeral</style></link> ally, give me +1|+0 this round.
cards.flavor: "You are smoke—a whisper on the wind. Your fists must join with the dark like shade to shadow. Now... again!" - Mistress Shi

cards.name: Dancing Droplet
cards.text: When I'm Recalled, draw 1.
cards.textHtml: When I'm <link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recalled</style></link>, draw 1.
cards.flavor: "Water is flexible, adaptive - it will take the form most needed in the moment, flowing forth or retreating from the shore." - Ionian monk

cards.name: Scattered Pod
cards.text:
Play: Draw a Slow, Fast, or Burst spell.
Enlightened: I have Elusive.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Draw a <link=keyword.Slow><sprite name=Slow><style=Keyword>Slow</style></link>, <link=keyword.Fast><sprite name=Fast><style=Keyword>Fast</style></link>, or <link=keyword.Burst><sprite name=Burst><style=Keyword>Burst</style></link> spell.
<link=keyword.Enlightened><style=Keyword>Enlightened</style></link>: I have <link=keyword.Elusive><sprite name=Elusive><style=Keyword>Elusive</style></link>.
cards.flavor: The strange and hauntingly beautiful sky-songs of the Cloud Drinkers kept some of the Black Mist at bay... but only for so long.

cards.text:
Play: Draw a Slow spell.
Enlightened: I have Elusive.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Draw a <link=keyword.Slow><sprite name=Slow><style=Keyword>Slow</style></link> spell.

cards.name: Rockfall Path
cards.text: Countdown 2: Obliterate the weakest enemy.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Countdown><style=Vocab>Countdown 2</style></link><style=Variable></style>: <link=vocab.Obliterate><style=Vocab>Obliterate</style></link> the <link=keyword.Weakest><style=Keyword>weakest</style></link> enemy.
cards.flavor:
"Okay so EV-ER-EE-BODY watch out here cuz dis is a BIG DROP an' I've fallen down here a few times and LEMME TELL YOU it's a long way down! An' I'm made of wok so I just bounce, but dat's not true for you guys... so be caref--ooh dere's Cliff! Let's go say hi!"
- Adventures with Chip, part 3

cards.name: Stonebreaker
cards.text: Play: If you've summoned 4+ landmarks this game, deal 4 to an enemy and 2 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Elemental Skill><sprite name=ElementalSkill><style=Keyword>Play</style></link>: If you've summoned 4+ landmarks this game, deal 4 to an enemy and 2 to the enemy Nexus. <style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor: From time to time, the great colossi of Targon awaken from their slumber and trek to new grounds atop the great mountain. These events are never quiet, and seldom safe.

cards.name: Shaken Ground
cards.text: If you've summoned 4+ landmarks this game, deal 4 to an enemy and 2 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml: If you've summoned 4+ landmarks this game, deal 4 to an enemy and 2 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: "Spike is not a morning person..." - Malphite

cards.name: Earth Elemental
cards.text: Once you've summoned 4+ landmarks this game, grant me +3|+0.
cards.textHtml: Once you've summoned 4+ landmarks this game, grant me +3|+0. <style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor:
"Okay, so dis is CLIFF! He's a big ol' fella who's been aroun' da block QUITE A FEW times let me tell you. An' I know dat he looks cool and I know dat he seems like a nice guy, but he's got a lotta heavy stuff on his back, and sometimes it falls on people so BE CAREFUL okay? Thank you moving on!"
- Adventures with Chip, part 4

cards.name: Blue Sentinel
cards.text: Last Breath: Summon a Crest of Insight.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>Last Breath</style></link>: Summon a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Crest of Insight</style></link>.
cards.flavor:
"Okay EV-ER-EE-ONE say "HI BLU!" HI BLU! Okay one time I thought he was like "HI BLU!" back, but now dat I think about it might have been my voice bouncin' off da walls. OH WELL he's all magical and stuff and also blue so if you ask me he doesn't even NEED to speak! OKAY BYE BLUE LET'S GO!"
- Adventures with Chip, part 5

cards.name: Crest of Insight
cards.text: Countdown 1: Get an extra mana gem this round.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Countdown><style=Keyword>Countdown 1</style></link><style=Variable></style>: Get an extra mana gem this round.
cards.flavor: "Dis is Blu's faaaaaavorite place inna whole wide world! He says it's SUPER magical! Oooh, ahhh!" - Chip

cards.name: Chip
cards.text: Once you've summoned a landmark this game, grant me +2|+2.
cards.textHtml: Once you've summoned a landmark this game, grant me +2|+2.
cards.flavor:
"Okay so hello I'm Chip an' I'm here to show you Targon! It's wowow big an' tall so I hope you got good shoes for da walkin'! Let's GO!"
- Adventures with Chip, part 1

cards.name: Starlit Epiphany
cards.text:
Invoke.
If you have a Celestial ally, replace your deck with 20 copies of Behold the Infinite.
cards.textHtml:
<link=keyword.Invoke><style=Keyword>Invoke</style></link>.
If you have a Celestial ally, replace your deck with 20 copies of <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Behold the Infinite</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "Look, Kulun! The stars have so many stories to tell! Which should we read tonight, hmm?" - Moondreamer

cards.name: Ground Slam
cards.text: Stun an enemy. Deal 3 to it if you've summoned a landmark this game.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> an enemy. Deal 3 to it if you've summoned a landmark this game.
cards.flavor: "Oop yep dat's just da ground shakin' and not papa doin' nothin' with his hands NOPE OKAY onwards annn' UPWARDS!" - Chip

cards.name: Malphite
cards.text: Play: Stun an enemy.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Elemental Skill><sprite name=ElementalSkill><style=Keyword>Play</style></link>: <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> an enemy.
cards.levelup: You've summoned 10+ mana of landmarks. When I level up, if you have the attack token, create an Unstoppable Force in hand.
cards.flavor:
"And here's da last stop on da Chip tour of Targon! It's PAPA! He's da BIGGEST of da Targon giants, an' sings a mean song, too, lemme tell ya. Just don't try to climb him! Da spikes tickle him, and you dun want him sneezin' when you're halfway up no sah!"
- Adventures with Chip, part 6

cards.name: Malphite
cards.text:
Play: Stun an enemy.
When I'm summoned or Round Start: If you have the attack token, create an Unstoppable Force in hand.
cards.textHtml:
<link=keyword.Elemental Skill><sprite name=ElementalSkill><style=Keyword>Play</style></link>: <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> an enemy.
When I'm summoned or <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: If you have the attack token, create an <link=card.cast><style=AssociatedCard>Unstoppable Force</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: "Boom boom boom!"

cards.name: Unstoppable Force
cards.text: Stun all enemies.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> all enemies.
cards.flavor: "ROCK. SOLID." - Malphite

cards.name: Malphite's Ground Slam
cards.text:
Stun an enemy. Deal 3 to it if you've summoned a landmark this game.
Create a Malphite in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
<link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> an enemy. Deal 3 to it if you've summoned a landmark this game.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Malphite</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "Oop yep dat's just da ground shakin' and not papa doin' nothin' with his hands NOPE OKAY onwards annn' UPWARDS!" - Chip

cards.name: Rockslide
cards.text: Stun an enemy.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> an enemy.
cards.flavor: "Only place to go is down!" - Malphite

cards.name: Spiral Stairs
cards.text: Countdown 3: Create a Seed of Strength in hand.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Countdown><style=Keyword>Countdown 3</style></link><style=Variable></style>: Create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Seed of Strength</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor:
"Here's da first stop on da tour! I call this da leg wobbler because WOWEE are dere a lot steps! Pretty cool view too, an' dat's one of the best things in Targon. Okay let's GO!"
- Adventures with Chip, part 2

cards.name: Seed of Strength
cards.text: Grant an ally +3|+2 and Overwhelm.
cards.textHtml: Grant an ally +3|+2 and <link=keyword.Overwhelm><sprite name=Overwhelm><style=Keyword>Overwhelm</style></link>.
cards.flavor:
"OH I FORGOT. Okay so you're probabab... probababer... problee thinkin' dat your legs are like WOWOW tired right now, but I seen the people who walk around here a lot, an' sooner or later dey get ALL KINDSA muscles! So keep at it, and let's GO! AGAIN!"
- Adventures with Chip, part 2.1

cards.name: Startipped Peak
cards.text: Countdown 2: Create 2 random Celestial cards that cost 3 or less in hand.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Countdown><style=Keyword>Countdown 2</style></link><style=Variable></style>: Create 2 random Celestial cards that cost 3 or less in hand.
cards.flavor: Those who set off to climb Mount Targon are soon rewarded with some of Runeterra's most glorious views. And as the climb steepens, so do its rewards.

cards.name: Destiny's Call
cards.text: Grant an ally in hand +8|+8.
cards.textHtml: Grant an ally in hand +8|+8.
cards.flavor: "Embrace your destiny, and shine more brilliantly than anyone could have ever known." - Taric

cards.name: Solari Sunhawk
cards.text: Daybreak: Stun the strongest enemy.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.PlaySkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword></style></link><link=keyword.Daybreak><style=Keyword>Daybreak</style></link>: <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> the <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> enemy.
cards.flavor: The Solari believe that it was Targon's sunhawks--brilliant as they are--who caught the Immortal Fire's attention, and who subsequently inspired her cycle of death and rebirth.

cards.name: Blinding Crest
cards.text: Stun the Strongest enemy.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> the <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>Strongest</style></link> enemy.
cards.flavor: Some Solari claim the sunhawk's brilliant gleam is the bird trying to send a signal to The Immortal Fire herself.

cards.name: Eye of the Ra-Horak
cards.text:
Countdown 1: Stun the 2 weakest enemies.
Daybreak: Summon a copy of me with Countdown 2.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Countdown><style=Vocab>Countdown 1</style></link><style=Variable></style>: <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> the 2 <link=keyword.Weakest><style=Keyword>weakest</style></link> enemies.
<link=keyword.Daybreak><style=Keyword>Daybreak</style></link>: Summon a copy of me with <link=vocab.Countdown><style=Vocab>Countdown</style></link> 2.
cards.flavor: "Let the sun shed Her light upon us. Those who are weak and unworthy will cower before Her gaze!" - Solari Priestess

cards.name: Heavens Aligned
cards.text:
Daybreak: Create a random Nightfall card in hand.
Nightfall: Create a random Daybreak card in hand.
cards.textHtml:
<link=keyword.Daybreak><style=Keyword>Daybreak</style></link>: Create a random <link=keyword.Nightfall><style=Keyword>Nightfall</style></link> card in hand.
<link=keyword.Nightfall><style=Keyword>Nightfall</style></link>: Create a random <link=keyword.Daybreak><style=Keyword>Daybreak</style></link> card in hand.
cards.flavor: So goes the cycle of night and day, one always following the other.

cards.name: Frightened Ibex
cards.text: When I'm supported, give me and my supporting ally +1|+1 this round.
cards.textHtml: When I'm supported, give me and my supporting ally +1|+1 this round.
cards.flavor:
"Don't be afraid of the howling gale
As it blows 'cross the mountain and through the dale
Never you worry, you have nothing to fear
My darling, rest, mother is near." - Targonian lullaby

cards.name: Mimic
cards.text:
Reputation: I cost 3 less. 
When you play your next spell this round, copy it with the same targets.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Reputation><style=Vocab>Reputation</style></link>: I cost 3 less. <style=Variable></style>
When you play your next spell this round, copy it with the same targets.
cards.flavor: Imitation is flattery, and flattery can be quite deadly.

cards.name: Whispered Words
cards.text:
Reputation: I cost 2 less. 
Draw 2.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Reputation><style=Vocab>Reputation</style></link>: I cost 2 less. <style=Variable></style>
Draw 2.
cards.flavor: Before the news, the rumors. Before the rumors, the play. Before the play, the plot.

cards.name: Sigil of Malice
cards.text:
Reputation: I cost 2 less. 
Deal 2 to anything.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Reputation><style=Vocab>Reputation</style></link>: I cost 2 less. <style=Variable></style>
Deal 2 to anything.
cards.flavor: Once the battle is won, one must not hesitate, but press on, pursue, and annihilate their foe.

cards.name: LeBlanc
cards.levelup: I've seen you deal 15+ damage. When I level up, create a Mirror Image in hand.
cards.flavor: "Now now, no need to squabble amongst ourselves. For the moment, we will refrain from any rash action. Let us reconvene once we've heard from our emissary. After all..."

cards.name: LeBlanc's Sigil of Malice
cards.text:
Reputation: I cost 2 less. 
Deal 2 to anything.
Create a LeBlanc in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Reputation><style=Vocab>Reputation</style></link>: I cost 2 less. <style=Variable></style>
Deal 2 to anything.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>LeBlanc</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: Once the battle is won, one must not hesitate, but press on, pursue, and annihilate their foe.

cards.name: LeBlanc
cards.text: Each time you deal 15+ damage, create a Mirror Image in hand. If you already have one, reduce its cost by 1 instead.
cards.textHtml: Each time you deal 15+ damage, create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Mirror Image</style></link> in hand. If you already have one, reduce its cost by 1 instead. <style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor: "...we all want the same thing."

cards.name: Mirror Image
cards.text: Pick an ally. Summon an exact Ephemeral copy of it.
cards.textHtml: Pick an ally. Summon an exact <link=keyword.Ephemeral><sprite name=Ephemeral><style=Keyword>Ephemeral</style></link> copy of it.
cards.flavor: "Seeing double?" - LeBlanc

cards.name: Black Rose Spy
cards.text: Reputation: When I'm summoned, transform me into an exact copy of the strongest ally that struck this round.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Reputation><style=Vocab>Reputation</style></link>: When I'm summoned, transform me into an exact copy of the <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> ally that <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>struck</style></link> this round. <style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor: "A secret is only worth the cost of keeping it."

cards.name: Atakhan, Bringer of Ruin
cards.text:
Play: Revive the Strongest dead ally.
Attack: Grant me Power equal to the total Power of all allies.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Revive the <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>Strongest</style></link> dead ally.
<link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Grant me Power equal to the total Power of all allies.
cards.flavor: A nameless aberration towered above them in the smoke-filled chamber. The mages chanted in discordant chorus, dread their voices reaching a strained, fevered pitch. The monster breathed deep of their mounting fear, and each breath brought it terrible power.

cards.name: Incisive Tactician
cards.text:
Reputation: I cost 2 less. 
When I'm summoned, Rally.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Reputation><style=Vocab>Reputation</style></link>: I cost 2 less. <style=Variable></style>
When I'm summoned, <link=vocab.Rally><style=Vocab>Rally</style></link>.
cards.flavor: Within the inner chambers of the Black Rose, Noxian nobles play their pieces, and murder befalls distant victims.

cards.name: Thorned Blade
cards.text: Give an ally +5|+0 this round.
cards.textHtml: Give an ally +5|+0 this round.
cards.flavor: "You will act with grace and courtesy. You will flatter, you will disarm. You will listen. You will learn. And, when it is time, you will strike, and you WILL kill." - LeBlanc

cards.name: Thorn of the Rose
cards.text: When I'm summoned, create a Guile in hand.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, create a <link=card.guile><style=AssociatedCard>Guile</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: "Aelana, my dearest friend and colleague! Have you seen Lord Duin about...? Ah, what a shame. I was very much looking forward to catching up. I do hope he paced himself tonight. I would hate for anything to happen to the old boy..." - Lady Auvray, Black Rose Spy

cards.name: Bloody Business
cards.text:
Reputation: I cost 2 less. 
An ally with 5+ Power strikes an enemy.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Reputation><style=Vocab>Reputation</style></link>: I cost 2 less. <style=Variable></style>
An ally with 5+ Power <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strikes</style></link> an enemy.
cards.flavor: "The greatest threats are the ones that go unseen." - LeBlanc

cards.name: Shrieking Spinner
cards.text: Attack: Give Spider allies +2|+0 this round.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Give Spider allies +2|+0 this round.
cards.flavor: "Go on, my sweet. Let the others hear your call. You know how it excites them. You know it pleases me." - Elise

cards.name: Strength in Numbers
cards.text: Summon 2 Legion Marauders.
cards.textHtml: Summon 2 <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Legion Marauders</style></link>.
cards.flavor: Though the soldiers of Noxus rarely leave survivors, the marauders leave even fewer.

cards.name: Crimson Bloodletter
cards.text: The next time you summon another ally, deal 1 to it and grant me +1|+1.
cards.textHtml: The next time you summon another ally, deal 1 to it and grant me +1|+1.
cards.flavor: "They're rarely kept as pets, you know. Just one little scratch from those claws of theirs can open up a vein... but I don't mind." - Clara, Crimson Disciple

cards.name: Thrashing Snapper
cards.text: When an enemy blocks me, give me +3|+0 this round.
cards.textHtml: When an enemy blocks me, give me +3|+0 this round.
cards.flavor: Surprised by the resilience of the creature they'd found on the shore of Ionia, the young general insisted on taking it back home, eager to find out its true strength.

cards.name: Retired Reckoner
cards.text: When you target me, grant me +1|+0.
cards.textHtml: When you target me, grant me +1|+0.
cards.flavor: After countless battles, Beryn had vowed to never again raise his sword, even if it meant forfeiting his life. But when the strange mists swept through Noxus and overtook Thea, he knew he had to break his promise. He would free her, no matter the cost.

cards.name: Ruined Reckoner
cards.text: When I'm summoned, create a Midnight Raid in hand.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Midnight Raid</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: When her sentence ended, Thea knew she could never rejoin her people. War - and Noxus - had changed her, made her a killer. She wouldn't know peace. Instead, she put her newfound skills to use for coin in the arenas.

cards.name: Midnight Raid
cards.text: An ally starts a free attack.
cards.textHtml: An ally starts a free attack.
cards.flavor: "Kill or be killed!" - Ruined Reckoner

cards.name: Ekko
cards.text: Strike: Create a Fleeting Time Trick in hand.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>Strike</style></link>: Create a <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Time Trick</style></link> in hand.
cards.levelup: You've Predicted 4+ times. When I level up, create 3 Chronobreaks in your deck.
cards.flavor: It's not about how much time you have, it's about how you spend it.

cards.name: Ekko's Called Shot
cards.text:
Draw 1.
Create a Parallel Convergence in your deck.
Create an Ekko in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
Draw 1.
Create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Parallel Convergence</style></link> in your deck.
Create an <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Ekko</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "Splitting the timelines..." - Ekko

cards.name: Ekko
cards.text: Strike: Create a Fleeting 0 cost Time Trick in hand.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>Strike</style></link>: Create a <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> 0 cost <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Time Trick</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: Ekko can't fix everyone's mistakes, but that'll never stop him from trying again, and again, and again, and...

cards.name: Chronobreak
cards.text: Revive all allies that died this round, then Rally.
cards.textHtml: Revive all allies that died this round, then <link=vocab.Rally><style=Vocab>Rally</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "Once more, for the first time." - Ekko

cards.name: Fallen Feline
cards.text: When I'm summoned, create a Hexite Crystal in the bottom 10 cards of your deck.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Hexite Crystal</style></link> in the bottom 10 cards of your deck.
cards.flavor: "BUT MY PLAAAANNN--MEEEOOOOOW!"

cards.name: Hexite Crystal
cards.text:
If you see me in a Prediction, draw me.
Deal 2 to enemies and the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml:
If you see me in a <link=vocab.Predict><style=Vocab>Prediction</style></link>, draw me.
Deal 2 to enemies and the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: "Strange how such a small thing could change the world so fundamentally. Strange, too, how that cat seems so intent on getting his paws on a sample. I suspect he enjoys the way light bounces through the crystal!" - Hextech researcher

cards.name: Timewinder
cards.text:
To play, discard 1.
Deal 1 to an enemy or the enemy Nexus, and 1 to another.
cards.textHtml:
To play, discard 1.
Deal 1 to an enemy or the enemy Nexus, and 1 to another.
cards.flavor: "Look out!" - Ekko

cards.name: Dropboarder
cards.text: If you see me in a Prediction, summon me.
cards.textHtml: If you see me in a <link=vocab.Predict><style=Vocab>Prediction</style></link>, summon me.
cards.flavor: "Ahh, Shomi's a GENIUS with that hoverboard. I once saw them switch a sumpgrinder into a bottomboard backslide, then catch air with a three-point triple dip! Or something. Look, the point is, they're awesome, okay?" - Practical Perfectionist

cards.name: Chirean Sumpworker
cards.text: When you summon another Chirean Sumpworker, Obliterate me and transform allied Chirean Sumpworkers everywhere into Sumpworks Posses.
cards.textHtml: When you summon another <link=card.selfRef><style=AssociatedCard>Chirean Sumpworker</style></link>, <link=vocab.Obliterate><style=Vocab>Obliterate</style></link> me and transform allied <link=card.selfRef><style=AssociatedCard>Chirean Sumpworkers</style></link> <link=vocab.Everywhere><style=Vocab>everywhere</style></link> into <link=card.transform><style=AssociatedCard>Sumpworks Posses</style></link>.
cards.flavor: The first Zaunite miners to discover the chirean thought them timid, simple creatures. But as the years passed, and as they grew comfortable with humans, they slowly revealed their close societal bonds, and their seemingly native understanding of technology.

cards.name: Sumpworks Posse
cards.text: Attack: Deal 1 to enemies and the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.AttackSkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Attack</style></link>: Deal 1 to enemies and the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: "They're sweet enough on their own, sure, but get a bunch of 'em together, and before you know it, they've built some madcap machine and are off knockin' down some part of the Lanes." - Zaunite machinist

cards.name: Circuit Breaker
cards.text: Deal 1 to enemies and the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml: Deal 1 to enemies and the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: It takes a lot to upset a group of chirean, but when they get mad, everyone's gonna know about it.

cards.name: Time Trick
cards.text: Predict, then draw 1.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Predict><style=Vocab>Predict</style></link>, then draw 1.
cards.flavor: "The future's what I make it..." - Ekko

cards.name: Concurrent Timelines
cards.text: Grant followers in your hand "When you play me, pick 1 of 3 followers with my cost and transform me into that follower."
cards.textHtml: Grant followers in your hand "When you play me, pick 1 of 3 followers with my cost and transform me into that follower."
cards.flavor: "We're playing by MY rules." - Ekko

cards.name: Called Shot
cards.text:
Draw 1.
Create a Parallel Convergence in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
Draw 1.
Create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Parallel Convergence</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "Splitting the timelines..." - Ekko

cards.name: Parallel Convergence
cards.text: Start a free attack with an exact Ephemeral copy of each ally.
cards.textHtml: Start a free attack with an exact <link=keyword.Ephemeral><sprite name=Ephemeral><style=Keyword>Ephemeral</style></link> copy of each ally.
cards.flavor: "Converging!" - Ekko

cards.name: Practical Perfectionist
cards.text: Play: Predict. Create 3 copies of the chosen card in your deck.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: <link=vocab.Predict><style=Vocab>Predict</style></link>. Create 3 copies of the chosen card in your deck.
cards.flavor: "Kay's awesome. She's got that whole 'practice makes perfect' mentality, you know? And boyyy does she practice." - Shomi

cards.name: Volunteer Elnuk
cards.text: When I'm summoned, create a random Elnuk in the top 6 cards of your deck.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, create a random Elnuk in the top 6 cards of your deck.
cards.flavor: "OKAY, LITTLE BUDDY, YOU JUST SIT STILL WHILE I FLIP THIS SWITCHAROO OVER HEEERE AND BOOM! HA! ELNUKS FOREVER! We're totally gonna need more grass. And room." - Practical Perfectionist

cards.name: Production Surge
cards.text: To play, spend all your mana. Summon random Turrets whose total cost equals the mana spent.
cards.textHtml: To play, spend all your mana. Summon random Turrets whose total cost equals the mana spent.
cards.flavor: "Not enough resources?! I built my first mechanized contraption with discarded clockwork parts and a rusted thermal capacitor. One must do what one can with what one has!" - Heimerdinger

cards.name: Adaptatron 3000
cards.text: When you summon a Tech, we share keywords.
cards.textHtml: When you summon a Tech, we share keywords.
cards.flavor: "Ah yes! The Adaptatron 3000! Adaptable, inventive, AND quite the looker! If the fellow could speak, I'm sure we'd have MUCH to share with each other." - Heimerdinger

cards.name: Boom Baboon
cards.text: When I'm summoned, create a Flame Chompers! in hand.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Flame Chompers!</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: Jinx had a more conventional supplier once, but the two of them had a small falling out. By which we mean, the supplier fell out of a window. By which we mean, the supplier was blown out of a window. By Jinx.

cards.name: Glorious Evolution
cards.text: Your cards have -1 cost, Augment, are created by Glorious Evolution, and are now Tech.
cards.textHtml: Your cards have -1 cost, <link=keyword.Augment><sprite name=Augment><style=Keyword>Augment</style></link>, are created by <link=card.selfRef><style=AssociatedCard>Glorious Evolution</style></link>, and are now Tech.
cards.flavor: "Progress is everything. I will bring the future to this city, whether it is ready or not." - Viktor

cards.name: Defective Swapbot
cards.text: Play: Swap my stats with another unit.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.PlaySkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Play</style></link>: Swap my stats with another unit.
cards.flavor:
"A new slotbot? Didn't they shut down the plant that made these years ago?"
"I thought so. Something about 'rolling bombs' and 'unintended conflagration."
"Huh."
"...Wanna play?"
"Absolutely yes."
- Zaunite patrons

cards.name: Swapbot's Swap
cards.text: Swap my Power and Health with that of another unit.
cards.textHtml: Swap my Power and Health with that of another unit.
cards.flavor: "Dealer's choice!" - Defective Swapbot

cards.name: Aspiring Chronomancer
cards.text: Play: Predict.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: <link=vocab.Predict><style=Vocab>Predict</style></link>.
cards.flavor: Throughout his time as a student of chronomancy, Tai had to reconcile his uncertainty with his determination. It was better to have hope in a potential victory than to dwell on what could possibly go wrong.

cards.name: Baccai Reaper
cards.text: When you slay a unit, grant me +1|+0.
cards.textHtml: When you <link=vocab.Slay><style=Vocab>slay</style></link> a unit, grant me +1|+0.
cards.flavor: "The baccai all fled or were spared following their failed Ascension, and none have seen them since. Who knows how long they have hidden in those dark tombs, bearing the mark of their shame?" - Scribe Kah'nir, History of the Ascended Host

cards.name: Azir
cards.text: When allies attack, summon an attacking Sand Soldier.
cards.textHtml: When allies attack, summon an attacking <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Sand Soldier</style></link>.
cards.levelup: You've summoned 12+ allies or landmarks.
cards.flavor: "When Azir took up the mantle as emperor of Shurima, he was arrogant. Blind. He accumulated power and planned his Ascension so that he might stand as ruler over not just Shurima, but the entire world." - Scribe Kah'nir, History of the Ascended Host

cards.name: Sand Soldier
cards.text: Nexus Strike: Deal 1 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.NexusStrike><style=Vocab>Nexus Strike</style></link>: Deal 1 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: Azir's legions were reputed to be unstoppable even before Shurima was reborn, but now they are truly innumerable.

cards.name: Azir
cards.text:
When I level up, replace your deck with the Emperor's Deck, then draw 1.
When allies attack, summon an attacking Sandstone Charger.
cards.textHtml:
When I level up, replace your deck with the Emperor's Deck, then draw 1.
When allies attack, summon an attacking <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Sandstone Charger</style></link>.
cards.flavor:
"The Emperor Azir, though haughty, is generous. Above all, he cares deeply for those who would march alongside him into Shurima's golden future, as the nation rises anew, its people once again united under his rule." 
- Scribe Kah'nir, History of the Ascended Host

cards.name: Azir
cards.text:
When allies attack, summon an attacking Sand Soldier.
When you summon another ally, give us both +1|+0 this round.
cards.textHtml:
When allies attack, summon an attacking <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Sand Soldier</style></link>.
When you summon another ally, give us both +1|+0 this round.
cards.levelup: You've restored the Sun Disc.
cards.flavor: "Short of fulfilling his destiny, Azir's lifelong friend - and newly named brother - hatefully cast him off the dais. In that fateful moment Shurima was cursed, doomed to ruin for thousands of years to follow." - Scribe Kah'nir, History of the Ascended Host

cards.name: Azir's Arise!
cards.text:
Summon a Sand Soldier.
Create a Fleeting Arise! in hand.
Create a Azir in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
Summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Sand Soldier</style></link>.
Create a <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> <link=card.selfRef><style=AssociatedCard>Arise!</style></link> in hand.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Azir</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "The order is given." - Azir

cards.name: Golden Herald
cards.text: When I'm summoned and Round Start: Summon 2 Sand Soldiers and grant them +2|+2.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned and <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Summon 2 <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Sand Soldiers</style></link> and grant them +2|+2.
cards.flavor: Now more powerful than ever, Azir has raised his most loyal soldiers to lead his armies.

cards.name: Crumbling Sands
cards.text:
Obliterate a follower.
Draw 1.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Obliterate><style=Vocab>Obliterate</style></link> a follower.
Draw 1.
cards.flavor: "Those who oppose us will be reduced to dust." - Azir

cards.name: Shimmering Mirage
cards.text:
Summon an exact copy of an ally. It's Ephemeral.
Draw 1.
cards.textHtml:
Summon an exact copy of an ally. It's <link=keyword.Ephemeral><sprite name=Ephemeral><style=Keyword>Ephemeral</style></link>.
Draw 1.
cards.flavor: Between the sand, the sun, and the heat, it can be difficult to tell what is real, and what is merely a mirage.

cards.name: Eternal Gladiator
cards.text:
When I'm summoned, draw 1.
Round End: The Strongest enemy and I strike each other.
cards.textHtml:
When I'm summoned, draw 1.
<link=vocab.RoundEnd><style=Vocab>Round End</style></link>: The <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>Strongest</style></link> enemy and I <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strike</style></link> each other.
cards.flavor: "Behold! See how our champion sits astride the lion? Even the king of beasts would yield to his power, for he is the Will of Azir!" - Voice of the Risen

cards.name: Emperor's Prosperity
cards.text: Draw 2.
cards.textHtml: Draw 2.
cards.flavor: Birds found in the desert climes are all considered symbols of Azir, and Shurimans find their presence a good omen.

cards.name: General's Palace
cards.text:
Enemies are Vulnerable.
Round Start: Rally.
cards.textHtml:
Enemies are <link=keyword.Vulnerable><sprite name=Vulnerable><style=Keyword>Vulnerable</style></link>.
<link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: <link=vocab.Rally><style=Vocab>Rally</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "Observe our god-emperor! He knows the power of these lands better than any, and his army only grows. Shurima is risen, and it shall never fall again!" - Voice of the Risen

cards.name: Emperor's Guard
cards.text: When I'm summoned, draw 1.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, draw 1.
cards.flavor: The emperor's golden guard moves as one, a succession of regimented warriors that is as terrifying as it is impressive to behold.

cards.name: Sandstorm
cards.text: Obliterate 3 enemy units or landmarks.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Obliterate><style=Vocab>Obliterate</style></link> 3 enemy units or landmarks.
cards.flavor: The storm rolls in with a peal like thunder, and when it passes, it leaves nothing behind.

cards.name: Ascended's Call
cards.text:
Rally.
Summon Renekton and Nasus. Immediately level them up to level 3.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Rally><style=Vocab>Rally</style></link>.
Summon <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Renekton</style></link> and <link=card.create2><style=AssociatedCard>Nasus</style></link>. Immediately level them up to level 3.
cards.flavor: "They will serve their emperor. My generals will make sure of it." - Azir

cards.name: Sandstone Charger
cards.flavor: "They appeared out of nowhere, made up of swirling sands! Then, after they had dispatched our forces, their forms simply... disappeared, melted back into the desert." - Desert Survivor

cards.name: Weight of Judgment
cards.text: Deal 2 to a champion or 4 to a follower.
cards.textHtml: Deal 2 to a champion or 4 to a follower.
cards.flavor: "One life in return for so many. One life so that others might thrive." - Nasus

cards.name: Bloodthirsty Marauder
cards.flavor: The Sandthrashers do everything with their companions. Fight, hunt, kill... and eat.

cards.name: Roiling Sands
cards.text: When an enemy is summoned, destroy me to grant it Vulnerable.
cards.textHtml: When an enemy is summoned, destroy me to grant it <link=keyword.Vulnerable><sprite name=Vulnerable><style=Keyword>Vulnerable</style></link>.
cards.flavor: Centuries of missteps have taught the Shurimans how to read the sands. Only they know which expanses will stand firm, and which give way. It is all the same to the layman observer.

cards.name: Rampaging Baccai
cards.text: Play: If you've slain 4+ units this game, an enemy and I strike each other.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.PlaySkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Play</style></link>: If you've <link=vocab.Slay><style=Vocab>slain</style></link> 4+ units this game, an enemy and I <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strike</style></link> each other. <style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor: The bearer of a grudge's resentment only deepens, even if those they bear the grudge against are long dead.

cards.name: Baccai Rampage
cards.text: Rampaging Baccai and an enemy strike each other.
cards.textHtml: <link=card.parentRef><style=AssociatedCard>Rampaging Baccai</style></link> and an enemy <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strike</style></link> each other.
cards.flavor: The baccai are twisted, warped versions of what they might have been - had they become part of the Ascended Host - and the rage they feel at their failure must be unleashed somewhere.

cards.name: Xenotype Researchers
cards.text: When I'm summoned, grant 3 random allies in your deck +3|+3.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, grant 3 random allies in your deck +3|+3.
cards.flavor: The Void is full of surprises, growing every day and finding new ways to infiltrate the tower, as intrusive as a thorned blindbrush but infinitely more deadly. Inasmuch, the study of it proves difficult, as it requires similarly clever and resourceful researchers to anticipate and understand the threat.

cards.name: Esteemed Hierophant
cards.text: When I'm summoned, advance your Buried Sun Disc 3 rounds.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, <link=vocab.Advance><style=Vocab>advance</style></link> your <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Buried Sun Disc</style></link> 3 rounds.
cards.flavor: "Oh! That's Padjuman, one of the elders of Nashramae! I think everyone has come to our city today, papa!" - Excited onlooker

cards.name: Preservarium
cards.text:
When I'm summoned, draw 1.
Countdown 2: Draw 1.
cards.textHtml:
When I'm summoned, draw 1.
<link=vocab.Countdown><style=Vocab>Countdown 2</style></link><style=Variable></style>: Draw 1.
cards.flavor: Zilean shows those he brings to the tower what, precisely, they are looking to restore. The Preservationist is able to show them, if only a glimpse at a time.

cards.name: Clockling
cards.flavor: The Clocklings were the first to wriggle free - precisely at the time Zilean had set them to wake up. They shook themselves off and went clambering over the ancient walls, seeking others of their kind.

cards.name: Raz Bloodmane
cards.text: Attack: Give enemies -2|-0 this round.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Give enemies <nobr>-2|-0</nobr> this round.
cards.flavor: "When this here croc was born, the others took bets on how long he'd live, assuming he was the runt of the litter and a freak to boot. Nobody thought to bet on him eatin' all his siblings. Heh."

cards.name: Siphoning Strike
cards.text:
An ally strikes a unit.
If it dies, grant allied champions everywhere +2|+2.
cards.textHtml:
An ally <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strikes</style></link> a unit.
If it dies, grant allied champions <link=vocab.Everywhere><style=Vocab>everywhere</style></link> +2|+2.
cards.flavor: "Your soul will be measured." - Nasus

cards.name: Rite of Dominance
cards.text: Kill an ally or destroy one of your mana gems to give all enemies -2|-0 this round.
cards.textHtml: Kill an ally or destroy one of your mana gems to give all enemies <nobr>-2|-0</nobr> this round.
cards.flavor: "We fight, they bleed!" - Renekton

cards.name: Rite of Dominance
cards.text: Destroy one of your mana gems to give all enemies -2|-0 this round.
cards.textHtml: Destroy one of your mana gems to give all enemies <nobr>-2|-0</nobr> this round.
cards.flavor: "We fight, they bleed!" - Renekton

cards.name: Rite of Dominance
cards.text: Kill an ally to give all enemies -2|-0 this round.
cards.textHtml: Kill an ally to give all enemies <nobr>-2|-0</nobr> this round.
cards.flavor: "We fight, they bleed!" - Renekton

cards.name: Rek'Sai
cards.text:
When I Lurk or Attack: Grant Lurker allies everywhere +1|+0.
Round End: Place me into your deck.
cards.textHtml:
When I <link=keyword.Lurker><sprite name=Lurker><style=Keyword>Lurk</style></link> or <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Grant Lurker allies <link=vocab.Everywhere><style=Vocab>everywhere</style></link> +1|+0.
<link=vocab.RoundEnd><style=Vocab>Round End</style></link>: Place me into your deck.
cards.levelup: I've attacked with 10+ Power.
cards.flavor: "Young Jhuraa was exploring, as is his way, and in a small hidden cave, discovered some ancient texts! We took them to a translator in Marrowmark, and the scrolls... they speak of an ancient terror who stalked our ancestors. A queen. A xer'sai queen!" - Fezhaur, Vekauran elder

cards.name: Rek'Sai
cards.text:
When I level up, create 3 random Lurkers in hand.
When I Lurk or Attack: Grant Lurker allies everywhere +1|+0.
cards.textHtml:
When I level up, create 3 random Lurkers in hand.
When I <link=keyword.Lurker><sprite name=Lurker><style=Keyword>Lurk</style></link> or <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Grant Lurker allies <link=vocab.Everywhere><style=Vocab>everywhere</style></link> +1|+0.
cards.flavor: "We have known of her terror for generations, but for our ancestors to know her, too? How old must she be? How many of our people has she butchered? The thought unsettles me greatly." - Fezhaur, Vekauran elder

cards.name: Rek'Sai's Call the Pack
cards.text:
To play, put a card from hand on top of your deck.
Create 2 random Lurkers in hand.
Create a Rek'Sai in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
To play, put a card from hand on top of your deck.
Create 2 random Lurkers in hand.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Rek'Sai</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor:
"May the sun shine, and may the xer'sai sleep."
- Merchant's prayer

cards.name: Sivir
cards.levelup: You've dealt 30+ damage.
cards.flavor: Sivir made her way through life as a mercenary, and burdened herself with all the risks and rewards that came with her choice. One fateful expedition almost cost her everything, but as her blood seeped into Shurima's sands, it awoke an ancient power that would return both her and her homeland to greatness.

cards.name: Sivir
cards.text: While I'm attacking, attacking allies have my keywords.
cards.textHtml: While I'm attacking, attacking allies have my keywords.
cards.flavor: "If you wanna work with me, I'll give you the same talk I give everyone: work for your share, and you'll get everything you're due. But if you slow me down, or get in my way, I'll kill you myself."

cards.name: Sivir's Ricochet
cards.text:
Reputation: I cost 3 less. 
Deal 1 to a random enemy or the enemy Nexus 5 times.
Create a Sivir in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Reputation><style=Vocab>Reputation</style></link>: I cost 3 less. <style=Variable></style>
Deal 1 to a random enemy or the enemy Nexus 5 times.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Sivir</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "This might get a little messy." - Sivir

cards.name: Khahiri the Returned
cards.text: When I'm summoned, create a copy of me in your deck. When you see me in a Prediction, grant all allied copies of me everywhere +2|+2.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, create a copy of me in your deck. When you see me in a <link=vocab.Predict><style=Vocab>Prediction</style></link>, grant all allied copies of me <link=vocab.Everywhere><style=Vocab>everywhere</style></link> +2|+2.
cards.flavor: Khahiri had only been gone a moment when he suddenly reappeared. Older by nearly a decade and wielding a strange and deadly-looking weapon, he was met with gasps of awe and concern.

cards.name: Xer'sai Dunebreaker
cards.flavor: While all xer'sai are able tunnelers, only their dunebreakers have the mass and power needed to break through the veins of solid bedrock that snake through the Great Sai, and open up the lands beyond for further hunting.

cards.name: Salt Spire
cards.text: Countdown 2: Summon a Grumpy Rockbear. Then, if you've summoned 4+ landmarks this game, grant the strongest ally +2|+2.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Countdown><style=Vocab>Countdown 2</style></link><style=Variable></style>: Summon a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Grumpy Rockbear</style></link>. Then, if you've summoned 4+ landmarks this game, grant the <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> ally +2|+2. <style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor: A Shuriman saltworker quickly learns which deposits are suitable for collection, and which are best left alone.

cards.name: Dunekeeper
cards.text: When I'm summoned, summon a Sand Soldier.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Sand Soldier</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "As the emperor commands, both the sand and I obey."

cards.name: Ancient Preparations
cards.text:
Play: Predict.
Countdown 2: Summon a Clockling.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: <link=vocab.Predict><style=Vocab>Predict</style></link>.
<link=vocab.Countdown><style=Vocab>Countdown 2</style></link><style=Variable></style>: Summon a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Clockling</style></link>.
cards.flavor: Though they might otherwise be thought of as lost to time, buried underneath years of sand, the automata were precisely placed, simply waiting to be awakened.

cards.name: Chronoshift
cards.text: Give an allied Champion "The next time I'd die this round, fully heal me and grant me +3|+3 instead".
cards.textHtml: Give an allied Champion "The next time I'd die this round, fully heal me and grant me +3|+3 instead".
cards.flavor: "We cannot stop the inevitable... but we can postpone it." - Zilean

cards.name: Promising Future
cards.text: Grant an allied landmark "My Countdown completion effect activates twice".
cards.textHtml: Grant an allied landmark "My <link=keyword.Countdown><style=Keyword>Countdown</style></link> completion effect activates twice".
cards.flavor: "Mortals spend so much of their time waiting. My fondest hope is that they all should be rewarded for their patience." - Zilean

cards.name: Callous Bonecrusher
cards.text: Reputation: I cost 1 less and when I'm summoned, grant me Overwhelm.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Reputation><style=Vocab>Reputation</style></link>: I cost 1 less and when I'm summoned, grant me <link=keyword.Overwhelm><sprite name=Overwhelm><style=Keyword>Overwhelm</style></link>. <style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor: The soldier struggled as he reached for his spear, but she leaned harder on his chest until he ceased, groaning. "No, no," she admonished, showing her sharpened eyeteeth with a wicked smile. "This is mine, now."

cards.name: The Clock Hand
cards.text: When I'm summoned, create 2 Instant Centuries in hand.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, create 2 <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Instant Centuries</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: The constant rumble in the lower levels of the tower are due to The Clock Hand, the tower guardian that steadily winds the gears below.

cards.name: Instant Century
cards.text: Summon a random landmark with Countdown, or advance a landmark 4 rounds.
cards.textHtml: Summon a random landmark with <link=keyword.Countdown><style=Keyword>Countdown</style></link>, or <link=vocab.Advance><style=Vocab>advance</style></link> a landmark 4 rounds.
cards.flavor: "There is little distinction between 'what has been' and 'what will be'..." - Zilean

cards.name: Instant Century
cards.text: Advance a landmark 4 rounds.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Advance><style=Vocab>Advance</style></link> a landmark 4 rounds.
cards.flavor: "There is little distinction between 'what has been' and 'what will be'." - Zilean

cards.name: Instant Century
cards.text: Summon a random landmark with Countdown.
cards.textHtml: Summon a random landmark with <link=keyword.Countdown><style=Keyword>Countdown</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "There is little distinction between 'what has been' and 'what will be'." - Zilean

cards.name: Payday
cards.text: Create a Lucky Find in hand.
cards.textHtml: Create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Lucky Find</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: "Sure, I've had good days and bad days, just like anyone. In this line of work, the bad days can get real bad, and the good days can get real rich." - Sivir

cards.name: Unraveled Earth
cards.text:
Summon 2 Roiling Sands.
Draw 1.
cards.textHtml:
Summon 2 <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Roiling Sands</style></link>.
Draw 1.
cards.flavor: As beautiful as the Great Sai may be, it is not a place for the weak. Many lives have been lost among its rolling dunes, and while the xer'sai claim many, the land itself takes its share.

cards.name: Rock Hopper
cards.text: When I'm summoned, summon a Roiling Sands.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, summon a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Roiling Sands</style></link>.
cards.flavor:
"Today, we began our journey to Nashramae! Samir is determined to cross the Great Sai before the next full moon, and is making SUCH a mess of things! I did not know a simple sandboard could collapse a whole dune. Neither did Sami. He's fine."
- Zaifa's diary

cards.name: Zilean
cards.text: Play: Create 4 Time Bombs in your deck, then Predict.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Create 4 <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Time Bombs</style></link> in your deck, then <link=vocab.Predict><style=Vocab>Predict</style></link>.
cards.levelup: I've seen you destroy 2+ allied Time Bombs.
cards.flavor: Over many years, Zilean established a network of promising young mages from different times, all of whom were capable of seeing out his life's work should the unthinkable happen. Although a kind and encouraging mentor, deep sorrow creased his brow when he sought solitude, and there was a weariness in his eyes that only someone who has lived multiple lifetimes could hope to comprehend.

cards.name: Zilean
cards.text:
Round Start: Create a Fleeting copy of each non-Fleeting card I saw you play last round.
Play: Create 4 Time Bombs in your deck, then Predict.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Create a <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> copy of each non-<link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> card I saw you play last round.
<link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Create 4 <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Time Bombs</style></link> in your deck, then <link=vocab.Predict><style=Vocab>Predict</style></link>.
cards.flavor: Countless possibilities stretched before and behind him. He saw them all at once, a dizzying array that only he could decipher. With a single gesture, Zilean could unfold entire timelines -- but none had yet shown him how to save Icathia.

cards.name: Zilean's Chronoshift
cards.text:
Give an allied Champion "The next time I'd die this round, fully heal me and grant me +3|+3 instead".
Create a Zilean in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
Give an allied Champion "The next time I'd die this round, fully heal me and grant me +3|+3 instead".
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Zilean</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "We cannot stop the inevitable... but we can postpone it." - Zilean

cards.name: Zilean's Careful Preparation
cards.text:
To play, place a card from your hand into your deck.
Predict, then create an exact copy of the chosen card in hand.
Create a Zilean in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
To play, place a card from your hand into your deck.
<link=vocab.Predict><style=Vocab>Predict</style></link>, then create an exact copy of the chosen card in hand.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Zilean</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "The actions we take today plant seeds for future trees." - Tai, Aspiring Chronomancer

cards.name: Sai Scout
cards.text: Play: Predict. If you pick a landmark, grant me Elusive.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: <link=vocab.Predict><style=Vocab>Predict</style></link>. If you pick a landmark, grant me <link=keyword.Elusive><sprite name=Elusive><style=Keyword>Elusive</style></link>.
cards.flavor:
"We had trouble earlier! A great storm threatened from the west, and Taliyah passed xer'sai tunnels to the south. I spotted a temple to the north, and we are now safe inside its terracotta walls. The others are all asleep, and my flame, like me, is ebbing. I hope I dream well."
- Zaifa's diary

cards.name: Hibernating Rockbear
cards.text: Countdown 3: Summon a Grumpy Rockbear.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Countdown><style=Keyword>Countdown 3</style></link><style=Variable></style>: Summon a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Grumpy Rockbear</style></link>.
cards.flavor:
"MY NAME IS ZAIFA AND I LIKE WRITING STUPID THINGS IN MY STUPID BOOK WHEN I THINK EVERYONE ELSE IS ASLEEP. EVEN SAMI."
- Zaifa's diary

cards.name: Shifting Sands
cards.text:
Deal 4 to a unit.
Summon 2 Sand Soldiers.
cards.textHtml:
Deal 4 to a unit.
Summon 2 <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Sand Soldiers</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "Go. Surround them. They cannot fight the land itself." - Azir

cards.name: Clockwork Curator
cards.text: Play: Advance an allied landmark 2 rounds.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: <link=vocab.Advance><style=Vocab>Advance</style></link> an allied landmark 2 rounds.
cards.flavor: The constructs that guard Zilean's tower are able to withstand the harsh desert for millennia, and not just for their clever construction.

cards.name: Exhaust
cards.text: Give an enemy -2|-0 and Vulnerable this round.
cards.textHtml: Give an enemy <nobr>-2|-0</nobr> and <link=keyword.Vulnerable><sprite name=Vulnerable><style=Keyword>Vulnerable</style></link> this round.
cards.flavor: Desert-dwellers know how to avoid the sun's searing and relentless heat, but those unprepared to withstand it will find their strength and energy sapped at remarkable speed.

cards.name: Sandstone Chimera
cards.text: I cost 1 less for each time an ally attacked this game.
cards.textHtml: I cost 1 less for each time an ally attacked this game.
cards.flavor: Upon Azir's return, Shurimans caught sight of ancient beasts of legend, made of sand but no less impressive.

cards.name: Nasus
cards.text: I have +1|+1 for each unit you've slain this game.
cards.textHtml: I have +1|+1 for each unit you've <link=vocab.Slay><style=Vocab>slain</style></link> this game. <style=Variable></style>
cards.levelup: I've struck for 10+ damage in one strike.
cards.flavor: "Nasus' newly won blessing allowed him countless lifetimes to spend in study and contemplation over the nature of life and death. But this same extended lifespan would, after the fall of Shurima, also prove to be his curse." - Scribe Kah'nir, History of the Ascended Host

cards.name: Nasus' Siphoning Strike
cards.text:
An ally strikes a unit.
If it dies, grant allied champions everywhere +2|+2.
Create a Nasus in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
An ally <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strikes</style></link> a unit.
If it dies, grant allied champions <link=vocab.Everywhere><style=Vocab>everywhere</style></link> +2|+2.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Nasus</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "Your soul will be measured." - Nasus

cards.name: Nasus
cards.text:
I have +1|+1 for each unit you've slain this game. 
Enemies have -3|-0.
cards.textHtml:
I have +1|+1 for each unit you've <link=vocab.Slay><style=Vocab>slain</style></link> this game. <style=Variable></style>
Enemies have <nobr>-3|-0</nobr>.
cards.flavor: "His hope revived by Shurima's rise, Nasus finally returned after years spent wandering the desert, eager to make amends with his brother. He never suspected he would find Renekton maddened by years spent suffering at Xerath's hands in the tomb, waiting for him." - Scribe Kah'nir, History of the Ascended Host

cards.name: Nasus
cards.text:
I have +1|+1 for each unit you've slain this game. 
Enemies have -1|-0.
cards.textHtml:
I have +1|+1 for each unit you've <link=vocab.Slay><style=Vocab>slain</style></link> this game. <style=Variable></style>
Enemies have <nobr>-1|-0</nobr>.
cards.levelup: You've restored the Sun Disc.
cards.flavor: "For years, Nasus and his brother Renekton served the empire. Nasus was a scholar, Renekton a fierce warrior. It was not until the two were called upon to confront the betrayer, Xerath, that Nasus was forced to make a terrible choice..." - Scribe Kah'nir, History of the Ascended Host

cards.name: Inner Sanctum
cards.text:
Reputation: I cost 3 less. 
Countdown 1: Create 2 Lucky Finds in hand.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Reputation><style=Vocab>Reputation</style></link>: I cost 3 less. <style=Variable></style>
<link=vocab.Countdown><style=Vocab>Countdown 1</style></link><style=Variable></style>: Create 2 <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Lucky Finds</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: "Some maps take years to decipher, some traps takes months to disarm, and some vaults take weeks to navigate. But the times you pull it off? They're worth every damned second." - Sivir

cards.name: Destined Poro
cards.text: Round Start: If you've leveled a champion, transform me into Exalted Poro.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: If you've leveled a champion, transform me into <link=card.transform><style=AssociatedCard>Exalted Poro</style></link>.
cards.flavor: She didn't know what she had found, precisely... but it was shiny, and looked like a good snack.

cards.name: Exalted Poro
cards.text: I have 3 random keywords.
cards.textHtml: I have 3 random keywords.
cards.flavor: As far as divine rulers go, she's awfully fond of snax.

cards.name: Emperor's Dais
cards.text: When allies attack, summon an attacking Sand Soldier.
cards.textHtml: When allies attack, summon an attacking <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Sand Soldier</style></link>.
cards.flavor: The Sandcrafters lifted their hands, willing the sand into the familiar shape of armored, faceless soldiers, a tireless army ready to fight for their god-emperor.

cards.name: Treasure Seeker
cards.text: When I'm summoned, create a Waking Sands in hand.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Waking Sands</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: "Okay, Davu. You're gonna go in there, grab that... whatever it is, and you're going to make us rich. Me rich. You're going to make me rich. Got it? Also, if that's a trapped thing, I am real sorry in advance."

cards.name: Ruin Runner
cards.flavor: Before the vaults, Shurima's mercenaries and tomb robbers must learn to survive the desert's more overt threats. First, the unrelenting heat. Second, the multitude of raiders, hellbent on carnage.

cards.name: Profiteer
cards.text: When I'm summoned, create a Lucky Find in hand.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Lucky Find</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: "My friend, for you I've procured this incomparable beauty straight from the fabled Tomb of the Emperors and pulled it right from the hand of the great Renekton himself and as I rode out, I was surrounded by ten--twenty!--bloodthirsty sauren riders! Truly, a miracle that such a treasure has made it to your hands."

cards.name: Inspiring Marshal
cards.text: When you summon another ally, give it +2|+0 this round.
cards.textHtml: When you summon another ally, give it +2|+0 this round.
cards.flavor: To receive the blessing of Azir is a great honor - to give a blessing in his name, an honor greater still.

cards.name: Sandcrafter
cards.text: Attack: Summon an attacking Sand Soldier.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Summon an attacking <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Sand Soldier</style></link>.
cards.flavor: Few are taught the ways of the desert, and even fewer given the ability to command its sands as Azir can. To wield this power and know the secrets of the sands is a gift given only to Azir's most faithful and capable followers.

cards.name: Rite of Negation
cards.text: Kill an ally or destroy one of your mana gems to stop all enemy Fast spells, Slow spells, and Skills.
cards.textHtml: Kill an ally or destroy one of your mana gems to stop all enemy <link=keyword.Fast><sprite name=Fast><style=Keyword>Fast</style></link> spells, <link=keyword.Slow><sprite name=Slow><style=Keyword>Slow</style></link> spells, and <link=keyword.Skill><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Skills</style></link>.
cards.flavor: Analysis is a mainstay of chronomancy, as many actions must be halted to consider future solutions.

cards.flavor: Analysis is a mainstay of chronomancy, as many actions must be halted to consider future solutions.

cards.flavor: Analysis is a mainstay of chronomancy, as many actions must be halted to consider future solutions.

cards.name: Time Bomb
cards.text:
When I'm summoned, draw 1 and advance other allied Time Bombs 1 round.
Countdown 1: Deal 1 to enemies and the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml:
When I'm summoned, draw 1 and <link=vocab.Advance><style=Vocab>advance</style></link> other allied Time Bombs 1 round.
<link=keyword.Countdown><style=Keyword>Countdown 1</style></link><style=Variable></style>: Deal 1 to enemies and the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: Using time "constructively" can also mean "destructively."

cards.name: Buried Sun Disc
cards.text:
Start of Game: Summon 1 of me from your deck if it's all Shuriman.
Countdown 25: Restore the Sun Disc.
I advance 9 rounds for each time an Ascended ally has leveled up this game.
cards.textHtml:
Start of Game: Summon 1 of me from your deck if it's all Shuriman.
<link=keyword.Countdown><style=Keyword>Countdown 25</style></link><style=Variable></style>: <link=vocab.SunDiscRestore><style=Vocab>Restore the Sun Disc</style></link>.
I <link=vocab.Advance><style=Vocab>advance</style></link> 9 rounds for each time an Ascended ally has leveled up this game.
cards.flavor: When Azir beheld the Shuriman capital's Sun Disc, he saw it not for what it was, but what it could be--the key to returning Shurima to its former glory.

cards.name: Restored Sun Disc
cards.text:
Immediately draw 1 of each of your Ascended allies.
For the rest of the game, your level 2 Ascended allies are level 3.
cards.textHtml:
Immediately draw 1 of each of your Ascended allies.
For the rest of the game, your level 2 Ascended allies are level 3.
cards.flavor: "Shurima has known no glory like today. Come, bask in the light of our sun!" - Voice of the Risen

cards.name: Xerxa'Reth, The Undertitan
cards.text: Attack: If I have 8+ Power, give me Fearsome, Overwhelm, and SpellShield this round.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: If I have 8+ Power, give me <link=keyword.Fearsome><sprite name=Fearsome><style=Keyword>Fearsome</style></link>, <link=keyword.Overwhelm><sprite name=Overwhelm><style=Keyword>Overwhelm</style></link>, and <link=keyword.SpellShield><sprite name=SpellShield><style=Keyword>SpellShield</style></link> this round.
cards.flavor: "It is said that hundreds of years ago, the river Khaleek bore a great trading outpost known as Taraleek upon its shores. That is, until one fateful day, when a mighty beast broke through the ground, and annihilated both the outpost and all who called it home. But what monster could do such a thing?" - Shuriman historian

cards.name: Time in a Bottle
cards.text: Predict and advance an allied landmark 2 rounds.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Predict><style=Vocab>Predict</style></link> and <link=vocab.Advance><style=Vocab>advance</style></link> an allied landmark 2 rounds.
cards.flavor: "If only you saw time as I do, you would know it is not immutable." - Zilean

cards.name: Renekton
cards.text: When I Challenge an enemy, give me +2|+1 this round.
cards.textHtml: When I <link=keyword.Challenger><sprite name=Challenger><style=Keyword>Challenge</style></link> an enemy, give me +2|+1 this round.
cards.levelup: I've dealt 10+ damage.
cards.flavor: "It could be easily forgotten that he was once human, for the visage of the crocodile fits his love for bloody battle so well..." - Scribe Kah'nir, History of the Ascended Host

cards.name: Renekton
cards.text: When I block or Attack: Deal 2 to enemies and the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.PlaySkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword></style></link>When I block or <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Deal 2 to enemies and the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: "When he finally has a chance at revenge on his brother Nasus, Renekton will stop at nothing. He will destroy all, and Shurima will again be left a ruin." - Scribe Kah'nir, History of the Ascended Host

cards.name: Renekton's Ruthless Predator
cards.text:
Give an ally +2|+0 to give an enemy Vulnerable this round.
Create a Renekton in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
Give an ally +2|+0 to give an enemy <link=keyword.Vulnerable><sprite name=Vulnerable><style=Keyword>Vulnerable</style></link> this round.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Renekton</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "Shred them!" - Renekton

cards.name: Renekton
cards.text: Attack: Give me +3|+3 this round.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Give me +3|+3 this round.
cards.levelup: You've restored the Sun Disc.
cards.flavor: "So many long years in the dark with that betrayer filling his head with words of hate and resentment, breeding contempt for his brother. It only fueled his rage, made him stronger." - Scribe Kah'nir, History of the Ascended Host

cards.name: Dominus Destruction
cards.text: Deal 2 to enemies and the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml: Deal 2 to enemies and the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: "I will spare no one!" - Renekton

cards.name: Xer'sai Caller
cards.text: Play: Predict.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: <link=vocab.Predict><style=Vocab>Predict</style></link>.
cards.flavor: Not all xer'sai are born to butcher. Some can summon their kin with piercing shrieks that rattle the sands as well as the senses.

cards.name: Ruthless Predator
cards.text: Give an ally +2|+0 to give an enemy Vulnerable this round.
cards.textHtml: Give an ally +2|+0 to give an enemy <link=keyword.Vulnerable><sprite name=Vulnerable><style=Keyword>Vulnerable</style></link> this round.
cards.flavor: "Shred them!" - Renekton

cards.name: Unworthy
cards.text:
Give an enemy follower -4|-0 this round.
If you have fewer mana gems than your opponent, kill it instead.
cards.textHtml:
Give an enemy follower <nobr>-4|-0</nobr> this round.
If you have fewer mana gems than your opponent, kill it instead.
cards.flavor: "The sun will shine again upon Shuriman lands." - Voice of the Risen

cards.name: Soothsayer
cards.text: When I'm summoned, grant allied champions and landmarks SpellShield.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, grant allied champions and landmarks <link=keyword.SpellShield><sprite name=SpellShield><style=Keyword>SpellShield</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "Ah, you did not expect to see water in the middle of the desert. Worry not. Come, drink your fill, wash your feet. Rest in the shade awhile. This is Azir's new Shurima, and it is an oasis."

cards.name: Taliyah
cards.text: Play: Summon an exact copy of an allied landmark.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Summon an exact copy of an allied landmark.
cards.levelup: You've summoned 5+ landmarks.
cards.flavor:
"The nomad's step is always light, for it is unburdened by the weight of roots, and their home is forever beyond the horizon."
- The Societies of Shurima

cards.name: Threaded Volley
cards.text: Deal 2 to Taliyah's blocker. If it's dead or gone, deal 2 to the enemy Nexus instead.
cards.textHtml: Deal 2 to <style=Variable>Taliyah</style>'s blocker. If it's dead or gone, deal 2 to the enemy Nexus instead.
cards.flavor: "Throw another rock!" - Taliyah

cards.name: Taliyah
cards.text:
Play: Summon an exact copy of an allied landmark. 
Attack: I deal 2 damage to my blocker 3 times. If it's dead or gone, I deal 2 damage to the enemy Nexus instead.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Summon an exact copy of an allied landmark. 
<link=keyword.Elemental Skill><sprite name=ElementalSkill><style=Keyword>Attack</style></link>: I deal 2 damage to my blocker 3 times. If it's dead or gone, I deal 2 damage to the enemy Nexus instead.
cards.flavor: Taliyah left Ionia after hearing word of monumental change in her homeland. She returned to Shurima to find an emperor reborn, her people fraught, and the xer'sai more active than ever. She had no choice but to grow beyond her years.

cards.name: Taliyah's Stoneweaving
cards.text:
Manifest a landmark you can afford.
Create a Taliyah in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Manifest><style=Vocab>Manifest</style></link> a landmark you can afford.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Taliyah</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "Come on - there's so much to see!" - Taliyah

cards.name: Xer'sai Hatchling
cards.flavor: Once a caravan has been disabled, the hunters will occasionally retreat and allow their hatchlings to forage forward. It is here that the young xer'sai refine their instincts, learning which sounds are of the desert, and which signal their prey.

cards.name: Emperor's Divide
cards.text: Give enemies Vulnerable this round and summon 6 Sand Soldiers.
cards.textHtml: Give enemies <link=keyword.Vulnerable><sprite name=Vulnerable><style=Keyword>Vulnerable</style></link> this round and summon 6 <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Sand Soldiers</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "My soldiers march on." - Azir

cards.name: Ancient Hourglass
cards.text: Obliterate an ally to summon a Stasis Statue in place with the ally stored inside.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Obliterate><style=Vocab>Obliterate</style></link> an ally to summon a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Stasis Statue</style></link> in place with the ally stored inside.
cards.flavor:
"Oh, Tai! Come here! We could use your help with something."
- Xetsa, Void Researcher

cards.name: Stasis Statue
cards.text: Countdown 1: Summon exact copies of the units and landmarks stored inside.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Countdown><style=Vocab>Countdown 1</style></link><style=Variable></style>: Summon exact copies of the units and landmarks stored inside.
cards.flavor:
"I like to think of this as 'capturing a moment'." 
"Ha. Clever."
- Xetsa and Zinsa, Void Researchers

cards.name: Voice of the Risen
cards.text: If you've leveled a champion, allies have +2|+0.
cards.textHtml: If you've leveled a champion, allies have +2|+0.
cards.flavor: "I saw her speak, long ago." The old soldier smiled, and for an instant, his granddaughter could picture it: Shurima, gold and gleaming, proud Azir standing over the city heralded by the Voice of the Risen. "She stirred in us all a passion we thought long lost."

cards.name: Scrying Sands
cards.text:
Predict.
Give an enemy -2|-0 this round.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Predict><style=Vocab>Predict</style></link>.
Give an enemy <nobr>-2|-0</nobr> this round.
cards.flavor: "I have seen my destiny, and this time, I will not be stopped." - Azir

cards.name: Call the Pack
cards.text:
To play, put a card from hand on top of your deck.
Create 2 random Lurkers in hand.
cards.textHtml:
To play, put a card from hand on top of your deck.
Create 2 random Lurkers in hand.
cards.flavor:
"May the sun shine, and may the xer'sai sleep."
- Merchant's prayer

cards.name: Baccai Sandspinner
cards.text: Play: Grant an enemy -1|-0 and Vulnerable.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Grant an enemy <nobr>-1|-0</nobr> and <link=keyword.Vulnerable><sprite name=Vulnerable><style=Keyword>Vulnerable</style></link>.
cards.flavor: Each grain she spills takes a second from their lives, wearing away at them like wind.

cards.name: Ruinous Path
cards.text:
Draw 1.
If you've slain a unit this round, drain 2 from the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml:
Draw 1.
If you've <link=vocab.Slay><style=Vocab>slain</style></link> a unit this round, <link=keyword.Drain><style=Keyword>drain</style></link> 2 from the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: Sandthrashers primarily recruit from their enemy's ranks. Whoever survives their initial assault is invited to join, or die.

cards.name: Feral Prescience
cards.text: Predict.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Predict><style=Vocab>Predict</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "The fin brings fear, but the teeth bring death." - Shuriman saying

cards.name: Desert Naturalist
cards.text: Play: Destroy a landmark. If it's allied, summon a Grumpy Rockbear.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.PlaySkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Play</style></link>: Destroy a landmark. If it's allied, summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Grumpy Rockbear</style></link>.
cards.flavor:
"Kadira broke something today! Again! It was just a stone wall this time, but it looked old and was probably important to someone's ancestor. Her excuse is that walls are built better in Tereshni, but still! I am very cross."
- Zaifa's diary

cards.name: Teen Spirit
cards.text: Destroy a landmark. If it's allied, summon a Grumpy Rockbear.
cards.textHtml: Destroy a landmark. If it's allied, summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Grumpy Rockbear</style></link>.
cards.flavor:
"Kadira broke something today! Again! It was just a stone wall this time, but it looked old and was probably important to someone's ancestor. Her excuse is that walls are built better in Tereshni, but still! I am very cross."
- Zaifa's diary

cards.name: Grumpy Rockbear
cards.flavor:
"Ogh today was fun! We stopped for lunch (skallashi cheese - BLEUGH!) when Kadira spotted a poor rockdoubb asleep in the shade. Of course, she had to tug on its tail, and of course, it got mad. I hope it likes the cheese we left behind!"
- Zaifa's diary

cards.name: Khahiri the Student
cards.text: When I'm summoned, if you've Predicted this game, grant me +1|+1.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, if you've <link=vocab.Predict><style=Vocab>Predicted</style></link> this game, grant me +1|+1.
cards.flavor:
"Remember what we learned," Zilean said, his voice unusually soft - grave, even. "Are you certain you're ready?"
Khahiri gave his mentor a reassuring smile. "I'll be back soon. And besides, I've spent every day for years preparing for this moment. If not now, when?"
