cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Give an ally +2|+0 to give an enemy -2|-0 this round.
cards.flavor: Tena waited patiently as her pet's caustic spittle wore away the gilded bars of the palace's rear gate. Around the corner, she would soon find a hoard of unspeakably valuable treasure--more than enough to bring Vekaura back to its former glory.

cards.name: Vekauran Vagabond
cards.text: When I'm summoned, summon a Warlord's Palace or advance it 2 rounds.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, summon a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Warlord's Palace</style></link> or <link=vocab.Advance><style=Vocab>advance</style></link> it 2 rounds.
cards.flavor: Seeing Akshan hanging underneath the fourth-floor window, Najah cursed under her breath. Pretty boy beat her to the mark. Again. Turning her dagger over in her hand, she pondered what to say to him. Maybe this time, he'd finally acknowledge her.

cards.name: Vekauran Bruiser
cards.text: Strike: Create a Lucky Find in hand.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>Strike</style></link>: Create a <link=card.create1><style=AssociatedCard>Lucky Find</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor:
"Okay, Barb. That's the last of the guards on this floor, but we've still gotta keep a low profile."
"BLARGH-BLAAA!"
"Inside voice, Barbara."
"Blarb."
"That's my girl."

cards.name: Akshan
cards.text: When I'm summoned or strike: Summon a Warlord's Palace or advance it 1 round.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned or <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strike</style></link>: Summon a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Warlord's Palace</style></link> or <link=vocab.Advance><style=Vocab>advance</style></link> it 1 round.
cards.levelup: Warlord's Palace has finished its Countdown. When I level up, summon a Warlord's Hoard.
cards.flavor: "The Sentinels' code seems full of complicated restrictions. Things like 'Never take a life in the name of vengeance' and 'Fight for the world, never for yourself'. As for me..."

cards.name: Warlord's Palace
cards.text:
Countdown 8: Create a Relic of Power in hand.
When you target allies advance me 1.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Countdown><style=Vocab>Countdown 8</style></link><style=Variable></style>: Create a <link=card.discover><style=AssociatedCard>Relic of Power</style></link> in hand.
When you target allies <link=vocab.Advance><style=Vocab>advance</style></link> me 1.
cards.flavor: "See that eyesore of a building? That's where the swine lives. We'll take him out, grab the loot, and be back in time for dinner." - Vekauran Vagabond

cards.name: Akshan
cards.text: When I'm summoned or strike: Summon a Warlord's Hoard or advance it 1 round.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned or <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strike</style></link>: Summon a <link=card.create1><style=AssociatedCard>Warlord's Hoard</style></link> or <link=vocab.Advance><style=Vocab>advance</style></link> it 1 round.
cards.flavor: "My code is far simpler--disregard any rule that prevents me from doing whatever I want."

cards.flavor: "They never expect the grappling hook!" - Akshan

When you target allies advance me 1.

cards.flavor: When a group of survivors from the fallen city of Vekaura learned of a particular warlord's sordid history, they wasted no time making plans to seize his ill-gotten gains.

cards.name: Fount of Power
cards.text: Draw 2. Your cards cost 1 less this round.
cards.textHtml: Draw 2. Your cards cost 1 less this round.
cards.flavor: "My love... Why won't you answer? Please. Answer me, Isolde. ANSWER ME!" - Viego

cards.flavor: The Sentinels of Light trace their heritage back to blessed Helia. The relic stones they saved from the Ruination would become the world's greatest defense against the darkness of the Black Mist.

cards.name: Relic of Power
cards.text: Grant allies +1|+0.
cards.textHtml: Grant allies +1|+0.
cards.flavor: The mist searched for her in everything. It cried out in his voice, grasped forward with his pleading hands, commanding her to return. But she could not. She would not.

cards.flavor: Before the thief could even reach for her tools, a pale green fog enveloped the box, coaxing it open with a cold whisper.

cards.name: The Absolver's Resurrection

cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, create a copy of me in hand if you've leveled a champion this game.
cards.flavor: The giant scarabs were thought to have perished when the Shuriman empire fell. But the Mist's creeping tendrils burrowed deep into the sands, and bound the ancient things to Viego's service.

cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Play me as <link=card.create1><style=AssociatedCard>First Wave</style></link> or <link=card.create2><style=AssociatedCard>Last Wind</style></link>.
cards.flavor: The Kinkou speak of only two gods: the first wave, who cradles life in its warm waters, and the last wind, who snatches life with its final, frigid sighs.

cards.textHtml: To play me, kill an ally.

cards.flavor:
Once there was a lonely man
Who split himself in twain
From one came two, born anew
Never alone again.

Death took the form of hunters 
None escape such as they
One cajoles with arrows and bow

cards.text: Kill an ally to kill an enemy.

cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.PlaySkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Play</style></link>: Kill an ally to deal 3 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: A handful of Targonian tribes speak of the Fox, a god of death seen as a lone star in the night sky. As the legend goes, the Fox descends upon the mountain with each death, and takes the soul to the skies to create his own dark constellation.

cards.text: Kill an ally to deal 3 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml: Kill an ally to deal 3 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: "Now you'll truly shine!" - Astral Fox

cards.name: Mask Mother
cards.text: Play: Kill an ally to grant me its stats and keywords.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Kill an ally to grant me its stats and keywords.
cards.flavor: They say the Mask Mother created Kindred, just as she created all the incarnations of death. But from whom did she receive her mask, if she didn't craft it herself?

cards.name: Prey
cards.flavor: "They flicker through the dark forest, dotting the treeline like stars in the night sky, unaware of their pursuers." - Lamb

cards.name: Sea Scarab
cards.text: When another ally dies, or Last Breath: Toss 1.
cards.textHtml:
When another ally dies, or <link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>Last Breath</style></link>: <link=vocab.Toss><style=Vocab>Toss</style></link> 1.
<style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor: "Alright, you lot--haul them traps up! An' remember: if you see one of 'em sea scarabs, you cut rope an' move on. I ain't riskin' the keel for whatever they've half-eaten, y'hear?" - Bilgewater captain

cards.name: Spirit Leech
cards.text: Play: Kill an ally to draw 2.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Kill an ally to draw 2.
cards.flavor: In shadow they lurk, waiting for a weary nod or an absent mind. Then claws, a gaping maw, and finally, darkness.

cards.name: Song of the Isles
cards.text: Grant an ally Lifesteal, Fearsome, and Ephemeral.
cards.textHtml: Grant an ally <link=keyword.Lifesteal><sprite name=Lifesteal><style=Keyword>Lifesteal</style></link>, <link=keyword.Fearsome><sprite name=Fearsome><style=Keyword>Fearsome</style></link>, and <link=keyword.Ephemeral><sprite name=Ephemeral><style=Keyword>Ephemeral</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "Come, child. See as I see, and feel as I feel. Do not fear the darkness." - The Rekindler

cards.name: The Twisted Treeline
cards.text: Once I've seen 3+ Fearsome or Nightfall allies attack, destroy me to summon Vilemaw.
cards.textHtml: Once I've seen 3+ <link=keyword.Fearsome><sprite name=Fearsome><style=Keyword>Fearsome</style></link> or <link=keyword.Nightfall><style=Keyword>Nightfall</style></link> allies attack, destroy me to summon <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Vilemaw</style></link>. <style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor:
Its altars may lie dormant, its paths may seem untrod,
But in the dark still skitters, the beast that fools forgot.

cards.name: Crawling Viperwyrm
cards.text: To play me, I strike an ally or deal 3 to your Nexus.
cards.textHtml: To play me, I <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strike</style></link> an ally or deal 3 to your Nexus.
cards.flavor: At first, the Demacian soldiers thought they heard dozens of claws skittering across the square's tile. It wasn't until it breached the watchtower that they realized those many limbs belonged to a single creature.

cards.name: Camavoran Dragon
cards.text:
To play me, I strike an ally or deal 3 to your Nexus.
When I kill another unit, drain 1 from the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml:
To play me, I <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strike</style></link> an ally or deal 3 to your Nexus.
When I kill another unit, <link=keyword.Drain><style=Keyword>drain</style></link> 1 from the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: For centuries, the Black Mist has sought out creatures all over the world, twisting and warping them; turning them into nightmarish versions of their past selves.

cards.name: Despair
cards.text: Pick a unit to strike your Nexus, then kill it.
cards.textHtml: Pick a unit to <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strike</style></link> your Nexus, then kill it.
cards.flavor: "I have given everything to find her, and yet it is not enough." - Viego

cards.name: Encroaching Mist
cards.text: When I'm summoned, grant all allied Viegos and other Encroaching Mists everywhere +1|+1.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, grant all allied <link=card.viego><style=AssociatedCard>Viegos</style></link> and other <link=card.mist><style=AssociatedCard>Encroaching Mists</style></link> <link=vocab.Everywhere><style=Vocab>everywhere</style></link> +1|+1.
cards.flavor: Each living creature that beholds the Black Mist sees something unique in it, their own fears manifested and realized in vague, roiling forms.

cards.name: Invasive Hydravine
cards.text: When I'm summoned or Round Start: Summon an Encroaching Mist.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned or <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Summon an <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Encroaching Mist</style></link>.
cards.flavor: Maokai worked tirelessly to cultivate life in the Shadow Isles. The Mist's ambivalence makes its ironies no less cruel.

cards.name: Camavoran Soldier
cards.text: When I'm summoned, summon an Encroaching Mist.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, summon an <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Encroaching Mist</style></link>.
cards.flavor: The soldiers of Camavor marched with Viego in life, then again in death, their loyalty unwavering.

cards.name: Viego
cards.text: Each round, the first time another ally dies, summon an Encroaching Mist.
cards.textHtml: Each round, the first time another ally dies, summon an <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Encroaching Mist</style></link>.
cards.levelup: I've seen allies with 20+ total power die.
cards.flavor: "There is something that deeply unsettles me about the young king. Something at his heart... a hunger that cannot be satisfied, a desire that goes unfulfilled." - From the record of Nunyo Necrit of Camavor

cards.name: Viego's Despair
cards.text:
Pick a unit to strike your Nexus, then kill it.
Create a Viego in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
Pick a unit to <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strike</style></link> your Nexus, then kill it.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Viego</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "I have given everything to find her, and yet it is not enough." - Viego

cards.name: Viego
cards.text:
Each round, the first time another unit dies, summon an Encroaching Mist.
Round Start: Steal the strongest enemy this round. If it's a champion, kill it instead.
cards.textHtml:
Each round, the first time another unit dies, summon an <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Encroaching Mist</style></link>.
<link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Steal the <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> enemy this round. If it's a champion, kill it instead.
cards.flavor: "It is obvious to me in hindsight that it was not Isolde's death that fueled Viego's delusions, nor his need for fulfillment, but simply that something he desperately wanted was denied him." - From the record of Nunyo Necrit of Camavor

cards.name: Withering Mist
cards.text: Drain 2 from 2 enemies.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Drain><style=Keyword>Drain</style></link> 2 from 2 enemies.
cards.flavor: "I will take what I want, and dispense with what I don't." - Viego

cards.name: Minimorph
cards.text: Transform a unit into a 3|3 Mini-Minitee and Silence it.
cards.textHtml: Transform a unit into a 3|3 <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Mini-Minitee</style></link> and <link=vocab.Silence><style=Vocab>Silence</style></link> it.
cards.flavor: "Oh-ho! How cute! How adorable! How TINY!" - Veigar

cards.name: Mini-Minitee
cards.flavor: Oh, the wee minitee!

cards.name: Otterpus
cards.text: When I'm summoned, create a Prank in hand.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Prank</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor:
"Curious and playful, the otterpus are an immensely cheery bunch. Or is it otterpi? Say, didn't I pack a third sandwich?" 
- Conchologist Ecological Entry, Day 7

cards.name: Kelp Maidens
cards.text: Nexus Strike: Create a Prank in hand.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.NexusStrike><style=Vocab>Nexus Strike</style></link>: Create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Prank</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor:
"Dear me, I've just had the oddest dream. One moment, I'm scrambling through the kelp, looking for my shell hat, when suddenly I hear the most wonderful melody. Next thing I know, I'm seated here, pen in hand, writing these words. I don't recall sitting down for a nap..."
- Conchologist Ecological Entry, Day 22

cards.name: The Arsenal
cards.text:
When I'm summoned, grant me a random keyword for each allied landmark you've destroyed this game. 
When you destroy an allied landmark, grant me a random keyword.
cards.textHtml:
When I'm summoned, grant me a random keyword for each allied landmark you've destroyed this game. <style=Variable></style>
When you destroy an allied landmark, grant me a random keyword.
cards.flavor: Wherever Ziggs went, Arnie followed, his serene demeanor a natural foil to Ziggs' chaotic zeal. His duties ranged from making sure the munitions were stocked, to putting out fires, to clapping his hands over Ziggs' ears when Ziggs (inevitably) forgot hearing protection.

cards.name: Stone Stackers
cards.flavor: Yordles haven't quite figured out gravity yet, but then, gravity hasn't quite figured out Bandle City, either.

cards.name: Shark Trainer
cards.text: When allies attack, summon an attacking Short Tooth.
cards.textHtml: When allies attack, summon an attacking <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Short Tooth</style></link>.
cards.flavor: The Trainer's routine is the same each night. Fish 'n ale for supper, a quick puff of his bubblepipe, followed by kisses on snouts and a story for his sharks before bedtime.

cards.name: Short Tooth
cards.flavor:
"They say don't bite the hand that feeds--but by Bandle--they bit my hand AND anything else they could reach!" 
- Conchologist Ecological Note, Day 13

cards.name: Tricksy Tentacles
cards.text: Your opponent discards their lowest cost card.
cards.textHtml: Your opponent discards their lowest cost card.
cards.flavor:
"Note to self: On next expedition, keep all valuables in my FRONT pockets." 
- Conchologist Ecological Entry, Day 19

cards.name: Teenydactyl
cards.text: Round End: If you've damaged the enemy Nexus this round, transform me into Terrordactyl.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.RoundEnd><style=Vocab>Round End</style></link>: If you've damaged the enemy Nexus this round, transform me into <link=card.transform><style=AssociatedCard>Terrordactyl</style></link>.
cards.flavor: The creatures of Nakotak Valley are as varied and lively as the land they inhabit... and just as likely to explode.

cards.name: Terrordactyl
cards.text: Round Start: Deal 1 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Deal 1 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: Once enraged, the Terrordactyls tear erratically through the skies, leaving mayhem and enraptured yordles in their colorful wake.

cards.name: Bitsy Lizard
cards.text: Round End: If you've damaged the enemy Nexus this round, transform me into Lava Lizard.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.RoundEnd><style=Vocab>Round End</style></link>: If you've damaged the enemy Nexus this round, transform me into <link=card.transform><style=AssociatedCard>Lava Lizard</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "Eat the pepper!" barked Nakotak, probably. "No, YOU eat the pepper!" replied Jojo, also probably. As they argued, a small lizard scuttled by, chasing a smaller fly. The two yordles looked at the lizard, then the pepper, then each other. If lightbulbs existed, one would've gone off.

cards.name: Lava Lizard
cards.flavor: Jojo and Nakotak screamed out giggles and giggled out screams as they fled. The Lava Lizard's flames had already singed their back fur, consumed trees, and was now starting to melt the delicate snowdrift. It was AWESOME.

cards.name: Pompous Cavalier
cards.flavor: "Nine hundred ninety-eight... nine hundred ninety-nine... one thousand! There we are, Bawky, you look impeccable as ever. Okay, now do mine!"

cards.name: Rainbowfish
cards.flavor: The Rainbowfish was glad to do some aerial reconnaissance, even if it meant taking a bigger leap than she ever had before. She would take any reprieve, however slight, from Yuumi's hungry stare.

cards.name: Rainbowfish
cards.text: Attach me to an ally to give it my stats and keywords while I'm Attached. When that ally leaves play, Recall me.
cards.textHtml: Attach me to an ally to give it my stats and keywords while I'm <link=keyword.Attach><sprite name=Attach><style=Keyword>Attached</style></link>. When that ally leaves play, <link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recall</style></link> me.
cards.flavor: "Help 'em out, Rainbowfish!" - Yuumi

cards.name: Rainbowfish
cards.flavor: The Rainbowfish was glad to do some aerial reconnaissance, even if it meant taking a bigger leap than she ever had before. She would take any reprieve, however slight, from Yuumi's hungry stare.

cards.name: Assistant Librarian
cards.text: Nexus Strike: Draw a spell that costs 3 or less.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.NexusStrike><style=Vocab>Nexus Strike</style></link>: Draw a spell that costs 3 or less.
cards.flavor: "Jelly's my BEST FRIEND! I mean, after you, Book. And Norra. Okay, Jelly's my THIRD-BEST FRIEND. That's still pretty good though, right?!" - Yuumi

cards.name: Bouncing Bomb
cards.text: Deal 2 to a unit or deal 1 to two enemies.
cards.textHtml: Deal 2 to a unit or deal 1 to two enemies.
cards.flavor: "Fire in the hole!" - Ziggs

cards.name: Bouncing Bomb
cards.text: Deal 2 to a unit.
cards.textHtml: Deal 2 to a unit.
cards.flavor: "Fire in the hole!" - Ziggs

cards.name: Bouncing Bomb
cards.text: Deal 1 to two enemies.
cards.textHtml: Deal 1 to two enemies.
cards.flavor: "Fire in the hole!" - Ziggs

cards.name: Minitee
cards.text: Round End: If you've damaged the enemy Nexus this round, transform me into Megatee.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.RoundEnd><style=Vocab>Round End</style></link>: If you've damaged the enemy Nexus this round, transform me into <link=card.transform><style=AssociatedCard>Megatee</style></link>.
cards.flavor: Things minitees like: napping on the warm summerstones beside the Nakotak tribal lands. Things minitees do not like: being shoved off said summerstones by cheeky yordles...

cards.name: Megatee
cards.text: Round Start: Transform the strongest enemy into a 3|3 Mini-Minitee and Silence it. It can't block.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Transform the <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> enemy into a 3|3 <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Mini-Minitee</style></link> and <link=vocab.Silence><style=Vocab>Silence</style></link> it. It can't block.
cards.flavor: ...but, as they say, yordles gonna yordle!

cards.name: Hidden Pathways
cards.text: I cost 2 less if you've created 2+ cards this game. Draw 2.
cards.textHtml: I cost 2 less if you've created 2+ cards this game. Draw 2.
cards.flavor: Very few outsiders know the way to Bandle City, but strange markings in the rocks and trees of Runeterra offer hints to those who know what to look for.

cards.name: Hexplosive Minefield
cards.text: When I’m summoned or you destroy me, Stun the strongest enemy.
cards.textHtml: When I’m summoned or you destroy me, <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> the <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> enemy.
cards.flavor: "What do you mean, 'this doesn't look safe'?" - Ziggs

cards.name: Yuumi
cards.text: Round Start: Grant the unit I'm Attached to +1|+1. Otherwise, grant me +1|+1 instead.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Grant the unit I'm <link=keyword.Attach><sprite name=Attach><style=Keyword>Attached</style></link> to +1|+1. Otherwise, grant me +1|+1 instead.
cards.levelup: I or the unit I'm Attached to have attacked 3 times.
cards.flavor: Yuumi did have to admit that for all her fussing, she did like Book quite a lot. She liked its smell. She liked its illustrations. She even liked jumping through its portals! ...but nothing was as good as just having Norra back home, safe and sound.

cards.name: Yuumi
cards.text: Round Start: Grant the unit I'm Attached to +1|+1.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Grant the unit I'm <link=keyword.Attach><sprite name=Attach><style=Keyword>Attached</style></link> to +1|+1.
cards.levelup: The unit I'm Attached to has attacked 3 times.
cards.flavor: "I'm sticking with you!" - Yuumi

cards.name: Yuumi
cards.text: Round Start: Grant the unit I'm Attached to SpellShield and +1|+1.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Grant the unit I'm <link=keyword.Attach><sprite name=Attach><style=Keyword>Attached</style></link> to <link=keyword.SpellShield><sprite name=SpellShield><style=Keyword>SpellShield</style></link> and +1|+1.
cards.flavor: "I go where you go!" - Yuumi

cards.name: Yuumi
cards.text: Round Start: Grant the unit I'm Attached to SpellShield and +1|+1. Otherwise, grant me SpellShield and +1|+1 instead.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Grant the unit I'm <link=keyword.Attach><sprite name=Attach><style=Keyword>Attached</style></link> to <link=keyword.SpellShield><sprite name=SpellShield><style=Keyword>SpellShield</style></link> and +1|+1. Otherwise, grant me <link=keyword.SpellShield><sprite name=SpellShield><style=Keyword>SpellShield</style></link> and +1|+1 instead.
cards.flavor: Yet with each new portal came new adventures, and with each new adventure came a chance to make new friends!

cards.name: Yuumi's Prowling Projectile
cards.text:
Grant an ally +1|+0. Deal 1 to an enemy.
Create a Yuumi in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
Grant an ally +1|+0. Deal 1 to an enemy.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Yuumi</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "Zoooooom!" - Yuumi

cards.name: Yuumi
cards.text: Round Start: Grant me +1|+1.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Grant me +1|+1.
cards.levelup: I've attacked 3 times.
cards.flavor: Yuumi did have to admit that for all her fussing, she did like Book quite a lot. She liked its smell. She liked its illustrations. She even liked jumping through its portals! ...but nothing was as good as just having Norra back home, safe and sound.

cards.name: Yuumi
cards.text: Round Start: Grant me SpellShield and +1|+1.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Grant me <link=keyword.SpellShield><sprite name=SpellShield><style=Keyword>SpellShield</style></link> and +1|+1.
cards.flavor: Yet with each new portal came new adventures, and with each new adventure came a chance to make new friends!

cards.name: Gleaming Lantern
cards.text: Each round, the first Fae you play costs 2 less.
cards.textHtml: Each round, the first Fae you play costs 2 less.
cards.flavor: "Lantern follows Norra, moon moths follow Lantern, mouses follow moon moths! Follow, follow!"

cards.name: Gruff Grenadier
cards.text: Allegiance: Summon a random Yordle follower that costs 3 or less.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Allegiance><style=Vocab>Allegiance</style></link>: Summon a random Yordle follower that costs 3 or less.
cards.flavor: "Alice here holds two shots: one's a greeting, the other's a farewell. You two wanna meet?"

cards.name: Trinket Trade
cards.text: Manifest an Otterpus or one of 2 spells from your regions that cost 3 or less.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Manifest><style=Vocab>Manifest</style></link> an <link=card.create1><style=AssociatedCard>Otterpus</style></link> or one of 2 spells from your regions that cost 3 or less.
cards.flavor: "Unhand my sandwich this instant!" - Conchologist

cards.name: Poppy
cards.text: Attack: Grant allies with equal or less power than me +1|+1.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Grant allies with equal or less power than me +1|+1.
cards.levelup: I've attacked with allies 3 times.
cards.flavor: Humility is a mark of heroism, but many historians would agree that Poppy is kind of pushing it.

cards.name: Poppy
cards.text: Attack: Grant allies with equal or less power than me +2|+2 and Impact.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Grant allies with equal or less power than me +2|+2 and <link=keyword.Impact><sprite name=Impact><style=Keyword>Impact</style></link>.
cards.flavor: Power is a famously corrupting influence, but Poppy proves that its corruption is no match for a good heart and stubborn, steadfast obliviousness.

cards.name: Poppy's Keeper's Verdict
cards.text: Place an enemy unit on top of the enemy deck. Create a Poppy in your deck.
cards.textHtml: Place an enemy unit on top of the enemy deck. Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Poppy</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "And don't come back!" - Poppy

cards.name: Purpleberry Shake
cards.text: Grow an ally to 3|3 this round.
cards.textHtml: Grow an ally to 3|3 this round.
cards.flavor:
"I used to be like you–couldn't even lift a puffcap. But then, I found "Shake: by Purpleberry." It's got all the right stuff a yordle needs to go from zero to hero. So when you've had a hard workout, fuel up with 'Shake,' and become the buffest of bros, like me!" 
- Printed Advertisement

cards.name: Thunder Fist
cards.text: When I’m summoned, if you’ve summoned a Thunder Fist this game, transform me into Masa, Crashing Thunder.
cards.textHtml: When I’m summoned, if you’ve summoned a <link=card.me><style=AssociatedCard>Thunder Fist</style></link> this game, transform me into <link=card.transform><style=AssociatedCard>Masa, Crashing Thunder</style></link>.
cards.flavor: As Masa struck the training dummy, a flash of lightning erupted from the fist, splitting the wood in two and singeing the hair on his hands. He pulled on the rope, reeling in the bronze hand and reflecting on his training—he was finally ready. Suddenly, a monstrous roar echoed in the distance.

cards.name: Masa, Crashing Thunder
cards.flavor: Masa attacked with a loud cry. There was a sizzle, then a crack, followed by a howl. Enraged, The Aberration fixed its massive eye on the still-smoking bronze fists, unaware of the encroaching Stormcloud. Masa steeled himself as a monstrous hand fast-approached and prayed he'd bought them enough time.

cards.name: Conchologist
cards.text: Play: Manifest a spell from your regions that costs 3 or less.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: <link=vocab.Manifest><style=Vocab>Manifest</style></link> a spell from your regions that costs 3 or less.
cards.flavor:
"Today is indeed a red letter day! An exploration into the deep! I expect things to proceed quite... swimmingly! Ho ho!" 
- Conchologist Ecological Entry, Day 1

cards.name: Benemone
cards.text: When I'm summoned, create 2 Pranks in hand.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, create 2 <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Pranks</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor:
"Those who are prone to nausea should approach this gentle giant with EXTREME caution. Your insides will thank you... On a related note, I really shouldn't have eaten that second mushroom sandwich..." 
- Conchologist Ecological Entry, Day 3

cards.name: Treasured Trash
cards.text: Fill your hand with random cards. They cost 0 and areFleeting. You can only play 3 more cards this round.
cards.textHtml: Fill your hand with random cards. They cost 0 and are<link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link>. You can only play 3 more cards this round.
cards.flavor: One mortal's trash is another yordle's giant pile of scrap parts.

cards.name: Gust Monk
cards.text: When I'm summoned, create a Cloud Stance in hand.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Cloud Stance</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: "It is from control of breath that our school's technique is derived. Just as it is from wind that a tempest is born."

cards.name: Stilted Robemaker
cards.text: When I'm summoned, reduce the cost of your Darkness everywhere by 1.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, reduce the cost of your <link=card.spell><style=AssociatedCard>Darkness</style></link> <link=vocab.Everywhere><style=Vocab>everywhere</style></link> by 1.
cards.flavor:
"It is important, when assembling one's cabal, that each maniacal member brings something unique to the supervillain table. One of my fellows, for instance, has a lethal sense of style..."
- Excerpt from Ch. 4 of "How to be a Supervillain", by Lord Veigar

cards.name: Kennen
cards.text: When I'm summoned, create a Mark of the Storm in hand.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, create a <link=card.cast><style=AssociatedCard>Mark of the Storm</style></link> in hand.
cards.levelup: You've summoned the same ally 5+ times.
cards.flavor: Kennen had heard it too, the roar of some unseen... something. Man or monster, it did not matter. The Kinkou would protect their land at any cost.

cards.name: Kennen
cards.text: When I'm summoned, blocked, or Attack: Create a Mark of the Storm in hand.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, blocked, or <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Create a <link=card.cast><style=AssociatedCard>Mark of the Storm</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: "We are wind and thunder! We are rain and lightning! This is... TEMPEST!"

cards.name: Kennen's Lightning Rush
cards.text:
Recall an ally to deal 2 to anything.
Create a Kennen in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
<link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recall</style></link> an ally to deal 2 to anything.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Kennen</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "First the crack, then the boom!" - Kennen

cards.name: Mark of the Storm
cards.text: Grant an enemy Mark of the Storm. If they already have it, remove the mark to Stun and deal 2 to them instead.
cards.textHtml: Grant an enemy Mark of the Storm. If they already have it, remove the mark to <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> and deal 2 to them instead.
cards.flavor: The storm approaches.

cards.name: Tornado Warrior
cards.text:
When I'm summoned, grant me +1|+0 and a random keyword.
I keep these stat buffs and keywords when I'm Recalled.
cards.textHtml:
When I'm summoned, grant me +1|+0 and a random keyword.
I keep these stat buffs and keywords when I'm <link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recalled</style></link>.
cards.flavor: The Tornado maintains her calm with breathing exercises... and by channeling her inner turmoil into a vicious hurricane of deadly blades.

cards.name: Quick Quill
cards.flavor: "W... h... e... r... e... s... N... o... r... r... a...? Oh dear, what should I tell it?" - Mouse steward

cards.name: Quick Quill
cards.text: Attach me to an ally to give it my stats and keywords while I'm Attached. When that ally leaves play, Recall me.
cards.textHtml: Attach me to an ally to give it my stats and keywords while I'm <link=keyword.Attach><sprite name=Attach><style=Keyword>Attached</style></link>. When that ally leaves play, <link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recall</style></link> me.
cards.flavor: "Show 'em what you can do, quills!" - Yuumi

cards.name: Quick Quill
cards.flavor: "W... h... e... r... e... s... N... o... r... r... a...? Oh dear, what should I tell it?" - Mouse steward

cards.name: Lecturing Yordle
cards.text: Attack: Create a Fleeting Poison Dart in hand.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Create a <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Poison Dart</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: Don't get him started.

cards.name: Ava Achiever
cards.text:
When I'm summoned or Round End: Plant 3 Poison Puffcaps in the enemy deck. 
Traps on enemy cards are doubled when activated.
cards.textHtml:
When I'm summoned or <link=vocab.RoundEnd><style=Vocab>Round End</style></link>: Plant 3 <link=card.puffcap><style=AssociatedCard>Poison Puffcaps</style></link> in the enemy deck. 
Traps on enemy cards are doubled when activated.
cards.flavor: "Rule 378: A good scout is always brave, always prepared, and always daring!"

cards.name: Inventive Chemist
cards.text: When I’m summoned, summon a Scrappy Bomb.
cards.textHtml: When I’m summoned, summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Scrappy Bomb</style></link>.
cards.flavor: Giselle was one of Professor Heimerdinger's best students until she heard of Ziggs' strange experiments down in Zaun. Then it was all "hexplosives" this and "could you recommend me for an internship" that.

cards.name: Scrappy Bomb
cards.text: Countdown 3 or when you destroy me: Deal 1 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Countdown><style=Vocab>Countdown</style></link><style=Variable></style> 3 or when you destroy me: Deal 1 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: "It's a real work of art, isn't it!" - Giselle, Inventive Chemist

cards.name: Electro Harpoon
cards.text: To play, discard 1. Deal 2 to a unit and 2 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml: To play, discard 1. Deal 2 to a unit and 2 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: "Let's give 'em a show!" - Rumble

cards.name: Lil Dipper
cards.text:
To play me, discard a unit.
Last Breath: Summon an exact copy of the discarded unit.
cards.textHtml:
To play me, discard a unit.
<link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>Last Breath</style></link>: Summon an exact copy of the discarded unit.
cards.flavor: "You thought I kept my money buried beneath the arena? HAH! What am I, a pirate? Now go fill that hole before the next match! ... ... Tim, we gotta move the money again." - Karl, Arena Kingpin

cards.name: Smash & Dash
cards.text: When I'm summoned, grant me 2 Impact.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, grant me 2 <link=keyword.Impact><sprite name=Impact><style=Keyword>Impact</style></link>.
cards.flavor:
"I didn't choose the smash life, the smash life chose ME!"
- Post-match interview

cards.name: Bouncer & Bolt
cards.flavor: "That hole you put in the ceiling during the last match? It's comin' outta your next paycheck!" - Karl, Arena Kingpin

cards.name: Squeaker
cards.text: Play: Discard 1 to Manifest a Mecha Yordle.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Discard 1 to <link=vocab.Manifest><style=Vocab>Manifest</style></link> a Mecha Yordle.
cards.flavor: Small stature, BIG personality.

cards.name: Bilgerat Rascal
cards.text: Play: Discard 1 to Manifest a Mecha Yordle and grant it SpellShield.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Discard 1 to <link=vocab.Manifest><style=Vocab>Manifest</style></link> a Mecha Yordle and grant it <link=keyword.SpellShield><sprite name=SpellShield><style=Keyword>SpellShield</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "Turn it down, will ya?! I can barely hear myself counting all this money!" - Karl, Arena Kingpin

cards.name: Earthshaker
cards.text: Attack: Double my Power and Impact.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Double my Power and <link=keyword.Impact><sprite name=Impact><style=Keyword>Impact</style></link>.
cards.flavor:
"They say I'm a joke. That I've got dirt for brains. That I'm all tremble and no quake. Well I've just got one thing to say to my opponents... I'm gonna rock your world!" 
- Pre-match interview

cards.name: Rumble
cards.text: Play: Discard up to 3 cards to grant allied Rumbles everywhere Impact for the first, Quick Attack for the second, and SpellShield for the third.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Discard up to 3 cards to grant allied <link=card.selfRef><style=AssociatedCard>Rumbles</style></link> <link=vocab.Everywhere><style=Vocab>everywhere</style></link> <link=keyword.Impact><sprite name=Impact><style=Keyword>Impact</style></link> for the first, <link=keyword.Quick Strike><sprite name=QuickStrike><style=Keyword>Quick Attack</style></link> for the second, and <link=keyword.SpellShield><sprite name=SpellShield><style=Keyword>SpellShield</style></link> for the third.
cards.levelup: I've seen Mecha Yordle allies deal 12+ damage.
cards.flavor:
"Annnnd that oughta do 'er."
"ERROR."
"WHAT? I just fixed that!"
"SYSTEM FAILURE IMMINENT."
"Turn it off. TURN IT OFF!"
- Rumble and Tristy

cards.name: Rumble's Flamespitter
cards.text:
Grant an ally +2|+0 and Impact.
Create a Rumble in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
Grant an ally +2|+0 and <link=keyword.Impact><sprite name=Impact><style=Keyword>Impact</style></link>.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Rumble</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "If they ain't howlin', it ain't hot enough! Heh heh." - Rumble

cards.name: Rumble
cards.text: When you deal damage to the enemy Nexus, create a random Mecha Yordle in hand or if you have one, grant all Mecha Yordles in hand +1|+1 and reduce their cost by 1.
cards.textHtml: When you deal damage to the enemy Nexus, create a random Mecha Yordle in hand or if you have one, grant all Mecha Yordles in hand +1|+1 and reduce their cost by 1.
cards.flavor: "I mean, I know Tristy's already got the flamethrower, the electro-drill, and the giant freakin' mace, but c'mon... I wasn't NOT gonna add rockets. Heh heh."

cards.name: Trumpetecher
cards.text: When I'm summoned, grant other allies +1|+1.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, grant other allies +1|+1.
cards.flavor: The mechs and yordles were bruised, battered, beaten. Then a clarion call sounded, granting them new steam, new life: Doot doot!

cards.name: Arena Promoter
cards.text: Play: Discard 1 to Manifest a Mecha Yordle and reduce its cost by 1.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Discard 1 to <link=vocab.Manifest><style=Vocab>Manifest</style></link> a Mecha Yordle and reduce its cost by 1.
cards.flavor: "TICKETS! GET YER TICKETS! NOWWWW HALF OFF! Oh, biscuits, if I don't sell these tickets, the boss'll kill me... literally."

cards.name: Veigar
cards.text: When I'm summoned, create a Darkness in hand if you don't have one. Round Start: Grant your Darkness everywhere 1 extra damage.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Darkness</style></link> in hand if you don't have one. <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Grant your <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Darkness</style></link> <link=vocab.Everywhere><style=Vocab>everywhere</style></link> 1 extra damage.
cards.levelup: You've dealt 12+ damage with Darkness.
cards.flavor:
"This world will fear me. It will wear my scars for all eternity. It will ache under the weight of my power. It will shudder under the shadow of my enormity!"
- Excerpt from Ch. 1 of "How to be a Supervillain", by Lord Veigar

cards.name: Veigar's Event Horizon
cards.text:
Stun an enemy and stun all enemies with 2 or less Power.
Create a Veigar in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
<link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> an enemy and stun all enemies with 2 or less Power.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Veigar</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "Just... stay right there..." - Veigar

cards.name: Grand Overseer Veigar
cards.text:
When I'm summoned or Round Start: Create a Darkness in hand if you don't have one. Round Start: Grant your Darkness everywhere 1 extra damage.
When you play Darkness, it can target anything.
cards.textHtml:
When I'm summoned or <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Darkness</style></link> in hand if you don't have one. <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Grant your <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Darkness</style></link> <link=vocab.Everywhere><style=Vocab>everywhere</style></link> 1 extra damage.
When you play <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Darkness</style></link>, it can target anything.
cards.flavor:
"Aha. Muaha. Ahahaha. AHAHA. AHAHAHAHAHA! MUAHAHAHA! MUAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA!"
- Excerpt from Ch. 12 of "How to be a Supervillain", by Lord Veigar

cards.name: Darkbulb Acolyte
cards.text: When I'm summoned, create a Darkness in hand if you don't have one.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Darkness</style></link> in hand if you don't have one.
cards.flavor: "Yes, I'm quite sure the fellow up on the roof has many stories to tell. We all know he has lots to say. We just don't have any idea exactly WHAT it is he's saying." - Stilted Robemaker

cards.name: Tenor of Terror
cards.text: When I'm summoned, if you've played a created card or killed a unit with a spell this game, summon a Bass of Burden.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, if you've played a created card or killed a unit with a spell this game, summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Bass of Burden</style></link>.
cards.flavor: If Veigar needed help tipping the scales of justice, then none were better suited to the job than these two. They knew all of them. Except the mixolydian one.

cards.name: Bass of Burden
cards.flavor: "The show had already run into a number of mishaps by the third piece, when the larger of the two singers--I use the term loosely--either delved into the world of the true avant-garde, or choked on a hairball. I am, even at the time of writing, unsure which." - Max Bliff, Gatekeeper

cards.name: Twisted Catalyzer
cards.text: Strike: Grant your Darkness everywhere 1 extra damage.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>Strike</style></link>: Grant your <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Darkness</style></link> <link=vocab.Everywhere><style=Vocab>everywhere</style></link> 1 extra damage.
cards.flavor: Darkness comes in all shapes and sizes. Some of them SURPRISINGLY adorable.

cards.name: Swole Scout
cards.text: When I'm summoned, grant me +1|+1 for each other Yordle ally you have.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, grant me +1|+1 for each other Yordle ally you have. <style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor: "What's my secret? You'll have to ask the biceps. They do all the talking."

cards.name: Puffcap Pup
cards.text: Strike: Plant 3 Poison Puffcaps in the enemy deck.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>Strike</style></link>: Plant 3 <link=card.shuffle><style=AssociatedCard>Poison Puffcaps</style></link> in the enemy deck.
cards.flavor: "What's that, boy? Two of the recruits were scouting in the woods and stumbled across a scary grass monster, and now they might die a long and painful death? Lead the way!" - Teemo

cards.name: Wizened Wizard
cards.text: Round Start: Refill 1 spell mana.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Refill 1 spell mana.
cards.flavor: If there is no greater pain than the papercut, then there is no one who better understands pain than the librarian.

cards.name: Primal Strength
cards.text: Grant an ally +2|+2 and Impact.
cards.textHtml: Grant an ally +2|+2 and <link=keyword.Impact><sprite name=Impact><style=Keyword>Impact</style></link>.
cards.flavor: Yes, he's very cute. Yes, he has a temper. No, you don't want to see it.

cards.name: Bandle Gunners
cards.text:
I cost 1 less for each multi-region ally you've summoned this game.
When I'm summoned, grant me 3 Impact.
cards.textHtml:
I cost 1 less for each multi-region ally you've summoned this game.
When I'm summoned, grant me 3 <link=keyword.Impact><sprite name=Impact><style=Keyword>Impact</style></link>.
cards.flavor: Squad goals.

cards.name: Grumbleslug
cards.flavor:
"Though quite small, the grumbleslug has a large appetite and possesses what I can only describe as a 'real attitude problem.'" 
- Conchologist Ecological Entry, Day 17

cards.name: Yordle Explorer
cards.text: When you summon another Yordle, grant it +1|+0.
cards.textHtml: When you summon another Yordle, grant it +1|+0.
cards.flavor: "Priceless is the glory of exploration, but the greatest discoveries are always... ahem... profitable."

cards.name: Scholarly Climber
cards.flavor: "Yes, yes, you've told me all about how much she likes tea, socks, you, buttons, and collecting little bits and bobs, but you still haven't told me anything about what she LOOKS like!"

cards.name: Yordles in Arms
cards.text: Give allies +2|+2 this round. If you've played cards from 4+ regions, give allies +3|+3 instead.
cards.textHtml: Give allies +2|+2 this round. If you've played cards from 4+ regions, give allies +3|+3 instead. <style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor: "We... look so cool right now." - Tristana

cards.name: Blastcone Seedling
cards.text: Play: Give me Barrier this round or grant me Impact.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Give me <link=keyword.Barrier><sprite name=Barrier><style=Keyword>Barrier</style></link> this round or grant me <link=keyword.Impact><sprite name=Impact><style=Keyword>Impact</style></link>.
cards.flavor: The Blastcone Seedlings are shy creatures, and while they will retreat first and foremost, if threatened...

cards.name: Blastcone Seedling
cards.text: Play: Grant me Impact.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Grant me <link=keyword.Impact><sprite name=Impact><style=Keyword>Impact</style></link>.
cards.flavor: ... some will attack!

cards.name: Blastcone Seedling
cards.text: Play: Give me Barrier this round.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Give me <link=keyword.Barrier><sprite name=Barrier><style=Keyword>Barrier</style></link> this round.
cards.flavor: ... some will stand their ground!

cards.name: Bandle City Mayor
cards.text:
Each round, the first multi-region unit you play costs 1 less.
Play: Manifest a multi-region follower.
cards.textHtml:
Each round, the first multi-region unit you play costs 1 less.
<link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: <link=vocab.Manifest><style=Vocab>Manifest</style></link> a multi-region follower.
cards.flavor: It's unclear whether Bandle City ever really elected a mayor, but an enormous mustache would almost certainly be a prerequisite.

cards.name: Minion
cards.text: Last Breath: Create a copy of me in hand at the next Round Start.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>Last Breath</style></link>: Create a copy of me in hand at the next <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>.
cards.flavor:
"A true supervillain can never have enough minions! Short little fellows who know their place, obey your every word, and always come back for further instruction."
- Excerpt from Ch. 2 of "How to be a Supervillain", by Lord Veigar

cards.name: Yordle Captain
cards.text: When you summon another ally with equal or less Power than me, grant it +1|+1.
cards.textHtml: When you summon another ally with equal or less Power than me, grant it +1|+1.
cards.flavor: "Adventuring means finding baddies, and turning them into friends!"

cards.name: Yordle Newbie
cards.text: When you summon another Yordle, give me +2|+0 this round.
cards.textHtml: When you summon another Yordle, give me +2|+0 this round.
cards.flavor: "Giantus grassicus. These terrifying creatures camouflage themselves by laying like ordinary grass and attack any unfortunate enough to walk over them. If encountered, run away forever!" - Ava Achiever

cards.name: Rissu, The Silent Storm
cards.text: When I'm summoned, summon a Stormcloud.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Stormcloud</style></link>.
cards.flavor: Weaving a Stormcloud took time. Time Rissu didn't have. Her hands worked furiously as the Aberration closed in. A bit of cloud here, some lightning there. Then... CRACK! BOOM! She had done it, but would it be enough?

cards.name: Stormcloud
cards.text: When I'm summoned, grant me 3 Impact.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, grant me 3 <link=keyword.Impact><sprite name=Impact><style=Keyword>Impact</style></link>.
cards.flavor: The Stormcloud crashed into the Aberration in a crackling tangle of mist and lightning. The beast howled as it fell to the ground, its monstrous eye rolling into the back of its head. Kennen gingerly approached through the Stormcloud's dissipating haze. The Kinkou had won, but it would be short-lived. There would always be another threat. Another monster. But they would be ready.

cards.name: Arena Kingpin
cards.flavor: "There's a sucker born every minute, and I'm gonna take 'em for all they got... this mech arena's gonna be a GOLD MINE."

cards.name: Hothead
cards.text: Attack: Grant the top champion in your deck +1|+1 and a random keyword.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Grant the top champion in your deck +1|+1 and a random keyword.
cards.flavor: Otto's summer barbecues had something of a reputation. While enthusiastic about grilling, he left his guests few choices for the steaks other than "well done" or "extremely well done".

cards.name: Buster Shot
cards.text:
I cost 2 less if you have a Tristana or if you've played cards from 4+ regions this game.
Deal 3 to a unit.
cards.textHtml:
I cost 2 less if you have a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Tristana</style></link> or if you've played cards from 4+ regions this game.
Deal 3 to a unit. <style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor: In every ka-blam there's a ka-boom waiting to be born.

cards.name: Tristana
cards.text:
I have +1|+0 for each multi-region ally you've summoned this game.
When you summon a multi-region ally, grant it +1|+0.
cards.textHtml:
I have +1|+0 for each multi-region ally you've summoned this game.
When you summon a multi-region ally, grant it +1|+0.
cards.levelup: You've summoned 5+ multi-region allies.
cards.flavor: "Okay, Plan A: We blast our way in and start shooting. If that doesn't work, we go to Plan B: Blast our way out and keep shooting. Then, we'll regroup and go to Plan C, which is basically Plan A again..."

cards.name: Tristana
cards.text:
I have +1|+0 for each multi-region ally you've summoned this game.
When you summon a multi-region ally, grant me and it +1|+0 and Impact.
cards.textHtml:
I have +1|+0 for each multi-region ally you've summoned this game.
When you summon a multi-region ally, grant me and it +1|+0 and <link=keyword.Impact><sprite name=Impact><style=Keyword>Impact</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "...and whatever happens... JUST. KEEP. SHOOTING."

cards.name: Double Tap
cards.text: An ally strikes an enemy. If the ally is multi-region, it strikes the enemy again.
cards.textHtml: An ally <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strikes</style></link> an enemy. If the ally is multi-region, it <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strikes</style></link> the enemy again.
cards.flavor: "The Acorn M1-85: a fully-automatic, oak caliber rifle with a bandlewood scope, and a purpleberry finish. Yeah, mama's cookin' up something good tonight!" - Bandle Commando

cards.name: Scrapheap
cards.text:
To play, discard 1.
Manifest a Mecha Yordle.
cards.textHtml:
To play, discard 1.
<link=vocab.Manifest><style=Vocab>Manifest</style></link> a Mecha Yordle.
cards.flavor: "Junk. Crap. Garbage... Hey, now THIS is what I'm freakin' talkin' about!" - Rumble

cards.name: Fix-Em-Uppers
cards.text: The first time you discard a card or damage the enemy Nexus, grant me +2|+1.
cards.textHtml: The first time you discard a card or damage the enemy Nexus, grant me +2|+1.
cards.flavor: "Alright, good fight. Good show everyone. Now clean up this crap, and uh, you know the drill: anything salvageable... fix it up, put it in the shop, and we'll just sell it right back to 'em! AHAHAHA!" - Karl, Arena Kingpin

cards.name: Poro Sled
cards.text: Attack: Summon an attacking random 1 cost Poro.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Summon an attacking random 1 cost Poro.
cards.flavor: "An' den DAT Bobjim da poro was like "DAT WAY!" an' so off dey went into da horizahn, with da other poros scamperin' behind, tryin' their bestest to keep up!" - Ingvar the Younger

cards.name: Heroic Refrain
cards.text: Give 2 allies +2|+1 this round.
cards.textHtml: Give 2 allies +2|+1 this round.
cards.flavor:
"'There the heroes stood, back to back--'"
"--Butt to butt! Hehehehehe!"
"N-no! Peppy, if you must interject, please do so during less dramatic moments!" 
- Tales told 'round the yordle campfire

cards.name: Yordle Squire
cards.text: Play: Create a Tiny Spear or a Tiny Shield in hand.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Create a <link=card.create1><style=AssociatedCard>Tiny Spear</style></link> or a <link=card.create2><style=AssociatedCard>Tiny Shield</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: "My spear used to belong to a great hero, too... I made Poppy hold it for a minute!"

cards.name: Tiny Spear
cards.text: Grant an ally +1|+0.
cards.textHtml: Grant an ally +1|+0.
cards.flavor: "A small spear is still a spear." - Yordle saying, probably

cards.name: Tiny Shield
cards.text: Grant an ally +0|+1.
cards.textHtml: Grant an ally +0|+1.
cards.flavor: "I found it! But you can use it!!" - Yordle Squire

cards.name: Bandle Painter
cards.text: Play: Discard 1 to create a multi-region follower in hand and reduce its cost by 1.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Discard 1 to create a multi-region follower in hand and reduce its cost by 1.
cards.flavor: "Painting's not about copying what you see, it's about expressing how YOU see the world. And right now, I'm seeing that you moved again. Hold still please!"

cards.name: Furious Faefolk
cards.text: When I'm summoned, if you've dealt damage to the enemy Nexus 4+ times this game, grant me 4 Impact.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, if you've dealt damage to the enemy Nexus 4+ times this game, grant me 4 <link=keyword.Impact><sprite name=Impact><style=Keyword>Impact</style></link>. <style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor: Chewy outside, tough and gritty center.

cards.name: Mirror Mage
cards.text: When you play a created follower, summon an exact copy. When you play a created spell, copy it with the same targets.
cards.textHtml: When you play a created follower, summon an exact copy. When you play a created spell, copy it with the same targets.
cards.flavor: "Oh yes, she's quite the mirror master. She makes my designs look even more sublime, and with a small trick of the light, even manages to lend a certain someone a touch of much needed verticality..." - Stilted Robemaker

cards.name: Aloof Travelers
cards.text: When I’m summoned, ALL players draw 1, then your opponent discards their highest cost card.
cards.textHtml: When I’m summoned, ALL players draw 1, then your opponent discards their highest cost card.
cards.flavor: "Worst. Trip. Ever." - Elle

cards.name: Ember Monk
cards.text: When you summon another ally, grant me +1|+0.
cards.textHtml: When you summon another ally, grant me +1|+0.
cards.flavor: "Small sparks become a raging blaze. We are the embers of your destruction!"

cards.name: Proto Poro
cards.flavor: The poros of yesteryear had much thicker heads than their contemporary kin, making them a little bit dumber, and a whole lot headbuttier.

cards.name: Gnar
cards.text: Strike: Create a Pokey Stick in hand or, if you have one, reduce its cost by 2.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>Strike</style></link>: Create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Pokey Stick</style></link> in hand or, if you have one, reduce its cost by 2.
cards.levelup: Round End: You've damaged the enemy Nexus this round.
cards.flavor: Long ago, Gnar and his kin thrived in the Nakotak Valley. It was an innocent place, untouched by modern trappings. How unfortunate that the passing of time took this place from Gnar. But how fortunate that time doesn't exactly function as expected in Bandle City.

cards.name: Mega Gnar
cards.text:
When I level up, grant the strongest enemy Vulnerable.
Round End: If I've seen you start the round with the attack token, transform me back into Gnar.
cards.textHtml:
When I level up, grant the <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> enemy <link=keyword.Vulnerable><sprite name=Vulnerable><style=Keyword>Vulnerable</style></link>.
<link=vocab.RoundEnd><style=Vocab>Round End</style></link>: If I've seen you start the round with the attack token, transform me back into <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Gnar</style></link>.
cards.flavor: The yordles sat on their tree branch and cheered for Gnar as he duked it out with another passing monster. These were rare events, but always awesome to spectate!

cards.name: Gnar's Wallop
cards.text:
Deal 1 to an enemy and Stun it. 
Create a Gnar in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
Deal 1 to an enemy and <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> it. 
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Gnar</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "Ahanga!" - Gnar

cards.name: Chief Nakotak
cards.text: When an ally transforms, fully heal it and grant it +1|+1 and Impact.
cards.textHtml: When an ally transforms, fully heal it and grant it +1|+1 and <link=keyword.Impact><sprite name=Impact><style=Keyword>Impact</style></link>.
cards.flavor: Chief Nakotak declared himself leader of the tribe after finding a large dinosaur bone in the snowdrifts surrounding their lands. None of the others were aware that dinosaur bones equated to tribe leadership, but also none of the others were really all that bothered. So Nakotak it was.

cards.name: Ziggs
cards.text: Attack: I deal 1 damage to my blocker and the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.AttackSkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Attack</style></link>: I deal 1 damage to my blocker and the enemy Nexus.
cards.levelup: You've destroyed 4+ allied landmarks.
cards.flavor:
"It's IMPORTANT we make a good impression. The new safety inspector is stopping by, and you know what that means!"
"No more explosions?"
"WHAT?! No! It means explode things where he can't see 'em! 'No more explosions'... are you crazy?!" - Ziggs and Otto

cards.name: Ziggs
cards.text:
Attack: I deal 2 damage to my blocker and the enemy Nexus.
When you destroy an allied landmark, deal 2 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml:
<link=keyword.AttackSkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Attack</style></link>: I deal 2 damage to my blocker and the enemy Nexus.
When you destroy an allied landmark, deal 2 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor:
"We passed?! WE PASSED!"
"Heh, well, 'passed' is a strong word... but hoo-wee, if you didn't put on a heck of a show!" - Ziggs and Wilfred, Safety Inspector

cards.name: Ziggs' Bouncing Bomb
cards.text:
Deal 2 to a unit or deal 1 to two enemies.
Create a Ziggs in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
Deal 2 to a unit or deal 1 to two enemies.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Ziggs</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "Fire in the hole!" - Ziggs

cards.name: Short Fuse
cards.text: Deal 1 to Ziggs' blocker and to the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml: Deal 1 to <link=card.parentRef><style=AssociatedCard>Ziggs</style></link>' blocker and to the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: "Boom!" - Ziggs

cards.name: Short Fuse
cards.text: Deal 2 to Ziggs' blocker and the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml: Deal 2 to <link=card.parentRef><style=AssociatedCard>Ziggs</style></link>' blocker and the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: "Boom!" - Ziggs

cards.name: Ziggs' Bouncing Bomb
cards.text:
Deal 1 to two enemies.
Create a Ziggs in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
Deal 1 to two enemies.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Ziggs</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "Fire in the hole!" - Ziggs

cards.name: Ziggs' Bouncing Bomb
cards.text:
Deal 2 to a unit.
Create a Ziggs in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
Deal 2 to a unit.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Ziggs</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "Fire in the hole!" - Ziggs

cards.name: Poison Dart
cards.text: Deal 1 to anything and plant 3 Poison Puffcaps in the enemy deck.
cards.textHtml: Deal 1 to anything and plant 3 <link=card.shuffle><style=AssociatedCard>Poison Puffcaps</style></link> in the enemy deck.
cards.flavor: "Haha! Bullseye!" - Teemo

cards.name: Pokey Stick
cards.text: Deal 1 to anything. Draw 1.
cards.textHtml: Deal 1 to anything. Draw 1.
cards.flavor: The first rule of experimentation: poke it, and see what happens.

cards.name: Bandle Commando
cards.text: Nexus Strike: Create a Hungry Owlcat in hand.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.NexusStrike><style=Vocab>Nexus Strike</style></link>: Create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Hungry Owlcat</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: "Gunnin' in the streets and tuckin' kiddos into sheets!"

cards.name: Hungry Owlcat
cards.flavor:
"...But one day he arrived, empty-handed,
And one by one, the greedy birds landed.
They pecked and scratched and mauled
'Til there was nothing left of him at all!"
- Bandle City tall tale

cards.name: Spotted Toad
cards.text: Round End: If you've damaged the enemy Nexus this round, transform me into Giga Gromp.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.RoundEnd><style=Vocab>Round End</style></link>: If you've damaged the enemy Nexus this round, transform me into <link=card.transform><style=AssociatedCard>Giga Gromp</style></link>.
cards.flavor: The yordles of Nakotak Valley had tried for several generations to understand their gromp neighbors. First, Chief Hegabo had tried poking them with a stick. Next, Chief Babobu tried poking them with a stick. Chief Nakotak had a brand new plan: he was going to poke them with a stick.

cards.name: Giga Gromp
cards.text: When I transform, deal 1 to all enemies.
cards.textHtml: When I transform, deal 1 to all enemies.
cards.flavor: So, it turns out that poking Nakotak Valley gromps with a stick causes them to react very... expansively! If only those yordles had known this through extensive, generational testing. If. Only.

cards.name: Shadowtech Walker
cards.flavor: Now you see him. Now you don't. And now you're dead.

cards.name: Furyhorn Crasher
cards.text: Attack: Grant the top 3 allies in your deck +1|+1.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Grant the top 3 allies in your deck +1|+1.
cards.flavor: Mess with the mech, you get the horns.

cards.name: Geode Mechaforcer
cards.text: Support: Give my supported ally SpellShield and +2|+2 this round.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Support><style=Keyword>Support</style></link>: Give my supported ally <link=keyword.SpellShield><sprite name=SpellShield><style=Keyword>SpellShield</style></link> and +2|+2 this round.
cards.flavor: Powered by gems mined from the caves beneath Bandle City, the Mechaforcer emits a defensive shield that can withstand even the strongest of weapons. It's pretty to look at too.

cards.name: Professor Von Mech
cards.text: When I'm summoned, create a random 1, 2, and 3 cost follower in hand.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, create a random 1, 2, and 3 cost follower in hand.
cards.flavor: "Somebody get these freakin' hairballs off my desk!" - Karl, Arena Kingpin

cards.name: Salty Spinner
cards.text: When I'm summoned or Round Start: Grant me +0|+2 for each card you discarded last round, then shuffle my stats.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned or <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Grant me +0|+2 for each card you discarded last round, then shuffle my stats. <style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor: For obvious reasons, "paddlemarpower" never really took off as a unit of measurement.

cards.name: Friendship!
cards.text: Give an ally Barrier or SpellShield this round.
cards.textHtml: Give an ally <link=keyword.Barrier><sprite name=Barrier><style=Keyword>Barrier</style></link> or <link=keyword.SpellShield><sprite name=SpellShield><style=Keyword>SpellShield</style></link> this round.
cards.flavor: "I'll protect you with my wild and furious... meow!" - Yuumi

cards.name: Best Buddies
cards.text: Give an ally Barrier this round.
cards.textHtml: Give an ally <link=keyword.Barrier><sprite name=Barrier><style=Keyword>Barrier</style></link> this round.
cards.flavor: "Look, Book! Friends!" - Yuumi

cards.name: Best Pals
cards.text: Give an ally SpellShield this round.
cards.textHtml: Give an ally <link=keyword.SpellShield><sprite name=SpellShield><style=Keyword>SpellShield</style></link> this round.
cards.flavor: "When my friends are happy, I'M happy!" - Yuumi

cards.name: Loping Telescope
cards.text: Play: Manifest a Celestial that costs 3 or less, Epic, or multi-region follower.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: <link=vocab.Manifest><style=Vocab>Manifest</style></link> a Celestial that costs 3 or less, Epic, or multi-region follower.
cards.flavor: The strangest part wasn't that the telescope got up, stretched, and started walking around, but that it insisted on dressing for the weather, so it had to find a suitably comfortable scarf.

cards.name: Prowling Projectile
cards.text: Grant an ally +1|+0. Deal 1 to an enemy.
cards.textHtml: Grant an ally +1|+0. Deal 1 to an enemy.
cards.flavor: "Zoooooom!" - Yuumi

cards.name: Papercraft Dragon
cards.flavor:
"One more fold, and see? This one is a giraffe! His name is Socks." 
"Why 'Socks'?" 
"Norra loves socks, so she'll love him, too!" - Mouse stewards

cards.name: Papercraft Dragon
cards.text: Attach me to an ally to give it my stats and keywords while I'm Attached. When that ally leaves play, Recall me.
cards.textHtml: Attach me to an ally to give it my stats and keywords while I'm <link=keyword.Attach><sprite name=Attach><style=Keyword>Attached</style></link>. When that ally leaves play, <link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recall</style></link> me.
cards.flavor: "Help out a friend, won'tcha, little guy?" - Yuumi

cards.name: Papercraft Dragon
cards.flavor:
"One more fold, and see? This one is a giraffe! His name is Socks." 
"Why 'Socks'?" 
"Norra loves socks, so she'll love him, too!" - Mouse stewards

cards.name: Yordle Ranger
cards.text: Attack: Grant allies with equal or less power than me +0|+1.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Grant allies with equal or less power than me +0|+1.
cards.flavor:
"Poppy! Excellent execution of our latest tactic. What do you think of calling it 'Peanut Petalstorm'?"
"I, uh, kinda just hit the baddie with my hammer. Can't we just call this one 'Hammer'?"
"That's what we called the last three!" - Kip and Poppy

cards.name: Quicken
cards.text: Recall a unit with 3 or less Power.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recall</style></link> a unit with 3 or less Power.
cards.flavor: "We are quick! We are the wind!" - Kennen

cards.name: Cloud Stance
cards.text: Give an ally +2|+0 and "Round End: Recall me" this round.
cards.textHtml: Give an ally +2|+0 and "<link=vocab.RoundEnd><style=Vocab>Round End</style></link>: Recall me" this round.
cards.flavor: "Return to breath, and find your strength!" - Gust Monk

cards.name: Lightning Rush
cards.text: Recall an ally to deal 2 to anything.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recall</style></link> an ally to deal 2 to anything.
cards.flavor: "First the crack, then the boom!" - Kennen

cards.name: Grandfather Fae
cards.text:
When I'm summoned, create a Hungry Owlcat in hand.
When you summon another Fae, grant it +1|+0.
cards.textHtml:
When I'm summoned, create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Hungry Owlcat</style></link> in hand.
When you summon another Fae, grant it +1|+0.
cards.flavor:
"Gather 'round, hear what I say,
The sad tale of Grandfather Fae.
Each day he'd feed the hungry birds,
An odd mixture of seed and curds..."
- Bandle City Tall Tale

cards.name: Babbling Balladeers
cards.text: When I'm summoned, create a Hungry Owlcat in hand.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Hungry Owlcat</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor:
"This is a song
About Poppy the strong!
Poppy the mightiest, frightiest... sprong!" 
- Scratched-out lyrics from the 'Songbook of Reginaldactyl and Faltimisquee, Bards Extraordinaire'

cards.name: Shell Game
cards.text: Refill your spell mana. Give an ally Elusive and +1|+1 this round.
cards.textHtml: Refill your spell mana. Give an ally <link=keyword.Elusive><sprite name=Elusive><style=Keyword>Elusive</style></link> and +1|+1 this round.
cards.flavor:
"I SEE them enter the left shell, yet when I CHOOSE that shell, it's empty. I'm beginning to suspect this game might be rigged..."
- Conchologist Ecological Entry, Day 14

cards.name: Curious Shellfolk
cards.text: When you pick a non-champion card from randomly selected options, create a copy in hand and reduce its cost by 1.
cards.textHtml: When you pick a non-champion card from randomly selected options, create a copy in hand and reduce its cost by 1.
cards.flavor: Famously shy, the elusive shellfolk are known to hide in their shells until their curiosity gets the better of them. Once emerged, their playful personalities become fully engaged, including a propensity to play tricks by expertly mimicking the sound of other sea life.

cards.name: Arena Mechacaster
cards.text: Attack: Give other attacking allies +2|+0 this round.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Give other attacking allies +2|+0 this round.
cards.flavor: "How do I do it? Screamin' matches night after night? Gargle engine oil. Five minutes in the mornin', five at night."

cards.name: Keeper's Verdict
cards.text: Place an enemy unit on top of the enemy deck.
cards.textHtml: Place an enemy unit on top of the enemy deck.
cards.flavor: "And don't come back!" - Poppy

cards.name: Bomber Twins
cards.text: When I'm summoned, create a random landmark that costs 2 or less in hand.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, create a random landmark that costs 2 or less in hand.
cards.flavor: The Fussyfoot Bomberator-X did precisely what it was meant to do: sow chaos. Plus, it was easy to parallel park.

cards.name: The Bandle Tree
cards.text: Round Start: Create a follower from a new region in hand. Then, if I've seen allies from 10 regions, win the game.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Create a follower from a new region in hand. Then, if I've seen allies from 10 regions, win the game. <style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor: Stretching an unknowable distance into the heavens above, The Bandle Tree is an impossible fixture at the heart of the city. Under its great, gnarled branches, some yordles see a beacon of hope and friendship while others see an ominous, riddle-filled monolith. All agree that to gaze upon the Bandle Tree is to glance into the soul of something very old and very powerful.

cards.name: Prank
cards.text: Pick 1 of 2 non-champion cards from the enemy hand or deck and Prank it.
cards.textHtml: Pick 1 of 2 non-champion cards from the enemy hand or deck and Prank it.
cards.flavor: "Gotcha!" - Fizz

cards.name: Dunehopper Mech
cards.text: Attack: Summon 2 attacking Sand Soldiers.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Summon 2 attacking <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Sand Soldiers</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "Ya see? It gets everywhere! I DON'T LIKE SAND! The cleanup's gonna cost me a fortune!" - Karl, Arena Kingpin

cards.name: Group Shot
cards.text: Deal 1 to a unit. If you have 4+ allies, deal 2 instead.
cards.textHtml: Deal 1 to a unit. If you have 4+ allies, deal 2 instead.
cards.flavor: "Okay, this one's for the newsletter. And remember to smile this time! One... two... three...!" - Tristana

cards.name: Yordle Portal
cards.text: To play, discard 1. Manifest a Yordle that costs 3 or less and summon it.
cards.textHtml: To play, discard 1. <link=vocab.Manifest><style=Vocab>Manifest</style></link> a Yordle that costs 3 or less and summon it.
cards.flavor: "Never leave a gunner behind!" - Tristana

cards.name: Tristana's Buster Shot
cards.text:
I cost 2 less if you have a Tristana or if you've played cards from 4+ regions this game.
Deal 3 to a unit.
Create a Tristana in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
I cost 2 less if you have a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Tristana</style></link> or if you've played cards from 4+ regions this game.
Deal 3 to a unit.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Tristana</style></link> in your deck. <style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor: In every ka-blam there's a ka-boom waiting to be born.

cards.name: Event Horizon
cards.text: Stun an enemy and stun all enemies with 2 or less Power.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> an enemy and stun all enemies with 2 or less Power.
cards.flavor: "Just... stay right there..." - Veigar

cards.name: Heroic Charge
cards.text: An ally strikes an enemy. If it survives, Stun it.
cards.textHtml: An ally <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strikes</style></link> an enemy. If it survives, <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> it.
cards.flavor: "Move it!" - Poppy

cards.name: Stress Defense
cards.text: Set a unit's stats to 1|6 this round.
cards.textHtml: Set a unit's stats to 1|6 this round.
cards.flavor: The Bawkatrice is a loyal, steadfast mount under normal circumstances. However, when put under too much stress they are known to react in... unusual ways.

cards.name: Flamespitter
cards.text: Grant an ally +2|+0 and Impact.
cards.textHtml: Grant an ally +2|+0 and <link=keyword.Impact><sprite name=Impact><style=Keyword>Impact</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "If they ain't howlin', it ain't hot enough! Heh heh." - Rumble

cards.name: Safety Inspector
cards.text: Round Start: Create a Inspection Passed! in hand.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Inspection Passed!</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: Wilfred was originally skeptical. He was skeptical throughout, too. In fact, he was skeptical 'til the very end - but Ziggs and the other hexplosive experts proved they knew how to put on a real humdinger of a fireworks show.

cards.name: Inspection Passed!
cards.text: Destroy an allied landmark to deal 3 to anything.
cards.textHtml: Destroy an allied landmark to deal 3 to anything.
cards.flavor: "... turns out, HE was a huge hexplosives fan, too!" - Ziggs

cards.name: Wallop
cards.text: Deal 1 to an enemy and Stun it.
cards.textHtml: Deal 1 to an enemy and <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> it.
cards.flavor: "Ahanga!" - Gnar

cards.name: Mega Inferno Bomb
cards.text: Deal 1 to all enemies, then do it again.
cards.textHtml: Deal 1 to all enemies, then do it again.
cards.flavor: "Bring out... 'The Big One'!" - Ziggs

cards.name: Yordle Contraption
cards.text: Destroy a landmark or create 2 random multi-region followers in hand.
cards.textHtml: Destroy a landmark or create 2 random multi-region followers in hand.
cards.flavor: "Hang on - we're rollin'!" - Bomber Twins

cards.name: Yordle Contraption
cards.text: Create 2 random multi-region followers in hand.
cards.textHtml: Create 2 random multi-region followers in hand.
cards.flavor: "Hang on - we're rollin'!" - Bomber Twins

cards.name: Yordle Contraption
cards.text: Destroy a landmark.
cards.textHtml: Destroy a landmark.
cards.flavor: "Hang on - we're rollin'!" - Bomber Twins

cards.name: Fae Sprout
cards.text: Manifest a Fae and grant it +1|+1.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Manifest><style=Vocab>Manifest</style></link> a Fae and grant it +1|+1.
cards.flavor: Every living thing requires sustenance. The fae are no different, though it can be hard to tell how exactly they use it.

cards.name: Fae Aid
cards.text: Create a Hungry Owlcat in hand, then grant Fae allies in hand +1|+1.
cards.textHtml: Create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Hungry Owlcat</style></link> in hand, then grant Fae allies in hand +1|+1.
cards.flavor: "Who keeps feeding these things?" - Poppy

cards.name: Mushroom Ring
cards.text: When I'm summoned or Round Start: Give me Power this round equal to the number of other Fae allies in play or Attached.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned or <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Give me Power this round equal to the number of other Fae allies in play or <link=keyword.Attach><sprite name=Attach><style=Keyword>Attached</style></link>.
cards.flavor: The little pinheads are rather cute, and by themselves, have mushroom to grow.

cards.name: Entrapment
cards.text: Pick 1 of 3 units or spells from the enemy deck and plant 3 Poison Puffcaps on all copies of it.
cards.textHtml: Pick 1 of 3 units or spells from the enemy deck and plant 3 <link=card.puffcap><style=AssociatedCard>Poison Puffcaps</style></link> on all copies of it.
cards.flavor: "Rule 986: Traps are NOT toys... but they sure are fun!"

cards.name: Entrapment
cards.text: Pick 1 of 3 units from the enemy deck and plant 3 Poison Puffcaps on all copies of it.
cards.textHtml: Pick 1 of 3 units from the enemy deck and plant 3 <link=card.puffcap><style=AssociatedCard>Poison Puffcaps</style></link> on all copies of it.
cards.flavor: "Rule 986: Traps are NOT toys... but they sure are fun!"

cards.name: Entrapment
cards.text: Pick 1 of 3 spells from the enemy deck and plant 3 Poison Puffcaps on all copies of it.
cards.textHtml: Pick 1 of 3 spells from the enemy deck and plant 3 <link=card.puffcap><style=AssociatedCard>Poison Puffcaps</style></link> on all copies of it.
cards.flavor: "Rule 986: Traps are NOT toys... but they sure are fun!"

cards.name: Transposition
cards.text: Recall an ally. The next ally you play this round with equal or less cost, costs 0 instead.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recall</style></link> an ally. The next ally you play this round with equal or less cost, costs 0 instead.
cards.flavor: "Speed of body, speed of mind!" - Kennen

cards.name: Spirit Portal
cards.text: To play, discard 1. Grant allies +1|+1.
cards.textHtml: To play, discard 1. Grant allies +1|+1.
cards.flavor: "I can never remember how these things work." - Poppy

cards.name: Yordle Smith
