cards.text: Attack: Give allies with equal or less power than me Quick Attack this round.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Give allies with equal or less power than me <link=keyword.Quick Strike><sprite name=QuickStrike><style=Keyword>Quick Attack</style></link> this round.
cards.flavor: "Poppy never listens t'me, so you better: It's not about the hammer, it's about the yordle who swings it."

cards.name: Marai Warden
cards.text: When I'm summoned, summon a random 1 cost follower.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, summon a random 1 cost follower.
cards.flavor: The Marai rarely desire to venture far from home. But Ai'la was born with curiosity in her heart--and though she is bound by duty to her tribe, she spends each waking moment dreaming of the day she can truly be free.

cards.name: Journeying Sandhopper
cards.flavor: "Sure, a few of 'em hunt us, like they hunt everything. But y'know, most landwalkers I meet are just looking to enjoy their time in the big blue, same as us. We're all just people."

cards.name: Tidal Wave
cards.text: Deal 1 to two different randomly targeted enemies and create a Crashing Wave in your deck.
cards.textHtml: Deal 1 to two different randomly targeted enemies and create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Crashing Wave</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "Oceans spill forth!" - Nami

cards.name: Crashing Wave
cards.text: Deal 2 to four different randomly targeted enemies and create a Colossal Wave in your deck.
cards.textHtml: Deal 2 to four different randomly targeted enemies and create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Colossal Wave</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "Roiling seas engulf them!" - Nami

cards.name: Colossal Wave
cards.text: Deal 4 to all enemies and the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml: Deal 4 to all enemies and the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: "Rolling tides, heed my call!" - Nami

cards.name: Avatar of the Tides
cards.text:
If you would get a mana gem, instead refill your spell mana.
When you play a spell, create in hand a random spell that costs 3 or less and grant it Fleeting.
cards.textHtml:
If you would get a mana gem, instead refill your spell mana.
When you play a spell, create in hand a random spell that costs 3 or less and grant it <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link>.
cards.flavor: To the Marai, the Leo'lei is a herald of great change. It is said each flourish of its graceful wings influences the flow of the tides.

cards.name: Nami
cards.text: When you play a spell, grant +1|+0 to the weakest other ally that isn't Immobile.
cards.textHtml: When you play a spell, grant +1|+0 to the <link=keyword.Weakest><style=Keyword>weakest</style></link> other ally that isn't <link=keyword.Immobile><sprite name=Immobile><sprite name=Reckless><style=Keyword>Immobile</style></link>.
cards.levelup: You've played 5+ spells with an allied Nami in play.
cards.flavor:
"Have you said your goodbyes, young Tidecaller?"
"Yes, greatmother."
"Are you afraid?"
"...Yes, greatmother."
"Good. To be afraid is to be cautious. But trust yourself, as we trust you. Now, go. And may the currents keep you."

cards.name: Nami
cards.text: When you play a spell, grant +2|+1 to the weakest other ally that isn't Immobile.
cards.textHtml: When you play a spell, grant +2|+1 to the <link=keyword.Weakest><style=Keyword>weakest</style></link> other ally that isn't <link=keyword.Immobile><sprite name=Immobile><sprite name=Reckless><style=Keyword>Immobile</style></link>.
cards.flavor:
"Do you think she's far along in her journey?"
"We can only hope, Tama."
"I can see her now... Beautiful eyes glowing in the light of the moon, the shine of saltwater glistening on her scales."
"This burden... the fate of our people. It should not be hers alone."
"She is doing her part, as we are doing ours, Loto. All we can do is believe in her, and love her with all our hearts."

cards.name: Nami's Ebb
cards.text:
Deal 2 randomly to an enemy or the enemy Nexus and create a Flow in hand.
Create a Nami in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
Deal 2 randomly to an enemy or the enemy Nexus and create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Flow</style></link> in hand.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Nami</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "Heed the tide's temper..." - Nami

cards.name: Ebb
cards.text: Deal 2 randomly to an enemy or the enemy Nexus and create a Flow in hand.
cards.textHtml: Deal 2 randomly to an enemy or the enemy Nexus and create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Flow</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: "Heed the tide's temper..." - Nami

cards.name: Ebb and Flow
cards.text: Deal 2 randomly to an enemy or the enemy Nexus and heal an ally or your Nexus 2.
cards.textHtml: Deal 2 randomly to an enemy or the enemy Nexus and heal an ally or your Nexus 2.
cards.flavor: "I decide what the tide will bring." - Nami

cards.name: Flow
cards.text: Heal an ally or your Nexus 2, and create an Ebb and Flow in hand.
cards.textHtml: Heal an ally or your Nexus 2, and create an <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Ebb and Flow</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: "...And cherish the swell's calm." - Nami

cards.name: Abyssal Guard
cards.text: When you play a spell, give me +2|+0 this round.
cards.textHtml: When you play a spell, give me +2|+0 this round.
cards.flavor: "Many of our tribe find Loto somewhat unnerving. They see only a tireless fighter, and the distance in his troubled gaze. But I know what's truly in his heart--fear that he is not strong enough to save us... and extraordinary love." - Tama, Marai Songstress

cards.name: Marai Greatmother
cards.text: When I'm summoned, create in deck 5 random 6+ cost spells and reduce their costs to 3.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, create in deck 5 random 6+ cost spells and reduce their costs to 3.
cards.flavor: The Marai's ancestral home is protected by the celestial light of a moonstone. Every hundred years, its light begins to wane, and a new Tidecaller is tasked with finding another--for without it, the Marai people would be plunged into darkness, and fall prey to the horrors that lurk in the depths.

cards.name: Fleet Admiral Shelly
cards.text: When you play 2 spells each round, grant other allies +1|+1.
cards.textHtml: When you play 2 spells each round, grant other allies +1|+1. <style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor: "LISTEN HERE, SOWDIER. I'LL HAVE YOU KNOW I HAVE OVA FWEE-HUNDWED CONFIRMED KWILLS AND I'M DA TOP ADMIWAL IN ALL DA MAWINE'S FORCES SO WHEN I SAY SWIM, YOU BETTA SWIM, OKAY? OKAY THANK YOU!"

cards.name: Marai Songstress
cards.text: When I'm summoned, if you've played a spell this round, grant me Elusive.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, if you've played a spell this round, grant me <link=keyword.Elusive><sprite name=Elusive><style=Keyword>Elusive</style></link>.
cards.flavor:
"The ocean believes that the wave will return,
gives trust to the ebb, to the flow, to the churn.
So 'ere the wave crashes against the shore, 
the ocean delights in the crest's bold roar."
- A verse from 'Serenade for the Tidecaller'

cards.name: Gorlith the Unscalable
cards.text:
Play: Swap my Health and your Nexus' Health. 
I can't be blocked by enemies with less Health than me.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Swap my Health and your Nexus' Health. 
I can't be blocked by enemies with less Health than me.
cards.flavor:
"An honorable tribute to those gone, but never forgotten: When the people of Demacia see the sun's rays shining off his form, they will know hope, and the indomitable spirit that inspired his construction will live on through him." 
- Durand workshop plaque

cards.name: Galio
cards.text: When I'm summoned, grant other allies +0|+3.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, grant other allies +0|+3.
cards.levelup: Round End: Your allies have 25+ total Health.
cards.flavor: For many years after his creation, Galio lay dormant, unfeeling, unknowing. It wasn't until magic brought him to life and he experienced the resulting thrill of battle that he knew the joy of being among the living. Now, when he slept, he missed such wonderful things!

cards.name: Galio
cards.text:
When I'm summoned, grant other allies +0|+3. 
Each round, the first time an ally takes damage, Rally.
cards.textHtml:
When I'm summoned, grant other allies +0|+3. 
Each round, the first time an ally takes damage, <link=vocab.Rally><style=Vocab>Rally</style></link>.
cards.flavor: When he awoke, Galio was overjoyed to find a whole family had been crafted for him, a facsimile of the same family that would carry on the legacy of his maker for years to come. They were just like him - they wouldn't break.

cards.name: Galio's Shield of Durand
cards.text: Grant an ally +0|+3. At the next Round Start, grant it +0|+2. Create a Galio in your deck.
cards.textHtml: Grant an ally +0|+3. At the next <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>, grant it +0|+2. Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Galio</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: Even the sight of Galio is enough to inspire the noble hearts of Demacians.

cards.name: Durand Sculptor
cards.text: When you summon another ally, grant it +0|+1.
cards.textHtml: When you summon another ally, grant it +0|+1.
cards.flavor: "It may not be evident to the untrained, but the work of a great artist is in one chip of the chisel to the next."

cards.name: Petricite Broadwing
cards.text: When you summon another ally, grant me Challenger.
cards.textHtml: When you summon another ally, grant me <link=keyword.Challenger><sprite name=Challenger><style=Keyword>Challenger</style></link>.
cards.flavor: As the Broadwing passed overhead, the battered Demacian soldiers below let out a cheer, inspired by its enduring form.

cards.name: Petricite Stag
cards.text: Support: I take all damage for my supported ally this round.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Support><style=Keyword>Support</style></link>: I take all damage for my supported ally this round.
cards.flavor: Following the stag-mounted Ranger's lead, the petricite guardian dwarfed the very creature that had inspired its elegant design.

cards.name: Durand Protege
cards.text: Play: Grant an ally +0|+1 and Tough.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Grant an ally +0|+1 and <link=keyword.Tough><sprite name=Tough><style=Keyword>Tough</style></link>.
cards.flavor: Shireen looked up from her work at the sound of pounding hoofbeats. The ranger's haste left her uneasy, but curious. She urged her petricite bird to take flight, and followed in the ranger's wake.

cards.name: Mountain Drake
cards.text: Fury grants me +0|+2 instead of +1|+1.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Fury><sprite name=Fury><style=Keyword>Fury</style></link> grants me +0|+2 instead of +1|+1.
cards.flavor: The placid mountain drakes are slow to anger despite their appearance, and their stoicism around other mountain beasts makes them natural protectors of otherwise vulnerable flocks.

cards.name: Winds of War
cards.text: Fully heal an ally. Then, that ally and an enemy strike each other.
cards.textHtml: Fully heal an ally. Then, that ally and an enemy <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strike</style></link> each other.
cards.flavor: "Let's crack on, then!" - Galio

cards.name: Petricite Hound
cards.flavor: "It's always a joy to see them come to life. You forget how distinct each is, their personalities reflections of the artist who made them." - Durand Sculptor

cards.name: Durand Architect
cards.text: Support: Give my supported ally +0|+2 and Formidable this round.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Support><style=Keyword>Support</style></link>: Give my supported ally +0|+2 and <link=keyword.Formidable><sprite name=Formidable><style=Keyword>Formidable</style></link> this round.
cards.flavor: "The Ranger Elmheart has brought us grim news," the architect said calmly, focusing on rerolling the parchment to hide how his hands shook. He turned to the waiting sculptors and gave them a stiff nod. "It seems the time has come for Demacia's unseen protectors to come out of hiding."

cards.name: Shield of Durand
cards.text: Grant an ally +0|+3. At the next Round Start, grant it +0|+2.
cards.textHtml: Grant an ally +0|+3. At the next <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>, grant it +0|+2.
cards.flavor: Even the sight of Galio is enough to inspire the noble hearts of Demacians.

cards.name: Might of the Vanguard
cards.text: To play, spend all of your mana. Summon a Dauntless Vanguard and grow its stats to that amount. If 9+ mana was spent, grant other Elite allies +2|+2.
cards.textHtml: To play, spend all of your mana. Summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Dauntless Vanguard</style></link> and grow its stats to that amount. If 9+ mana was spent, grant other Elite allies +2|+2.
cards.flavor: When it seems all hope is lost, the soldiers of Demacia look to the Vanguard.

cards.name: Murkwolf Shaman
cards.text: Round End: If you've damaged the enemy Nexus this round, transform me into Murkwolf Rager.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.RoundEnd><style=Vocab>Round End</style></link>: If you've damaged the enemy Nexus this round, transform me into <link=card.transform><style=AssociatedCard>Murkwolf Rager</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "We do not die as cowards! Instead, we fall with claws drawn and teeth bared. In doing so, we honor The Wolf." - Hyara Allseer

cards.name: Murkwolf Rager
cards.text: When I transform, draw a unit.
cards.textHtml: When I transform, draw a unit.
cards.flavor: A shaman of the Murkwolf never truly dies alone. In death, they are joined by the spirits of other fallen shaman and begin their journey through the Great Beyond as a new pack.

cards.name: Mammoth Shaman
cards.text: Round End: If you've damaged the enemy Nexus this round, transform me into Mammoth Rager.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.RoundEnd><style=Vocab>Round End</style></link>: If you've damaged the enemy Nexus this round, transform me into <link=card.transform><style=AssociatedCard>Mammoth Rager</style></link>.
cards.flavor: When faced with predators, mammoth herds will surround their young calves and pregnant cows. And so the shamans of the great mammoth spirit call not just upon their spirit's physical strength but also upon the strength of unity with which it protects its family.

cards.name: Mammoth Rager
cards.text: Round Start: Grant me +2|+2.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Grant me +2|+2.
cards.flavor: Few Freljodian beasts are as fearsome as a mammoth protecting its herd.

cards.name: Vulpine Wanderer
cards.text: When I'm summoned, create a Stance Swap in hand.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Stance Swap</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: "Eager and cautious. Quick and quiet. The way of the fox is the joy of seeing but not being seen. In travel and war, a wise leader honors those who follow the fox spirit. For no battle is won without pathfinders and scouts." - Scarmother Vrynna

cards.name: Bone Scryer
cards.text: When I survive damage, deal 1 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml: When I survive damage, deal 1 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: Few scry the future as well as the shamans serving the Elk of Bones. Fewer still can stomach seeing the looming death of any who come seeking their foresight.

cards.name: Tusk Speaker
cards.text: Play: Deal 1 to EACH Nexus.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.PlaySkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Play</style></link>: Deal 1 to EACH Nexus.
cards.flavor: Few shaman families have served the Winter's Claw tribe as long as Chuluun's. As a shaman of great walrus, he heralds and portends the sea's bounty... and its dangers.

cards.name: Dance of Tusks
cards.text: Deal 1 to EACH Nexus.
cards.textHtml: Deal 1 to EACH Nexus.
cards.flavor: "Many songs can touch your heart. My songs shake the heavens." - Chuluun

cards.name: Stance Swap
cards.text: Grant a Stance to an ally.
cards.textHtml: Grant a Stance to an ally.
cards.flavor: "Spirits, I call upon you!" - Udyr

cards.name: Wildclaw Stance
cards.text: Grant an ally +2|+0 and Overwhelm.
cards.textHtml: Grant an ally +2|+0 and <link=keyword.Overwhelm><sprite name=Overwhelm><style=Keyword>Overwhelm</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "Claws and TEETH!" - Udyr

cards.name: Bear Stance
cards.text: Grant an ally +2|+2.
cards.textHtml: Grant an ally +2|+2.
cards.flavor: "The Great Bear is indomitable, and in taking it's blessing, we shall know no fear... or mercy." - Hyara Allseer

cards.name: Boar Stance
cards.text: Grant an ally +0|+2 and Regeneration.
cards.textHtml: Grant an ally +0|+2 and <link=keyword.Regeneration><sprite name=Regeneration><style=Keyword>Regeneration</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "It is not the absence of pain I seek. It is the tenacity to fight through it." - Hyara Allseer

cards.name: Ram Stance
cards.text: Pick an ally. Deal 1 to EVERYTHING else.
cards.textHtml: Pick an ally. Deal 1 to EVERYTHING else.
cards.flavor: "Against the freezing night you warm us. Against our foes you bring protective flame... Spirit of fire, AID US!" - Udyr

cards.name: Hyara Allseer
cards.text:
When I'm summoned, create a Stance Swap in hand. 
The first Stance Swap you play each round costs 0.
cards.textHtml:
When I'm summoned, create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Stance Swap</style></link> in hand. 
The first <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Stance Swap</style></link> you play each round costs 0.
cards.flavor: Revered by all, the great shaman, Hyara Allseer, lost her sight long ago and now sees through the eyes of the hawks and eagles that nest on her mountaintop home. Now, troublesome tidings have brought her down from the mountain... she hopes the omens remain but mere visions.

cards.name: Udyr
cards.text: When I'm summoned or strike: Create a Stance Swap in hand or, if you have one, reduce its cost to 0.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned or <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strike</style></link>: Create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Stance Swap</style></link> in hand or, if you have one, reduce its cost to 0.
cards.levelup: You've played Stance Swap 3+ times.
cards.flavor: "The Spirits shape our world just as we and our world shapes the Spirits. By drawing power from them we take power from within ourselves."

cards.name: Udyr
cards.text:
When I'm summoned or strike: Create a Stance Swap in hand or, if you have one, reduce its cost to 0. 
I have +1|+1 for each stance you've played this game.
cards.textHtml:
When I'm summoned or <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strike</style></link>: Create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Stance Swap</style></link> in hand or, if you have one, reduce its cost to 0. 
I have +1|+1 for each stance you've played this game. <style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor: "We are united as one, heart and Spirit! Together, we will drive our foes into the cold, eternal night!"

cards.name: Udyr's Spirits Unleashed
cards.text:
Grant allies everywhere +1|+1. Then deal 1 to EVERYTHING.
Create an Udyr in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
Grant allies everywhere +1|+1. Then deal 1 to EVERYTHING.
Create an <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Udyr</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor:
"Ancient ones, bolster our strength against the encroaching cold, and drive away our foes with storms of wind and ice. For we have not forgotten you or the honors you are due."
- Murkwolf Shaman's Benediction

cards.name: Wrath of the Freljord
cards.text:
Play:Frostbite an enemy.
Enemies with 3 or less Power can't block.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>:<link=keyword.Frostbite><sprite name=Frostbite><style=Keyword>Frostbite</style></link> an enemy.
Enemies with 3 or less Power can't block.
cards.flavor: "I was there, years ago... first came the cold, biting and unrelenting. Then a storm, angry and uncaring. Last came a roar, so sharp it cut me to the bone. I fell to my knees and prayed we hadn't made a grave mistake. To call upon a great spirit is to ask for its vengeance... and its mercy." - Hyara Allseer

cards.name: Spirits Unleashed
cards.text: Grant allies everywhere +1|+1. Then deal 1 to EVERYTHING.
cards.textHtml: Grant allies everywhere +1|+1. Then deal 1 to EVERYTHING.
cards.flavor:
"Ancient ones, bolster our strength against the encroaching cold, and drive away our foes with storms of wind and ice. For we have not forgotten you or the honors you are due."
- Murkwolf Shaman's Prayer

cards.name: Shaman's Call
cards.text: Create 2 Fleeting 0 cost Stance Swaps in hand.
cards.textHtml: Create 2 <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> 0 cost <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Stance Swaps</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: "You will see them... great Spirits of teeth and claw, scale and feather. And in that moment, you will tremble in fear and awe, and you will know that the Old Gods have not forgotten us." - Hyara Allseer

cards.name: Inner Beast
cards.text: Give an ally +1|+1 this round. Create a Stance Swap in hand.
cards.textHtml: Give an ally +1|+1 this round. Create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Stance Swap</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: "Gather, spirits, gather..." - Udyr

cards.name: Woodland Keeper
cards.text: When I’m summoned, give me +1|+0 and Elusive this round.
cards.textHtml: When I’m summoned, give me +1|+0 and <link=keyword.Elusive><sprite name=Elusive><style=Keyword>Elusive</style></link> this round.
cards.flavor: "They say you don't speak to save others from the weight of your knowledge. Hmm... I bet you just got tired of answering questions." - Ahri

cards.name: Memory's Cloak
cards.text: Pick an ally being targeted by enemy Fast spells, Slow spells, or Skills with only 1 allied target. Stop them.
cards.textHtml: Pick an ally being targeted by enemy <link=keyword.Fast><sprite name=Fast><style=Keyword>Fast</style></link> spells, <link=keyword.Slow><sprite name=Slow><style=Keyword>Slow</style></link> spells, or <link=keyword.Skill><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Skills</style></link> with only 1 allied target. Stop them.
cards.flavor: An arrow knows neither the intent of the hunter, nor the worth of its prey.

cards.name: Pathless Ancient
cards.text: I cost 2 less for each unit you've Recalled this round.
cards.textHtml: I cost 2 less for each unit you've <link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recalled</style></link> this round.
cards.flavor:
"Himon'she, it is an honor to travel with you. The others tell me you are wise beyond measure. Where are we heading?"
"Oh dear. I was following you!" - Ahri and the Pathless Ancient

cards.name: Ahri
cards.text: Attack: The first time I attack strike, swap me with the ally to my right, then Recall it.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: The first time I <link=vocab.AttackStrike><style=Vocab>attack strike</style></link>, swap me with the ally to my right, then <link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recall</style></link> it.
cards.levelup: You've Recalled 5+ units.
cards.flavor: She searched for herself in other peoples' secrets. Saw herself through the eyes of so many. As she approached the forest, she wondered if it would be just another lens--or if, just this once, she'd found a mirror.

cards.name: Ahri's Charm
cards.text:
Recall an ally to give an enemy Vulnerable this round.
Create an Ahri in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
<link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recall</style></link> an ally to give an enemy <link=keyword.Vulnerable><sprite name=Vulnerable><style=Keyword>Vulnerable</style></link> this round.
Create an <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Ahri</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "Tell me a secret." - Ahri

cards.name: Ahri
cards.text:
When you Recall an ally, reduce its cost by 1.
Attack: Each time I attack strike, swap me with the ally to my right, then Recall it.
cards.textHtml:
When you <link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recall</style></link> an ally, reduce its cost by 1.
<link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Each time I <link=vocab.AttackStrike><style=Vocab>attack strike</style></link>, swap me with the ally to my right, then <link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recall</style></link> it.
cards.flavor: "I can remember a thousand memories I've never had. From now on, I'll make my own." - Ahri

cards.name: Nine Lives
cards.text: Summon a Liminal Guardian.
cards.textHtml: Summon a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Liminal Guardian</style></link>.
cards.flavor: The forest needed a guardian, someone who could stand sentry at its borders for years, maybe centuries, without moving. Gai'sh was an eager volunteer and promptly proved his dedication with a ten-year nap.

cards.name: Liminal Guardian
cards.text:
When I'm summoned, summon a random 1 cost follower from your regions.
When I'm Recalled, transform me into Nine Lives.
cards.textHtml:
When I'm summoned, summon a random 1 cost follower from your regions.
When I'm <link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recalled</style></link>, transform me into <link=card.cardRef><style=AssociatedCard>Nine Lives</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "My best quality? I sleep like a rock."

cards.name: Sai'nen Thousand-Tailed
cards.text: When I'm summoned, draw 2 and give allies +1|+1 this round.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, draw 2 and give allies +1|+1 this round.
cards.flavor: The forest offers its secrets freely... but few bear the courage to ask questions of it.

cards.name: Windsinger
cards.text: Play: Recall a unit.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Elemental Skill><sprite name=ElementalSkill><style=Keyword>Play</style></link>: <link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recall</style></link> a unit.
cards.flavor: Chaos gives claws to the meek. A wolf hounds its prey and is stalled by a felled branch. A hawk dives and tumbles amidst a sudden gale. We are the branch. We are the wind.

cards.name: Gust
cards.text: Recall a unit.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recall</style></link> a unit.
cards.flavor: The wind moves all, in its own time.

cards.name: God-Willow Seedling
cards.text:
Play: Recall an ally to summon an Ephemeral copy of it.
Countdown 3: Summon another Ephemeral copy of it.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: <link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recall</style></link> an ally to summon an <nobr><link=keyword.Ephemeral><sprite name=Ephemeral><style=Keyword>Ephemeral</style></link> copy of it.</nobr>
<link=vocab.Countdown><style=Vocab>Countdown 3</style></link><style=Variable></style>: Summon another <link=keyword.Ephemeral><sprite name=Ephemeral><style=Keyword>Ephemeral</style></link> <nobr>copy of it.</nobr>
cards.flavor: Once, the God-Willow grew within Omikayalan. What springs forth from that place now may be stronger, may be weaker. What matters is that it is new.

cards.name: Charm
cards.text: Recall an ally to give an enemy Vulnerable this round.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recall</style></link> an ally to give an enemy <link=keyword.Vulnerable><sprite name=Vulnerable><style=Keyword>Vulnerable</style></link> this round.
cards.flavor: "Tell me a secret." - Ahri

cards.name: Children of the Forest
cards.text: Recall an ally, or spend 8 mana to summon Ephemeral copies of the 3 strongest followers you've Recalled this game.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recall</style></link> an ally, or spend 8 mana to summon <link=keyword.Ephemeral><sprite name=Ephemeral><style=Keyword>Ephemeral</style></link> copies of the 3 <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> followers you've <link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recalled</style></link> this game.
cards.flavor: Memories have fangs.

cards.name: Children of the Forest
cards.text: Recall an ally.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recall</style></link> an ally.
cards.flavor: Memories have fangs.

cards.name: Children of the Forest
cards.text: Summon Ephemeral copies of the 3 strongest followers you've Recalled this game.
cards.textHtml: Summon <link=keyword.Ephemeral><sprite name=Ephemeral><style=Keyword>Ephemeral</style></link> copies of the 3 <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> followers you've <link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recalled</style></link> this game.
cards.flavor: Memories have fangs.

cards.name: Tail-Cloak Matriarch
cards.text: Each round, the first time you Recall a follower, summon an exact Ephemeral copy of it.
cards.textHtml: Each round, the first time you <link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recall</style></link> a follower, summon an exact <link=keyword.Ephemeral><sprite name=Ephemeral><style=Keyword>Ephemeral</style></link> copy of it.
cards.flavor: Mystery is a greater thing than its conclusion.

cards.name: The Mourned
cards.text: Nexus Strike: Recall me.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.NexusStrike><style=Vocab>Nexus Strike</style></link>: <link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recall</style></link> me.
cards.flavor: If one is to venerate the hunt, one must pause to weep for the hunted.

cards.name: We Stand Together
cards.text: Give 2 allies +1|+2 this round.
cards.textHtml: Give 2 allies +1|+2 this round.
cards.flavor: "It is in the bonds of kinship that we must find our strength." - Pantheon

cards.name: Pantheon
cards.levelup: You've targeted allies in 5+ different rounds.
cards.flavor: Here stands Atreus, who had his freedoms stripped from him by the very Aspects he revered. Here stands the embers of War, who left Atreus with gifts few mortals can comprehend. Here stands a man, ready to fight and die for those he cherishes.

cards.name: Pantheon's Shield Vault
cards.text:
Grant an ally +1|+1 and Stun an enemy.
Create a Pantheon in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
Grant an ally +1|+1 and <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> an enemy.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Pantheon</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: Pantheon was well-versed in warfare. He knew from countless fights that his enemies would always track his spear, and rarely his shield.

cards.name: Pantheon
cards.text: Once a Pantheon has leveled up, grant me a random keyword for each round you've targeted allies this game.
cards.textHtml: Once a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Pantheon</style></link> has leveled up, grant me a random keyword for each round you've targeted allies this game. <style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor: Here stands Pantheon, who took up his spear and swore to drive all gods and demons from this land we call home.

cards.name: Camphor, the Doubt
cards.text: When I'm summoned, if you've targeted allies in 4 different rounds, grant me Spellshield, Overwhelm, and Challenger.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, if you've targeted allies in 4 different rounds, grant me <link=keyword.SpellShield><sprite name=SpellShield><style=Keyword>Spellshield</style></link>, <link=keyword.Overwhelm><sprite name=Overwhelm><style=Keyword>Overwhelm</style></link>, and <link=keyword.Challenger><sprite name=Challenger><style=Keyword>Challenger</style></link>. <style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor: For centuries, the demon Camphor stalked the lands of Targon, pulling from her victims the very strengths that defined them. From the mighty, she would take strength; from the wise, wisdom. But she had no interest in these boons. Instead, she feasted on the suffering, doubt, and misery she inflicted. Camphor was a monster in every sense of the word.

cards.name: Saga Seeker
cards.flavor: Tor felt his life fading with every heartbeat, but in that grave and looming darkness, where he was expected to embrace dread, he instead found purpose. He would not only face death willingly, but would bring with him the very demon who had dared to cut his life short. This is how he would be remembered. This would be Tor's saga.

cards.name: Wounded Whiteflame
cards.flavor: "Targonians need no further proof of the gods' cruelty. Look at what they have done to us. Look at what they have done to our most cherished companions." - Pantheon

cards.name: Shield Vault
cards.text: Grant an ally +1|+1 and Stun an enemy.
cards.textHtml: Grant an ally +1|+1 and <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> an enemy.
cards.flavor: Pantheon was well-versed in warfare. He knew from countless fights that his enemies would always track his spear, and rarely his shield.

cards.name: Battle Bonds
cards.text: Grant 2 allies +2|+2.
cards.textHtml: Grant 2 allies +2|+2.
cards.flavor: Warring against the gods seemed a fool's errand, but through the scars and through the screams, those brave few learned lessons. The gods thought singularly, selfishly, and had lost the gift of camaraderie. This would be their weapon. This would be their armor.

cards.name: Blinded Mystic
cards.text: Play: Grant an ally +1|+1 and Silence an enemy follower.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Grant an ally +1|+1 and <link=vocab.Silence><style=Vocab>Silence</style></link> an enemy follower.
cards.flavor: Eshiyme was once a revered oracle who used her Sight to guide those in need. But this gift was stolen from her by Camphor, who intended to feast on her inevitable anguish. How sorely the demon underestimated brave Eshiyme.

cards.name: Against the Odds
cards.text: If your opponent has more units than you, grant an ally +1|+1 for each extra unit they have.
cards.textHtml: If your opponent has more units than you, grant an ally +1|+1 for each extra unit they have.
cards.flavor: These brave few knew they were stepping into warfare with beings of unimaginable power. They knew death was likely. But still, they stepped.

cards.name: Freed Colossus
cards.text: When I'm summoned or Attack: Create a Gem in hand.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned or <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Gem</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: The colossi are ancient and venerated protectors of Targon's most revered sites. To harm them is to insult the mountain itself. To torture them is a crime no Targonian can forgive.

cards.name: Iula
cards.text: Play: Grant an ally Spellshield or Overwhelm. If you don't, grant it to me.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Grant an ally <link=keyword.SpellShield><sprite name=SpellShield><style=Keyword>Spellshield</style></link> or <link=keyword.Overwhelm><sprite name=Overwhelm><style=Keyword>Overwhelm</style></link>. If you don't, grant it to me.
cards.flavor: Iula still remembers the burning grief that coursed through her after she learned of her husband's death. When Pantheon came to her, asking if she would help him destroy a creature that feasted on this very pain, her answer was swift.

cards.name: Iula
cards.text: Play: Grant an ally Overwhelm. If you don't, grant it to me.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Grant an ally <link=keyword.Overwhelm><sprite name=Overwhelm><style=Keyword>Overwhelm</style></link>. If you don't, grant it to me.

cards.name: Iula
cards.text: Play: Grant an ally Spellshield. If you don't, grant it to me.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Grant an ally <link=keyword.SpellShield><sprite name=SpellShield><style=Keyword>Spellshield</style></link>. If you don't, grant it to me.

cards.name: Celestial Wonder
cards.text: Stun two enemies.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> two enemies.
cards.flavor: "Targon's night sky is a wondrous thing of unimaginable beauty. It is all too easy to lose oneself gazing at that expanse, not knowing how far the stars stretch, and what manner of being might be looking back..." - Targonian climber

cards.name: Sion
cards.text:
When I'm discarded, grant your strongest ally Overwhelm and place me into your deck.
I have +1|+0 for each card you've discarded this game (Max +7|+0).
cards.textHtml:
When I'm discarded, grant your <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> ally <link=keyword.Overwhelm><sprite name=Overwhelm><style=Keyword>Overwhelm</style></link> and place me into your deck.
I have +1|+0 for each card you've discarded this game (Max +7|+0).
cards.levelup: You've discarded or summoned 35+ Power.
cards.flavor: Sion glimpsed fleeting flashes of opaque memories. Legions standing before him. Accolades. Crowns. War. A king's deathrattle. The Great Nothing. Blood. But just as soon as they floated by, they floated past, pale ribbons in the wind.

cards.name: Sion Returned
cards.text: When I'm summoned, Rally.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, <link=vocab.Rally><style=Vocab>Rally</style></link>.
cards.flavor:
"Though the fog lingers as we first wake Sion, the full spectrum of war stirs a life within him that is both furious and reluctant to end."
- Notes from Dr. Esslanger

cards.name: Sion's Roar of the Slayer
cards.text:
To play, discard 1. Kill the weakest enemy.
Create a Sion in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
To play, discard 1. Kill the <link=keyword.Weakest><style=Keyword>weakest</style></link> enemy.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Sion</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "Ally, enemy... I don't care." - Sion

cards.name: Sion
cards.text:
Last Breath: Summon Sion Returned. 
When I'm discarded, grant your strongest ally Overwhelm and place me into your deck.
cards.textHtml:
<link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>Last Breath</style></link>: Summon <link=card.transform><style=AssociatedCard>Sion Returned</style></link>. 
When I'm discarded, grant your <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> ally <link=keyword.Overwhelm><sprite name=Overwhelm><style=Keyword>Overwhelm</style></link> and place me into your deck.
cards.flavor: Through the din of battle, he remembered. He remembered his life, a proud servant of Noxus. A revered general who gave his life felling Demacia's king. He remembered his death, and the empty expanse that followed. His was a good life, and a good death. But this... this was madness.

cards.name: Noble Rebel
cards.text: Grant me +2|+1 once you've discarded 3+ cards this game.
cards.textHtml: Grant me +2|+1 once you've discarded 3+ cards this game. <style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor: "What could better instill loyalty in a would-be traitor than the sight of a butchered conspirator, brought back to fight under the Noxian banner? They will all serve, one way or another." - The Lady of Blood

cards.name: Salt And Stitches
cards.text:
To play, discard a card.
Summon a Reborn Grenadier and give it +2|+0 this round.
cards.textHtml:
To play, discard a card.
Summon a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Reborn Grenadier</style></link> and give it +2|+0 this round.
cards.flavor: "Rise again, my child..." - Dr. Esslanger, Pensive Physician

cards.name: Grave Physician
cards.text: Play: Discard 1 to draw a unit.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Discard 1 to draw a unit.
cards.flavor: Dr. Esslanger was once a respected and retiring physician who garnered his credible reputation through years of hard work. But it wasn't until a young noblewoman was brought to his study, her blood blackened by betrayal, that he truly began serving Noxus.

cards.name: Ancient Warmonger
cards.text: When I'm discarded, grant your strongest ally +2|+0.
cards.textHtml: When I'm discarded, grant your <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> ally +2|+0.
cards.flavor: As Lady Noradi's powers grew, she pondered whether her powers would take root in the corpses lining Noxus's oldest tombs. She found the light of life a mere flicker in the husks, but from those wilting flames, the shadows of war still danced.

cards.name: Reborn Grenadier
cards.text:
To play, discard 1.
When I'm discarded, summon an exact copy of me.
cards.textHtml:
To play, discard 1.
When I'm discarded, summon an exact copy of me.
cards.flavor:
"We have an irregularity in our midst. Though most of those we revive abhor their return to life, this fellow seems to both understand his lot, and revels in the subsequent opportunities. Curious."
- Notes from Dr. Esslanger

cards.name: Twinblade Revenant
cards.text: Last Breath: Create a Lost Soul in hand.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>Last Breath</style></link>: Create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Lost Soul</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor:
"The Demacians palpably lost their will to fight upon seeing our fallen--who were so selflessly cut down by those brave Vanguard--rise once more. Victory was never in question."
- Excerpt from the Lady of Blood's field report, recipient unknown

cards.name: Lost Soul
cards.text: When I'm summoned or discarded, create a Twinblade Revenant in hand.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned or discarded, create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Twinblade Revenant</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: The Demacians crawled to their ramparts to find death itself descending upon their walls. Though they were able to fell some of the Gray Legion, the dark tide of war soon proved unstoppable.

cards.name: Roar of the Slayer
cards.text: To play, discard 1. Kill the weakest enemy.
cards.textHtml: To play, discard 1. Kill the <link=keyword.Weakest><style=Keyword>weakest</style></link> enemy.
cards.flavor: "Ally, enemy... I don't care." - Sion

cards.name: Fallen Rider
cards.text: When I'm discarded, create a Risen Rider in hand.
cards.textHtml: When I'm discarded, create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Risen Rider</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor:
"It was only after rubbing the rider's armor with Blackshade leaves that they were spared from the basilisk's viciousness. The plants are native to the hinterlands, just as the beasts, and are as pungent as they are poisonous."
- Notes from Dr. Esslanger

cards.name: Weapons of the Lost
cards.text: Deal 3 to a unit and summon a Trifarian Shieldbreaker.
cards.textHtml: Deal 3 to a unit and summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Trifarian Shieldbreaker</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "Shieldbreaker!" - Sion

cards.name: Fallen Reckoner
cards.text:
When I'm summoned, grant Can't Block to the weakest enemy.
Last Breath: Create a Risen Reckoner in hand.
cards.textHtml:
When I'm summoned, grant <link=keyword.Reckless><sprite name=Reckless><style=Keyword>Can't Block</style></link> to the <link=keyword.Weakest><style=Keyword>weakest</style></link> enemy.
<link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>Last Breath</style></link>: Create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Risen Reckoner</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor:
"The first minotaurs I revived were docile, useless beasts. Neither the thrum of war nor the threat of death could stir their senses."
- Notes from Dr. Esslanger

cards.name: The Lady of Blood
cards.text: When a non-Fleeting ally in hand is discarded, create a Fleeting copy of it in hand.
cards.textHtml: When a non-<link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> ally in hand is discarded, create a <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> copy of it in hand.
cards.flavor: Under cover of night, Lady Faris Noradi led her Gray Legion out of the Noxian capital. It took three hard, bloody weeks, but they finally neared the small Demacian outpost her scouts had identified. It was time for the demonstration.

cards.name: Risen Reckoner
cards.text: When I'm summoned, grant Can't Block to the weakest enemy.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, grant <link=keyword.Reckless><sprite name=Reckless><style=Keyword>Can't Block</style></link> to the <link=keyword.Weakest><style=Keyword>weakest</style></link> enemy.
cards.flavor:
"It was the good Lady's suggestion that finally woke the creature. A small dose of iodine salt into the bloodstream, lethal to any mortal, but simply agonizing to our patient. To the risen, there is no greater motivator than pain."
- Notes from Dr. Esslanger

cards.name: Risen Rider
cards.flavor: "Upon the night, death rode." - The Lady of Blood

cards.name: For Glory!
cards.text: Reputation: I cost 3 less.  Summon 2 Trifarian Gloryseekers.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Reputation><style=Vocab>Reputation</style></link>: I cost 3 less. <style=Variable></style> Summon 2 <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Trifarian Gloryseekers</style></link>.
cards.flavor: Those seeking glory will stop at nothing to find it.

cards.name: Insider Knowledge
cards.text: ALL players draw 2.
cards.textHtml: ALL players draw 2.
cards.flavor: "This a popular case, you know. Just had a chap in here earlier looking at it. Enjoy!" - Station Archivist

cards.name: Officer Squad
cards.text: When I’m summoned, create a Most Wanted in hand.
cards.textHtml: When I’m summoned, create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Most Wanted</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: From unloading silently into the street to prepping the ram, setup didn't take long. It was just a matter of waiting on Caitlyn's cue.

cards.name: Caitlyn
cards.text: Strike: Plant 2 Flashbomb Traps in the top 8 cards of the enemy deck.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>Strike</style></link>: Plant 2 <link=card.shuffle><style=AssociatedCard>Flashbomb Traps</style></link> in the top 8 cards of the enemy deck.
cards.levelup: 5+ of your traps have been activated.
cards.flavor: Caitlyn was always a dogged and thorough investigator, a quality that helped propel her fast through the ranks of Piltover enforcement. But when a case concerning a certain 'C' came along, one that countless other enforcers had abandoned, it seemed almost as though Caitlyn had finally met her match. Almost.

cards.name: Caitlyn's Piltover Peacemaker
cards.text:
Deal 2 to a unit and plant 2 Flashbomb Traps in the top 8 cards of the enemy deck.
Create a Caitlyn in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
Deal 2 to a unit and plant 2 <link=card.shuffle><style=AssociatedCard>Flashbomb Traps</style></link> in the top 8 cards of the enemy deck.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Caitlyn</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "Here's MY calling card." - Caitlyn

cards.name: Caitlyn
cards.text: Strike: Plant 4 Flashbomb Traps in the top 8 cards of the enemy deck and deal damage to the enemy Nexus equal to the number of your traps activated this round.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>Strike</style></link>: Plant 4 <link=card.shuffle><style=AssociatedCard>Flashbomb Traps</style></link> in the top 8 cards of the enemy deck and deal damage to the enemy Nexus equal to the number of your traps activated this round. <style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor: She burst in, leveled her rifle at the culprit, and looked down the scope. There, smiling through the looking glass, was a familiar face.

cards.name: Flashbomb Trap
cards.text: Deal 1 damage to a random ally.
cards.textHtml: Deal 1 damage to a random ally.
cards.flavor: "Boom." - Caitlyn

cards.name: Sting Officer
cards.text: Nexus Strike: Plant 2 Flashbomb Traps in the top 8 cards of the enemy deck.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.NexusStrike><style=Vocab>Nexus Strike</style></link>: Plant 2 <link=card.shuffle><style=AssociatedCard>Flashbomb Traps</style></link> in the top 8 cards of the enemy deck.
cards.flavor: Zayne Asako, like all Zaunite kids, had to grow up fast on those violent and dark understreets. After losing his brother to yet another senseless gang crime, he committed himself to Piltover enforcement, hoping reason and law would make his home finally safe.

cards.name: Advanced Intel
cards.text:
Plant 2 Flashbomb Traps in the top 8 cards of the enemy deck.
Draw 1.
cards.textHtml:
Plant 2 <link=card.shuffle><style=AssociatedCard>Flashbomb Traps</style></link> in the top 8 cards of the enemy deck.
Draw 1.
cards.flavor: "On my signal." - Caitlyn

cards.name: Station Archivist
cards.text: Play: Pick a spell in the top 5 cards of your deck and create an exact Fleeting copy in hand, then place those top 5 cards into your deck
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Pick a spell in the top 5 cards of your deck and create an exact <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> copy in hand, then place those top 5 cards into your deck
cards.flavor: Detectives are nothing without leads. An archivist's job is to collect every scrap of intel and create new possibilities where none previously existed.

cards.name: Piltover Peacemaker
cards.text: Deal 2 to a unit and plant 2 Flashbomb Traps in the top 8 cards of the enemy deck.
cards.textHtml: Deal 2 to a unit and plant 2 <link=card.shuffle><style=AssociatedCard>Flashbomb Traps</style></link> in the top 8 cards of the enemy deck.
cards.flavor: "Here's MY calling card." - Caitlyn

cards.name: Corina, Mastermind
cards.text: Play: Plant 5 Flashbomb Traps in the top 5 cards of the enemy deck or activate the effects of all traps in the top 5 cards of the enemy deck.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.PlaySkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Play</style></link>: Plant 5 <link=card.shuffle><style=AssociatedCard>Flashbomb Traps</style></link> in the top 5 cards of the enemy deck or activate the effects of all traps in the top 5 cards of the enemy deck.
cards.flavor: Corina smiled as the Piltover Wardens burst down her door, as they trampled her precious flowers underfoot, as they sent up clouds of toxic pollen. All as planned.

cards.name: Beguiling Blossom
cards.text: Play: Plant 5 Flashbomb Traps in the top 5 cards of the enemy deck.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Plant 5 <link=card.shuffle><style=AssociatedCard>Flashbomb Traps</style></link> in the top 5 cards of the enemy deck.
cards.flavor: "Watch your step..." - Corina Veraza

cards.name: Volatile Bloom
cards.text: Play: Activate the effects of all traps in the top 5 cards of the enemy deck.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Activate the effects of all traps in the top 5 cards of the enemy deck.
cards.flavor: "Right where I want you." - Corina Veraza

cards.name: Justice Rider
cards.text: Whenever your opponent draws, plant 1 Flashbomb Trap in the top 8 cards of the enemy deck.
cards.textHtml: Whenever your opponent draws, plant 1 <link=card.shuffle><style=AssociatedCard>Flashbomb Trap</style></link> in the top 8 cards of the enemy deck.
cards.flavor:
"Officer was witnessed pursuing suspect at a high speed into a trap of her own making. Following the arrest, officer proceeded to submit her own speeding citation and fine, claiming (somewhat dramatically) 'Justice is a two-way street.'" 
- Excerpt from a Warden beat report

cards.name: Coup de Grace
cards.text: Place an enemy follower into the enemy deck, then your opponent draws 1.
cards.textHtml: Place an enemy follower into the enemy deck, then your opponent draws 1.
cards.flavor: The grand city of Piltover is home to some of the finest minds in Runeterra. Piltover's jails are also home to some of the finest minds in Runeterra.

cards.name: Sump Fumes
cards.text: Deal 2 to a unit. If you've added 2+ cards to your hand this round, deal 3 to it instead.
cards.textHtml: Deal 2 to a unit. If you've added 2+ cards to your hand this round, deal 3 to it instead.
cards.flavor: "Better let 'em air out a minute. Greenies can't take the smell. But lemme tells ya... once you're accustomed, nothin' like it!" - Puffcap Peddler

cards.name: Most Wanted
cards.text: Pick a player to discard their lowest cost card to draw 3.
cards.textHtml: Pick a player to discard their lowest cost card to draw 3.
cards.flavor: "Everything has a cost." - Corina Veraza

cards.name: Ambush
cards.text: Give an ally +2|+0 this round. If you've added 2+ cards to your hand this round, give it Elusive this round.
cards.textHtml: Give an ally +2|+0 this round. If you've added 2+ cards to your hand this round, give it <link=keyword.Elusive><sprite name=Elusive><style=Keyword>Elusive</style></link> this round.
cards.flavor: "We'll surround the location while using smokespinners to mask our movements..." - Caitlyn

cards.name: The Forge Of Tomorrow
cards.text: When I am summoned, summon a Forge Worker. When you play a 6+ cost spell, destroy me and refill your spell mana.
cards.textHtml: When I am summoned, summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Forge Worker</style></link>. When you play a 6+ cost spell, destroy me and refill your spell mana.
cards.flavor: If Piltover is a city driven by invention, then its forges are its engines.

cards.name: Jayce
cards.text: Play: Grant me Quick Attack or Challenger.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Grant me <link=keyword.Quick Strike><sprite name=QuickStrike><style=Keyword>Quick Attack</style></link> or <link=keyword.Challenger><sprite name=Challenger><style=Keyword>Challenger</style></link>.
cards.levelup: You've played two 6+ cost spells.  When I level up, create an Acceleration Gate in hand.
cards.flavor:
"So, Rosa, as you know, this powerformative tech promises to change the world."
"Truly groundbreaking work, Jayce. The way those coinhiberators splice together. It's breathtaking."
"It sure is. All Axel's idea, too! Right, my good man?"
"Well, you know me, mate. Don't like to brag..."

cards.name: Jayce
cards.text:
Play: Grant me Quick Attack or Challenger.
Each round, the first time you play a 6+ cost spell, copy it with the same targets.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Grant me <link=keyword.Quick Strike><sprite name=QuickStrike><style=Keyword>Quick Attack</style></link> or <link=keyword.Challenger><sprite name=Challenger><style=Keyword>Challenger</style></link>.
Each round, the first time you play a 6+ cost spell, copy it with the same targets.
cards.flavor: "Cannon's primed, and hammer's engaged. This is going to be one for the history books, folks."

cards.name: Jayce's Shock Blast
cards.text: Deal 3 to an enemy or the enemy Nexus, and 3 to another. Create a Jayce in your deck.
cards.textHtml: Deal 3 to an enemy or the enemy Nexus, and 3 to another. Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Jayce</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "Firing!" - Jayce

cards.name: Acceleration Gate
cards.text: Give allies +2|+0 and Quick Attack this round. If they already have it or Double Attack, give them a random keyword instead.
cards.textHtml: Give allies +2|+0 and <link=keyword.Quick Strike><sprite name=QuickStrike><style=Keyword>Quick Attack</style></link> this round. If they already have it or <link=keyword.Double Strike><sprite name=DoubleStrike><style=Keyword>Double Attack</style></link>, give them a random keyword instead.
cards.flavor: "Gate is a go." - Jayce

cards.name: Jayce
cards.levelup: You've played two 6+ cost spells.  When I level up, create an Acceleration Gate in hand.
cards.flavor:
"So, Rosa, as you know, this powerformative tech promises to change the world."
"Truly groundbreaking work, Jayce. The way those coinhiberators splice together. It's breathtaking."
"It sure is. All Axel's idea, too! Right, my good man?"
"Well, you know me, mate. Don't like to brag..."

cards.name: Jayce
cards.levelup: You've played two 6+ cost spells.  When I level up, create an Acceleration Gate in hand.
cards.flavor:
"So, Rosa, as you know, this powerformative tech promises to change the world."
"Truly groundbreaking work, Jayce. The way those coinhiberators splice together. It's breathtaking."
"It sure is. All Axel's idea, too! Right, my good man?"
"Well, you know me, mate. Don't like to brag..."

cards.name: Jayce
cards.text: Each round, the first time you play a 6+ cost spell, copy it with the same targets.
cards.textHtml: Each round, the first time you play a 6+ cost spell, copy it with the same targets.
cards.flavor: "Cannon's primed, and hammer's engaged. This is going to be one for the history books, folks."

cards.name: Jayce
cards.text: Each round, the first time you play a 6+ cost spell, copy it with the same targets.
cards.textHtml: Each round, the first time you play a 6+ cost spell, copy it with the same targets.
cards.flavor: "Cannon's primed, and hammer's engaged. This is going to be one for the history books, folks."

cards.name: Forge Worker
cards.flavor: "Yeah so I've been 'elping Jayce an' them lot 'tinker around with this new thing. Powerformative technology, we call it. Truth be told, Jayce said I'll be listed as co-inventor once the documentation's done! Them bigwigs know where the real smarts is, eh?"

cards.name: Ferros Financier
cards.text: Play: Manifest a 6+ cost spell from your regions.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: <link=vocab.Manifest><style=Vocab>Manifest</style></link> a 6+ cost spell from your regions.
cards.flavor:
"About the only good part of Ferros financing my work was getting to team up with Reggie. Not only is the man one of the most competent people I've ever worked with, he's a heck of a guy, too."
- Excerpt from Jayce's journal

cards.name: Forge Chief
cards.text: Strike: Refill 1 spell mana.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>Strike</style></link>: Refill 1 spell mana.
cards.flavor: "Takes two things to get an idea off the page and into your hands. Funding's one half of the equation, the other's a good forge. And it's not just the tools or the hardware in the forge; if your chief doesn't have what it takes to run things, well, your idea's staying on paper." - Jayce

cards.name: Assembly Line
cards.text: Summon 2 Forge Workers.
cards.textHtml: Summon 2 <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Forge Workers</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "Shift change!" - Forge Chief

cards.name: Shock Blast
cards.text: Deal 3 to an enemy or the enemy Nexus, and 3 to another.
cards.textHtml: Deal 3 to an enemy or the enemy Nexus, and 3 to another.
cards.flavor: "Firing!" - Jayce

cards.name: Ferros Skycruiser
cards.text: Grant me +2|+0 once you've played a 6+ cost spell this game.
cards.textHtml: Grant me +2|+0 once you've played a 6+ cost spell this game.
cards.flavor: "The people of this city worship at the feet of 'intelligence'. But what good is the greatest mind without the means to express itself? No. I will show Piltover true greatness. It will tower over them. It will blot out the sun. And it will carry my name." - Albus Ferros

cards.name: Hextech Handler
cards.text: Grant Tech allies everywhere +1|+0 once you've played a 6+ cost spell this game.
cards.textHtml: Grant Tech allies <link=vocab.Everywhere><style=Vocab>everywhere</style></link> +1|+0 once you've played a 6+ cost spell this game.
cards.flavor: The Hextech Handler was initially constructed to transport raw materials through Piltover, but as time went on, the locals apparently developed a soft spot for him. Jayce's forge crew nicknamed him Nugget, a Piltovan lord reportedly donated a hat, and passing kids now adorn him with whatever they have to hand.

cards.name: Hextech Anomaly
cards.text: When you draw or create me in hand or each Round Start: while I'm in hand, transform me into a random 6+ cost spell.
cards.textHtml: When you draw or create me in hand or each <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: while I'm in hand, transform me into a random 6+ cost spell.
cards.flavor:
"...configuring hextech into a stable state was the most difficult hurdle I faced. Most nights, it felt like the crystals and hexite were actively conspiring to trip me up, and it was only through extensive trial and error that I was able to get the component parts working in harmony..."
- Excerpt from Jayce's journal

cards.name: Albus Ferros
cards.text: When I'm summoned, draw Jayce. Attack: Deal 3 to the enemy Nexus. For each 6+ cost spell you've played this game, increase it by 1.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, draw <link=card.champ1><style=AssociatedCard>Jayce</style></link>. <link=keyword.AttackSkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Attack</style></link>: Deal 3 to the enemy Nexus. For each 6+ cost spell you've played this game, increase it by 1.
cards.flavor:
"The magnanimous Albus Ferros has once again THRUST himself into the spotlight, dramatically outbidding Clans Cadwalder and Giopara for the rights to sponsor Jayce's Hexgate research. 'A fine day for Ferros is a fine day for Piltover', as the saying goes, and yesterday was a very fine day for Clan Ferros, indeed!"
- Excerpt from a sponsored spread in the Piltover Daily

cards.name: Ferros' Dividend
cards.text: Deal 3 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml: Deal 3 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: "First, the investment. Then, the dividend." - Albus Ferros

cards.name: Stinky Whump
cards.text: Last Breath: Create a copy of me in the enemy deck with 2 Poison Puffcaps attached.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>Last Breath</style></link>: Create a copy of me in the enemy deck with 2 <link=card.shuffle><style=AssociatedCard>Poison Puffcaps</style></link> attached.
cards.flavor: The stink of a whump in the height of puffcap season is unlike any other. Imagine an open sewer full of week-old fish and rotten eggs, and you're halfway there.

cards.name: Rocket Barrage
cards.text: Deal 4 to an enemy and 1 to all other enemies.
cards.textHtml: Deal 4 to an enemy and 1 to all other enemies.
cards.flavor: "They're supposed to go up, not EVERYWHERE! Oh, my!" - Heimerdinger

cards.name: Waste Walker
cards.text: When you destroy an allied landmark, grant me +1|+1.
cards.textHtml: When you destroy an allied landmark, grant me +1|+1.
cards.flavor: The acolytes had been accomplished before they sought out Xerath. Now that they had studied what he had once studied himself, they were unstoppable.

cards.name: Obelisk of Power
cards.text: Countdown 3 or when I'm summoned or you destroy me: Grant the strongest ally +2|+0.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Countdown><style=Vocab>Countdown 3</style></link> or when I'm summoned or you destroy me: Grant the <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> ally +2|+0.
cards.flavor: Sparking, crackling pillars rose from the sands, subverted places of power that would reinforce Xerath's already powerful army.

cards.name: Unleashed Energy
cards.text: Give an ally +2|+1 this round or destroy an allied landmark to give an ally +4|+2 this round.
cards.textHtml: Give an ally +2|+1 this round or destroy an allied landmark to give an ally +4|+2 this round.
cards.flavor: "I will rip the power from the desert, and destroy those who would oppose me!" - Xerath

cards.name: Unleashed Energy
cards.text: Destroy an allied landmark to give an ally +4|+2 this round.
cards.textHtml: Destroy an allied landmark to give an ally +4|+2 this round.
cards.flavor: "I will rip the power from the desert, and destroy those who would oppose me!" - Xerath

cards.name: Unleashed Energy
cards.text: Give an ally +2|+1 this round.
cards.textHtml: Give an ally +2|+1 this round.
cards.flavor: "I will rip the power from the desert, and destroy those who would oppose me!" - Xerath

cards.name: Rite of the Arcane
cards.text: Destroy an allied landmark or one of your mana gems to deal 4 to a unit.
cards.textHtml: Destroy an allied landmark or one of your mana gems to deal 4 to a unit.
cards.flavor: "A small sacrifice in exchange for great power." - Xerath

cards.name: Rite of the Arcane
cards.text: Destroy an allied landmark to deal 4 to a unit.
cards.textHtml: Destroy an allied landmark to deal 4 to a unit.
cards.flavor: "Pitiful." - Xerath

cards.name: Rite of the Arcane
cards.text: Destroy one of your mana gems to deal 4 to a unit.
cards.textHtml: Destroy one of your mana gems to deal 4 to a unit.
cards.flavor: "Pitiful." - Xerath

cards.name: Endless Devout
cards.text: Last Breath: Summon a Sarcophagus.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>Last Breath</style></link>: Summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Sarcophagus</style></link>.
cards.flavor: As richly appointed as the tomb was, it did little good for the banished and the dead.

cards.name: Restored Devout
cards.flavor: Xerath's new army would make better use of the tomb's many artifacts, turning useless extravagance into a powerful conduit for the Magus Ascendant's magic.

cards.name: Sarcophagus
cards.text: Countdown 3 or when you destroy me: summon a Restored Devout.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Countdown><style=Vocab>Countdown</style></link><style=Variable></style> 3 or when you destroy me: summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Restored Devout</style></link>.
cards.flavor: The Tomb of Emperors is no less lavish for serving as Xerath's prison. Indeed, the beauty of the place and its trappings is nothing if not a reminder of the inhabitants' fall from grace - a gilded prison.

cards.name: Risen Altar
cards.text: Countdown 3 or when you destroy me: Summon a Dami'yin the Unbound.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Countdown><style=Vocab>Countdown</style></link><style=Variable></style> 3 or when you destroy me: Summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Dami'yin the Unbound</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "At each place of power shall an obelisk be raised, an instrument through which the Magus Ascendant may draw the power from beneath the sands." - Herald of the Magus

cards.name: Dami'yin the Unbound
cards.flavor: "At each place of power shall we draw forth the magical energy of the land, and in so doing, bolster our great emperor's armies!" - Herald of the Magus

cards.name: Xerath
cards.text: When you destroy an allied landmark, deal 1 to the weakest enemy.
cards.textHtml: When you destroy an allied landmark, deal 1 to the <link=keyword.Weakest><style=Keyword>weakest</style></link> enemy.
cards.levelup: You've destroyed 4+ allied landmarks.
cards.flavor:
"The two were once friends, but time and affinity made them into brothers. Certainly Azir could not have achieved all that he was able without Xerath by his side." 
- Scribe Kah'nir, History of the Ascended Host

cards.name: Xerath
cards.text: When you destroy an allied landmark, deal 3 to the weakest enemy.
cards.textHtml: When you destroy an allied landmark, deal 3 to the <link=keyword.Weakest><style=Keyword>weakest</style></link> enemy.
cards.levelup: You've restored the Sun Disc.
cards.flavor:
"If only Xerath had known that Azir planned to free him of his bondage, it might have prevented Shurima's demise... but some part of a mortal's humanity is lost when they Ascend, and any forgiveness or leniency was quickly erased from Xerath's mind." 
- Scribe Kah'nir, History of the Ascended Host

cards.name: Xerath
cards.text:
When you destroy an allied landmark or Round Start: Deal 5 to the weakest enemy or the enemy Nexus if there are none.
If an enemy unit would die, Obliterate it instead.
cards.textHtml:
When you destroy an allied landmark or <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Deal 5 to the <link=keyword.Weakest><style=Keyword>weakest</style></link> enemy or the enemy Nexus if there are none.
If an enemy unit would die, <link=vocab.Obliterate><style=Vocab>Obliterate</style></link> it instead.
cards.flavor:
"For years he sowed seeds of revenge, plotting against Azir in the dark of the Emperor's Tomb. Xerath would see a new Shurima made in his own image, gathering the acolytes who had studied his arcane magics to serve as his army. Now, he marches on Shurima just as Azir has revived it." 
- Scribe Kah'nir, History of the Ascended Host

cards.name: Xerath's Rite of the Arcane
cards.text:
Destroy an allied landmark or one of your mana gems to deal 4 to a unit.
Create a Xerath in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
Destroy an allied landmark or one of your mana gems to deal 4 to a unit.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Xerath</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "A small sacrifice in exchange for great power." - Xerath

cards.name: Xerath's Rite of the Arcane
cards.text: Destroy one of your mana gems to deal 4 to a unit.
cards.textHtml: Destroy one of your mana gems to deal 4 to a unit.
cards.flavor: "Pitiful." - Xerath

cards.name: Xerath's Rite of the Arcane
cards.text: Destroy an allied landmark to deal 4 to a unit.
cards.textHtml: Destroy an allied landmark to deal 4 to a unit.
cards.flavor: "Pitiful." - Xerath

cards.name: Sandseer
cards.text: When I'm summoned, draw 1. If you drew a landmark, repeat this effect.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, draw 1. If you drew a landmark, repeat this effect.
cards.flavor: The horizon before her sang with energy. Where others saw sand and silt, she saw the ley lines, blinding lattices of pure energy that were hers for the taking.

cards.name: Ruinous Acolyte
cards.text: Play: Destroy an allied landmark to grant allied Ruinous Acolytes everywhere +1|+1.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Destroy an allied landmark to grant allied <link=card.selfRef><style=AssociatedCard>Ruinous Acolytes</style></link> <link=vocab.Everywhere><style=Vocab>everywhere</style></link> +1|+1.
cards.flavor: All of Xerath's acolytes gave something of themselves in exchange for power, but his most powerful devotees were hardly more than husks of their former selves, serving as both conduit and power source for their new emperor's energy.

cards.name: Herald of the Magus
cards.text: When I'm summoned, if you've destroyed 4+ allied landmarks this game, grant your champions everywhere +2|+2 and Overwhelm.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, if you've destroyed 4+ allied landmarks this game, grant your champions <link=vocab.Everywhere><style=Vocab>everywhere</style></link> +2|+2 and <link=keyword.Overwhelm><sprite name=Overwhelm><style=Keyword>Overwhelm</style></link>. <style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor: The Herald spread her arms wide as she lifted her face to the sun, which hung bloody and red above Shurima. "Hail, the Magus Ascendant," she breathed beatifically, her voice echoing off the ring of ruined columns. "Hail, Xerath!"

cards.name: Servitude of Desolation
cards.text: Summon a Stasis Statue to store all allied units and landmarks that died or were destroyed this round inside.
cards.textHtml: Summon a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Stasis Statue</style></link> to store all allied units and landmarks that died or were destroyed this round inside.
cards.flavor: Magical energy does not dissipate. It is merely repurposed.

cards.name: Construct of Desolation
cards.text: Create a Ruinous Acolyte or an Obelisk of Power in hand.
cards.textHtml: Create a <link=card.create1><style=AssociatedCard>Ruinous Acolyte</style></link> or an <link=card.create2><style=AssociatedCard>Obelisk of Power</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: "I will fashion Shurima in MY image." - Xerath

cards.name: Desert Duel
cards.text: Give an enemy -2|-0 this round. An ally and that enemy strike each other.
cards.textHtml: Give an enemy <nobr>-2|-0</nobr> this round. An ally and that enemy <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strike</style></link> each other.
cards.flavor: "A traveler who does not fear the desert, does not know the desert." - Shuriman adage

cards.name: Piercing Darkness
cards.text: Drain 5 from a unit.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Drain><style=Keyword>Drain</style></link> 5 from a unit.
cards.flavor: "Death is drawn to life." - Senna

cards.name: Watcher on the Isles
cards.text: Each round, the first time you kill a unit with a spell, deal 2 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml: Each round, the first time you kill a unit with a spell, deal 2 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: "Pups is pups." - Wisdom scrawled upon the soul

cards.name: Ixtali Sentinel
cards.text: When I'm summoned, create a Darkness in hand if you don't have one. When you play your next Darkness this round, copy it targeting the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Darkness</style></link> in hand if you don't have one. When you play your next <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Darkness</style></link> this round, copy it targeting the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: "You asked me, Senna, what brought me to this fight. I have lost nothing to the Mist, it does not threaten my home. It exists, and it should not. I am here to discover why. Do I need sentiment to join your cause?"

cards.name: Senna
cards.text: When I'm summoned or Attack: Create a Darkness in hand if you don't have one. Your damage and kill spells accelerate to Fast.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned or <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Darkness</style></link> in hand if you don't have one. Your damage and kill spells accelerate to <link=keyword.Fast><sprite name=Fast><style=Keyword>Fast</style></link>.
cards.levelup: I've seen you kill 3+ units with spells or an allied Lucian die.
cards.flavor: "To be a Sentinel is to fight. To lose yourself or to lose the ones you love. But more than that? It means to live. For yourself... and for the ones you love."

cards.name: Senna
cards.text: When I'm summoned or Attack: Create a Darkness in hand if you don't have one. Your damage and kill spells accelerate to Fast and cost 1 less.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned or <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Darkness</style></link> in hand if you don't have one. Your damage and kill spells accelerate to <link=keyword.Fast><sprite name=Fast><style=Keyword>Fast</style></link> and cost 1 less.
cards.flavor: "We were wrong. The Black Mist isn't heartless. It's not random. It has a goal. But that means we can track it. Means it can bleed."

cards.name: Senna's Dawning Shadow
cards.text:
Kill a unit and give all enemies -2|-0 this round.
Create a Senna in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
Kill a unit and give all enemies <nobr>-2|-0</nobr> this round.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Senna</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "No shadow without light. No death without life." - Senna

cards.name: Dess & Ada
cards.text: When I'm summoned, create a Darkness in hand if you don't have one. Your next Darkness this round costs 0 and gains “I deal damage to all enemy targets.”
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Darkness</style></link> in hand if you don't have one. Your next <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Darkness</style></link> this round costs 0 and gains “I deal damage to all enemy targets.”
cards.flavor:
"Another nightmare?"
"Wasn't all bad. You weren't there."
"Dolt. What was the bad part?"
"You weren't there."

cards.name: Burgeoning Sentinel
cards.text: The first time you kill a unit with a spell, grant me +2|+1.
cards.textHtml: The first time you kill a unit with a spell, grant me +2|+1.
cards.flavor: What must the Mist see when it looks upon Maeve? Exuberance, confidence--irrepressible optimism. How it must long to snuff that taunting flame. For what can death fear, but life?

cards.name: Solari Sentinel
cards.text: When I'm summoned, create a Darkness in hand if you don't have one.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Darkness</style></link> in hand if you don't have one.
cards.flavor: "I can feel the sun no longer. Even so, I wield its memory--and that is enough."

cards.name: Mistkeepers
cards.text: Each round, the first time you kill a unit with a spell, summon an Ephemeral Mistwraith.
cards.textHtml: Each round, the first time you kill a unit with a spell, summon an <link=keyword.Ephemeral><sprite name=Ephemeral><style=Keyword>Ephemeral</style></link> <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Mistwraith</style></link>.
cards.flavor: The Black Mist traps its victims in endless cycles of self-imposed torment. Through the Mistcatchers, Tek and Kana give those souls a chance to break that cycle for themselves.

cards.name: Catalogue of Regrets
cards.text: Round Start: Create in hand a Fleeting copy of a non-Fleeting spell you played last round.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Create in hand a <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> copy of a non-<link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> spell you played last round.
cards.flavor: The Blessed Isles forget. The Shadow Isles remember. The Shadow Isles forget. The Blessed Isles remember.

cards.name: Buhru Sentinel
cards.text: The first time you kill a unit with a spell, grant me +2|+1.
cards.textHtml: The first time you kill a unit with a spell, grant me +2|+1.
cards.flavor: The Buhru and Sentinel philosophy align on a single crucial point: all things must end, and some must be made to end.

cards.name: Dawning Shadow
cards.text: Kill a unit and give all enemies -2|-0 this round.
cards.textHtml: Kill a unit and give all enemies <nobr>-2|-0</nobr> this round.
cards.flavor: "No shadow without light. No death without life." - Senna

cards.name: Darkness
cards.text: Deal 2 to an enemy.
cards.textHtml: <style=Variable>Deal 2 to an enemy.</style>
cards.flavor: There is a little of fear in everything. It lays quietly at the heart of mystery. It is the spark of joy in awe and wonder. It grants life its purpose - death, its power. It is everything. It is nothing.

cards.name: Byrd, The Bellringer
cards.text: When I'm summoned, plant a Chime on the top card of your deck.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, plant a <link=card.chime><style=AssociatedCard>Chime</style></link> on the top card of your deck.
cards.flavor: "..second time was the big 'un. I was sweepin' the floors, when all a sudden I spot me dinner spilt on the table and me pots 'n' pans waddlin' on two legs, hurryin’ out the door! I followed fast as these knees’d go, and I found ‘em at that temple, rummagin’ through the shelves like they was lookin’ for somethin’.” - Old Gaff’s tale, part 2

cards.name: Proximity Puffcap
cards.text: Deal 1 to a unit. If one of your traps or boons activated this round, deal 3 to it instead.
cards.textHtml: Deal 1 to a unit. If one of your traps or boons activated this round, deal 3 to it instead.
cards.flavor: "If it starts to glow, it's gonna blow!" - Bandle Scout rule number 463

cards.name: Maduli, The Gatekeeper
cards.text: When I'm summoned, plant a Chime on the top card of your deck, then double the boons in your deck.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, plant a <link=card.chime><style=AssociatedCard>Chime</style></link> on the top card of your deck, then double the boons in your deck.
cards.flavor:
"Gave me a right fright, it did. Arms sproutin' all over. Teeth big as boulders. Oh, and when that creature ran that mallet 'cross its teeth, made a song so eerie, thought I'd die. Ran for my life, I did. But not before I seen it... holes in the sky! Musta been hundreds of 'em!"
- Old Gaff’s tale, part 4

cards.name: The Papertree
cards.text: When an ally with an attachment attacks, grant that attachment +1|+0.
cards.textHtml: When an ally with an attachment attacks, grant that attachment +1|+0.
cards.flavor: The leaves of the papertree shimmer with the same fae magic that created the tree itself. And, just like the birds that inspired their form, they find the allure of shiny things impossible to resist.

cards.name: Paparo the Great
cards.text:
Play: Manifest a Yordle.
Attack: Grant Yordle allies +1|+0.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: <link=vocab.Manifest><style=Vocab>Manifest</style></link> a Yordle.
<link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Grant Yordle allies +1|+0.
