cards.flavor: "EVERYONE loves Paparo! Every summer, he brings us trinkets from all across the world, and they're always either tasty, pretty, or topsy-turvy! Sometimes, all three!" - Ava Achiever

cards.name: Drop the Bomb
cards.text: Deal 2 to a unit and summon a Scrappy Bomb.
cards.textHtml: Deal 2 to a unit and summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Scrappy Bomb</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "Well, that's not good," Giselle said quietly, ducking behind cover.

cards.name: Bandle Tellstones
cards.text: Create a Fleeting Electro Harpoon, Heroic Refrain, or Yordle Contraption in hand.
cards.textHtml: Create a <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> <link=card.spell3><style=AssociatedCard>Electro Harpoon</style></link>, <link=card.spell2><style=AssociatedCard>Heroic Refrain</style></link>, or <link=card.spell1><style=AssociatedCard>Yordle Contraption</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: Yordles are always down for a game... but don't be surprised if the rules change in the middle of one!

cards.name: Cosmic Binding
cards.text: Deal 2 to an enemy and Stun another. Plant 6 Chimes in your deck.
cards.textHtml: Deal 2 to an enemy and <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> another. Plant 6 <link=card.chime><style=AssociatedCard>Chimes</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor:
"Mama, where does the Caretaker go?"
"He goes everywhere, love. As far as the eye can reach."
"Why?"
"Ah, my sweet. Do not think on why. Not even our wisest elders can understand the Caretaker's ways..."
- A mother and child

cards.name: Sneezy Biggledust!
cards.text: Give allies +1|+1 this round. If they're created, give them +2|+2 instead.
cards.textHtml: Give allies +1|+1 this round. If they're created, give them +2|+2 instead.
cards.flavor: "HELLO. I MUSHROOM I TALKING I DON'T KNOW WHY OR HOW OR WHAT IS HAPPEN PLEASE LET ME BE MUSHROOM. PLEASE. THANK. BYE." - Mushroom

cards.name: Illaoi
cards.text: Attack: Spawn 1, then I gain Power equal to your strongest Tentacle's Power this round.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: <link=vocab.Spawn><style=Vocab>Spawn</style></link> 1, then I gain Power equal to your <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Tentacle</style></link>'s Power this round.
cards.levelup: I've seen myself or allied Tentacles deal 15+ damage.

cards.name: Tentacle
cards.flavor: There is no greater symbol of what lurks below. Whether it means you harm or not is irrelevant to the fear--the panic that rises in your chest. Nature supplies spectacle, but your mind supplies intent.

cards.name: Watchful Idol
cards.text: Round Start: Deal 2 to me and Spawn 1.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Deal 2 to me and <link=vocab.Spawn><style=Vocab>Spawn</style></link> 1.
cards.flavor: When terrors swarm out from the Shadow Isles, the idol glows bright--a blazing beacon on the horizon.

cards.name: Buhru Leader
cards.text: Play: A 1 cost ally starts a free attack.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: A 1 cost ally starts a free attack.
cards.flavor: "Recall the ocean's wisdom! If you do not move, you will be moved! Follow my voice if you've lost your way--for your foe surely knows their own."

cards.name: Nagakabouros
cards.text: When I'm summoned or Round Start: Spawn 2. Then, if your strongest Tentacle has 12+ Power, create a Nagakabouros' Tantrum in hand.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned or <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: <link=vocab.Spawn><style=Vocab>Spawn</style></link> 2. cards.flavor: "The Mother Serpent. The Great Kraken. The Bearded Lady. Nagakabouros cares little for names, and less for the restless dead." - Illaoi

cards.name: Nagakabouros' Tantrum
cards.text: Nagakabouros starts a free attack with 4 Nagakabouros' Tentacle.
cards.textHtml: <link=card.parentRef><style=AssociatedCard>Nagakabouros</style></link> starts a free attack with 4 <link=card.unitRef><style=AssociatedCard>Nagakabouros' Tentacle</style></link>.
cards.flavor: It is a common Buhru story that the land was once whole, and Nagakabouros shattered it into islands to provide greater challenge for navigators. It's a story, of course. Nagakabouros didn't shatter the land. Nobody questions, however, whether she could if she felt like it.

cards.name: Nagakabouros' Tentacle
cards.text: When I'm summoned, grow my stats to that of your strongest Tentacle and grant me its keywords.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, grow my stats to that of your <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> <link=card.tentacle><style=AssociatedCard>Tentacle</style></link> and grant me its keywords.
cards.flavor: "To say you've witnessed Nagakabouros after seeing her tendrils is to say you know the sun after witnessing daylight. Nagakabouros is more than enormous. Nagakabouros is unending." - Falaweh, Buhru Priestess

cards.name: Answered Prayer
cards.text: Spawn 2, or spend 5 mana to Spawn 4 instead.

cards.flavor: Prayer to Nagakabouros is not about supplication, nor about asking and receiving. Hers is a blessing not unlike life: strive, struggle, push, and occasionally, reward will find you.

cards.name: Buhru Lookout
cards.text: When I'm summoned, Spawn 3.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, <link=vocab.Spawn><style=Vocab>Spawn</style></link> 3.
cards.flavor: Life is sweetest in simplicity. Salt spray in your face, birdsong in your ears... and an uncomplicated foe on the horizon.

cards.name: Steem
cards.text:
When I'm summoned, summon a random Husk.
When you summon a 1 cost ally, grant the strongest enemy Vulnerable.
cards.textHtml:
When I'm summoned, summon a random Husk.
When you summon a 1 cost ally, grant the <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> enemy <link=keyword.Vulnerable><sprite name=Vulnerable><style=Keyword>Vulnerable</style></link>.
cards.flavor: Evelynn's first encounter with Steem was a violent, thrilling affair. Evelynn remembered how he smiled with unbridled pleasure as she flayed him, and how he returned the suffering just as eagerly when it was his turn. After finally overpowering Steem, Evelynn chose then not to destroy the lesser demon, but to bind him to her forever. Perhaps, she thought, they could share their mutual love for butchery with the world.

cards.name: Riptide Sermon
cards.text:
Deal 3 to an enemy unit.
Spawn 3.
Deal 1 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml:
Deal 3 to an enemy unit.
<link=vocab.Spawn><style=Vocab>Spawn</style></link> 3.
Deal 1 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: "We learn as children to ride the dangerous waters. To struggle is to die. It is natural that the first trial a priestess must overcome is forgetting this lesson; to battle the undertow with all her might. For a Truth Bearer is not the swimmer--she is the current." - Illaoi

<link=vocab.Spawn><style=Vocab>Spawn</style></link> 2.
Draw 2.
cards.flavor: Nagakabouros is a god of providence--provided one survives the act of worship.

cards.name: The Sea's Voice
cards.text: Attack: Spawn 1 and give your strongest Tentacle Overwhelm this round.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: <link=vocab.Spawn><style=Vocab>Spawn</style></link> 1 and give your <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Tentacle</style></link> <link=keyword.Overwhelm><sprite name=Overwhelm><style=Keyword>Overwhelm</style></link> this round.
cards.flavor: Summoning Nagakabouros involves little in the way of ritual or rite. She answers the call of those whose soul can rise to match the ocean's, every swell, every thrash. It is a battle few can withstand.

cards.name: Wharf Rat
cards.text: I have +1|+0 for each different round you've damaged the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml: I have +1|+0 for each different round you've damaged the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: "Ain't no place bloodier in Bilgewater than the bay. Just look at them rats. Reared on blood, they are. Can't get enough o' the stuff. Creepy little scrits." - Jagged Butcher

cards.name: Ransom Riches
cards.text: Manifest a follower you can afford.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Manifest><style=Vocab>Manifest</style></link> a follower you can afford.
cards.flavor:
"Alright, Baz. You sure you wanna try again?"
"Third time's a charm, Gav. Besides, I reckon we've fought everything this stinkin' city's got goin' for it."
"Fought, and lost, Baz." - Baz and Gav, aspiring bounty hunters

cards.name: Megatusk
cards.text: Once you're Deep, heal your allies and Nexus 3.
cards.textHtml:
Once you're <link=keyword.Deep><sprite name=Deep><style=Keyword>Deep</style></link>, heal your allies and Nexus 3. 
<style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor:
"What does it want?!"
"It... it's after the oranges!"
"By the Bearded Lady, JUST GIVE IT THE WHOLE BUSHEL!" - Unlucky sailors

cards.name: Swindle
cards.text: Pick 1 of 2 non-champion cards from the enemy hand and create a copy in your hand. Plunder: I cost 1 less.
cards.textHtml: Pick 1 of 2 non-champion cards from the enemy hand and create a copy in your hand. <link=keyword.Plunder><style=Keyword>Plunder</style></link>: I cost 1 less.
cards.flavor: "FIVE aces? Looks like I win again!" - Pool Shark

cards.name: Bilgewater Tellstones
cards.text: Create a Fleeting More Powder!, Playful Trickster, or Chum the Waters in hand.
cards.textHtml: Create a <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> <link=card.cardA><style=AssociatedCard>More Powder!</style></link>, <link=card.cardB><style=AssociatedCard>Playful Trickster</style></link>, or <link=card.cardC><style=AssociatedCard>Chum the Waters</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: "Don't try to catch someone bluffin' in a match of 'stones. Bilgewater's full of good liars. If you really wanna win, you gotta watch the hands." - Twisted Fate

cards.name: Blood in the Water
cards.text: Deal 1 to anything, then Rally.
cards.textHtml: Deal 1 to anything, then <link=vocab.Rally><style=Vocab>Rally</style></link>.
cards.flavor: Not much keeps the circling sharks of Ripper's Bay away. Once they've had a taste of blood, they're eager for more.

cards.textHtml: Summon a random Husk and grant it +1|+0.
cards.levelup: Missing Translation
cards.flavor: "Closer, love..." - Evelynn

ALL spells cost 2 more.
<link=vocab.Countdown><style=Vocab>Countdown 2</style></link><style=Variable></style>.
cards.flavor: Mageseekers place towering petricite obelisks throughout their compounds, ensuring that even the strongest mages are rendered completely powerless.

cards.name: Protective Broodfather
cards.text: Attack: Draw a unit. If it's a Dragon, summon it attacking.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Draw a unit. If it's a Dragon, summon it attacking.
cards.flavor: "Luckily, my research suggests that broodfathers spend most of their time hunting a good distance from their young. It goes without saying that if the male should return, we would all be dragon food! Ha ha!" - Anden Mayne, Egghead Researcher

cards.name: Lord Eldred, Mageseeker Leader

Other allies and your Nexus have Tough.

cards.textHtml:
Other allies and your Nexus have <link=keyword.Tough><sprite name=Tough><style=Keyword>Tough</style></link>.

cards.flavor: "I couldn't help but overhear your fervent whispering, dear wife. I advise you to exercise more caution when discussing family matters in so public a place. You can never be certain who might be listening."

cards.name: Demacian Tellstones

cards.flavor: "Why do they call it 'King's Gambit'? Queens take risks, too!" - Cithria of Cloudfield

cards.name: Inspiring Light

cards.textHtml: Grant allies <link=keyword.Spirit><sprite name=Spirit><style=Keyword>Spirit</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "No more hiding! Step into the light, and shine brightly with me!" - Lux

cards.name: Revna, the Lorekeeper
cards.text: When I'm summoned, grant units in your deck my stats, then draw a unit with 5+ Power.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, grant units in your deck my stats, then draw a unit with 5+ Power.
cards.flavor: Avarosan lorekeepers are often seasoned elders of the tribe, protectors of the people and seasoned storytellers. They keep the tradition of both the hunt and fight alive through story and song.

cards.name: Frozen in Fear
cards.text: Frostbite an enemy and summon a Rimefang Pack.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Frostbite><sprite name=Frostbite><style=Keyword>Frostbite</style></link> an enemy and summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Rimefang Pack</style></link>. <style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor: With the cold, so too come the rimefangs, and they don't have to outpace their prey... merely outwait them.

cards.name: Harbinger of Thralls
cards.text: Play: Summon a Frozen Thrall or advance all your Frozen Thralls 1 round.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Frozen Thrall</style></link> or <link=vocab.Advance><style=Vocab>advance</style></link> all your <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Frozen Thralls</style></link> 1 round.
cards.flavor: The strange, whistling cry of the creature overhead was barely audible, but as it rung off the ravine's stone walls, the scouts felt it vibrate along their bones. Before their very eyes, cracks rapidly formed along the surface of the ice, disproportionate and quick.

cards.name: Harbinger of Thralls
cards.text: Play: Advance all your Frozen Thralls 1 round.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: <link=vocab.Advance><style=Vocab>Advance</style></link> all your <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Frozen Thralls</style></link> 1 round.
cards.flavor:
The ice grows thin at daylight break,
And with the thaw, Her servants wake.

cards.flavor: The cycle of life and death looks different in the Freljord. The harsh environment ensures that little goes to waste.

cards.flavor: One must always test the ice before stepping onto it, no matter how thick it may look.

cards.name: Wings of the Cryophoenix

Deal 3 to ALL units.
Enlightened: Instead, deal 3 to all enemies and heal your Nexus 3.
cards.textHtml:
Deal 3 to ALL units.
<link=keyword.Enlightened><style=Keyword>Enlightened</style></link>: Instead, deal 3 to all enemies and heal your Nexus 3.
cards.flavor: In the shadow of the great Cryophoenix's wings, her followers rejoiced, and her enemies shuddered.

cards.name: Wildclaw's Ferocity
cards.text: Transform an allied follower into an Alpha Wildclaw.
cards.textHtml: Transform an allied follower into an <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Alpha Wildclaw</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "Great wildclaw spirit, grant us your power!" - Udyr

cards.name: The Stagehand
cards.text: Play: Stun an enemy.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.PlaySkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Play</style></link>: <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> an enemy.
cards.flavor: "Act Four: A young priestess enters our story. Her tale is one of tragedy, conveyed on the pale lips of those she betrayed. Desperate to repent for her transgression, she carries in her arms a great burden, a gilded gift for the Noxians she welcomed to her land. We are left to wonder: was it sorrow or the bullet that broke her heart?"

cards.name: Stunning Performance
cards.text: Stun an enemy.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> an enemy.
cards.flavor: "An actor must not shy from the spotlight." - Jhin

cards.name: The Maker

cards.flavor: "An extraordinary creator, The Maker. A legendary artisan! Her art, peerless! Her execution, flawless! It is a great honor to be in her presence, let alone wield an instrument of her making." - Kashuri Witness

cards.name: Peerless Artistry
cards.text: Recall a unit with less Power than me.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recall</style></link> a unit with less Power than me.
cards.flavor: "Training is a path, and at its end lies perfection." - The Maker

cards.textHtml: Start a free attack with 2 <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Dragonlings</style></link>.
cards.flavor:

- The Dragonmaster

cards.text: Create a Fleeting Gruesome Theater, Ritual of Renewal, or Stand United in hand.
cards.textHtml: Create a <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> <link=card.create1><style=AssociatedCard>Gruesome Theater</style></link>, <link=card.create2><style=AssociatedCard>Ritual of Renewal</style></link>, or <link=card.create3><style=AssociatedCard>Stand United</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: "Learning to read your opponent is an essential skill, even outside of a fight. But most importantly, the purpose of a game is to have fun. Now, fetch me my footbath!" - Inspiring Mentor

cards.name: Moral Support
cards.text: I cost 2 less if you've supported an ally this game.Give an ally Barrier this round.
cards.textHtml:
I cost 2 less if you've supported an ally this game.
Give an ally Barrier this round.
cards.flavor: "Trust the balance. Walk the divide." - Shen

cards.name: Esmus, Breath of the World
cards.text:
When I'm summoned, plant a Chime on the top card of your deck.
Support: Grant my supported ally +1|+1.
cards.textHtml:
When I'm summoned, plant a <link=card.chime><style=AssociatedCard>Chime</style></link> on the top card of your deck.
<link=keyword.Support><style=Keyword>Support</style></link>: Grant my supported ally +1|+1.
cards.flavor:
"...but I heard Esmus was created by the Caretaker himself, and with her birth, sound came to the world!"
"I say lies! It is known that Esmus bears the face of an old singer who had the heart of an angel but the voice of the dead... until Bard himself granted her a voice of pure beauty!"
"I say lies! Esmus is..."
- An instance of the Birth of Esmus, a popular bard's game

cards.name: Consult the Heavens
cards.text: Fully heal all allies, then grow their Power to equal their Health.
cards.textHtml: Fully heal all allies, then grow their Power to equal their Health.
cards.flavor: "We must show ourselves compassion first of all. The rest will follow." - Soraka

cards.name: The Winding Light
cards.text: Nightfall: Give other allies +2|+1 and Overwhelm this round.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Nightfall><style=Keyword>Nightfall</style></link>: Give other allies +2|+1 and <link=keyword.Overwhelm><sprite name=Overwhelm><style=Keyword>Overwhelm</style></link> this round.
cards.flavor:
"Mother Moon, lend us your strength,
Though darkness surrounds us,
With your light, we shall overcome."
- Lunari prayer

cards.name: Dragon Roost
cards.text: Countdown 3: Summon Inviolus Vox.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Countdown><style=Vocab>Countdown 3</style></link><style=Variable></style>: Summon <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Inviolus Vox</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "It is said the celestial dragons are born from the nebulae themselves, springing forth fully formed from hazy cosmic dust. But how would we mere mortals know? From far away, all we see is their light." - Herald of Dragons

cards.name: Starhound Pack
cards.text: My Fated buffs are granted to allied Starhound Packs everywhere.
cards.textHtml: My <link=keyword.Fated><sprite name=Fated><style=Keyword>Fated</style></link> buffs are granted to allied <link=card.me><style=AssociatedCard>Starhound Packs</style></link> <link=vocab.Everywhere><style=Vocab>everywhere</style></link>.
cards.flavor: The starhounds could not be beckoned or persuaded by climbers on their journey. They were aloof, seemingly inured to the mountain's magics.

cards.name: Targonian Tellstones
cards.text: Create a Fleeting Behold the Infinite, Hush, or Blessing of Targon in hand.
cards.textHtml: Create a <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> <link=card.spell1><style=AssociatedCard>Behold the Infinite</style></link>, <link=card.spell2><style=AssociatedCard>Hush</style></link>, or <link=card.spell3><style=AssociatedCard>Blessing of Targon</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: "It's the strangest thing, Shorin... Even without turning the stone over, I know exactly what constellation is painted on it." - Tyari the Traveler

cards.name: Solari Stellacorn
cards.text: Daybreak: Give other allies +0|+2 this round.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Daybreak><style=Keyword>Daybreak</style></link>: Give other allies +0|+2 this round.
cards.flavor: Stellacorns are born of stars, with some burning hotter than others.

cards.name: Celestial Trifecta
cards.text: Invoke a low, medium, and high cost Celestial card.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Invoke><style=Keyword>Invoke</style></link> a low, medium, and high cost Celestial card.
cards.flavor: "The stars, they are foretelling great potential. Something is coming. What shape will they take? It is not for me to know! What do you think, Kulun?" - Moondreamer

cards.name: Mystic Vortex
cards.text: When I'm summoned or when I count down, plant 3 Chimes in your deck. Countdown 2: Draw 1.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned or when I count down, plant 3 <link=card.chime><style=AssociatedCard>Chimes</style></link> in your deck. <link=vocab.Countdown><style=Vocab>Countdown 2</style></link><style=Variable></style>: Draw 1.
cards.flavor: "Then I seen it--thousands of 'em, all singin' and dancin' this way and that-un. Next thing I know, I seen a flash o' light, and they’re all gone, the temple with 'em–not a stone to see. And in me hands? Well Old Gaff was left there holdin' a chime." - Old Gaff’s tale, part 3

cards.name: Mikhael's Blessing
cards.text: Grant an ally +1|+2 and remove all negative keywords from it.
cards.textHtml: Grant an ally +1|+2 and remove all negative keywords from it.
cards.flavor: Those that hear the bell ring are struck by the purity of its tone.

cards.name: The Prefect
cards.text: When you play a Fast spell, Slow spell, or Skill, grant me +1|+0.
cards.textHtml: When you play a <link=keyword.Fast><sprite name=Fast><style=Keyword>Fast</style></link> spell, <link=keyword.Slow><sprite name=Slow><style=Keyword>Slow</style></link> spell, or <link=keyword.Skill><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Skill</style></link>, grant me +1|+0.
cards.flavor: "Many of the children are of an age where their natural inclinations lead them to rebel against formal direction. Fortunate, then, that the eldest of them is both favored by the rest, and malleable to our cause. If the students choose to ignore our lessons, then we will teach through her." - Headmistress Telsi

cards.name: Captive Greyback
cards.text: Attack: I deal 3 damage to my blocker. If it's dead or gone, I deal 3 damage to the enemy Nexus instead.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.AttackSkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Attack</style></link>: I deal 3 damage to my blocker. If it's dead or gone, I deal 3 damage to the enemy Nexus instead.
cards.flavor: "Act Three: A cruel keeper and her pet. The greyback is innocent even in grisly purpose - the artifact it bears forces subservience. The keeper refuses to scream as she is fed to her pet. If only all Noxians were so noble in their demise."

cards.name: Obeyed Order
cards.text: Deal 3 to Captive Greyback's blocker. If it's dead or gone, deal 3 to the enemy Nexus instead.
cards.textHtml: Deal 3 to <link=card.parentRef><style=AssociatedCard>Captive Greyback</style></link>'s blocker. If it's dead or gone, deal 3 to the enemy Nexus instead.
cards.flavor: "Let that be a lesson. Subjugators live only until the first revolt." - Jhin

cards.name: Annie
cards.text: Attack: I deal 2 to my blocker. If it's dead or gone, I deal 2 to the enemy Nexus instead.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Elemental Skill><sprite name=ElementalSkill><style=Keyword>Attack</style></link>: I deal 2 to my blocker. If it's dead or gone, I deal 2 to the enemy Nexus instead.
cards.levelup: I've seen you play 6 Fast spells, Slow spells, or Skills. When I level up, create Tibbers in hand.
cards.flavor: Over a decade ago, Amoline Kiosar fled the Ravenbloom Conservatory with an invaluable and incandescent asset in her control. Ravenbloom's scouts searched for her in every corner of the empire, but none of the rumors they heard led them to Amoline. And so, years later, when news arrived of a lost girl burning with rage in the northern Ironspike Mountains, Fynn Retrick reluctantly gathered his things and left to investigate. He expected to find nothing. How wrong he was.

cards.name: Tibbers
cards.text: Play: Stun an enemy, then deal 2 to all Stunned or damaged enemies.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Elemental Skill><sprite name=ElementalSkill><style=Keyword>Play</style></link>: <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> an enemy, then deal 2 to all <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stunned</style></link> or damaged enemies.
cards.flavor: The demon Tybaulk had infested the minds of countless victims over the centuries. Slowly, inexorably, he would lead them to the fire, and watch his flames feast on scorched flesh. But in young Annie, Tybaulk found a will completely indomitable, and a talent for magic that rivaled even his own.

cards.name: Annie's Disintegrate
cards.text:
Pick a unit. The next time it takes 1 or more damage this round, kill it.
Create an Annie in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
Pick a unit. The next time it takes 1 or more damage this round, kill it.
Create an <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Annie</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: Headmistress Telsi spoke at length about the Noxian tenets, leaving the children before her increasingly bored and restless. But, while most students largely contained their outbursts, Annie acted. First with smoke, then with fire.

cards.name: Pyroclastic Arrival
cards.text: Stun an enemy, then deal 2 to all Stunned or damaged enemies.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> an enemy, then deal 2 to all <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stunned</style></link> or damaged enemies.
cards.flavor: "TIBBERS!" - Annie

cards.name: Molten Shield
cards.text: Deal 2 to Annie's blocker. If it's dead or gone, deal 2 to the enemy Nexus instead.
cards.textHtml: Deal 2 to <link=card.parentRef><style=AssociatedCard>Annie</style></link>'s blocker. If it's dead or gone, deal 2 to the enemy Nexus instead.
cards.flavor: "Do you wanna play, too?" - Annie

cards.name: Annie
cards.text: Attack: I deal 3 to my blocker and Stun it. If it's dead or gone, I deal 3 to the enemy Nexus instead.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Elemental Skill><sprite name=ElementalSkill><style=Keyword>Attack</style></link>: I deal 3 to my blocker and <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> it. If it's dead or gone, I deal 3 to the enemy Nexus instead.
cards.flavor:
"I've found her. She's Amoline's, no doubt. Same eyes, same giggle. I'll bring her back within the fortnight. Having spoken to the girl, I ask that you be kind to her. I believe there's good in there, along with the dark."
- Excerpt of a letter from Fynn Retrick

cards.name: Molten Shield
cards.text: Deal 3 and Stun Annie's blocker. If it's dead or gone, deal 3 to the enemy Nexus instead.
cards.textHtml: Deal 3 and <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> <link=card.parentRef><style=AssociatedCard>Annie</style></link>'s blocker. If it's dead or gone, deal 3 to the enemy Nexus instead.
cards.flavor: "It'll be fun..." - Annie

cards.name: Spell Slinger
cards.text: Play: Stun an enemy or if it's already Stunned deal 2 to it instead.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.PlaySkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Play</style></link>: <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> an enemy or if it's already <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stunned</style></link> deal 2 to it instead.
cards.flavor:
"Student: Sydell Kythera
Teacher: J. Willough
Report: I am spiderbit on left forearm. Sydell claims a misunderstanding, but his smirk belies his innocence. He is ordered to two weeks additional chores (refectory)."
- Ravenbloom discipline card

cards.name: Stiffened Sinews
cards.text: Stun an enemy or if it's already Stunned deal 2 to it instead.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> an enemy or if it's already <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stunned</style></link> deal 2 to it instead.
cards.flavor: "Fang's turn..." - Spell Slinger

cards.name: Disintegrate
cards.text: Pick a unit. The next time it takes 1 or more damage this round, kill it.
cards.textHtml: Pick a unit. The next time it takes 1 or more damage this round, kill it.
cards.flavor: Headmistress Telsi spoke at length about the Noxian tenets, leaving the children before her increasingly bored and restless. But, while most students largely contained their outbursts, Annie acted. First with smoke, then with fire.

cards.name: Manasoul Student
cards.text: Each round, the first time you play a Fast spell, Slow spell, or Skill, I play Magic Embers.
cards.textHtml: Each round, the first time you play a <link=keyword.Fast><sprite name=Fast><style=Keyword>Fast</style></link> spell, <link=keyword.Slow><sprite name=Slow><style=Keyword>Slow</style></link> spell, or <link=keyword.Skill><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Skill</style></link>, I play <link=card.skill><style=AssociatedCard>Magic Embers</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "First time I met Daani must've been a couple years ago. Lovely lad. Lovely family, too. Then, on my last trip, I stopped by his village and found poor Daani sat in the square, alone. Said he was waiting for his family to come home. Poor lad must've been sat there months. Didn't have the heart to tell him what I'd seen down the way..." - Fynn Retrick

cards.name: Magic Embers
cards.text: Deal 1 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml: Deal 1 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: "Whoa... I can SEE the magic!" - Manasoul Student

cards.name: Lord Broadmane
cards.text:
Play: Deal 2 to an enemy.
Your Fast spells, Slow spells, and Skills have "When I damage a Stunned or damaged enemy, kill it."
cards.textHtml:
<link=keyword.PlaySkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Play</style></link>: Deal 2 to an enemy.
Your <link=keyword.Fast><sprite name=Fast><style=Keyword>Fast</style></link> spells, <link=keyword.Slow><sprite name=Slow><style=Keyword>Slow</style></link> spells, and <link=keyword.Skill><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Skills</style></link> have "When I damage a <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stunned</style></link> or damaged enemy, kill it."
cards.flavor: "Act Two: A duplicitous lord with little to his name but a pilfered Kashuri gauntlet charms an audience of Ionians. However, his mask is crude, and easily seen through. He begs for his life, claiming ignorance. The iron hand he sought to rule with lies empty."

cards.name: Kashuri Gauntlet
cards.text: Deal 2 to an enemy.
cards.textHtml: Deal 2 to an enemy.
cards.flavor: Fine tools are wasted on the unsophisticated craftsman.

cards.name: Ravenbloom Conservatory
cards.text:
Countdown 11: Create a Tybaulk in hand.
I advance 1 round for each Fast spell, Slow spell, or Skill you've played this game.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Countdown><style=Vocab>Countdown 11</style></link>: Create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Tybaulk</style></link> in hand.
I <link=vocab.Advance><style=Vocab>advance</style></link> 1 round for each <link=keyword.Fast><sprite name=Fast><style=Keyword>Fast</style></link> spell, <link=keyword.Slow><sprite name=Slow><style=Keyword>Slow</style></link> spell, or <link=keyword.Skill><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Skill</style></link> you've played this game. <style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor:
"...by now, word has no doubt reached you of the Roseguard Academy's dismal failure. I expect you will learn from your sister school's failings. I expect you will manage your facility in a manner that benefits the empire."
- A scorched letter found in the conservatory's rubble

cards.name: Tybaulk
cards.text: When I'm summoned, grant allies everywhere +1|+0 and for the rest of the game, all of your spells and Skills deal 1 extra damage.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, grant allies <link=vocab.Everywhere><style=Vocab>everywhere</style></link> +1|+0 and for the rest of the game, all of your spells and <link=keyword.Skill><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Skills</style></link> deal 1 extra damage.
cards.flavor:
"...it burns in me. This dark presence. It whispers to me. Fire. FIRE. In the flames, I see its eyes. Black and unblinking. Staring. Smiling. Urging me to step in. Urging me to join the rest. Silhouettes in the inferno. Reaching out. Come home. Come home."
- Remains of a decrepit Nockmirchian diary

cards.name: The Gray Apothecary
cards.text: When an ally with 5+ Power dies, create a random follower with 5+ Power in hand.
cards.textHtml: When an ally with 5+ Power dies, create a random follower with 5+ Power in hand.
cards.flavor:
"Today I found myself thinking back to my small infirmary in Penrose Hill, and the years I spent there trying to unlock the secrets of physiology. Years! I've now been in Lady Noradi's employ for just a few short months, but I know now that I learned nothing. How simple I was. How fortunate."
- Notes from Dr. Esslanger

cards.name: Legion Deserter
cards.text: I gain all allied everywhere buffs.
cards.textHtml: I gain all allied <link=vocab.Everywhere><style=Vocab>everywhere</style></link> buffs.
cards.flavor: "Act One: An ex-soldier, having abandoned his post following the theft of an ancient Kashuri artifact, hides at a Qayanvi bar, full of arrogance and too much drink. Little does he know, his stolen treasure whispers of all it sees to its true owner! His life pours away like so much wine, Noxian crimson on Ionian gold."

cards.name: Captive Yeti
cards.text: Reputation: I cost 4 less.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Reputation><style=Vocab>Reputation</style></link>: I cost 4 less. <style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor: The crowd gasped as the two shackled yetis were brought into the Bordent's legendary fighting pit. No one thought the beasts strong enough to break their chains, because none of them had ever faced a yeti's might before.

cards.name: Obedient Drakehound
cards.text: When an ally attacks, I attack with it.
cards.textHtml: When an ally attacks, I attack with it.
cards.flavor: "Drakehounds are a delight, aren't they? So eager to please. So malleable. If only my enemies held the same qualities." - Thorn of the Rose

cards.name: Strategic Execution
cards.text: Stun 2 enemies or spend 6 mana to summon a Legion General.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> 2 enemies or spend 6 mana to summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Legion General</style></link>. <style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor: Assignment is one of the first great decisions that lies before every battle. A good commander knows that the key to victory...

cards.name: Strategic Execution
cards.text: Stun 2 enemies.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> 2 enemies.
cards.flavor: ... is a good defense.

cards.name: Strategic Execution
cards.text: Summon a Legion General.
cards.textHtml: Summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Legion General</style></link>. <style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor: ... is a good offense.

cards.name: Noxian Tellstones
cards.text: Create a Fleeting Sharpened Resolve, Whirling Death, or Weapons of the Lost in hand.
cards.textHtml: Create a <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> <link=card.create1><style=AssociatedCard>Sharpened Resolve</style></link>, <link=card.create2><style=AssociatedCard>Whirling Death</style></link>, or <link=card.create3><style=AssociatedCard>Weapons of the Lost</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: "Clara darling, you have to clean the blood from the tokens." - Ophelia Noradi, Crimson Aristocrat

cards.name: Trifarian Training Pits
cards.text: Each round, the first time an ally with 5+ Power attacks, Rally.
cards.textHtml: Each round, the first time an ally with 5+ Power attacks, <link=vocab.Rally><style=Vocab>Rally</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "At my command, you will fight! If you kill your sparring partner, find another! If you fall, then die knowing your death made Noxus stronger! Trifarian soldiers... begin!" - Trifarian Assessor

cards.name: Solitude
cards.text:
When I'm summoned, summon a random Husk.
When you summon a 1 cost ally, grant it a random keyword.
cards.textHtml:
When I'm summoned, summon a random Husk.
When you summon a 1 cost ally, grant it a random keyword.
cards.flavor:
"On my walk home from the Entresol, I saw again that poor vagabond sobbing in a small alleyway. That so many veer around her so pointedly breaks my heart as much as her own palpable dismay. So, tomorrow, should we cross paths again, I will endeavor to help her in any way I can."
- Notes from Lady Sempescu's diary

cards.name: Discreet Invitation
cards.text: Create a Fleeting Shady Character or Chempunk Shredder in hand and reduce its cost by 1.
cards.textHtml: Create a <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> <link=card.create1><style=AssociatedCard>Shady Character</style></link> or <link=card.create2><style=AssociatedCard>Chempunk Shredder</style></link> in hand and reduce its cost by 1.
cards.flavor: Zaun's best night life is invite-only. If you're not in the band, you've gotta really be somebody to snag a spot. Or find a ticket on the ground.

cards.name: Sputtering Songspinner
cards.text: Pick one of two new 2 cost spells to create in hand and set its cost to 0 this round. Repeat two more times.
cards.textHtml: Pick one of two new 2 cost spells to create in hand and set its cost to 0 this round. Repeat two more times.
cards.flavor: Zaun's first songspinner was surprisingly reliable. The only downside was that nobody could figure out how to control the volume.

cards.name: Scavenged Camocloaker
cards.text: Grant an ally Elusive and "Nexus Strike: Draw 1."
cards.textHtml: Grant an ally <link=keyword.Elusive><sprite name=Elusive><style=Keyword>Elusive</style></link> and "<link=vocab.NexusStrike><style=Vocab>Nexus Strike</style></link>: Draw 1."
cards.flavor: "You guys won't BELIEVE what I found today!" - Sumpsnipe Scavenger

cards.name: Salvaged Scrap
cards.text: To play, discard up to 2 cards. Create that many followers from your regions that cost 1 more and reduce their costs by 1.
cards.textHtml: To play, discard up to 2 cards. Create that many followers from your regions that cost 1 more and reduce their costs by 1.
cards.flavor: Down in the depths of Zaun, the locals are forced to turn the scraps and the dregs they salvage into workable material. After decades of practice, they've become rather good at it.

cards.name: Evil Imperfectionist
cards.text: Play: Pick a card in hand. Create 4 exact copies of it in your deck and reduce their costs by 1.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Pick a card in hand. Create 4 exact copies of it in your deck and reduce their costs by 1.
cards.flavor:
"Well, all I'm gonna say about today is that things could have gone better. Gonna leave it at that. Future me... you know what we did."
- Kay's diary

cards.name: Piltovan Tellstones
cards.text: Create a Fleeting Aftershock, Hextech Transmogulator, or Progress Day! in hand.
cards.textHtml: Create a <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> <link=card.create1><style=AssociatedCard>Aftershock</style></link>, <link=card.create2><style=AssociatedCard>Hextech Transmogulator</style></link>, or <link=card.create3><style=AssociatedCard>Progress Day!</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: "You won't find a finer set of pieces anywhere in the world, good sir. My daughter put her heart into every last detail." - Corin Reveck

cards.name: Bard
cards.text:
Origin: The Wandering Caretaker.
Attack: Plant 3 Chimes in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Origin><style=Vocab>Origin</style></link>: <link=card.origin><style=AssociatedCard>The Wandering Caretaker</style></link>.
<link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Plant 3 <link=card.chime><style=AssociatedCard>Chimes</style></link> in your deck.
cards.levelup: You've increased the total stats of allies in play or hand by 20+.
cards.flavor: "Aye, Old Gaff's seen his share o' strange! First time was the Caretaker 'imself, I reckon. Like a star streamin' 'cross the sky, he was. Felt like the whole world stopped a minute, and it was just me 'n' him…" - Old Gaff’s tale, part 1

cards.name: Chime
cards.text: Grant a random ally in hand +1|+1.
cards.textHtml: Grant a random ally in hand +1|+1.
cards.flavor: On still windless nights, cast your eyes to the heavens and listen for the soft symphony of tinkling chimes. In that moment you will know that He is watching.

cards.name: Bard
cards.text:
Attack: Plant 6 Chimes in your deck.
When you activate a Chime, grant +1|+1 to a random ally in play.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Plant 6 <link=card.chime><style=AssociatedCard>Chimes</style></link> in your deck.
When you activate a <link=card.chime><style=AssociatedCard>Chime</style></link>, grant +1|+1 to a random ally in play.
cards.flavor:
"Sound the horn for the young and old
Sound it loud for all to behold. 
Kings bow down and sing their praise
To The Caretaker and his curious ways." - Runeterran Ballad

cards.name: Bard's Traveler's Call
cards.text:
Draw a follower, then activate the effects of all boons in the top 3 cards of your deck.
Create a Bard in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
Draw a follower, then activate the effects of all boons in the top 3 cards of your deck.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Bard</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: Songs tell of Bard hiding chimes amongst the towns of Runeterra, said to raise spirits and inspire spontaneous bouts of joyful dance.

cards.name: The Wandering Caretaker
cards.text:
You may put any cards that plant Chimes into your deck during deckbuilding. 
Round Start: If you have 3+ mana gems, plant a Chime in your deck for each Bard that started the game in your deck.

cards.flavor: A mysterious traveler from beyond the cosmos, Bard is a being of harmony and balance, whose ear is attuned to the symphony of creation and the discord within. Surrounded by a choir of peculiar creatures, known as meeps, the Wandering Caretaker's curious works are celebrated in songs and stories across Runeterra.

cards.flavor: The priestess' pupils were blown wide, and her hand trembled with nervous excitement. She was ready. This was the single moment Evelynn craved more than any other. She grinned, and slowly shed her visage. Then, as always, the screaming began.

cards.name: Desperate Husk

cards.textHtml: When you play an ally, kill me to grant it my stats and positive keywords.
cards.flavor: "Not enough! More." - Vora

cards.textHtml: When you play an ally, kill me to grant it my stats and positive keywords.

cards.name: Scattered Husk

cards.textHtml: When you play an ally, kill me to grant it my stats and positive keywords.

cards.text:

cards.flavor: As Evelynn stalked Runeterra, she attracted the attentions of lesser demons, each hoping to destroy the Widowmaker and feast on her power. She butchered most, of course, but a few talented individuals caught her eye. Today, they live on, bound to their mistress, and when the mood strikes, Evelynn lets them out to play.

cards.flavor: Dharna remembered throwing open the windows that morning and smelling the freshly baked loaves. Down the way, fishermen had already began hauling the day's catch up to the noon markets. She remembered smiling, thinking it would be a fine day.

cards.name: Belvethi Elder
cards.text: <style=Variable></style>
cards.textHtml: <style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor: Shalatai reeled at the horror before her. There lay Ferai, the kind butcher's daughter, crushed to death. Beside her was Gorrub, the fisherman's son, still reaching toward his love with lifeless hands. So many memories gone. So many lives lost. With a grimace, Shalatai turned to the evil, ready to give her life to save the rest of her people.

cards.name: Kai'Sa
cards.text: When I'm summoned or Round Start: If you have the attack token, create a Second Skin in hand.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned or <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: If you have the attack token, create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Second Skin</style></link> in hand.
cards.levelup: You've Evolved.
cards.flavor: Just a few days prior, Kai'Sa noticed her second skin bristling with new excitement, pulling her with ever-increasing vigor toward the Shuriman coast. Something was wrong, and as Kai'Sa neared Belveth, she soon realized the scale of the horror unfolding before her.

cards.name: Kai'Sa's Supercharge

cards.flavor: Kai'Sa worked as fast as she could. Another salvo tore through another abomination, sending it crashing to the ground. She had learned how to fight the Void long ago, but these creatures... they were different.

cards.name: Void Blaster
cards.text: <style=Variable></style>
cards.textHtml: <style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor: The Void eruption in the city of Belveth was both sudden and terrifying. Most of the civilians were terrified by the chaos that quickly enveloped the city, and fled for safety as fast as they were able. Most, but not Koyemi.

cards.flavor: "We had heard tales of Void breaches before, and the devastation that came with them. But to see it myself... I don't know that I will ever rid my eyes of that sight, or my heart of that horror." - Belveth survivor

cards.name: Hive Herald
cards.text: Play: Grant a unit and me each other's positive keywords.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Grant a unit and me each other's positive keywords. <style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor: "It spoke to me as... as if it knew me. Like it wanted me to meet... something..." - Kai'Sa

cards.textHtml:
When I'm summoned, summon a random Husk.

cards.flavor: Sometimes, all the powerful want is to feel powerless.

cards.name: Chamber of Renewal
cards.text: When you summon a champion, destroy me to grant it +2|+1 and SpellShield.
cards.textHtml: When you summon a champion, destroy me to grant it +2|+1 and <link=keyword.SpellShield><sprite name=SpellShield><style=Keyword>SpellShield</style></link>.
cards.flavor: Nasus emerged from the sarcophagus, his mind clear and his wounds fully healed. He scribbled a few notes and peered at the sarcophagi hanging high above, pondering the mental state of the beastly aberrations resting within. Time would tell if this magic could bring the baccai back from their insanity, a magic the other Ascended had once protested. But they were gone now and Renekton and his madness were not. Nasus scribbled a few more words, hoping he had finally found a way to save his brother.

cards.name: Baccai Witherclaw
cards.text:
Play: Grant an enemy Vulnerable.
When an enemy is Challenged, give it -2|-0 this round.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Grant an enemy <link=keyword.Vulnerable><sprite name=Vulnerable><style=Keyword>Vulnerable</style></link>.
When an enemy is <link=keyword.Challenger><sprite name=Challenger><style=Keyword>Challenged</style></link>, give it -2|-0 this round.
cards.flavor: Their sanity withered away like dunes in the wind--and in its place, a seed of anger flourished into a fury no desert waters could quench.

cards.flavor: "A game of Tellstones is never about who wins--it's about how great you look while playing!" - Akshan

cards.name: Sands of Time

cards.textHtml: Give enemies -2|-0 this round. Create a <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Instant Century</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: The sands of time flow without thought or consideration. Theirs is a scheme of cruel indifference, but not all are slave to its callous machinations...

cards.name: Ghastly Band
cards.flavor: Their repertoire was impressive, from minuets and waltzes to ballads and folk songs, but truth be told, the party's guests were dying for something new.

cards.name: Gwen
cards.text: Attack: When another ally gains Power from Hallowed, so do I. Drain 2 from the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: When another ally gains Power from <link=keyword.Hallowed><sprite name=Hallowed><style=Keyword>Hallowed</style></link>, so do I. <link=keyword.Drain><style=Keyword>Drain</style></link> 2 from the enemy Nexus.
cards.levelup: I've dealt 10+ damage.
cards.flavor: Gwen snip-snip-snipped her way through the Black Mist, thinking it strange how completely it enveloped the area, and once she had, the enchanted manse stood out amongst the bleak woods like a beacon. Little wonder Gwen was drawn to it. How curious it was--but also, how grand!

cards.name: Gwen
cards.text: Attack: When another ally gains Power from Hallowed, so do I. Drain 1 from the enemy Nexus one time for every 2 Power I have.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: When another ally gains Power from <link=keyword.Hallowed><sprite name=Hallowed><style=Keyword>Hallowed</style></link>, so do I. <link=keyword.Drain><style=Keyword>Drain</style></link> 1 from the enemy Nexus one time for every 2 Power I have.
cards.flavor: She knew that the Black Mist must be driven back from wherever it had spread to, and the joy and light these spirits lent her efforts cut through it readily. If she could help their celebration in the meantime, all the better!

cards.name: Gwen's Thread the Needle

Create a Gwen in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
Kill an ally to deal damage equal to its Power to an enemy.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Gwen</style></link> in your deck.

cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Revive an attacking <link=keyword.Ephemeral><sprite name=Ephemeral><style=Keyword>Ephemeral</style></link> copy of the <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> dead ally other than <link=card.me><style=AssociatedCard>Eternal Dancers</style></link> with my power or less.
cards.flavor: It's always easier to join someone on the dance floor than be the first person on it. The twins, however, are always delighted to show others how it's done.

cards.textHtml: Summon two <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Ghastly Bands</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "Keep it lively! Double-time!" - Conductor of the Mists

cards.name: Boisterous Host
cards.flavor:
"We CORDIALLY INVITE you to the party of a lifetime at THE MIDNIGHT REVEL. Join us in celebration at PORCELAIN MANSE for drink, dance, and delight! (Celebrations to end promptly at the 13th hour)" 
- An invitation written in elegant cursive

cards.name: Vora
cards.text: When I'm summoned, summon a random Husk.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, summon a random Husk.
cards.flavor: Unlike other demons, who lure their victims in with false pretenses, Vora is too single-minded in her craving, too overwhelmed by desire. Rather than a predator who stalks her food, she is a wild beast who must be fed.

cards.name: Sultur
cards.text: When I'm summoned, summon a random Husk.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, summon a random Husk.
cards.flavor:
"Beware those who smile on these haunted isles. Perhaps they are too newly arrived to understand the brutality of this place. Perhaps they are crazed. Perhaps they are something else entirely. But beware."
- Notes from Jens Tommen

cards.flavor: "Be as loud as you like." - Evelynn

cards.name: Ghostly Paramour
cards.flavor: Whether he was a ghost, a memory, or a dream, something about him was familiar...

cards.name: Conductor Of The Mists
cards.text: Last Breath: Create a Ghastly Band in hand.

cards.flavor: "Play on, my friends! We will have a livelier concert than ever before!"

cards.name: Thread the Needle

cards.textHtml: Kill an ally to deal damage equal to its Power to an enemy.
cards.flavor: "Needles out!" - Gwen

cards.name: Phantom Butler

cards.flavor: The sound of sword on shield was like a death knell, and it drew forth spirits whose tethers to the world had not quite been cut, whose will could not be quelled even in death.
