cards.flavor: "Polished... decorations. Tokens... learn rules. Curious game. Breathtaking... unparalleled craftsmanship... unforgettable." - Recovered journal

cards.name: Harrowing Return
cards.text: Revive the strongest dead allied follower and grant it Ephemeral and Fearsome. Give enemies -1|-0 this round.
cards.textHtml: Revive the <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> dead allied follower and grant it <link=keyword.Ephemeral><sprite name=Ephemeral><style=Keyword>Ephemeral</style></link> and <link=keyword.Fearsome><sprite name=Fearsome><style=Keyword>Fearsome</style></link>. Give enemies -1|-0 this round.
cards.flavor: Spirits can be banished for a time, but they always return.

cards.name: Undergrowth
cards.text:
Toss 3.
Drain 2 from a unit.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Toss><style=Vocab>Toss</style></link> 3.
<link=keyword.Drain><style=Keyword>Drain</style></link> 2 from a unit.
cards.flavor: Even in the Shadow Isles, old growth still finds new purpose.

cards.name: Magical Journey
cards.text: Plant a Mysterious Portal in the top 4 cards of your deck and plant a Chime on the top card of your deck.
cards.textHtml: Plant a <link=card.portal><style=AssociatedCard>Mysterious Portal</style></link> in the top 4 cards of your deck and plant a <link=card.chime><style=AssociatedCard>Chime</style></link> on the top card of your deck.
cards.flavor: Wandering through the various realms as he pleases, Bard listens, knowing that a great conflict approaches - one that could silence the song of creation.

cards.name: Norra
cards.text: Nexus Strike: Plant a Mysterious Portal in the top 4 cards of your deck.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.NexusStrike><style=Vocab>Nexus Strike</style></link>: Plant a <link=card.portal><style=AssociatedCard>Mysterious Portal</style></link> in the top 4 cards of your deck.
cards.levelup: You've summoned 6+ created allies.
cards.flavor: Norra’s worked quickly, thoughts of home in mind. Portalwork was notoriously tricky business, and she hadn’t even had her first cup of tea yet. But Norra loved a good puzzle, especially the type that found her hopelessly lost in pocket dimensions between space and time. She worked faster, thinking fondly of her cat, who would be worried and expecting dinner.

cards.name: Norra's Portalpalooza
cards.text:
Plant 2 Mysterious Portals in the top 4 cards of your deck.
Draw 1.
Create a Norra in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
Plant 2 <link=card.portal><style=AssociatedCard>Mysterious Portals</style></link> in the top 4 cards of your deck.
Draw 1.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Norra</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor:
“I ought to take the Low Roads more often! Silly me, I always forget to mind my head...“
- Norra

cards.name: Norra
cards.text:
Your Mysterious Portals now summon 4, 5, 6, or 7 cost followers instead.
Nexus Strike: Plant a Mysterious Portal in the top 4 cards of your deck.
cards.textHtml:
Your <link=card.portal><style=AssociatedCard>Mysterious Portals</style></link> now summon 4, 5, 6, or 7 cost followers instead.
<link=vocab.NexusStrike><style=Vocab>Nexus Strike</style></link>: Plant a <link=card.portal><style=AssociatedCard>Mysterious Portal</style></link> in the top 4 cards of your deck.
cards.flavor: With a whiz and a snap, the totem’s various bits and bobs sprang to life, a knick-knack spinning here, a doohickey flashing there. As the room rumbled and groaned, a portal materialized high above, and the vague silhouette of cat ears appeared within. Norra squealed, spilling her tea in delight. Had she finally found the way home?

cards.name: Mysterious Portal
cards.text: Summon a random 2 or 3 cost follower. If your board is full, create a 0 cost Fleeting copy in hand instead.
cards.textHtml: Summon a random 2 or 3 cost follower. If your board is full, create a 0 cost <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> copy in hand instead.
cards.flavor: Another mysterious portal... where would this one lead?

cards.name: Living Library
cards.text: When I'm summoned, if one of your traps or boons has activated this round, draw 1.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, if one of your traps or boons has activated this round, draw 1.
cards.flavor: Considering it his duty to possess immense knowledge, he collects tomes from various travelers who have passed through Realm’s End. Unfortunately, all of this knowledge appears to have gone to his head.

cards.name: Portalpalooza
cards.text:
Plant 2 Mysterious Portals in the top 4 cards of your deck.
Draw 1.
cards.textHtml:
Plant 2 <link=card.portal><style=AssociatedCard>Mysterious Portals</style></link> in the top 4 cards of your deck.
Draw 1.
cards.flavor:
“I ought to take the Low Roads more often! Silly me, I always forget to mind my head...“
- Norra

cards.name: The Tea Maker
cards.text: When I'm summoned, plant a Mysterious Portal in the top 4 cards of your deck.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, plant a <link=card.portal><style=AssociatedCard>Mysterious Portal</style></link> in the top 4 cards of your deck.
cards.flavor: Ashane was once a renowned tea maker before finding herself lost in Realm’s End. While experimenting with new flavors, an unfortunate blend of two leaves had put her into a deep sleep--she dreamed strange dreams about odd creatures and impossible structures, silhouetted against an endless horizon. But upon waking, she discovered it had been no dream at all.

cards.name: Origami Slicer
cards.text: Give me +1|+0 for each of your traps or boons that was activated this round.
cards.textHtml: Give me +1|+0 for each of your traps or boons that was activated this round.
cards.flavor: The magic of papercraft can be somewhat unpredictable. It is as much about the intention that goes into creating something new as the creation's desire to be shaped.

cards.name: Junk Construct
cards.text: Last Breath: Plant a Mysterious Portal in the top 4 cards of your deck.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>Last Breath</style></link>: Plant a <link=card.portal><style=AssociatedCard>Mysterious Portal</style></link> in the top 4 cards of your deck.
cards.flavor: He’d only been born the day before, but Marv--as Norra affectionally called him--took great pride in serving as her assistant. However, he sternly insisted on being referred to as "junk" and not "trash", as the latter held a negative connotation.

cards.name: Puzzling Signposts
cards.text: Return a Fast or Slow spell to hand or destroy a unit's Equipment. Draw 1.
cards.textHtml: Return a <link=keyword.Fast><sprite name=Fast><style=Keyword>Fast</style></link> or <link=keyword.Slow><sprite name=Slow><style=Keyword>Slow</style></link> spell to hand or destroy a unit's <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equipment</style></link>. Draw 1.
cards.flavor: "Dear me! Was it this way, that way, or... this-a-that-way? I never can remember!" - Norra

cards.name: Realm's Caretaker
cards.text: Each round, the first time one of your traps or boons activate, give allies +1|+1 and Impact this round.
cards.textHtml: Each round, the first time one of your traps or boons activate, give allies +1|+1 and <link=keyword.Impact><sprite name=Impact><style=Keyword>Impact</style></link> this round.
cards.flavor: Gaspar was the first yordle to arrive in Realm’s End. For many years, he wandered alone amidst the twisting paths and portals that all seemed to lead nowhere. Having decided that no one should ever have to do the same, he now helps other lost travelers find their way home.

cards.name: Blooming Cultist
cards.text: Once you've Equipped an ally this game, grant me Elusive.
cards.textHtml: Once you've <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equipped</style></link> an ally this game, grant me <link=keyword.Elusive><sprite name=Elusive><style=Keyword>Elusive</style></link>.
cards.flavor: Person, plant, animal... the Darkin's corruptive influence spares no one and nothing.

cards.name: The Darkin Staff
cards.text:
Strike: Refill 1 spell mana.
You may spend 8 mana to play me as Baalkux.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>Strike</style></link>: Refill 1 spell mana.
You may spend 8 mana to play me as <link=card.unit><style=AssociatedCard>Baalkux</style></link>.
cards.flavor: The bandlewood seemed a perfect place to hide a Darkin weapon, they reasoned. Bandlewoods are, by their very nature, impossible to navigate, and the yordles would know to steer clear of such abject malevolence. But the Targonians failed to realize the efficacy of such strange magic, and the effects it would have over the local flora.

cards.name: Baalkux
cards.text: When you spend spell mana, grant me Impact for every spell mana you spend.
cards.textHtml: When you spend spell mana, grant me <link=keyword.Impact><sprite name=Impact><style=Keyword>Impact</style></link> for every spell mana you spend.
cards.flavor: Baalkux felt the tree's limbs grip the staff inside which he lay dormant. Quickly, he gripped back. His life erupted from the darkin staff and coursed through the tree's ancient boughs and branches. There was no heart to control here. No blood to bend. Baalkux could finally return to his general, and atone for his past transgressions.

cards.name: The Darkin Staff
cards.text: Strike: Refill 1 spell mana.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>Strike</style></link>: Refill 1 spell mana.
cards.flavor: The bandlewood seemed a perfect place to hide a Darkin weapon, they reasoned. They are, at their core, impossible to navigate, and the yordles would know to steer clear of such abject malevolence. But the Targonians failed to realize the efficacy of bandle magic, and the effects it would have over the local flora.

cards.name: Eclectic Collection
cards.text: For each ally, plant a Mysterious Portal and 3 Chimes in the top 10 cards of your deck and plant a Flashbomb Trap and 3 Poison Puffcaps in the enemy deck.
cards.textHtml: For each ally, plant a <link=card.portal><style=AssociatedCard>Mysterious Portal</style></link> and 3 <link=card.chime><style=AssociatedCard>Chimes</style></link> in the top 10 cards of your deck and plant a <link=card.flashbomb><style=AssociatedCard>Flashbomb Trap</style></link> and 3 <link=card.puffcap><style=AssociatedCard>Poison Puffcaps</style></link> in the enemy deck.
cards.flavor:
"Portals, portals, everywhere!"
- Norra

cards.name: Mechapulverizer
cards.text: To play, discard 1.
cards.textHtml: To play, discard 1.
cards.flavor: "Behold! From the ruins of a sunken ferry, I fetched the boxing glove. From the depths of the city they call Zaun, I recovered springs, and from the forges of Demacia, I found metal! This is truly a creation of the world!" - Paparo the Great

cards.name: The Sudden Surge
cards.text:
Once you've Equipped an ally this game, I cost 2 less. 
Grow an ally to 4|4 this round.
cards.textHtml:
Once you've <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equipped</style></link> an ally this game, I cost 2 less. 
Grow an ally to 4|4 this round.
cards.flavor: "There is so much power in us." - Varus

cards.name: Skrappy's Partsapalooza
cards.text: When I'm discarded, summon me. When you summon a Mecha Yordle, grant it a random keyword.
cards.textHtml: When I'm discarded, summon me. When you summon a Mecha Yordle, grant it a random keyword.
cards.flavor: Big or small, inanimate or otherwise, if there's a doodad you want found, try Skrappy's! Just don't ask Skrappy where it is, because she is not a believer in cataloguing.

cards.name: Curious Changelings
cards.text: When an allied follower transforms into another follower, transform me into an exact copy of it.
cards.textHtml: When an allied follower transforms into another follower, transform me into an exact copy of it.
cards.flavor: Chameleon see, chameleon be.

cards.name: Poro Stories
cards.text: Create 3 random 1 cost Poros in hand.
cards.textHtml: Create 3 random 1 cost Poros in hand.
cards.flavor: "...AN' DEN DA PORO WAS LIKE "HEY YOU I WANNA SNAX TOO!" SO DA POROS GATHERED TOGETHER AT DA GREAT MEETING OF DA POROS TO TALK ABOUT ALL DA PORO PROBLEMS LIKE WHERE ARE DA SNAX AND WHY AREN'T THERE MORE POROS AND..." - Ingvar the Younger

cards.name: Sharesies
cards.text: Give an ally with an attachment the stats and keywords of its attachment this round and move the attachment to another ally.
cards.textHtml: Give an ally with an attachment the stats and keywords of its attachment this round and move the attachment to another ally.
cards.flavor: You’d think a shepherd would have no place on the battlefield, but the skillset has surprising utility. You just have to think about all the combatants as sheep in need of herding.

cards.name: Banana Blaster
cards.text: Play: Deal damage equal to my Power to a unit.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.PlaySkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Play</style></link>: Deal damage equal to my Power to a unit.
cards.flavor: “HEY! ANYBODY NEED SOME POTASSIUM?” - Nanners, just moments before “The Incident”

cards.name: Rotten Banana
cards.text: Deal damage equal to my Power.
cards.textHtml: <style=Variable>Deal damage equal to my Power.</style>
cards.flavor: Believe it or not, very overripe bananas can still be healthy! Just don’t tell Nanners. Please, please don’t tell Nanners.

cards.name: Test of Spirit
cards.text: Give an enemy Vulnerable this round. If it dies this round, deal 1 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml: Give an enemy <link=keyword.Vulnerable><sprite name=Vulnerable><style=Keyword>Vulnerable</style></link> this round. If it dies this round, deal 1 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: "Will you stand, or cower?" - Illaoi

cards.name: The Darkin Harpoon
cards.text:
Attack: Draw 1 at next Round Start and grant it Fleeting. 
You may spend 9 mana to play me as Ibaaros.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Draw 1 at next <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link> and grant it <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link>. 
You may spend 9 mana to play me as <link=card.unit><style=AssociatedCard>Ibaaros</style></link>.
cards.flavor:
"Steer clear, steer clear, of the strait of Daray,
Where the waters whisper and the winds betray,
Where sea beast and bird so seldom foray,
For fear o' the darkness deep 'neath the strait of Daray."
- Bilgewater rhyme

cards.name: Ibaaros
cards.text: I have +1|+1 for each card you've drawn this game. I can only be blocked by enemies with 4 or more Power.
cards.textHtml: I have +1|+1 for each card you've drawn this game. I can only be blocked by enemies with 4 or more Power.
cards.flavor: Ibaaros, the Champion of the Dunes, lifted himself through the water. His blood coursed with that same familiar yearning from years before. To serve. To obey. To submit.

cards.name: The Darkin Harpoon
cards.text: Attack: Draw 1 at the next Round Start and grant it Fleeting.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Draw 1 at the next <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link> and grant it <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link>.
cards.flavor:
"Steer clear, steer clear, of the strait of Daray,
Where the waters whisper and the winds betray,
Where sea beast and bird so seldom foray,
For fear o' the darkness deep 'neath the strait of Daray."
- Bilgewater rhyme

cards.name: Jagged Cutlass
cards.text: Plunder: I cost 2 less.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Plunder><style=Keyword>Plunder</style></link>: I cost 2 less.
cards.flavor:
"Like the saying goes, nothin' ends a Bilgewater quarrel faster than a cutlass."
"Except maybe a pistol."
"Shut up, Baz."
- Baz and Gav, aspiring bounty hunters

cards.name: Buhru Cultist
cards.text: When Equipped allies attack, deal 1 to the enemy nexus.
cards.textHtml: When <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equipped</style></link> allies attack, deal 1 to the enemy nexus.
cards.flavor: It didn't matter where the power came from--her goddess would not care. What mattered was the glory it would bring her through the monsters she slayed.

cards.name: Piercing Bolt
cards.text: Deal 1 to the enemy nexus.
cards.textHtml: Deal 1 to the enemy nexus.
cards.flavor: Yes... this weapon will certainly please Mother Serpent.

cards.name: Parts Made Whole
cards.text: To play, discard 1. Draw 2 and if you discarded an equipment, summon a Icathian Mirage.
cards.textHtml: To play, discard 1. Draw 2 and if you discarded an equipment, summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Icathian Mirage</style></link>.
cards.flavor: Jax’s crew is proof that a whole can be greater than the sum of its parts. Still, Pesh insists on a different philosophy: sometimes, parts are pretty great on their own.

cards.name: Piltovan Castaway
cards.text: When I'm summoned, I Improvise.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, I <link=vocab.Improvise><style=Vocab>Improvise</style></link>.
cards.flavor: Pesh met Jax in a dockside brawl, and their timely escape was more convenience than partnership. But Pesh has been ferrying Jax about ever since, because things break around Jax, and if there’s one thing Pesh likes more than a good scrap, it’s a break in need of fixing.

cards.name: Heavy Metal
cards.text: Destroy a unit's equipment and deal 2 to it.
cards.textHtml: Destroy a unit's equipment and deal 2 to it.
cards.flavor: "WHO THROWS AN ANCHOR IN A BAR FIGHT?! WHAT IS WRONG WITH YOU LOT?!!" - Bilgewater Bartender

cards.name: The Unending Wave
cards.text:
Once you've Equipped an ally this game, I cost 2 less.
Draw 2 and grant them Fleeting.
cards.textHtml:
Once you've <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equipped</style></link> an ally this game, I cost 2 less.
Draw 2 and grant them <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link>.
cards.flavor: Though Ibaaros' old bones moved slow, the waters that surged ahead of him moved at an almost incomprehensible speed.

cards.name: Eye of God
cards.text: Attack: Spawn 2.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: <link=vocab.Spawn><style=Vocab>Spawn</style></link> 2.
cards.flavor: "Stand strong beneath Her gaze!" - Illaoi

cards.name: Loaded Vessel
cards.text: Deal 2 to a unit. Draw 1 at the next Round Start for each damage dealt and grant them Fleeting.
cards.textHtml: Deal 2 to a unit. Draw 1 at the next <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link> for each damage dealt and grant them <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "Rex'll take care of the boom, don't you worry - an' I'll take care of the treasure. I'll take care of Rex's share too, elsewise he'll try to put it in the cannon, an' that's always a mess." - Petty Officer

cards.name: Wily Newtfish
cards.text: Nexus Strike: Draw 1 and grant it Fleeting.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.NexusStrike><style=Vocab>Nexus Strike</style></link>: Draw 1 and grant it <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "Nasty, thievin' little monsters, they are. Easy enough to spot 'em when they've filched somethin', at least."

cards.name: Mischievous Marai
cards.text: When you play a spell, summon a Powder Keg.
cards.textHtml: When you play a spell, summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Powder Keg</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "Bibi is a little... unhinged, sure. But that's what we love about her!" - Ai'la, Marai Warden

cards.name: Combat Cook
cards.text: When I'm summoned, I Improvise, then Forge me.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, I <link=vocab.Improvise><style=Vocab>Improvise</style></link>, then <link=vocab.Forge><style=Vocab>Forge</style></link> me.
cards.flavor: After his time in the Demacian military, Breshi thought he’d retire and cook at a quiet hamlet tavern. Jax ruined this retirement with a tavern brawl and a particularly bad opinion on hardboiled eggs. Since then, Breshi’s embraced a new lot in life: teaching Jax some taste.

cards.name: Ranger-Knight Defector
cards.text: Once you've Equipped an ally this game, grant me Scout.
cards.textHtml: Once you've <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equipped</style></link> an ally this game, grant me <link=keyword.Scout><sprite name=Scout><style=Keyword>Scout</style></link>.
cards.flavor: Years of suppressing her magical abilities bred within her a fathomless self-hatred she maliciously unleashed on her victims. Once she had defected from the ranger-knights, her anger was aimless until a voice called in the darkness. It spoke of a new order, one where she could practice her cruelty unfettered.

cards.name: The Darkin Aegis
cards.text: You may spend 5 mana to play me as Joraal.
cards.textHtml: You may spend 5 mana to play me as <link=card.unit><style=AssociatedCard>Joraal</style></link>.
cards.flavor:
"My son, listen now. That shield must never be touched. Long ago, it was gifted to our house on the condition that we keep it safe, and leave it be. It is my responsibility, and when I pass, it will be yours. Do you hear me now? You must never climb to it again. You must never touch it."
"But mama, the voice inside... it cries to me. It sounds so sad."
"...All the more reason, my son."
- Lady Fortis and her son

cards.name: Joraal
cards.text: Your opponent's spells cost 2 more while I am attacking.
cards.textHtml: Your opponent's spells cost 2 more while I am attacking.
cards.flavor: A mighty Ascended tactician known as the Aegis of Eternity, Joraal seemed impervious to attack, even for the immortal god-warriors of Shurima. But the war against the Void raged on, and as resilient as Joraal's body was, it was his mind that broke. And how it broke.

cards.name: The Darkin Aegis
cards.flavor:
"My son, listen now. That shield must never be touched. Long ago, it was gifted to our house on the condition that we keep it safe, and leave it be. It is my responsibility, and when I pass, it will be yours. Do you hear me now? You must never climb to it again. You must never touch it."
"But mama, the voice inside... it cries to me. It sounds so sad."
"...All the more reason, my son."
- Lady Fortis and her son

cards.name: Fish Fight
cards.text: An ally and an enemy strike each other, or an Equipped ally strikes an enemy, then is unequipped.
cards.textHtml: An ally and an enemy <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strike</style></link> each other, or an <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equipped</style></link> ally <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strikes</style></link> an enemy, then is unequipped.
cards.flavor: "Fish, meet face!" - Ionian Hookmaster

cards.name: Fish Fight
cards.text: An ally and an enemy strike each other.
cards.textHtml: An ally and an enemy <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strike</style></link> each other.
cards.flavor: "Fish, meet face!" - Ionian Hookmaster

cards.name: Fish Fight
cards.text: An Equipped ally strikes an enemy, then is unequipped.
cards.textHtml: An <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equipped</style></link> ally <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strikes</style></link> an enemy, then is unequipped.
cards.flavor: "Fish, meet face!" - Ionian Hookmaster

cards.name: Condemn
cards.text:
If you've attacked 2+ times this round, I cost 5 less.
An ally strikes an enemy.
cards.textHtml:
If you've attacked 2+ times this round, I cost 5 less.
An ally <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strikes</style></link> an enemy.
cards.flavor: "Purifying bolts." - Vayne

cards.name: Widowed Huntress
cards.text: Play: Equip me with an equipment that costs 2 or less from hand.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equip</style></link> me with an equipment that costs 2 or less from hand.
cards.flavor: "Though the woman seems a competent enough fighter, her grief is fresh and threatens to overwhelm her. Despair is indeed a compelling motivator--I should know--but unbridled so? Mayhap she is looking to die..." - From the personal journal of Sirius Rowill, Zealous Ranger-Knight

cards.name: Vayne
cards.text: When I'm summoned or Round Start: Create a Tumble in hand or if you have one, reduce its cost by 1.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned or <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Tumble</style></link> in hand or if you have one, reduce its cost by 1.
cards.levelup: I've seen you attack 4 times.
cards.flavor: "Our target was once human, which means it's smarter than your average beast. One wrong move could spell death for us all. Stay within eyesight of one another, call out anything suspicious--but above all else, remember..."

cards.name: Vayne
cards.text: When I'm summoned or Round Start: Create a 0 cost Tumble in hand or if you have one, reduce its cost to 0.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned or <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Create a 0 cost <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Tumble</style></link> in hand or if you have one, reduce its cost to 0.
cards.flavor: "...shoot to kill."

cards.name: Vayne's Condemn
cards.text:
If you've attacked 2+ times this round, I cost 5 less.
An ally strikes an enemy.
Create a Vayne in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
If you've attacked 2+ times this round, I cost 5 less.
An ally <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strikes</style></link> an enemy.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Vayne</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "Purifying bolts." - Vayne

cards.name: Tumble
cards.text: Equip an ally with an equipment in hand that costs 2 or less. It starts a free attack.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equip</style></link> an ally with an equipment in hand that costs 2 or less. It starts a free attack.
cards.flavor: "I bring swift death." - Vayne

cards.name: Catch!
cards.text: Give an ally +1|+1 this round or equip it with an equipment in hand that costs 2 or less.
cards.textHtml: Give an ally +1|+1 this round or <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>equip</style></link> it with an equipment in hand that costs 2 or less.
cards.flavor: This move is more painful if the party hasn't eaten yet.

cards.name: Catch!
cards.text: Equip an ally with an equipment that costs 2 or less.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equip</style></link> an ally with an equipment that costs 2 or less.
cards.flavor: This move is more painful if the party hasn't eaten yet.

cards.name: Catch!
cards.text: Give an ally +1|+1 this round.
cards.textHtml: Give an ally +1|+1 this round.
cards.flavor: This move is more painful if the party hasn't eaten yet.

cards.name: Kind-hearted Recruit
cards.text: When I'm summoned, give Equipped allies Barrier this round.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, give <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equipped</style></link> allies <link=keyword.Barrier><sprite name=Barrier><style=Keyword>Barrier</style></link> this round.
cards.flavor: "The boy is a liability. I was adamant he should not be taken along on our hunt, as still he refers to the foul creature as his 'sister'. It is a naivete so profound, it is frankly revolting. Yet, I suppose I do pity him well enough. At the very least, this will be an important lesson for him." - From the personal journal of Sirius Rowill, Zealous Ranger-Knight

cards.name: Icathian Myths
cards.text: Create an Icathian Mirage in hand that costs 0 this round, or create a Golden Spatula in hand.
cards.textHtml: Create an <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Icathian Mirage</style></link> in hand that costs 0 this round, or create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Golden Spatula</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor:
Legends say the original wielder of the Golden Spatula was a marine creature of outstanding culinary prowess--one who sought to become a warrior as strong and fearless as Jax.

Other, more credible legends say that particular legend was fabricated entirely by a certain cook who was very, VERY lost in the sauce.

cards.name: Icathian Myths
cards.text: Create an Icathian Mirage in hand that costs 0 this round.
cards.textHtml: Create an <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Icathian Mirage</style></link> in hand that costs 0 this round.
cards.flavor:
Legends say the original wielder of the golden spatula was a marine creature of outstanding culinary prowess--one who sought to become a warrior as strong and fearless as Jax.

Other, more credible legends say that particular legend was fabricated entirely by a certain cook who was very, VERY lost in the sauce.

cards.name: Icathian Myths
cards.text: Create a Golden Spatula in hand.
cards.textHtml: Create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Golden Spatula</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor:
Legends say the original wielder of the golden spatula was a marine creature of outstanding culinary prowess--one who sought to become a warrior as strong and fearless as Jax.

Other, more credible legends say that particular legend was fabricated entirely by a certain cook who was very, VERY lost in the sauce.

cards.name: Golden Spatula
cards.flavor: It definitely does something.

cards.name: Zealous Ranger-Knight
cards.text: Attack: Give Equipped allies +1|+1 this round.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Give <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equipped</style></link> allies +1|+1 this round.
cards.flavor:
"Janan, was it? What can you tell me about Sirius?"
"Oh, Ranger-Knight Rowill? A few years ago, he had his title revoked. Apparently, he willfully disregarded every order he was given. Seems he does whatever he wants and doesn't take 'no' for an answer."
"Ah."
"So... why did you let him join this hunt, anyway?"
"I didn't."
"Then, why... oh, right. Fantastic."
- Vayne and Janan, Widowed Huntress

cards.name: Bloodcursed Harpy
cards.text:
Play: Equip me with an equipment that costs 2 or less from hand. 
The first time I would die while Equipped, fully heal me and destroy the equipment instead.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equip</style></link> me with an equipment that costs 2 or less from hand. 
The first time I would die while <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equipped</style></link>, fully heal me and destroy the equipment instead.
cards.flavor:
"Kian, if you're reading this... I'm hopefully dead. I can't control what's happening to me. The blood under my nails won't wash off. I'm so itchy. I scratch and scratch but nothing helps. It hurts. I just want it to stop. If I'm still alive somehow, promise me you'll stop trying to find me.

I would ask for forgiveness, but I don't deserve it. Be good to mother, okay?"
- Crumpled letter found in a torn-up satchel

cards.name: Steadfast Elkin
cards.text: The first time an ally is Equipped, grant me Tough.
cards.textHtml: The first time an ally is <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equipped</style></link>, grant me <link=keyword.Tough><sprite name=Tough><style=Keyword>Tough</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "Back, foul creature! Rend even a single hair from Purity's immaculate coat and I will see that you suffer AN ETERNITY OF AGONY!" - Sirius Rowill, Zealous Ranger-Knight

cards.name: Demacian Steel
cards.flavor: The standard sword and shield of choice for Demacia's helmeted brothers-in-arms.

cards.name: Silence and Suppress
cards.text: Destroy a unit's equipment, and if it's a follower, Silence it.
cards.textHtml: Destroy a unit's equipment, and if it's a follower, <link=vocab.Silence><style=Vocab>Silence</style></link> it.
cards.flavor: "You've brought this upon yourself." - Lord Eldred, Mageseeker Leader

cards.name: Faithful Wolfdog
cards.text:
If an ally died this round, I cost 2 less.
Play: Equip me with an equipment that costs 2 or less from hand and Forge me.
cards.textHtml:
If an ally died this round, I cost 2 less.
<link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equip</style></link> me with an equipment that costs 2 or less from hand and <link=vocab.Forge><style=Vocab>Forge</style></link> me.
cards.flavor: "I've had Maggie since she was a pup. She may be long in the tooth, but she's still sharp as a fresh-whetted blade. I'd give my life for hers--and I know she'd give hers for mine." - Janan, Widowed Huntress

cards.name: Roar of Icathia
cards.text: Summon 2 Icathian Mirages Equipped with up to 2 Equipment in hand that cost 2 or less.
cards.textHtml: Summon 2 <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Icathian Mirages</style></link> <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equipped</style></link> with up to 2 <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equipment</style></link> in hand that cost 2 or less.
cards.flavor: Jax has spent countless dreams fighting alongside his lost kin. Some battles they win, some they lose, but always, they are together.

cards.name: Tempting Prospect
cards.text: Pick a follower or equipment from the top 4 cards of your deck. Draw it, place the rest into your deck.
cards.textHtml: Pick a follower or equipment from the top 4 cards of your deck. Draw it, place the rest into your deck.
cards.flavor: Soft, enticing whispers plant desire deep within the heart. Like a splinter, this festers and grows into hunger. Hunger gives way to transgression, which in turn brings death. And so the cycle continues.

cards.name: Champions' Strength
cards.text: Give allies +4|+4 this round and Rally.
cards.textHtml: Give allies +4|+4 this round and <link=vocab.Rally><style=Vocab>Rally</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "Into battle with hearts aglow!" - Lux

cards.name: Trusty Ramhound
cards.text: The first time you summon an Elite, grant me +2|+2.
cards.textHtml: The first time you summon an Elite, grant me +2|+2.
cards.flavor: "She's not as fast as a silverwing, but you'd be surprised how fast her little legs can carry her." - Cithria, Lady of Clouds

cards.name: Petricite Charger
cards.text: I don't take damage from enemy spells or Skills.
cards.textHtml: I don't take damage from enemy spells or <link=keyword.Skill><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Skills</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "Nothing is stronger than petricite." - Durand Architect

cards.name: Blocking Badgerbear
cards.flavor: “If ye be friend, then ye are welcome here, but woe to any who intrude upon this realm with evil in their heart, for they shall taste the vengeance of its mighty protector!”

cards.name: Weaponsmith's Apprentice
cards.text: The first time you equip an ally, Forge it.
cards.textHtml: The first time you <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>equip</style></link> an ally, <link=vocab.Forge><style=Vocab>Forge</style></link> it.
cards.flavor: Ornn made the living forge many, many years ago, and only went looking for it recently. He never once thought it might go looking for a new owner and wander off on its own.

cards.name: Ornn's Forge
cards.text: When I'm summoned or Round Start: Create a Fleeting Time and Dedication in hand.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned or <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Create a <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Time and Dedication</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: Alone in Hearth-Home's forge with nothing but the sound of the molten river's slow coursing below, and the ring of Hammer on anvil... he quite liked that.

cards.name: Hearthblood Mender
cards.text: Play: Forge an ally twice and heal it and your Nexus 3.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: <link=vocab.Forge><style=Vocab>Forge</style></link> an ally twice and heal it and your Nexus 3.
cards.flavor: The Hearthblood were gone, all of them, when Ornn decided to leave the world. Generations passed and their name was all but forgotten. More recently, however, the tales of Ornn resurfaced, and it was whispered that some had begun to return to the way of the Hearthblood.

cards.name: Adept Weaponsmith
cards.text: Play: Forge an ally.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: <link=vocab.Forge><style=Vocab>Forge</style></link> an ally.
cards.flavor: When Fiske had first envisioned an apprentice, he imagined someone dedicated, serious about their craft, strong, and capable. Kindra was none of those things. She was prone to daydreaming. She would rather play than work. She was always fussing with that silly little turtle of hers. However... she was learning. That was what mattered.

cards.name: Ornn
cards.text:
Play: Equip me with an exact copy of an ally's equipment or the strongest equipment from hand.
Attack: Forge me twice.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equip</style></link> me with an exact copy of an ally's equipment or the <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> equipment from hand.
<link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: <link=vocab.Forge><style=Vocab>Forge</style></link> me twice.
cards.levelup: An ally has struck for 8+ damage in one strike.
cards.flavor: If anyone asked Ornn why he had so little patience, he would answer simply that he did have patience. Tremendous patience, in fact, and that was why his work was incomparable. He simply did not have patience for PEOPLE. But nobody asked, and so he never answered.

cards.name: Ornn
cards.text:
Play: Equip me with an exact copy of an ally's equipment or the strongest equipment from hand.
Attack: Forge me twice, then summon an attacking Spirit of the Ram with my stats.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equip</style></link> me with an exact copy of an ally's equipment or the <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> equipment from hand.
<link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: <link=vocab.Forge><style=Vocab>Forge</style></link> me twice, then summon an attacking <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Spirit of the Ram</style></link> with my stats.
cards.flavor: Some believe that when the world truly needs him, the chosen of Ornn will finally be able to find their god. Isn't that just the way of withdrawn, ornery gods? To be found only in the very last place you look?

cards.name: Ornn's Bellows Breath
cards.text:
Forge an ally and deal 1 to ALL units, then do it again.
Create an Ornn in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Forge><style=Vocab>Forge</style></link> an ally and deal 1 to ALL units, then do it again.
Create an <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Ornn</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "An iron will must be forged!" - Ornn

cards.name: Spirit of the Ram
cards.flavor: "What remains after the fire is either forged, or melted. Better to be steel that takes shape than... something that burns away!" - Ornn

cards.name: Favored Artisan
cards.text: When I'm summoned, create a Time and Dedication in hand.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Time and Dedication</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: "My mother told me of Ornn, as her mother told her, and her mother before... and now I will tell you. Listen closely. Do not interrupt. Long ago, across a great, hot, churning sea..."

cards.name: Time and Dedication
cards.text: Forge an ally.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Forge><style=Vocab>Forge</style></link> an ally.
cards.flavor: "You may be worthy of this. Do not prove me wrong." - Ornn

cards.name: Icevale Cultist
cards.text: Your Equipped allies have Overwhelm.
cards.textHtml: Your <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equipped</style></link> allies have <link=keyword.Overwhelm><sprite name=Overwhelm><style=Keyword>Overwhelm</style></link>.
cards.flavor: The Winter's Claw was right. The Avarosans HAD been too soft. It was time for a new leader, one that would not seek to unify the Freljord through peace, but rule over it.

cards.name: The Darkin Spear
cards.text:
Attack: Grant the top 2 allies in your deck +1|+1.
You may spend 8 mana to play me as Anaakca.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Grant the top 2 allies in your deck +1|+1.
You may spend 8 mana to play me as <link=card.unit><style=AssociatedCard>Anaakca</style></link>.
cards.flavor:
"Warmother, the grip of winter has tightened. The Avarosans have fled beyond their outposts. North is the sea... our only path leads east."
"Do not listen to him, Warmother. That way is the Pale, and beyond it, the whispering wilds. I say better to die than face that cursed land."
"How fortunate for you both that neither must decide my people's fate."
"True, Warmother. But perhaps there is a third way. Let me travel east. Better a scout is lost to darkness than all of our people."
- Warmother Sejuani conferring with her generals

cards.name: Anaakca
cards.text: Attack: From the top 6 cards of your deck, summon an attacking follower or non-Champion Darkin and grant it +1|+1.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: From the top 6 cards of your deck, summon an attacking follower or non-Champion Darkin and grant it +1|+1.
cards.flavor: With newfound vigor, the great warrior Anaakca sped south through the Freljord and into Demacian lands. The outposts prepared as best they could to repel her assault, but no mere mortal would stand between Anaakca's fury and the coward who stoked it.

cards.name: The Darkin Spear
cards.text: Attack: Grant the top 2 allies in your deck +1|+1.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Grant the top 2 allies in your deck +1|+1.
cards.flavor:
"Warmother, the grip of winter has tightened to the east. South, the Avarosans have fled beyond their outposts. North is the sea... our only path leads east."
"No, Warmother. That way is the Pale, and beyond it, the whispering wilds. I say better to die than face that cursed land."
"How fortunate for you both that neither must decide my people's fate."
"True, Warmother. But perhaps there is a third way. Let me travel East. Better a scout is lost to darkness than all of our people."
- Warmother Sejuani, conferring with her generals

cards.name: Fracture
cards.text: Deal 1 to EVERYTHING or destroy a unit's equipment.
cards.textHtml: Deal 1 to EVERYTHING or destroy a unit's equipment.
cards.flavor: The cold spares nothing and no one.

cards.name: Fracture
cards.text: Deal 1 to EVERYTHING.
cards.textHtml: Deal 1 to EVERYTHING.
cards.flavor: The cold spares nothing and no one.

cards.name: Fracture
cards.text: Destroy a unit's equipment.
cards.textHtml: Destroy a unit's equipment.
cards.flavor: The cold spares nothing and no one.

cards.name: Pouty Poro
cards.text: Empowered 3: Overwhelm, Regeneration, and Tough.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Empowered><style=Vocab>Empowered</style></link> 3: <link=keyword.Overwhelm><sprite name=Overwhelm><style=Keyword>Overwhelm</style></link>, <link=keyword.Regeneration><sprite name=Regeneration><style=Keyword>Regeneration</style></link>, and <link=keyword.Tough><sprite name=Tough><style=Keyword>Tough</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "Come on, you have to take your medicine! You won't feel better 'til you do!" - Ingvar the Younger

cards.name: Bellows Breath
cards.text: Forge an ally and deal 1 to ALL units, then do it again.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Forge><style=Vocab>Forge</style></link> an ally and deal 1 to ALL units, then do it again.
cards.flavor: "An iron will must be forged!" - Ornn

cards.name: Wrought Colossus
cards.text: The first time I'm Equipped, create a 4 cost copy of me in hand. Grant it the equipment's stats.
cards.textHtml: The first time I'm <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equipped</style></link>, create a 4 cost copy of me in hand. Grant it the equipment's stats.
cards.flavor: Though he would not admit it, Ornn was quite pleased with the colossi. They served the exact purpose he assigned to them, and best of all, they did not speak.

cards.name: Bone Club
cards.flavor: "Crunch!" - Tarkaz the Tribeless

cards.name: Woolly Snailmoth
cards.text: Empowered 8: Regeneration.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Empowered><style=Vocab>Empowered</style></link> 8: <link=keyword.Regeneration><sprite name=Regeneration><style=Keyword>Regeneration</style></link>.
cards.flavor: While troll aren't typically known for their intellect, they can be surprisingly ingenious.

cards.name: Gift of the Hearthblood
cards.text: Heal your Nexus 4 and grant all allies and equipment in your deck +1|+1. Draw 1 of them.
cards.textHtml: Heal your Nexus 4 and grant all allies and equipment in your deck +1|+1. Draw 1 of them.
cards.flavor: "Come, warm yourself by the fire." - Hearthblood Mender

cards.name: The Unforgiving Cold
cards.text: Frostbite the strongest enemy. If you've Equipped an ally this game, copy me.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Frostbite><sprite name=Frostbite><style=Keyword>Frostbite</style></link> the <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> enemy. If you've <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equipped</style></link> an ally this game, copy me.
cards.flavor: Anaakca moved with such speed that the Freljord itself seemed to follow in her wake. Those who survived her butchery soon felt their skin freeze, and their hearts still.

cards.name: Here to Help
cards.text: Give an ally +0|+3 this round. If it's damaged, give it +2|+3 instead.
cards.textHtml: Give an ally +0|+3 this round. If it's damaged, give it +2|+3 instead.
cards.flavor: "Do not worry, little poro. I am with you!" - Braum

cards.name: Wild Mysticism
cards.text:
Get an empty mana gem.
Summon a Feral Mystic.
cards.textHtml:
Get an empty mana gem.
Summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Feral Mystic</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "The spirits, the stars... again, they bring us together." - Hyara Allseer

cards.name: Warden of the Tribes
cards.text: When I'm summoned, grant allies +1|+1 for each different subtype you’ve summoned this game.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, grant allies +1|+1 for each different subtype you’ve summoned this game. <style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor: "...an' there was a BIG creature that cared for aaaaaaall of the LIL' creatures..." - Ingvar the Younger

cards.name: Winter's Touch
cards.text: Get an empty mana gem. Enlightened: I cost 1. Draw 1.
cards.textHtml: Get an empty mana gem. <link=keyword.Enlightened><style=Keyword>Enlightened</style></link>: I cost 1. Draw 1.
cards.flavor: Strange runes pulse from the facets of the gem in your hand. With an eerie flash their light rises off the surface, curling up your arm in a chilling whorl. But rather than freezing, its chill is invigorating, as though the cold itself imbued you with its essence.

cards.name: Disciple of Doran
cards.text: When I'm summoned, create a Preparation in hand.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Preparation</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor:
"I have learned what knowledge I could to continue this sacred art. As for Doran, and his master, and his master before him... I hope their spirits will guide my hammer."
- Disciple of Doran, handwritten scroll

cards.name: Preparation
cards.text: Reduce the cost of a spell in your hand by 1.
cards.textHtml: Reduce the cost of a spell in your hand by 1.
cards.flavor:
"A warrior is only as able as they are prepared."
- Wuju words of wisdom

cards.name: Master Yi
cards.text: Round Start: Reduce the cost of a spell in your hand by 1 and Flow: Grant all allied Master Yis Everywhere +2|+0.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Reduce the cost of a spell in your hand by 1 and <link=vocab.Flow><style=Vocab>Flow</style></link>: Grant all allied <link=card.selfRef><style=AssociatedCard>Master Yis</style></link> <link=vocab.Everywhere><style=Vocab>Everywhere</style></link> +2|+0.
cards.levelup: Allied Master Yis have dealt 12+ damage.
cards.flavor: Master Yi's mind drifted to the Darkin weapon. Ever since its discovery, he'd been troubled by a terrible sense of foreboding. Some of his students had taken a keen interest–too keen–so he had the curved blades placed under guard, deep within the temple. With some effort, he pushed those thoughts from his mind and continued his meditation. Passing on the teachings of Wuju was all that mattered, and Jun showed great promise.

cards.name: Master Yi
cards.text:
Attack: I immediately strike the Weakest enemy. 
Round Start: Reduce the cost of a spell in your hand by 1 and Flow: Grant all allied Master Yis Everywhere +2|+0.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: I immediately strike the <link=keyword.Weakest><style=Keyword>Weakest</style></link> enemy. 
<link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Reduce the cost of a spell in your hand by 1 and <link=vocab.Flow><style=Vocab>Flow</style></link>: Grant all allied <link=card.selfRef><style=AssociatedCard>Master Yis</style></link> <link=vocab.Everywhere><style=Vocab>Everywhere</style></link> +2|+0.
cards.flavor: From the corner of his eye, Yi saw the flash of steel and heard the unmistakable thud of a lifeless body. Could it have been her? How could he have failed his pupils so utterly? They were untrained and unprepared. But he was a master of Wuju, and neither shame nor shadow would win the day.

cards.name: Master Yi's Wuju Style
cards.text:
Give an ally +2|+0 this round.
Create Meditate in hand. Create a Master Yi in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
Give an ally +2|+0 this round.
Create <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Meditate</style></link> in hand. Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Master Yi</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor:
"One cut, of many."
- Master Yi

cards.name: Jun, the Prodigy
cards.text: The first time I am Equipped, give me Barrier and Lifesteal this round.
cards.textHtml: The first time I am <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equipped</style></link>, give me <link=keyword.Barrier><sprite name=Barrier><style=Keyword>Barrier</style></link> and <link=keyword.Lifesteal><sprite name=Lifesteal><style=Keyword>Lifesteal</style></link> this round.
cards.flavor: At his signal, Jun unleashed a series of blows as precise as any Yi would have made himself. Though he deftly avoided the attack, he bowed before her, pride in his smile.

cards.name: Wuju Style
cards.text:
Give an ally +2|+0 this round.
Create a Meditate in hand.
cards.textHtml:
Give an ally +2|+0 this round.
Create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Meditate</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor:
"One cut, of many."
- Master Yi

cards.name: Meditate
cards.text: Give an ally +0|+2 this round.
cards.textHtml: Give an ally +0|+2 this round.
cards.flavor: "Form before strength." - Master Yi

cards.name: Vastayan Disciple
cards.text: Nexus Strike: Recall me and transform me into Shimon Wind
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.NexusStrike><style=Vocab>Nexus Strike</style></link>: Recall me and transform me into <link=card.spell><style=AssociatedCard>Shimon Wind</style></link>
cards.flavor: Ting grinned as the attackers flooded the temple. Finally, a chance to prove himself! First Wukong, then Yi... both had dismissed his talents. Let the others run to find their "master"! He was ready. He was the Shimon Wind.

cards.name: Shimon Wind
cards.text: Summon a Vastayan Disciple and draw 1.
cards.textHtml: Summon a <link=card.parentRef><style=AssociatedCard>Vastayan Disciple</style></link> and draw 1.
cards.flavor: "Whoosh!" - Ting, the Shimon Wind

cards.name: The Witness
cards.text:
Flow: I cost 2 less.
Play: Stun an enemy.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Flow><style=Vocab>Flow</style></link>: I cost 2 less.
<link=keyword.PlaySkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Play</style></link>: <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> an enemy.
cards.flavor: What is this one's role in this strange and gruesome show? Ah, more than audience, she is observer, the lens through which all things pass and must be held up against truth and beauty. The Witness!

cards.name: Scintillating Artifact
cards.text: Stun an enemy.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> an enemy.
cards.flavor: The Kashuri spies are mostly observers, but they are well-equipped in case they are ever attacked.

cards.name: Dragoncaller
cards.text: Round Start: Flow: Summon The Empyrean and grant it Ephemeral.

cards.flavor: "The shape of the water reflects the shape of your desire. Tell me, wanderer... what do you see?"

cards.name: The Darkin Fan
cards.text:
Attack: Summon an attacking Dragonling. 
You may spend 9 mana to play me as Praa the Breachwalker.

<link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Summon an attacking <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Dragonling</style></link>. 
You may spend 9 mana to play me as <link=card.unit><style=AssociatedCard>Praa the Breachwalker</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "In the bridge between worlds, I have long sensed a shadow that pulses with silent rage. Though I know better than to delve into the darkness after it, the pulse has lately grown stronger, faster--and I fear the creatures of the spirit realm will soon begin searching for it." - Shen

cards.name: Praa the Breachwalker
cards.text: Play, and when I transform: Summon two Ephemeral copies of me. Grant one Lifesteal, one Challenger and me Elusive.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>, and when I transform: Summon two <link=keyword.Ephemeral><sprite name=Ephemeral><style=Keyword>Ephemeral</style></link> copies of me. cards.flavor: His general's call stirred him from slumber. As his senses came to him, Praa found himself looking through a weighted veil to a lush, unfamiliar land. Slowly, inexorably, he stepped through the divide, and buried his feet in Runeterra's soil once more. For Aatrox. For victory. For peace. For death.

cards.text: Attack: Summon an attacking Dragonling.

cards.name: Shadowblade Fanatic
cards.text: Once you've Equipped an ally this game, create a Shadow Fiend in hand.

cards.flavor: In the darkness, he'd seen it - a weapon to cut through the shadows. And in that moment, he heard a voice call to him, distant but powerful. He followed it to Kayn, the truth of its words guiding him.

cards.name: Entrancing Lure
cards.text: Give an ally Challenger this round. If it's Equipped, draw 1.
cards.textHtml: Give an ally <link=keyword.Challenger><sprite name=Challenger><style=Keyword>Challenger</style></link> this round. If it's <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equipped</style></link>, draw 1.
cards.flavor: Everything's hungry for the right bait.

cards.name: The Spirit of Wuju
cards.text:
Flow: I cost 2 less. 
When I'm summoned, draw a spell.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Flow><style=Vocab>Flow</style></link>: I cost 2 less. 
When I'm summoned, draw a spell.
cards.flavor: "Master Doran believed each eye of the Spirit of Wuju offered unique insight into a person's being. But try as I might, all my helm's lenses can behold are different shades of green. What am I missing?" - Lui, Disciple of Doran

cards.name: Mistfall
cards.text:
When I'm summoned, draw an equipment.
The first time each round an unequipped ally is Equipped, refill 2 spell mana.
cards.textHtml:
When I'm summoned, draw an equipment.
The first time each round an unequipped ally is <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equipped</style></link>, refill 2 spell mana.
cards.flavor:
"Mistfall is sacred ground. The swords at the site have been here for centuries... and it is my belief that any blade left here with a poem on its hilt will invite the spirits of lost wielders to imbue it with their blessing."
- Disciple of Doran, handwritten scroll

cards.name: Soul Sword
cards.text: Flow: I cost 2 less.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Flow><style=Vocab>Flow</style></link>: I cost 2 less.
cards.flavor: "Blade and body." - Master Yi

<link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recall</style></link> a unit or landmark. If it has any attachments, destroy them first.
cards.flavor: "You are not worthy of the power you hold." - Rhaast

If you've Equipped an ally this game, I cost 1 less.

cards.flavor: Angry tears streamed down Jun’s face as she surveyed the bodies littering the ground. She had failed them. She had failed her master. And now, only one choice remained…

cards.flavor: "What is one life, but a shadow of existence? Embrace the darkness, and you will live forever." - Zed

cards.flavor: The longtail first befriended his Brigand pal one winter's evening, as the two shared the remnants of an abandoned campfire. By the week's end, the two had discovered a common sense of mischief, and a strong interest in the golden shine of coin.

cards.flavor: To the Ionians, wind is the most capricious of the elements. Capricious, but not untamable.

cards.name: Serene Sky-Singer
cards.text: When I'm summoned, reduce the cost of spells in your deck by half, rounded up.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, reduce the cost of spells in your deck by half, rounded up.
cards.flavor: "Some seek peace through meditation. Others seek knowledge for self-reflection. Those that find their center by expression, by creation--they may bring peace to others, too." - Karma

cards.name: Wandering Shepherd
cards.text: Play: Pick an ally, it Improvises. If you don't, I Improvise.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Pick an ally, it <link=vocab.Improvise><style=Vocab>Improvises</style></link>. If you don't, I <link=vocab.Improvise><style=Vocab>Improvise</style></link>.
cards.flavor: Jax helped Chaska rescue their herd from rampaging faefolk. Then, Chaska rescued Jax from rampaging faefolk. They travel together whenever one of them doesn’t wander off.

cards.name: The Darkin Lodestone
cards.text:
Support: Grant my supported ally +1|+1.
You may spend 8 mana to play me as Horazi.
cards.textHtml:
<link=keyword.Support><style=Keyword>Support</style></link>: Grant my supported ally +1|+1.
You may spend 8 mana to play me as <link=card.unit><style=AssociatedCard>Horazi</style></link>.
cards.flavor: Perhaps those who imprisoned the Darkin thought that burying the legendary warrior Horazi within an orb of star metal would sufficiently dim her irascible will. But as her general stirred, so too did Horazi, who found that even Targon's ancient protectors could be tempted by promises whispered from afar.

cards.name: Horazi
cards.text: Support: Grow my supported ally's stats to mine. Give it my positive keywords this round.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Support><style=Keyword>Support</style></link>: Grow my supported ally's stats to mine. Give it my positive keywords this round.
cards.flavor: Horazi was gifted a higher perspective in the burning celestial matter that imprisoned her. She glimpsed the secrets of the cosmos, and of the infinite passage of time that preceded and followed her existence. She learned so much, and yet her hatred for the coward Xolaani remained.

cards.name: The Darkin Lodestone
cards.text: Support: Grant my supported ally +1|+1.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Support><style=Keyword>Support</style></link>: Grant my supported ally +1|+1.

But as her general stirred, so too did Horazi, who found that even Targon's ancient protectors could be tempted by promises whispered from afar.

cards.name: Seraphic Wyvern
cards.text: Empowered 5: Overwhelm.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Empowered><style=Vocab>Empowered</style></link> 5: <link=keyword.Overwhelm><sprite name=Overwhelm><style=Keyword>Overwhelm</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "Ah, I see it now... the shapes left in the mountain were merely imprints--conduits for the beings from the realm beyond the stars..." - Lorekeeper Skai'en

cards.name: Kayle
cards.text:
I have +1|+0 for each time an ally attacked with increased Power.

cards.levelup: Round Start: I have 11+ Power.
cards.flavor: "The Demacians know her as the Winged Protector, but those of us who live under the vault of stars in Targon know her as the daughter of Justice, bearing divine purpose and a sword of starfire." - Lorekeeper Skai'en

cards.name: Kayle's Divine Judgment
cards.text:
Give an ally "I can't take damage or die" this round. 
Give all allies +1|+0 this round.
Create a Kayle in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
Give an ally "I can't take damage or die" this round. 
Give all allies +1|+0 this round.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Kayle</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "Shielded by righteous flame!" - Kayle

cards.name: Kayle
cards.text:
I have +1|+0 for each time an ally attacked with increased Power.
When I'm summoned or level up, grant allies +1|+1.
Empowered 16: Double Attack.
cards.textHtml:
I have +1|+0 for each time an ally attacked with increased Power.
When I'm summoned or level up, grant allies +1|+1.
<link=vocab.Empowered><style=Vocab>Empowered</style></link> 16: <link=keyword.Double Strike><sprite name=DoubleStrike><style=Keyword>Double Attack</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "We would surely know her to see her, should she ever return... but I worry there is little reason for her to do so beyond a threat so dire that it requires her interference." - Lorekeeper Skai'en

cards.name: Divine Judgment

cards.flavor: "Shielded by righteous flame!" - Kayle

cards.name: Purifying Flames
cards.text: Grant 2 allies in hand +2|+2.
cards.textHtml: Grant 2 allies in hand +2|+2.
cards.flavor: "Evil shall burn!" - Kayle

cards.name: Winged Messenger
cards.text: Empowered 3: Elusive.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Empowered><style=Vocab>Empowered</style></link> 3: <link=keyword.Elusive><sprite name=Elusive><style=Keyword>Elusive</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "Yes... I recognize you. The message you bear... it can only be a summons." - Ryze

cards.name: Divine Clerk
cards.text: Empowered 3: Lifesteal.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Empowered><style=Vocab>Empowered</style></link> 3: <link=keyword.Lifesteal><sprite name=Lifesteal><style=Keyword>Lifesteal</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "It is said that when Mihira left this place, she left a part of herself behind--a holy flame, burning brightly. For years, my family has tended to that fire, keeping it lit in the hopes that she may yet return."

cards.name: Lawkeeper
cards.text: Play: Stun enemies with less Power than me.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.PlaySkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Play</style></link>: <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> enemies with less Power than me.
cards.flavor: "I fear the day has finally come... Justice returns on golden wings, and with her she brings a shining army!" - Lorekeeper Skai'en

cards.name: Blinding Light
cards.text: Stun enemies with less Power than me.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> enemies with less Power than me.
cards.flavor: "Gaze upon its golden light and know judgment!" - Mihira, Aspect of Justice

cards.name: Mihira, Aspect of Justice
cards.text:
Round End: Grant allies in play and in hand +1|+1.
Empowered 5: Elusive, Lifesteal, and Overwhelm.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.RoundEnd><style=Vocab>Round End</style></link>: Grant allies in play and in hand +1|+1.
<link=vocab.Empowered><style=Vocab>Empowered</style></link> 5: <link=keyword.Elusive><sprite name=Elusive><style=Keyword>Elusive</style></link>, <link=keyword.Lifesteal><sprite name=Lifesteal><style=Keyword>Lifesteal</style></link>, and <link=keyword.Overwhelm><sprite name=Overwhelm><style=Keyword>Overwhelm</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "Some revere the Aspects as gods. Others see them as messengers from the realm beyond. Still others fear them... and perhaps rightly so." - Lorekeeper Skai'en

cards.name: Lunari Cultist
cards.text: When I'm summoned or once you've Equipped an ally this game, create a Gem in hand.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned or once you've <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equipped</style></link> an ally this game, create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Gem</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: She sought an end to the conflict between Sun and Moon, day and night. The bow offered power, though it came with a terrible cost - yet she pledged herself to it anyway, hoping that it would stop the war once and for all.

cards.name: Draconic Bands
cards.text: My bearer is a Dragon.
cards.textHtml: My bearer is a Dragon.
cards.flavor: Many call upon the might of dragons, though it manifests differently across Runeterra. Those that invoke the power of a celestial dragon may discover they possess an inner strength that burns as bright and hot as a star.

cards.name: Celestial Impact
cards.text: Obliterate a unit or landmark. Heal your Nexus 3.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Obliterate><style=Vocab>Obliterate</style></link> a unit or landmark. Heal your Nexus 3.
cards.flavor: "Who would arrive in our hour of need?" - Shuriman Elder

cards.name: Xolaani the Bloodweaver
cards.text:
I have +2|+2 for each ally that died with its power increased.
Empowered 16: Transform me into Xolaani, Aspect's Bane.
cards.textHtml:
I have +2|+2 for each ally that died with its power increased.
<link=vocab.Empowered><style=Vocab>Empowered</style></link> 16: Transform me into <link=card.transform><style=AssociatedCard>Xolaani, Aspect's Bane</style></link>.
cards.flavor: Xolaani watched on as Anaakco fell to his knees, subjugated by the very enemy he sought so desperately to destroy. Slowly, the beat of his heart rang out in unison with the others. Another heart to control. Another body to command.

cards.name: Xolaani, Aspect's Bane
cards.text:
I have +2|+2 for each ally that died with its power increased.
Attack: Transform attacking non-Darkin followers into exact copies of me.
cards.textHtml:
I have +2|+2 for each ally that died with its power increased.
<link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Transform attacking non-Darkin followers into exact copies of me.
cards.flavor: More. More. Even the great hero of legend Mihira could not withstand Xolaani's overwhelming strength. The earth seemed to shudder to one beat now, such was the hemomantic power growing within Xolaani. She took a moment to observe the battlefield, and wept with the joy filling her soul. Soon, this world would be united in peace. In love. In silence.

cards.name: Seal In Steel
cards.text: Obliterate an ally and create a Corrupted Form with its stats.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Obliterate><style=Vocab>Obliterate</style></link> an ally and create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Corrupted Form</style></link> with its stats.
cards.flavor: The fallen god-warriors entombed in these weapons could not be easily defeated, and so instead were contained.

cards.name: Corrupted Form
cards.flavor: While the Darkin were entombed in the weapons they carried, they slowly changed until they resembled nothing of their original form.

cards.name: The Expanse's Protection
cards.text:
Once you've Equipped an ally this game, I cost 2 less.
Give an ally SpellShield this round.
cards.textHtml:
Once you've <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equipped</style></link> an ally this game, I cost 2 less.
Give an ally <link=keyword.SpellShield><sprite name=SpellShield><style=Keyword>SpellShield</style></link> this round.
cards.flavor: Look to the night sky and focus your eyes on a small swathe of the firmament. Now imagine all those lived within it, all the knowledge gained and all the experiences lived over countless millennia. Imagine all that information condensed into a shard that could fit into the palm of your hand. Think of how much wisdom you would hold. How much power.

cards.name: Twilit Protector
cards.text:
Daybreak: Give Daybreak allies +1|+1 this round.
Nightfall: Grant Nightfall allies +1|+0.
cards.textHtml:
<link=keyword.Daybreak><style=Keyword>Daybreak</style></link>: Give <link=keyword.Daybreak><style=Keyword>Daybreak</style></link> allies +1|+1 this round.
<link=keyword.Nightfall><style=Keyword>Nightfall</style></link>: Grant <link=keyword.Nightfall><style=Keyword>Nightfall</style></link> allies +1|+0.
cards.flavor: In the twilight hours and just before sunrise the owl can be heard, its call a reminder of the liminal places between dusk and dawn.

cards.name: Celestial Blessing
cards.text: Grant an ally in play and an ally in hand Spirit.
cards.textHtml: Grant an ally in play and an ally in hand <link=keyword.Spirit><sprite name=Spirit><style=Keyword>Spirit</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "By divine grace." - Kayle

cards.name: Generous Gemcrafter
cards.text: When you play a spell, grant a random ally in hand +1|+1.
cards.textHtml: When you play a spell, grant a random ally in hand +1|+1.
cards.flavor: Eyes kind but expression hidden behind a veil, she offers crystal prayer beads to those making ready to begin their pilgrimages. She asks nothing from them in return, for the price will be paid on the Mountain.

cards.name: Noxian Defector
cards.text: Attack: Grow my Power to that of the strongest equipped ally this round.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Grow my Power to that of the <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>equipped</style></link> ally this round.
cards.flavor:
“Been having dreams again, hearing that voice in the dark. Ten years... a whole bloody decade spent as the empire's obedient dog. Go there. Kill that. And for what? The glory of Noxus? Glory’s a pretty lie, and I fell for it. But no more. Kayn’s shown me a different path, and it leads to vengeance.”
- Royce, The Butcher’s journal

cards.name: The Darkin Ballista
cards.text: You may spend 8 mana to play me as Naganeka of Zuretta.
cards.textHtml: You may spend 8 mana to play me as <link=card.unit><style=AssociatedCard>Naganeka of Zuretta</style></link>.
cards.flavor: The steppes of eastern Valoran were known to be barren, unfit to feed or home the Noxii people. But as the centuries fell by, a new empire was founded, hungry for expansion. Fallow lands found new fertility under new farming techniques, and weapons once thought safely buried become uncovered once again.

cards.name: Naganeka of Zuretta
cards.text: Round End: The Strongest enemy and I strike each other.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.RoundEnd><style=Vocab>Round End</style></link>: The <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>Strongest</style></link> enemy and I <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strike</style></link> each other.
cards.flavor: Ancient muscles flexed once more. The warrior heard her general's call, and knew where she was needed--south, in the lands she once knew as Icathia.

cards.name: The Darkin Ballista
cards.flavor: The steppes of eastern Valoran were known to be barren, unfit to feed or home the Noxii people. But as the centuries fell by, a new empire was founded, hungry for expansion. cards.flavor: "Few are given the opportunity to serve in the Trifarian Legion. Do not squander this chance." - Trifarian Assessor

cards.textHtml: Draw an ally with 5+ Power.
cards.flavor: "Few are given the opportunity to serve in the Trifarian Legion. Do not squander this chance." - Trifarian Assessor
