cards.name: Ionian Hookmaster
cards.text: When I'm summoned, I Improvise.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, I <link=vocab.Improvise><style=Vocab>Improvise</style></link>.
cards.flavor: Trisk’s life was turned upside down when, during what would be her last fishing tournament, she somehow managed to fish up a sputtering Jax. He refuses to discuss the incident, but the sea monster Trisk rescued him from gets bigger each time she retells it.

cards.name: Great Hammers
cards.flavor: Vessid isn't the Bordent's fastest Reckoner, but when his great hammers find their target, there's never much of an opponent left to fight back.

cards.name: Brutal Skirmish
cards.text: Destroy an enemy's equipment. An ally and that enemy strike each other.
cards.textHtml: Destroy an enemy's equipment. An ally and that enemy <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strike</style></link> each other.
cards.flavor:
"One two, watch him scream,
The soldier's caught on fi-re,
three four, watch him burn,
Tibbers wants a py-re!" - Annie

cards.name: Furious Wielder
cards.text: An Equipped ally strikes an enemy.
cards.textHtml: An <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equipped</style></link> ally <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strikes</style></link> an enemy.
cards.flavor: "Brothers in blood, once again!" - Noxian Defector

cards.name: Rune Squire
cards.text: When I'm summoned, Reforge.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, <link=vocab.Reforge><style=Vocab>Reforge</style></link>.
cards.flavor: For months, he'd slogged through the cold and the rain, a thankless task with no end in sight. And yet the end came. Finally, he would make something of himself.

cards.name: Reveler's Feast
cards.text: Deal 2 to an ally to give allies +2|+0 this round.
cards.textHtml: Deal 2 to an ally to give allies +2|+0 this round.
cards.flavor: "It's not a feast until someone starts screaming. So scream, boy." - Vladimir

cards.name: Crimson Pigeon
cards.text: Support: Deal 1 to my supported ally to give me +1|+1 this round.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Support><style=Keyword>Support</style></link>: Deal 1 to my supported ally to give me +1|+1 this round.
cards.flavor: "It's rather fun, feeding the birds. I wagered with poor Feoward that they'd sup blood as keenly as a Bordent basilisk, and lo and behold: the pigeons are Noxian indeed!" - Edvin Cortain, Crimson Curator

cards.name: Skulking String-Puller
cards.text: Attack: Grow other attacking allies' Power to mine this round.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Grow other attacking allies' Power to mine this round.
cards.flavor: "A good mother teaches her children to hunt. But a great mother... she does the hunting for them." - Elise

cards.name: Encore
cards.text: Create a random new 2 cost spell in hand, reduce it's cost by 2 and grant it Fleeting.
cards.textHtml: Create a random new 2 cost spell in hand, reduce it's cost by 2 and grant it <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link>.
cards.flavor: There's nothing more satisfying than good reverb.

cards.name: Ambitious Cultist
cards.text: Once you've Equipped an ally this game, create in hand a new spell that costs 2 and set its cost to 0 this round.
cards.textHtml: Once you've <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equipped</style></link> an ally this game, create in hand a new spell that costs 2 and set its cost to 0 this round.
cards.flavor: "I have always been willing to sacrifice in the name of science. No matter the personal risk, the limitless, inexhaustible power I gained through the exchange was more than reward."

cards.name: The Darkin Harp
cards.text: You may spend 8 mana to play me as Styraatu.
cards.textHtml: You may spend 8 mana to play me as <link=card.unit><style=AssociatedCard>Styraatu</style></link>.
cards.flavor: As the Targonians pondered where they should scatter the Darkin weapons, one of their kind suggested the lands that would become known as Zaun. Buried deep within the walls of the cavernous and winding passageways would be perfect, they assumed. Far from human reach. But not Chirean.

cards.name: Styraatu
cards.text: Attack: Draw 2, then reduce those cards' costs by 2.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Draw 2, then reduce those cards' costs by 2.
cards.flavor: Styraatu burst through the processing plant, furious and impatient. Her rage was known even before the tendrils of madness found their way into her mind, but now... now she would make them all pay. First here, in this land of technology, then south, where she would war alongside her general once again.

cards.name: The Darkin Harp
cards.flavor: As the Targonians pondered where they should scatter the Darkin weapons, one of their kind suggested the lands that would become known as Zaun. Buried deep within the walls of the cavernous and winding passageways would be perfect, they assumed. Far from human reach. But not Chirean.

cards.name: Caustic Riff
cards.text:
Flow: I cost 2 less.
Deal 1 to all enemies.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Flow><style=Vocab>Flow</style></link>: I cost 2 less.
Deal 1 to all enemies.
cards.flavor: It takes a special sound to break through Zaun's rattle and clang, but the Diva always delivers.

cards.name: Acoustician
cards.text: Strike: Create a random new 2 cost spell in hand.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>Strike</style></link>: Create a random new 2 cost spell in hand.
cards.flavor: Once, he'd dreamed of leaving Zaun and traveling the world with a song in his heart. Now, the world was asleep in her room, waiting for the songs tomorrow might bring.

cards.name: Fanclub President
cards.text: Play: Manifest a spell that costs 5 and set its cost to 2.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: <link=vocab.Manifest><style=Vocab>Manifest</style></link> a spell that costs 5 and set its cost to 2.
cards.flavor: "It's not about how big your voice is, it's about how big your heart is!" - Fanclub President

cards.name: High Note
cards.text: Deal 2 to a unit. If you've played 6+ other new spells this game, deal 1 to another unit.
cards.textHtml: Deal 2 to a unit. If you've played 6+ other new spells this game, deal 1 to another unit. <style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor: Simple and clean.

cards.name: Zaun Bouncer
cards.text: Round Start: Flow: Refill 2 spell mana.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: <link=vocab.Flow><style=Vocab>Flow</style></link>: Refill 2 spell mana.
cards.flavor: If he had things his way, NOBODY would get in.

cards.name: Acorn, the Hextechnician
cards.text: Nexus Strike: Reduce the cost of the most expensive spell in your hand by 1.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.NexusStrike><style=Vocab>Nexus Strike</style></link>: Reduce the cost of the most expensive spell in your hand by 1.
cards.flavor: You wouldn't find his name on any of the blueprints, or credited in any of the songs, but those in the know agreed: Acorn was the heart of the whole operation.

cards.name: Seraphine
cards.text: When I'm summoned, create a random new 2 cost spell in hand.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, create a random new 2 cost spell in hand.
cards.levelup: You've played 9+ new spells.
cards.flavor: Seraphine and her dad never talked about her "secret" trips to the Undercity, or the subtle upgrades she kept making to her stage. She was sure he'd forbid her from participating in Zaun's grungiest musical duel, but one night he tucked the flyer under her door. All she could do was smile, and get to work.

cards.name: Seraphine's High Note
cards.text:
Deal 2 to a unit. If you've played 6+ other new spells this game, deal 1 to another unit. 
Create a Seraphine in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
Deal 2 to a unit. If you've played 6+ other new spells this game, deal 1 to another unit. <style=Variable></style>
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Seraphine</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: Simple and clean.

cards.name: Seraphine
cards.text:
When I'm summoned, create a random new 2 cost spell in hand.
When you play a new spell that costs 2 or less, copy it with the same targets.
cards.textHtml:
When I'm summoned, create a random new 2 cost spell in hand.
When you play a new spell that costs 2 or less, copy it with the same targets.
cards.flavor: She'd never heard anything like it--maybe nobody had. Together, on that stage, they made something new.

cards.name: Drum Solo
cards.text:
Draw 2.
Flow: Reduce those cards' costs by 1.
cards.textHtml:
Draw 2.
<link=vocab.Flow><style=Vocab>Flow</style></link>: Reduce those cards' costs by 1.
cards.flavor: Music's all about timing, but once in a while you've gotta just let loose.

cards.name: Crowd Pleaser
cards.text:
Give an ally +2|+0 and Quick Attack this round.
Flow: Create a new 2 cost spell in hand.
cards.textHtml:
Give an ally +2|+0 and <link=keyword.Quick Strike><sprite name=QuickStrike><style=Keyword>Quick Attack</style></link> this round.
<link=vocab.Flow><style=Vocab>Flow</style></link>: Create a new 2 cost spell in hand.
cards.flavor: "I can't hear you, Zaun!" - Seraphine

cards.name: Inspired Plans
cards.text: Attack: Create a new 2 cost spell in hand and grant it Fleeting.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Create a new 2 cost spell in hand and grant it <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link>.
cards.flavor:
"Oh dear, sounds like rain."
"Huh? Dad, it's so bright outside."
"Quick, cover the blueprints! It's a BRAINstorm!"
"Daaaaad."
- Seraphine & her father

cards.name: Gatalyst v1.0
cards.text: Your spells and Skills deal 1 extra damage.
cards.textHtml: Your spells and <link=keyword.Skill><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Skills</style></link> deal 1 extra damage.
cards.flavor:
"Location: Sector 3, Underway 19B
Item: Illegal Firearm
Notes: Confiscated during Operation: Sumplight. Weapon is highly dangerous. Handle with extreme care."
- Piltover Warden field report

cards.name: Hexbliterator
cards.text: Deal 6 to a unit. If it would die, Obliterate it instead.
cards.textHtml: Deal 6 to a unit. If it would die, <link=vocab.Obliterate><style=Vocab>Obliterate</style></link> it instead.
cards.flavor: For some creatures, death just isn't enough.

cards.name: The Zaun Diva
cards.text: Play: Deal 1 to all enemies. If you've played 6+ new spells this game, deal 3 instead.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.PlaySkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Play</style></link>: Deal 1 to all enemies. If you've played 6+ new spells this game, deal 3 instead. <style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor: "Zaun! I hope you're ready to scream, 'cause we're about to sink this place all over again!" - Zaun Diva

cards.name: Fatal Encore
cards.text: Deal 1 to all enemies. If you've played 6+ new spells this game, deal 3 instead.
cards.textHtml: Deal 1 to all enemies. If you've played 6+ new spells this game, deal 3 instead.
cards.flavor: "The Diva's show is totally worth the hearing damage!" - Fans, probably

cards.name: The Violent Dischord
cards.text: Deal 1 to a unit. If you've Equipped an ally this game, copy me with the same target.
cards.textHtml: Deal 1 to a unit. If you've <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equipped</style></link> an ally this game, copy me with the same target.
cards.flavor: If discord be the cacophony of destruction, then butcher on.

cards.name: Back Alley Bar
cards.text:
When I'm summoned, summon a Back Alley Barkeep.
Your new cards cost 1 less.
cards.textHtml:
When I'm summoned, summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Back Alley Barkeep</style></link>.
Your new cards cost 1 less.
cards.flavor: After drying the last of the glasses, the barkeep took a moment to look over his place. This spot, this home from home, had seen so many strangers become friends, and wore the graffiti and dents from many a wild night. The barkeep smiled to himself. It wasn't a perfect place, but it was his.

cards.name: Cunning Kitten
cards.text: When I'm summoned, if I was created, draw 1 and grant me +2|+1.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, if I was created, draw 1 and grant me +2|+1.
cards.flavor: When they're not sleeping in the middle of the day or throwing up in the middle of the night, cats are always up to some brand of mischief.

cards.name: Formula
cards.text: Draw 2. Refill your spell mana.
cards.textHtml: Draw 2. Refill your spell mana.
cards.flavor: “Magic is merely scientific truth yet to be discovered.” - Jayce

cards.name: Kayn
cards.text:
Origin: The Shadow Reaper.
Auto-Equip: The Darkin Scythe.
When I kill an enemy, heal me 2.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Origin><style=Vocab>Origin</style></link>: <link=card.origin><style=AssociatedCard>The Shadow Reaper</style></link>.
<link=vocab.AutoEquip><style=Vocab>Auto-Equip</style></link>: <link=card.equipment><style=AssociatedCard>The Darkin Scythe</style></link>.
When I kill an enemy, heal me 2.
cards.levelup: I've struck twice. When I level up, Recall me.
cards.flavor: As another body fell, Kayn let out a gleeful laugh, knowing that he would soon unleash the second Darkin weapon that lay below. Within him, Rhaast's anticipation grew, knowing that Kayn’s undoing was finally near.

cards.name: The Shadow Assassin
cards.text: Auto-Equip: Shadow Scythe.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.AutoEquip><style=Vocab>Auto-Equip</style></link>: <link=card.equipment><style=AssociatedCard>Shadow Scythe</style></link>.
cards.flavor: Tremendous power flowed through his veins. Freed from the Darkin’s influence, the full power of the shadows was his to command. Kayn laughed, slipping into darkness, and emerged a moment later only to silently slit the throat of the guard before him.

cards.name: Rhaast
cards.text:
Auto-Equip: Corrupted Scythe.
When I kill an enemy, fully heal me and heal your Nexus 2.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.AutoEquip><style=Vocab>Auto-Equip</style></link>: <link=card.equipment><style=AssociatedCard>Corrupted Scythe</style></link>.
When I kill an enemy, fully heal me and heal your Nexus 2.
cards.flavor: Rhaast let out a triumphant howl. Years of waiting, yearning, and now... he was finally free. He lifted Xolaani’s blades and put them to his tongue, savoring the taste of fresh blood. He closed his eyes in bliss, and a smile crept across his face for the first time in millennia. The reaping had begun.

cards.name: The Darkin Scythe
cards.text: Attack: Grant The Darkin Scythe +1|+0.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Grant <link=card.selfRef><style=AssociatedCard>The Darkin Scythe</style></link> +1|+0.
cards.flavor:
“Time to reap.”
- Rhaast

cards.name: Kayn's Shadowstep
cards.text:
Give Kayn Quick Attack this round. He starts a free attack Challenging an enemy.
Create a Kayn in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
Give <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Kayn</style></link> <link=keyword.Quick Strike><sprite name=QuickStrike><style=Keyword>Quick Attack</style></link> this round. He starts a free attack <link=keyword.Challenger><sprite name=Challenger><style=Keyword>Challenging</style></link> an enemy.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Kayn</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "No escape." - Kayn

cards.name: The Shadow Reaper
cards.text: You may put any Cultist cards into your deck during deckbuilding. Once you've summoned 4+ Cultist units, draw a Kayn.
cards.textHtml: You may put any Cultist cards into your deck during deckbuilding. Once you've summoned 4+ Cultist units, draw a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Kayn</style></link>.
cards.flavor: Only two outcomes are possible: either Kayn bends Rhaast to his will, or he is consumed by it.

cards.name: Kayn
cards.text: Play: Transform me and all copies of me into Rhaast or The Shadow Assassin.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Transform me and all copies of me into <link=card.Rhaast><style=AssociatedCard>Rhaast</style></link> or <link=card.TheShadowAssassin><style=AssociatedCard>The Shadow Assassin</style></link>.
cards.flavor: A fierce and sudden flash of anger overwhelmed Kayn, and a terrible, searing pain passed behind his eyes, bringing him to his knees. Rhaast’s triumphant laughter echoed all around him, mocking and merciless. He had known this day would come--the day he would finally prevail or lose himself to the Darkin...

cards.name: Shadow Scythe
cards.text: Attack: Grant Shadow Scythe +2|+0.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Grant <link=card.selfRef><style=AssociatedCard>Shadow Scythe</style></link> +2|+0.
cards.flavor: Kayn’s anger grew into a fearsome blaze amidst Rhaast's furious screams. The Darkin's hold on the shadow warrior burned away, and when Kayn rose to his feet, he knew the full power of the Darkin was his to command.

cards.name: Corrupted Scythe
cards.text: Attack: Grant Corrupted Scythe +1|+1.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Grant <link=card.selfRef><style=AssociatedCard>Corrupted Scythe</style></link> +1|+1.
cards.flavor: As Kayn yielded his spirit to the Darkin, his anger subsided and an unbearable emptiness was left in its place. The young warrior was gone. Only Rhaast remained.

cards.name: Ryze
cards.text:
Origin: The Rune Mage.
When I'm summoned or Round Start: Create 2 Delve Into The Pasts in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Origin><style=Vocab>Origin</style></link>: <link=card.origin><style=AssociatedCard>The Rune Mage</style></link>.
When I'm summoned or <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Create 2 <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Delve Into The Pasts</style></link> in your deck.
cards.levelup: I see 3+ unique World Runes.
cards.flavor: Ryze crested the ridge, accompanied by Kayle's silent servant. He looked down on a land scarred by war, and caught sight of the darkin monstrosities warring below. For centuries, he had watched on as humanity veered from one catastrophe to another. What if, he thought, his efforts were futile, and Runeterra was doomed to die?"

cards.name: Shard of Madness
cards.text:
When I'm Played, if I'm unique, activate all your other World Runes.
When I'm Played or activated, create a Rune Prison in hand or if you have one, reduce its cost by 1.
cards.textHtml:
When I'm <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Played</style></link>, if I'm unique, activate all your other World Runes.
When I'm <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Played</style></link> or activated, create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Rune Prison</style></link> in hand or if you have one, reduce its cost by 1.
cards.flavor: The god-warriors of Shurima were thought peerless. Perfect. But years of war against an unstoppable foe eventually bowed their spirits, then broke them entirely. Xolaani and Aatrox turned on each other in a dispute that soon threatened Runeterra's very existence.

cards.name: Shard of Betrayal
cards.text:
When I'm Played, if I'm unique, activate all your other World Runes.
When I'm Played or activated, deal 2 to the weakest enemy.
cards.textHtml:
When I'm <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Played</style></link>, if I'm unique, activate all your other World Runes.
When I'm <link=keyword.PlaySkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Played</style></link> or activated, deal 2 to the <link=keyword.Weakest><style=Keyword>weakest</style></link> enemy.
cards.flavor: Of all the wrongs Ryze had witnessed in his time on Runeterra, this cut the deepest. How could his own master, who inculcated in Ryze the virtues of control and patience, lose himself so fully to the World Runes? How?!

cards.name: Ryze's Realm Warp
cards.text:
Draw 3. Discard any followers drawn.
Create a Ryze in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
Draw 3. Discard any followers drawn.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Ryze</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "The shards will show me the path..." - Ryze

cards.name: Shard of Violence
cards.text:
When I'm Played, if I'm unique, activate all your other World Runes.
When I'm Played or activated, draw 1.
cards.textHtml:
When I'm <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Played</style></link>, if I'm unique, activate all your other World Runes.
When I'm <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Played</style></link> or activated, draw 1.
cards.flavor: Ryze watched on as the mindscape before him constructed itself. Before him. the Icathians warred with Shurima in a desperate bid for freedom. Ryze knew too well what came next, but watched on regardless. Cruel purple tendrils burst out, engulfing the battlefield. Icathia reached for freedom, but in the darkness, unleashed the Void upon Runeterra.

cards.name: Ryze
cards.text:
When I'm summoned or Round Start: Create 2 Delve Into The Pasts in your deck.
Attack: Activate all your World Runes. If you have 5 unique World Runes, destroy the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml:
When I'm summoned or <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Create 2 <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Delve Into The Pasts</style></link> in your deck.
<link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Activate all your World Runes. If you have 5 unique World Runes, destroy the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: Ryze pulled himself back to the present. The mindscapes he'd visited had answered his questions, and filled him with purpose. The flaws of Runeterra's people, great as they were, should not condemn them to oblivion.

cards.name: Shard of Hope
cards.text:
When I'm Played, if I'm unique, activate all your other World Runes.
When I'm Played or activated, heal allied Ryzes and your Nexus 2.
cards.textHtml:
When I'm <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Played</style></link>, if I'm unique, activate all your other World Runes.
When I'm <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Played</style></link> or activated, heal allied <link=card.ryze><style=AssociatedCard>Ryzes</style></link> and your Nexus 2.
cards.flavor: Love. A fog that blinds the wise to reason, and that rids the patient of patience. Ryze watched on as the King lowered his beloved beneath the waters, and closed his eyes as the screaming began. Ryze felt the cold grip of undeath spread through the room, then beyond. All for love.

cards.name: Shard of Reverence
cards.text:
When I'm Played, if I'm unique, activate all your other World Runes.
When I'm Played or activated, refill your spell mana.
cards.textHtml:
When I'm <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Played</style></link>, if I'm unique, activate all your other World Runes.
When I'm <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Played</style></link> or activated, refill your spell mana.
cards.flavor: Lust for power seemed a common trait among the Runeterrans. Even Targon's revered few craved it, and so when they realized that simple flattery could bring them the power of the stars themselves, they didn't hesitate.

cards.name: The Rune Mage
cards.text:
You may put any non-targeted Burst and Focus spells into your deck during deckbuilding.
At the start of the game, create 2 Delve Into The Past in your deck for each Ryze that started the game in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
You may put any non-targeted <link=keyword.Burst><sprite name=Burst><style=Keyword>Burst</style></link> and <link=keyword.Focus><sprite name=Focus><style=Keyword>Focus</style></link> spells into your deck during deckbuilding.
At the start of the game, create 2 <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Delve Into The Past</style></link> in your deck for each Ryze that started the game in your deck.
cards.flavor: Can this world be saved? And if it can... should it?

cards.name: Overload
cards.text: Deal 2 to the weakest enemy.
cards.textHtml: Deal 2 to the <link=keyword.Weakest><style=Keyword>weakest</style></link> enemy.
cards.flavor: "THEY ARE MINE TO CONTROL! MINE!" - Tyrus

cards.name: Delve Into The Past
cards.text: Choose one of two World Runes you don't have in play or in hand and create it in hand. If you can't, I cost 1 less and draw 1.
cards.textHtml: Choose one of two World Runes you don't have in play or in hand and create it in hand. If you can't, I cost 1 less and draw 1.
cards.flavor: Before him, the world teetered on the brink of apocalypse. Ryze had the power to save Runeterra, but as he watched the carnage unfolding ahead of him, a single question lingered in him: should he? He resolved to create mindscapes of Runeterra's pivotal moments, and let his understanding of the land's history decide its future.

cards.name: Rune Prison
cards.text: Stun an attacking enemy.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> an attacking enemy.
cards.flavor: "Enough!" - Ryze

cards.name: Jax
cards.text:
Origin: Grandmaster at Arms.
Auto-Equip: The Light of Icathia.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Origin><style=Vocab>Origin</style></link>: <link=card.origin><style=AssociatedCard>Grandmaster at Arms</style></link>.
<link=vocab.AutoEquip><style=Vocab>Auto-Equip</style></link>: <link=card.equipment><style=AssociatedCard>The Light of Icathia</style></link>.
cards.levelup: Equipped allies have attacked with 16+ total Power.
cards.flavor: Centuries ago, Jax lost his homeland to the Void. Now, he travels the world, searching for warriors with the strength of will--and the sheer gall--to one day stand against that terrible foe.

cards.name: Grandmaster at Arms
cards.text: You may put any Weaponmaster cards into your deck during deckbuilding.
cards.textHtml: You may put any Weaponmaster cards into your deck during deckbuilding.

cards.name: The Light of Icathia
cards.text: If Jax has leveled, The Light of Icathia has Overwhelm.
cards.textHtml: If <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Jax</style></link> has leveled, <link=card.selfref><style=AssociatedCard>The Light of Icathia</style></link> has <link=keyword.Overwhelm><sprite name=Overwhelm><style=Keyword>Overwhelm</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "It's a stick with a heavy bit at the end. Weapon enough for me." - Jax

cards.name: Jax
cards.text:
Auto-Equip The Light of Icathia.
Attack: Give me +1|+1 this round for each Equipped ally.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.AutoEquip><style=Vocab>Auto-Equip</style></link> <link=card.equipment><style=AssociatedCard>The Light of Icathia</style></link>.
<link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Give me +1|+1 this round for each <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equipped</style></link> ally.
cards.flavor: "Icathia's been quiet a long time. But while I'm still standin', her people's roar will echo forever!" - Jax

cards.name: Jax's Counter Strike
cards.text:
Give Jax Barrier this round and Forge him.
Create a Jax in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
Give <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Jax</style></link> <link=keyword.Barrier><sprite name=Barrier><style=Keyword>Barrier</style></link> this round and <link=vocab.Forge><style=Vocab>Forge</style></link> him.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Jax</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "That's right, eyes on the champ!" - Jax

cards.name: Varus
cards.text:
Origin: The Arrow of Retribution.
Auto-Equip The Darkin Bow.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Origin><style=Vocab>Origin</style></link>: <link=card.origin><style=AssociatedCard>The Arrow of Retribution</style></link>.
<link=vocab.AutoEquip><style=Vocab>Auto-Equip</style></link> <link=card.item><style=AssociatedCard>The Darkin Bow</style></link>.
cards.levelup: You've targeted 7+ allies.
cards.flavor: What if, over time, the man that became the Darkin remembered himself, prompted by the mortal voices within? What if, instead of overcoming those voices entirely, he came to believe in them?

cards.name: Varus
cards.text:
Auto-Equip The Darkin Bow. 
The Darkin Bow activates twice and has max +10|+0.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.AutoEquip><style=Vocab>Auto-Equip</style></link> <link=card.item><style=AssociatedCard>The Darkin Bow</style></link>. 
<link=card.item><style=AssociatedCard>The Darkin Bow</style></link> activates twice and has max +10|+0.
cards.flavor: Varus was empowered, bolstered, reminded of who he was and what he had yet to become. He embraced the sum of his parts instead of working against them--and when they acted, they acted as one.

cards.name: The Darkin Bow
cards.text: When you play a spell or equip an ally, give me +1|+0 (max +5|+0) until the next time my bearer strikes.
cards.textHtml: When you play a spell or <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>equip</style></link> an ally, give me +1|+0 (max +5|+0) until the next time my bearer <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strikes</style></link>.
cards.flavor: Heartlights Kai and Valmar were not the first to bear the bow and host Varus' inhuman power... but they were the first to remind him of his lost humanity.

cards.name: Varus' Chain of Corruption
cards.text:
Give an enemy Vulnerable and give an ally +1|+0 this round.
Create a Fleeting Chain of Corruption in hand. 
Create a Varus in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
Give an enemy <link=keyword.Vulnerable><sprite name=Vulnerable><style=Keyword>Vulnerable</style></link> and give an ally +1|+0 this round.
Create a <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> <link=card.selfRef><style=AssociatedCard>Chain of Corruption</style></link> in hand. 
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Varus</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "Pity those who cross me." - Varus

cards.name: Chain of Corruption
cards.text:
Give an enemy Vulnerable and give an ally +1|+0 this round.
Create a Fleeting Chain of Corruption in hand.
cards.textHtml:
Give an enemy <link=keyword.Vulnerable><sprite name=Vulnerable><style=Keyword>Vulnerable</style></link> and give an ally +1|+0 this round.
Create a <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> <link=card.selfRef><style=AssociatedCard>Chain of Corruption</style></link> in hand.

cards.name: The Arrow of Retribution
cards.text:
You may put any Cultist cards into your deck during deckbuilding.
Once you've played 3+ Cultist spells, draw a Varus.
cards.textHtml:
You may put any Cultist cards into your deck during deckbuilding.
Once you've played 3+ Cultist spells, draw a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Varus</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "We will seek out our betrayers, and we will bring them oblivion." - Varus

cards.name: The Fix-Em 5000
cards.flavor: This wrench is the only belonging Pesh brought with him when he made the move from Piltover to Bilgewater. It’s not magic or anything, though you might think otherwise when you see him put it to work.

cards.name: Pot O' Pain
cards.flavor: The flavors in this pot are so good it hurts.

cards.name: Aatrox
cards.text:
Origin: The World Ender.
Auto-Equip: The Darkin Blade.
When I'm summoned or strike: Heal your Nexus 2 and create a World Ender in hand if you don't have one.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Origin><style=Vocab>Origin</style></link>: <link=card.origin><style=AssociatedCard>The World Ender</style></link>.
<link=vocab.AutoEquip><style=Vocab>Auto-Equip</style></link>: <link=card.item><style=AssociatedCard>The Darkin Blade</style></link>.
When I'm summoned or <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strike</style></link>: Heal your Nexus 2 and create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>World Ender</style></link> in hand if you don't have one.
cards.levelup: You've played World Ender.
cards.flavor: Even across continents, Aatrox felt her awakening. How the hatred still burned. He had already broken her statues, now he could wage a final war against the Coward of Icathia, and through destroying her, end this pitiful existence.

cards.name: The Darkin Blade
cards.flavor: "By my sword, this world must die." - Aatrox

cards.name: Deathbringer Descent
cards.text: Aatrox and an enemy strike each other.
cards.textHtml: <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Aatrox</style></link> and an enemy <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strike</style></link> each other.
cards.flavor: "Apocalypse comes!" - Aatrox

cards.name: Aatrox
cards.text:
Auto-Equip: The Darkin Blade.
Darkin allies cost 5 less.
When I'm summoned or strike: Heal your Nexus 2.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.AutoEquip><style=Vocab>Auto-Equip</style></link>: <link=card.item><style=AssociatedCard>The Darkin Blade</style></link>.
Darkin allies cost 5 less.
When I'm summoned or <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strike</style></link>: Heal your Nexus 2.
cards.flavor: The battle gathered pace. Xolaani had finally found the courage to face him, and as the two ancient enemies warred, the terrain itself began to wither and bend beneath their fury. An army of celestials descended upon them, desperate to save their dying land--but it was too late. Aatrox would have his day. He would find his peace.

cards.name: Deathbringer Slash
cards.text:
Aatrox and an enemy strike each other.
Create a Deathbringer Descent in hand.
cards.textHtml:
<link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Aatrox</style></link> and an enemy <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strike</style></link> each other.
Create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Deathbringer Descent</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: "I am the ender of worlds!" - Aatrox

cards.name: Aatrox's Deathbringer Sweep
cards.text:
Aatrox and an enemy strike each other.
Create a Deathbringer Slash in hand.
Create a Aatrox in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
<link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Aatrox</style></link> and an enemy <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strike</style></link> each other.
Create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Deathbringer Slash</style></link> in hand.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Aatrox</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "I will break this land!" - Aatrox

cards.name: The World Ender
cards.text: You may put any non-Champion Darkin into your deck during deckbuilding. Once you've played or summoned 3+ different other Darkin, draw a Aatrox.
cards.textHtml: You may put any non-Champion Darkin into your deck during deckbuilding. Once you've played or summoned 3+ different other Darkin, draw a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Aatrox</style></link>.
cards.flavor: Peace. Peace through war. Peace through death. Peace through oblivion.

cards.name: World Ender
cards.text:
I cost 1 less for each time an Equipped or Darkin ally has struck this game.
Assimilate allied followers Equipped with Darkin.
cards.textHtml:
I cost 1 less for each time an <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equipped</style></link> or Darkin ally has struck this game.
<link=vocab.Assimilate><style=Vocab>Assimilate</style></link> allied followers <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equipped</style></link> with Darkin.
cards.flavor: "Darkin! Awaken!" - Aatrox

cards.name: Sandworn Amulet
cards.flavor: Her spectral guardian bursts from the amulet whenever Fireth is in danger. She seems to have no memory of these events, and aggressively denies its existence when her allies try to explain.

cards.name: Fishawhack
cards.flavor: Catch and release is an excellent tactic whether you're fishing or fighting.

cards.name: Upcycled Rake
cards.flavor: Fireth says her mother made this rake for her. Exactly where her mother found an artifact of the ancient empire, and exactly why she attached it to a rake, Fireth cannot say.

cards.name: Shepherd's Authority
cards.flavor: Chaska takes a philosophical approach to shepherding. Their flock is whomever happens to be in the vicinity.

cards.name: Combat Reel
cards.text: Attack: Refill 1 spell mana.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Refill 1 spell mana.
cards.flavor: The monks of Hirana send unruly students to the fisherfolk for a lesson in patience. Only a handful ever choose to return to the monastery.

cards.name: Pan O' Pain
cards.flavor: Do NOT wash it with soap. Warm water or magic only.

cards.name: Deathbringer Sweep
cards.text:
Aatrox and an enemy strike each other.
Create a Deathbringer Slash in hand.
cards.textHtml:
<link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Aatrox</style></link> and an enemy <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strike</style></link> each other.
Create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Deathbringer Slash</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: "I will break this land!" - Aatrox

cards.name: Shadowstep
cards.text: Give Kayn Quick Attack this round. He starts a free attack Challenging an enemy.
cards.textHtml: Give <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Kayn</style></link> <link=keyword.Quick Strike><sprite name=QuickStrike><style=Keyword>Quick Attack</style></link> this round. He starts a free attack <link=keyword.Challenger><sprite name=Challenger><style=Keyword>Challenging</style></link> an enemy.
cards.flavor: "No escape." - Kayn

cards.name: Counter Strike
cards.text: Give Jax Barrier this round and Forge him.
cards.textHtml: Give <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Jax</style></link> <link=keyword.Barrier><sprite name=Barrier><style=Keyword>Barrier</style></link> this round and <link=vocab.Forge><style=Vocab>Forge</style></link> him.
cards.flavor: "That's right, eyes on the champ!" - Jax

cards.name: Realm Warp
cards.text: Draw 3. Discard any followers drawn.
cards.textHtml: Draw 3. Discard any followers drawn.
cards.flavor: "If I am to act, I must act now." - Ryze

cards.name: The Darkin Bloodletters
cards.text:
Last Breath: If my bearer is not a Darkinthrall, summon a Darkinthrall.
You may spend 6 mana and kill an ally to play me as Xolaani.
cards.textHtml:
<link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>Last Breath</style></link>: If my bearer is not a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Darkinthrall</style></link>, summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Darkinthrall</style></link>.
You may spend 6 mana and kill an ally to play me as <link=card.unit><style=AssociatedCard>Xolaani</style></link>.
cards.flavor: As the fighting raged on, Jun, desperate and badly wounded, turned to the voice whispering in her thoughts. "You will never die," it said, soft as summer rain, "because I will never let you."

cards.name: Darkinthrall
cards.text: The first time I'm Equipped grant me +2|+2.
cards.textHtml: The first time I'm <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equipped</style></link> grant me +2|+2.
cards.flavor: Long did these devoted few tend their lady's temples. Long did they sweep back the sands and expel would-be desecrators. Long did they pray for her return. Her kindness. Her control.

cards.name: Xolaani
cards.text:
To play me, kill an ally.
Last Breath: Create a The Darkin Bloodletters in hand.
cards.textHtml:
To play me, kill an ally.
<link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>Last Breath</style></link>: Create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>The Darkin Bloodletters</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: Shurima's Ascended were doomed the moment they took up arms against the Void. This was an enemy that could never be beaten, and while the god-warriors were all but guaranteed immortality, their minds were never as resilient. Madness consumed them all. Xolaani, once a beloved and gifted healer, began using her hemomantic powers to control her brethren, and soon enough, the hatred between her and Aatrox boiled over into civil war.

cards.name: The Darkin Bloodletters
cards.text: LastBreath: If my bearer is not a Darkinthrall, summon a Darkinthrall.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>LastBreath</style></link>: If my bearer is not a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Darkinthrall</style></link>, summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Darkinthrall</style></link>.

cards.name: Forsaken Baccai
cards.text: Play: Predict. If you pick a Darkin or an equipment, grant me +1|+1.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: <link=vocab.Predict><style=Vocab>Predict</style></link>. If you pick a Darkin or an equipment, grant me +1|+1.
cards.flavor: In his hand he clutched a braided belt, a gift from his friend Rhaast before their Ascension ceremony - but even as he revered the Darkin’s power, he harbored a secret resentment in his beastly heart.

cards.name: Camouflaged Horror
cards.text: Play: I strike an enemy.
cards.textHtml:
<link=keyword.PlaySkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Play</style></link>: I <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strike</style></link> an enemy.
<style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor: As the assault continued, larger and even more ferocious creatures poured from the widening gate. The city of Belveth was lost, though, as the cruelty of fate would have it, its name would live on.

cards.name: Feed the Void
cards.text: Camouflaged Horror strikes an enemy.
cards.textHtml: <link=card.parentRef><style=AssociatedCard>Camouflaged Horror</style></link> <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strikes</style></link> an enemy.
cards.flavor: With each corpse, the Void grew. Knowledge. Matter. Perspective. It began to feel. It began to want.

cards.name: Void Gate
cards.text: When you summon an ally or an ally dies, grant each of its positive keywords to 3 allies in your deck.
cards.textHtml: When you summon an ally or an ally dies, grant each of its positive keywords to 3 allies in your deck.
cards.flavor: The Hive Herald raised two hands to the colossal structure above. "A THRONE," he screamed, "FOR AN EMPRESS." The void gate above pulsed with life. Soon.

cards.name: Treasure of the Sands
cards.flavor:
"Put those down, Silvio!"
"Why? It ain't like the poor bugger's coming back for 'em!"
"Some things should stay buried." 
- Argus and Silvio, tomb robbers

cards.name: Buried Armory
cards.text: Countdown 2: Create a Treasure of the Sands in hand.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Countdown><style=Keyword>Countdown 2</style></link><style=Variable></style>: Create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Treasure of the Sands</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor:
"Why must you touch everything?"
"What, you think it's booby-trapped? You think some boulder's just gonna come rollin' outta–"
"RUNNN!"
- Argus and Silvio, tomb robbers

cards.name: Curse of the Tomb
cards.text: Predict. Give a unit "I take double damage and if I would die, Obliterate me instead" this round.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Predict><style=Vocab>Predict</style></link>. Give a unit "I take double damage and if I would die, <link=vocab.Obliterate><style=Vocab>Obliterate</style></link> me instead" this round.
cards.flavor: "Only fools seek power beyond their control." - Xerath

cards.name: The Altar of Blood
cards.text: When you slay a unit, reduce the cost of the next Darkin Unit you play by 1.
cards.textHtml: When you <link=vocab.Slay><style=Vocab>slay</style></link> a unit, reduce the cost of the next Darkin Unit you play by 1.
cards.flavor: The altar throbbed with life once more, shaking the sands around it with a slow and steady beat. Each of Xolaani's disciples felt the same beat deep in their heart. Every muscle, every thought, every moment... they were all hers to control.

cards.name: Swinging Glaive
cards.text: Strike: Create a Lucky Find in hand.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>Strike</style></link>: Create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Lucky Find</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: "Chase what you want. Without mercy." - Ruin Runner

cards.name: Heedless Resurrection
cards.text: Once you've equipped an ally this game, I cost 2 less. Revive the Strongest dead allied champion.
cards.textHtml: Once you've <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>equipped</style></link> an ally this game, I cost 2 less. Revive the <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>Strongest</style></link> dead allied champion.
cards.flavor:
“You’ll never die, because I’ll never let you.”
- Xolaani

cards.name: Acolyte's Reliquary
cards.text: When I'm summoned, create a Ruinous Acolyte in hand. When you destroy me create an Acolyte's Reliquary in the top 5 cards of your deck.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Ruinous Acolyte</style></link> in hand. When you destroy me create an <link=card.selfref><style=AssociatedCard>Acolyte's Reliquary</style></link> in the top 5 cards of your deck.
cards.flavor: "Our hands shape the desert!" - Ruinous Acolyte

cards.name: Rockbear Shepherd
cards.text:
When you summon another ally, advance your highest Countdown landmark 1 round.
When I'm summoned, summon a Hibernating Rockbear.
cards.textHtml:
When you summon another ally, <link=vocab.Advance><style=Vocab>advance</style></link> your highest <link=keyword.Countdown><style=Keyword>Countdown</style></link> landmark 1 round.
When I'm summoned, summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Hibernating Rockbear</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "The rockdoubbs treat Sadira like one of their own. She'd run away with 'em in a heartbeat if I let her, the little scamp!" - Kadira, Desert Naturalist

cards.name: Priestess Of Desert Light
cards.text: Round Start: Deal 4 to me. Draw a champion and grant it +2|+2. If your deck started with 6+ different champions, summon it instead.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Deal 4 to me. Draw a champion and grant it +2|+2. If your deck started with 6+ different champions, summon it instead.
cards.flavor: The faithful stand as evil encroaches, offering the last of their strength to channel the light of justice. A desperate call for deliverance they know will be answered before darkness consumes them.

cards.name: Castigate
cards.text: Kill ALL followers.
cards.textHtml: Kill ALL followers.
cards.flavor: Sometimes you're drawn to the light, and sometimes it's drawn to you.

cards.name: Fireth, Reaper of the Sands
cards.text: When I'm summoned, I Improvise.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, I <link=vocab.Improvise><style=Vocab>Improvise</style></link>.
cards.flavor: Jax asked for Fireth’s name two dozen times in their first weeks of travel together, but she would only ever growl, “I am the Reaper!”. Breshi found a novel solution—he’d just baked a cake, you see, and needed the name of the group’s strongest member to properly celebrate.

cards.name: Keeper of the Box
cards.text: Once you've Equipped an ally this game, grant me Lifesteal.
cards.textHtml: Once you've <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equipped</style></link> an ally this game, grant me <link=keyword.Lifesteal><sprite name=Lifesteal><style=Keyword>Lifesteal</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "The Box does not give its secrets freely, Shieda Kayn. They come at a grim price. But if you have the courage to gaze into the shadow of shadows, you will find that wonderful, terrible things lay within." - Ysdra, Keeper of the Box

cards.name: The Darkin Halberd
cards.text:
To play me, kill an ally.
You may spend 10 mana to play me as Taarosh.
cards.textHtml:
To play me, kill an ally.
You may spend 10 mana to play me as <link=card.unit><style=AssociatedCard>Taarosh</style></link>.
cards.flavor: Straining against the confines of his cell, Taarosh heard his general's call. He would answer it, one way or another.

cards.name: Taarosh
cards.text: Each round, the first time I attack, fill your attackers with revived Ephemeral copies of the strongest followers you've slain this game.
cards.textHtml: Each round, the first time I attack, fill your attackers with revived <link=keyword.Ephemeral><sprite name=Ephemeral><style=Keyword>Ephemeral</style></link> copies of the <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> followers you've <link=vocab.Slay><style=Vocab>slain</style></link> this game.
cards.flavor: Legend says Taarosh was mere moments from destroying Xolaani when the Darkin were set upon by the Targonians. As centuries passed, he sensed the land around him become corrupted, tainted with rot and perpetual stench of death. How he dreamt of steeping Xolaani in this same suffering once he'd claimed his freedom.

cards.name: The Darkin Halberd
cards.text: To play me, kill an ally.
cards.textHtml: To play me, kill an ally.

cards.name: Opulent Foyer
cards.text:
When I am summoned, summon a Ghastly Band.
Round Start: If you have the attack token, summon a Ghastly Band.
cards.textHtml:
When I am summoned, summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Ghastly Band</style></link>.
<link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: If you have the attack token, summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Ghastly Band</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "The players are ready, the stage is set, our audience is waiting--Maestro, if you please!" - Boisterous Host

cards.name: Malefic Spear
cards.text: If an ally died this round, I cost 2 less.
cards.textHtml: If an ally died this round, I cost 2 less.
cards.flavor: "There can be no justice... only revenge." - Kalista

cards.name: Blades of the Fallen
cards.text: Give an ally "Last Breath: Summon a Icathian Mirage with my equipment" this round.
cards.textHtml: Give an ally "<link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>Last Breath</style></link>: Summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Icathian Mirage</style></link> with my equipment" this round.
cards.flavor: Sometimes, the best you can do for a fallen ally is to take up their weapon and continue the fight.

cards.name: Icathian Mirage
cards.flavor: Perhaps they are a mirage. Perhaps she and hers hail from a remote, hidden village. She says nothing of her origin, and Jax does not ask. But when she rises from the sands and stands beside him, they fight in perfect, soundless, impossible harmony.

cards.name: Quietus
cards.text: Kill a unit with total Power and Health of 4 or less, or destroy a unit's equipment.
cards.textHtml: Kill a unit with total Power and Health of 4 or less, or destroy a unit's equipment.
cards.flavor: However death manifests on the Shadow Isles, may it be blessedly swift.

cards.name: Quietus
cards.text: Kill a unit with total Power and Health of 4 or less.
cards.textHtml: Kill a unit with total Power and Health of 4 or less.
cards.flavor: However death manifests on the Shadow Isles, may it be blessedly swift.

cards.name: Quietus
cards.text: Destroy a unit's equipment.
cards.textHtml: Destroy a unit's equipment.
cards.flavor: However death manifests on the Shadow Isles, may it be blessedly swift.

cards.name: Wraith of Echoes
cards.text: Round End: For each ally that died this round, grant all allied copies of it everywhere +1|+1.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.RoundEnd><style=Vocab>Round End</style></link>: For each ally that died this round, grant all allied copies of it <link=vocab.Everywhere><style=Vocab>everywhere</style></link> +1|+1.
cards.flavor: "I don't know what wicked magic they work, and I don't WANNA know. All's I need to know is that if they rise up, they're gettin' killed. Again." - Watcher on the Isles

cards.name: Utter Devastation
cards.text: Kill ALL units except Darkin allies and Equipped allies.
cards.textHtml: Kill ALL units except Darkin allies and <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equipped</style></link> allies.
cards.flavor: As she took hold of the weapons, her humanity fled, and in its place a hateful essence filled the emptying vessel that was once the student Jun. It washed through her, over her, around her, and out into the world, stirring the slumbering Darkin.

cards.name: Redeemed Prodigy
cards.text: Attack: Summon an attacking Ghastly Band.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Summon an attacking <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Ghastly Band</style></link>.
cards.flavor: Striving for perfection was limiting, rigid. Perfection had no life; could not breathe. However, perfect imperfection--now, that was something to strive for.

cards.name: Shape of Fear
cards.text: Kill an ally to summon an Encroaching Mist.
cards.textHtml: Kill an ally to summon an <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Encroaching Mist</style></link>.
cards.flavor: Only a fool would stare into the Black Mist in hopes of deciphering a familiar shape.

cards.name: Moonlit Glenkeeper
cards.text:
When you summon an Ephemeral ally, grant it +1|+0.
Nightfall: Summon a Sapling.
cards.textHtml:
When you summon an <link=keyword.Ephemeral><sprite name=Ephemeral><style=Keyword>Ephemeral</style></link> ally, grant it +1|+0.
<link=keyword.Nightfall><style=Keyword>Nightfall</style></link>: Summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Sapling</style></link>.
cards.flavor: Far from the Shadow Isles' shores are copses of trees thought long-dead, crooked and unmoving to all but the most keen observer--who will note that in that moon-drenched soil, new life stirs.

cards.name: Deathless Knight
cards.text: When I would gain Ephemeral, grant me +1|+1 instead.
cards.textHtml: When I would gain <link=keyword.Ephemeral><sprite name=Ephemeral><style=Keyword>Ephemeral</style></link>, grant me +1|+1 instead.
cards.flavor: Soldiers that had been trained to withstand punishment in life were only more diligent and able in death--undeterred by cold, pain, or fear.

cards.name: Soul Cleave
cards.text: Kill an ally to summon 2 Ephemeral copies of it.
cards.textHtml: Kill an ally to summon 2 <link=keyword.Ephemeral><sprite name=Ephemeral><style=Keyword>Ephemeral</style></link> copies of it.
cards.flavor: They weren't using it anyway.

cards.name: Ceaseless Sentry
cards.text: Last Breath: Draw 1.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>Last Breath</style></link>: Draw 1.
cards.flavor: “...and so I'll stand watch, into eternity, for mine is a duty beyond life, and beyond death.”

cards.name: Carved Bladetwirler
cards.flavor: "Well, that's new." - Fae Bladetwirler

cards.name: Pie Toss
cards.text: Deal 1 to a unit. Create a Perilous Pastry in hand.
cards.textHtml: Deal 1 to a unit. Create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Perilous Pastry</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: Brace yourself.

cards.name: Perilous Pastry
cards.text: Deal 1 to anything.
cards.textHtml: Deal 1 to anything.
cards.flavor: It tastes better than it feels.

cards.name: Condense
cards.text: Pick a follower. Create a 1 cost copy of it in hand and set its stats to 1|1.
cards.textHtml: Pick a follower. Create a 1 cost copy of it in hand and set its stats to 1|1.
cards.flavor: "Hmm... I guess smaller doesn't always mean cuter!" - Lulu

cards.name: Perfidious Promoter
cards.text: When you refill mana, create a Fleeting random follower in hand you can exactly afford.
cards.textHtml: When you refill mana, create a <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> random follower in hand you can exactly afford.
cards.flavor: “If you want the crimson, then you want Jack. You wanna know the where, the when, the who, and how much? You talk to me.”

cards.name: Jack
cards.text:
Strike: Create a Coin in hand.
When you refill mana, heal me 1 for each mana refilled.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>Strike</style></link>: Create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Coin</style></link> in hand.
When you refill mana, heal me 1 for each mana refilled.
cards.levelup: You've spent 12+ mana in one round.
cards.flavor: "You've got to be brave or dumb to stand against me, but either way, the outcome's the same. My advice: worry about making it out alive."

cards.name: Jack's Risky Venture
cards.text:
Deal 3 to a unit. If this kills it, create 2 Coins in hand.
Create a Jack in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
Deal 3 to a unit. If this kills it, create 2 <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Coins</style></link> in hand.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Jack</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: “Nothing ventured, nothing gained--and these jaws are built for ventures.” - Jack

cards.name: Jack
cards.text:
Strike: Create 2 Coins in hand.
When you refill mana, grant me +1|+0 and heal me 1 for each mana refilled.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>Strike</style></link>: Create 2 <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Coins</style></link> in hand.
When you refill mana, grant me +1|+0 and heal me 1 for each mana refilled.
cards.flavor: “Jack ain’t all bad. In fact, the few who’ve earned his respect might even call him charming, almost decent. But once he gets that blood smell in his nose, well... I don't think there's a more dangerous man alive.” - Bull

cards.name: Pocket Picker
cards.text: Last Breath: Create a Coin in hand.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>Last Breath</style></link>: Create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Coin</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: "Oi, get back here, slimeball! That's my potato money!" - Angel

cards.name: The King's Court
cards.text:
When I'm summoned, draw a Jack.
When you summon an ally, create a Fleeting Prize Fight in hand.
When an ally survives damage, grant it Brash.
cards.textHtml:
When I'm summoned, draw a <link=card.champ1><style=AssociatedCard>Jack</style></link>.
When you summon an ally, create a <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Prize Fight</style></link> in hand.
When an ally survives damage, grant it <link=keyword.Brash><sprite name=Brash><style=Keyword>Brash</style></link>.
cards.flavor: Jack’s personal vessel has borne him and his ilk across Runeterra's waters, from Bilgewater to Ionia. How it travels underneath the water without sinking is anyone’s guess, but it’s been said that beneath the surface is where the real danger lies...

cards.name: Risky Venture
cards.text: Deal 3 to a unit. If this kills it, create 2 Coins in hand.
cards.textHtml: Deal 3 to a unit. If this kills it, create 2 <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Coins</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: “Nothing ventured, nothing gained--and these jaws are built for ventures.” - Jack

cards.name: Prize Fight
cards.text: An ally and an enemy strike each other. They can't drop below 1 Health from this strike.
cards.textHtml: An ally and an enemy <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strike</style></link> each other. They can't drop below 1 Health from this <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strike</style></link>.
cards.flavor: Sometimes you trade in coin and lamp oil, and sometimes you trade in knuckles and teeth. That’s just the way it is, but an even exchange? That’s good business!

cards.name: Angel
cards.text: Plunder: Create 3 Coins in hand.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Plunder><style=Keyword>Plunder</style></link>: Create 3 <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Coins</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: "That the best you got? Cute. Now it's my turn."

cards.name: Five-Punch Pablo
cards.text: When I'm summoned, create a Fleeting Prize Fight in hand.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, create a <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Prize Fight</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: “That’s the way, Jackie Boy! Keep dolin’ out the ol' Bilgewater charm, and I’ll keep ye fightin' fit. Ahh, this reminds me of my golden days, when they used to call me 'Pretty-As-A-Picture Pablo'... They didnae, ye say? They did, too! That knock to yer head must've fouled yer memory.” - Five-Punch Pablo

cards.name: Mad Ol' Babs
cards.text: When you refill mana, grant me +1|+0 for each mana refilled.
cards.textHtml: When you refill mana, grant me +1|+0 for each mana refilled.
cards.flavor: "Little Jack darling, see here! I find something that interest you, yes?"

cards.name: Brazen Buccaneer
cards.text: Plunder: Summon a random 1 cost follower and grant it Brash.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Plunder><style=Keyword>Plunder</style></link>: Summon a random 1 cost follower and grant it <link=keyword.Brash><sprite name=Brash><style=Keyword>Brash</style></link>.
cards.flavor: “I’d steer clear of her if I were you. She’s got a real nasty habit of making her problems other people’s.” - Samira

cards.name: Inferna
cards.text: When you activate Plunder, draw 1 and grant it Fleeting.
cards.textHtml: When you activate <link=keyword.Plunder><style=Keyword>Plunder</style></link>, draw 1 and grant it <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link>.
cards.flavor: “There are certain advantages to being a pyromaniac at sea. Water doesn’t let a flame get outta hand, and it never asks for a cut.”

cards.name: Barbed Chain
cards.text:
Plunder: I cost 2 less.
Draw 2 at the next Round Start and grant them Fleeting.
cards.textHtml:
<link=keyword.Plunder><style=Keyword>Plunder</style></link>: I cost 2 less.
Draw 2 at the next <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link> and grant them <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link>.
cards.flavor: By the time you hear the rattling, it’s already too late to run.

cards.name: Father Fury
cards.text: Plunder: Refill 1 spell mana and create a random 1 cost spell from your regions in hand.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Plunder><style=Keyword>Plunder</style></link>: Refill 1 spell mana and create a random 1 cost spell from your regions in hand.
cards.flavor: Father Fury's origins are as thick as a thundercloud, and even when they've asked, no one's ever heard a straight answer--at least, not one they could hear over the din of his destruction.

cards.name: Nukkle
cards.text: When I'm summoned, create a Fleeting Mako in hand.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, create a <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Mako</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: “Little nick ‘ere, little slice there, all in good fun. Bit ‘o blood in the water never hurt anybody. Well, not me anyways.” - Nukkle

cards.name: Mako
cards.text: When I'm summoned, create a Fleeting Bull in hand.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, create a <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Bull</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: “You’re a small fish. I’d keep swimming.”

cards.name: Bull
cards.text: When I'm summoned, Rally.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, <link=vocab.Rally><style=Vocab>Rally</style></link>.
cards.flavor: His body a tapestry of scars and ink telling his brutal legend, Bull now serves as mentor and sparring partner to Jack. He's saving that last bit of fighting spirit for an opponent worthy enough to merit one last scrap.

cards.name: Barknuckles
cards.text: Strike: Create a Coin in hand.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>Strike</style></link>: Create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Coin</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: “Hmmm, now I know they’re not the most traditional piece of kit, yeah I’ll grant you that. But do give ‘em a try, they really grow on ya.” - Bull

cards.name: Search Warrant
cards.text: An ally with 4+ Power Captures a unit or an ally Captures a landmark.
cards.textHtml: An ally with 4+ Power <link=keyword.Capture><sprite name=Capture><style=Keyword>Captures</style></link> a unit or an ally <link=keyword.Capture><sprite name=Capture><style=Keyword>Captures</style></link> a landmark.
cards.flavor: “Remain still and silent. Any resistance would be unwise.” - Mageseeker Inspector

cards.name: Search Warrant
cards.text: An ally Captures a landmark.
cards.textHtml: An ally <link=keyword.Capture><sprite name=Capture><style=Keyword>Captures</style></link> a landmark.
cards.flavor: “Remain still and silent. Any resistance would be unwise.” - Mageseeker Inspector

cards.name: Search Warrant
cards.text: An ally with 4+ Power Captures a unit.
cards.textHtml: An ally with 4+ Power <link=keyword.Capture><sprite name=Capture><style=Keyword>Captures</style></link> a unit.
cards.flavor: “Remain still and silent. Any resistance would be unwise.” - Mageseeker Inspector

cards.name: Form Up!
cards.text: Give an ally +2|+2 this round.
cards.textHtml: Give an ally +2|+2 this round.
cards.flavor: “Stand strong! You are bent, not broken!” - Dauntless Vanguard

cards.name: Altar to Unity
cards.text:
When I'm summoned, draw a unit.
When you summon an ally, grow its stats to equal its cost.
cards.textHtml:
When I'm summoned, draw a unit.
When you summon an ally, grow its stats to equal its cost.
cards.flavor: The first time she saw the Altar, Cithria found herself at a loss for words. For a while, she could only stand in awe of the majesty of those honored heroes. Would she ever be bold enough to stand by their side?

cards.name: Thrall Bulwark
cards.text: I don't take damage from allied spells or Skills.
cards.textHtml: I don't take damage from allied spells or <link=keyword.Skill><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Skills</style></link>.
cards.flavor: “The avalanche, once begun, cannot be stopped.” - Lissandra

cards.name: Frostcoat Cub
cards.text: Spend 6 mana to play me as Frostcoat Mother instead.
cards.textHtml: Spend 6 mana to play me as <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Frostcoat Mother</style></link> instead.
cards.flavor: There are many dangers in the Freljord, especially for those yet to learn its cold truths.

cards.name: Frostcoat Mother
cards.flavor: Luckily for some in the Freljord, they have guardians who see fit that they learn the path of survival, and are not made lessons themselves.

cards.name: Frostcoat Cub
cards.flavor: There are many dangers in the Freljord, especially for those yet to learn its cold truths.

cards.name: Innovative Blacksmith
cards.text:
When I'm summoned, I Improvise.
Each round, the first time you Forge or Equip an ally, heal your Nexus 1.
cards.textHtml:
When I'm summoned, I <link=vocab.Improvise><style=Vocab>Improvise</style></link>.
Each round, the first time you <link=vocab.Forge><style=Vocab>Forge</style></link> or <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equip</style></link> an ally, heal your Nexus 1.
cards.flavor: "The little fuzzball may not be helping me work faster, but he does put a smile on my face. That's help enough." - Innovative Blacksmith

cards.name: Facebreaker
cards.text: Stun 2 enemies and create a Coin in hand.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> 2 enemies and create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Coin</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: “What? He said he’d take it on the chin--he didn't say whose!” - Sett

cards.name: Attentive Accountant
cards.text: Nexus Strike: Create a Coin in hand.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.NexusStrike><style=Vocab>Nexus Strike</style></link>: Create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Coin</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: Amid ambitious anglers and self-interested schemers, Lise has the one quality Sett prizes above all: reliability. She is never off, never short, and has never given Sett cause to wonder. This has granted Lise his backing and a warning to any seeking to stir up trouble: Bet against the House, and lose.

cards.name: Sett
cards.text: The first time I would drop below 1 Health while attacking, give me Barrier instead.
cards.textHtml: The first time I would drop below 1 Health while attacking, give me <link=keyword.Barrier><sprite name=Barrier><style=Keyword>Barrier</style></link> instead.
cards.levelup: You've spent 40+ mana.
cards.flavor: Basking in the roar of the crowd packed into his exclusive underground arena, Sett indulges in a rare moment of introspection. He remembers all he fought for, and what might yet come his way. He knows one thing for certain, though: It’s good to be the Boss.

cards.name: Sett
cards.text:
While I'm attacking, I can't take damage or die.
Each round, create a Show Stopper in hand once you've spent 12+ mana that round.
cards.textHtml:
While I'm attacking, I can't take damage or die.
Each round, create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Show Stopper</style></link> in hand once you've spent 12+ mana that round. <style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor: “Problem with bein’ the boss is, for most, ya get soft. Your own callouses start healing, and before long you’re what you swore you’d never be. So I'm grateful for all this chaos. Finally, someone’s bringing the beast outta me!”

cards.name: Sett's Facebreaker
cards.text:
Stun 2 enemies and create a Coin in hand.
Create a Sett in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
<link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> 2 enemies and create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Coin</style></link> in hand.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Sett</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: “What? He said he’d take it on the chin--he didn't say whose!” - Sett

cards.name: Show Stopper
cards.text: Obliterate an enemy. Deal 1 to all other enemies and the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Obliterate><style=Vocab>Obliterate</style></link> an enemy. Deal 1 to all other enemies and the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: "For one moment, just before I shatter your spine to splinters, I'm gonna make you immortal.” - Sett

cards.name: Coin
cards.text:
Coins stack.
Refill 1 mana.
cards.textHtml:
<link=card.selfRef><style=AssociatedCard>Coins</style></link> stack.
Refill <style=Variable>1</style> mana.
cards.flavor: "What can I say? I'm a generous guy." - Sett

cards.name: Bout Security
cards.text:
When I'm summoned, create a Fleeting Bout Security in hand and grant other Bout Security +1|+1.
Empowered 5: Quick Attack.
cards.textHtml:
When I'm summoned, create a <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link> <link=card.selfRef><style=AssociatedCard>Bout Security</style></link> in hand and grant other <link=card.selfRef><style=AssociatedCard>Bout Security</style></link> +1|+1.
<link=vocab.Empowered><style=Vocab>Empowered</style></link> 5: <link=keyword.Quick Strike><sprite name=QuickStrike><style=Keyword>Quick Attack</style></link>.
cards.flavor: “If they think you’re thick, go on and let ‘em. Let the bad apples think they’re safe to run their games--there ain’t a thing in life better than the look in their eyes when they realize they underestimated you.” - Sett

cards.name: Pit Professional
cards.text: When I'm summoned, create a Coin in hand.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Coin</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: “Some are in it for the coin, others the blood, and some for the roar of the crowd. Me? Never could choose just one. I need it all, and I have everything here in spades.”

cards.name: Master Bingwen, the Sieve
cards.text: Play: The next time you play a unit this round, summon an exact Ephemeral copy of it.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: The next time you play a unit this round, summon an exact <link=keyword.Ephemeral><sprite name=Ephemeral><style=Keyword>Ephemeral</style></link> copy of it.
cards.flavor: Bingwen the Bird was once a fighter, so called for his cranelike stance and agility. Since retiring, he has taken up the mantle of a trainer--using his keen eye and firm hand to separate the fine talent from the coarse.

cards.name: Place Your Bets
cards.text: Draw 2 and create 2 Coins in hand.
cards.textHtml: Draw 2 and create 2 <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Coins</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: “They give us real money, and we give them a chance. Heh… and some really wonder how the House always wins.”

cards.name: Smooth Mixologist
cards.text: Play: Heal an ally or your Nexus 3 and create a Coin in hand.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Heal an ally or your Nexus 3 and create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Coin</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: "First round is about saying hello, and the second gets them cozy. Problems come out by the third, and from the fourth on, the lips get real loose--you wouldn't believe the kind of things I hear!"

cards.name: Tag Out!
cards.text: Recall an ally and create a Coin in hand, or spend 5 mana to Recall an enemy and create a Coin in hand.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recall</style></link> an ally and create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Coin</style></link> in hand, or spend 5 mana to <link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recall</style></link> an enemy and create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Coin</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: “I’ll only come in under two conditions. First, if your opponent is havin’ too much fun wreckin’ ya. Second, you’re the one havin’ too much fun, and I want my piece too!” - Pit Professional

cards.flavor: “I’ll only come in under two conditions. First, if your opponent is havin’ too much fun wreckin’ ya. Second, you’re the one havin’ too much fun, and I want my piece too!” - Pit Professional

cards.name: The Old Timer
cards.text: Play: Recall the strongest enemy. If you've spent 16+ mana this round, Recall all enemies instead.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.PlaySkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Play</style></link>: <link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recall</style></link> the <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> enemy. If you've spent 16+ mana this round, <link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recall</style></link> all enemies instead. <style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor: "The mask's not comin' off, girl. And unless you wanna end up looking like this thing, don't ask again."

cards.name: More Than You Can Chew
cards.text: Recall the strongest enemy. If you've spent 16+ mana this round, Recall all enemies instead.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recall</style></link> the <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> enemy. If you've spent 16+ mana this round, <link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recall</style></link> all enemies instead.
cards.flavor: “You need this lesson, make no mistake⁠--but you ain’t gonna like it.” - The Old Timer

cards.name: Royal Shimmerwing
cards.text: Other Bird allies have +1|+0 and Quick Attack.
cards.textHtml: Other Bird allies have +1|+0 and <link=keyword.Quick Strike><sprite name=QuickStrike><style=Keyword>Quick Attack</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "In these jungles, I've consistently found the most beautiful specimens to be the deadliest predators." - Anura

cards.name: Beguiling Cobra
cards.text: Each round, the first time you play another follower, summon an exact copy of it. If your board is full, grant its stats and keywords to me instead.
cards.textHtml: Each round, the first time you play another follower, summon an exact copy of it. If your board is full, grant its stats and keywords to me instead.
cards.flavor: "Think these flowers are worth anything? And don't call me crazy, but do they look like they're... dancing?" - Piltovan Poacher

cards.name: Falling Star
cards.text: Deal 4 to an enemy that attacked this round or is Stunned.
cards.textHtml: Deal 4 to an enemy that attacked this round or is <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stunned</style></link>.
cards.flavor: The stars look down upon our acts, be they good or ill. The righteous are lifted up, while the wicked suffer judgment.

cards.name: Cosmic Youngling
cards.text: Round Start: Heal me and your Nexus 1.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Heal me and your Nexus 1.
cards.flavor: Like the tear of an aurora they trace the heavens, their radiant gaze bringing calm, soothing wounds and mending what is broken.

cards.name: Sacrificial Scholar
cards.text: Last Breath: Create in hand copies of the first 3 spells you played on me.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>Last Breath</style></link>: Create in hand copies of the first 3 spells you played on me. <style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor: "Camphor has taken too much, from too many. When it is your time to die, make sure it is on your own terms. Do not give her the satisfaction." - Pantheon

cards.name: Daring Demolisher
cards.text: Play: Deal 1 to the enemy Nexus or activate an ally's Plunder effect.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Deal 1 to the enemy Nexus or activate an ally's <link=keyword.Plunder><style=Keyword>Plunder</style></link> effect.
cards.flavor: “Being in the weapons business means having a healthy relationship with data. Concept, test, rebuild, modify: all that takes information. There’s nothing like a little field testing to create a healthy sample size, and a few craters!” - Lani

cards.name: Daring Demolisher
cards.text: Play: Activate an ally's Plunder effect.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Activate an ally's <link=keyword.Plunder><style=Keyword>Plunder</style></link> effect.

cards.flavor: “Being in the weapons business means having a healthy relationship with data. Concept, test, rebuild, modify: all that takes information. There’s nothing like a little field testing to create a healthy sample size, and a few craters!” - Lani

cards.name: All Out
cards.text:
Give an ally +2|+0 this round.
Plunder: Give it +2|+1 instead.
cards.textHtml:
Give an ally +2|+0 this round.
<link=keyword.Plunder><style=Keyword>Plunder</style></link>: Give it +2|+1 instead.
cards.flavor: “Indari’s pulled some strings to get us in without a fuss. Here’s hoping there’ll be time for me to make one on our way out.” - Samira

cards.name: Adroit Artificer
cards.text: When I'm summoned, activate all ally Plunder effects.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, activate all ally <link=keyword.Plunder><style=Keyword>Plunder</style></link> effects.
cards.flavor: “Setting up shop can be tricky in some places, but with one look at my and Lani’s wares, the coin was flying. Didn’t see our mark among those perusing, but plenty others with violence on their minds tonight. After all, finding out who wants to kill who is a decent way to get the lay of the land.” - Miel

cards.name: Captain Indari
cards.text:
When I'm summoned, I Improvise.
Plunder: Forge other allies.
cards.textHtml:
When I'm summoned, I <link=vocab.Improvise><style=Vocab>Improvise</style></link>.
<link=keyword.Plunder><style=Keyword>Plunder</style></link>: <link=vocab.Forge><style=Vocab>Forge</style></link> other allies.
cards.flavor: “I’ve worked with many operatives before. Some were easy, some a challenge... and then there’s Samira. I made peace with the fact that I can’t reign her in--instead, I direct the bedlam, aim it--and occasionally, join in here and there.”

cards.name: Dashing Dandy
cards.text: Plunder: Double my power.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Plunder><style=Keyword>Plunder</style></link>: Double my power.
cards.flavor: “Look, normally I like to set down some rules--like "paws off the hair and face", but who am I kidding? You won’t lay a finger on me.”

cards.name: Samira
cards.text: Plunder or strike: Create a Flair in hand if you don't already have one.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Plunder><style=Keyword>Plunder</style></link> or <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strike</style></link>: Create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Flair</style></link> in hand if you don't already have one.
cards.levelup: I've seen you play 6 cards. Resets when you start a round with the attack token.
cards.flavor: “I'm always running down some mark who ran up debts he couldn’t pay. And running from those debts makes you the wrong kind of enemies--the ones who call me.”

cards.name: Samira
cards.text:
Plunder or strike: Create a Flair in hand if you don't already have one.
When you play 6 cards, Rally. Resets when you start a round with the attack token.
cards.textHtml:
<link=keyword.Plunder><style=Keyword>Plunder</style></link> or <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strike</style></link>: Create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Flair</style></link> in hand if you don't already have one.
