When you play 6 cards, <link=vocab.Rally><style=Vocab>Rally</style></link>. Resets when you start a round with the attack token. <style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor: “Had a feeling there was more going on here than a little debt evader. Indari calls these ‘complications.’ I call them flavor.”

cards.name: Samira's All Out
cards.text:
Give an ally +2|+0 this round.
Plunder: Give it +2|+1 instead.
Create a Samira in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
Give an ally +2|+0 this round.
<link=keyword.Plunder><style=Keyword>Plunder</style></link>: Give it +2|+1 instead.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Samira</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: “Indari’s pulled some strings to get us in without a fuss. Here’s hoping there’ll be time for me to make one on our way out.” - Samira

cards.name: Flair
cards.text: Give an allied Samira Challenger this round.
cards.textHtml: Give an allied <link=card.samira><style=AssociatedCard>Samira</style></link> <link=keyword.Challenger><sprite name=Challenger><style=Keyword>Challenger</style></link> this round.
cards.flavor: “Get too close, you’ll get the steel. Stray too far, you get the lead.” -Samira

cards.name: Flair
cards.text: Deal 1 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml: Deal 1 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: “Get too close, you’ll get the steel. Stray too far, you get the lead.” -Samira

cards.name: Flair
cards.text: Give an allied Samira Challenger this round or deal 1 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml: Give an allied <link=card.samira><style=AssociatedCard>Samira</style></link> <link=keyword.Challenger><sprite name=Challenger><style=Keyword>Challenger</style></link> this round or deal 1 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: “Get too close, you’ll get the steel. Stray too far, you get the lead.” -Samira

cards.name: Elegant Edge
cards.text: Plunder: Grant me +2|+0.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Plunder><style=Keyword>Plunder</style></link>: Grant me +2|+0.
cards.flavor: “My fee is steep, and I don’t work for just anybody. If you’re lucky enough to hire me, you get grace, poise, and blades that never miss their mark. But most of all, style. Because who doesn’t love killing with a flourish?”

cards.name: Stylish Shot
cards.text: Deal 1 to the enemy Nexus. The next time an ally strikes the Nexus this round, create a Stylish Shot in hand.
cards.textHtml: Deal 1 to the enemy Nexus. The next time an ally <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strikes</style></link> the Nexus this round, create a <link=card.selfRef><style=AssociatedCard>Stylish Shot</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: “Nobody could keep up with me even if all I had were sticks and stones. With my kit? Don’t even try.” - Samira

cards.name: Pirouette
cards.text:
Plunder: I cost 2 less.
Deal 1 to anything and Stun an enemy.
cards.textHtml:
<link=keyword.Plunder><style=Keyword>Plunder</style></link>: I cost 2 less.
Deal 1 to anything and <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> an enemy.
cards.flavor: “What? I was stretching. Don’t tell me you died to me stretching.” - Elegant Edge

cards.name: Dame the Despoiler
cards.text: Plunder: Grant allies +1|+0.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Plunder><style=Keyword>Plunder</style></link>: Grant allies +1|+0.
cards.flavor: “Ah, Dame. She has a flair for the dramatic, that one. Some might turn their nose up at a little pageantry, but when she’s in her element, we’re all getting paid.” - Elegant Edge

cards.name: Blowback
cards.text: Deal 1 to an enemy and the enemy Nexus. Discard up to 2 to increase the damage by 1 for each card discarded.
cards.textHtml: Deal 1 to an enemy and the enemy Nexus. Discard up to 2 to increase the damage by 1 for each card discarded.
cards.flavor: “Okay, okay, this may only work once, but trust me, it’s gonna be a blast!” - Jinx

cards.name: Augmented Clockling
cards.text: Play: Predict, then draw 1 and reduce its cost by 1.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: <link=vocab.Predict><style=Vocab>Predict</style></link>, then draw 1 and reduce its cost by 1.
cards.flavor: “This little guy just needed a bit of tinkering. Fresh gears here, a new arm there, and they get a new lease on life. Time’s a gift everyone should get a little more of, I say.” - Ekko

cards.name: Flashbomb Peddler
cards.text: When you play a spell, plant 1 Flashbomb Trap in the top 8 cards of the enemy deck.
cards.textHtml: When you play a spell, plant 1 <link=card.trap><style=AssociatedCard>Flashbomb Trap</style></link> in the top 8 cards of the enemy deck.
cards.flavor: "...And you know what else makes these babies better than mushrooms? You decide when they explode! How's THAT for value?"

cards.name: Pack Attack
cards.text: Start a free attack with an exact Ephemeral copy of each Cat ally.
cards.textHtml: Start a free attack with an exact <link=keyword.Ephemeral><sprite name=Ephemeral><style=Keyword>Ephemeral</style></link> copy of each Cat ally.
cards.flavor: A lone huntress is fearsome enough--but a pack is truly ferocious.

cards.name: Secret Keeper
cards.text: When I'm summoned, create at the bottom of your deck two random level 2 champions that aren't in your hand, deck, or play.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, create at the bottom of your deck two random level 2 champions that aren't in your hand, deck, or play.
cards.flavor: He knew not fully what he saw, what shape the calamity might take, or when--but he knows this world and its people. They are not ready. They may never be.

cards.name: Fallen Sands General
cards.text: I have +1|+0 for each Ephemeral ally you've summoned this game.
cards.textHtml: I have +1|+0 for each <link=keyword.Ephemeral><sprite name=Ephemeral><style=Keyword>Ephemeral</style></link> ally you've summoned this game. <style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor: “Though you may be naught but grains of sand to this foe, I see you. I feel your presence in the dunes. Lend your strength to me, and we shall bring our enemies low together!”

cards.name: Eradication
cards.text: Kill ALL units with 3 or less Power.
cards.textHtml: Kill ALL units with 3 or less Power.
cards.flavor: Whoever looks upon me shall know oblivion’s touch, and they shall never be free of it.

cards.name: Soul Harvest
cards.text: Kill a follower with 3 or less Power, or spend 3 mana to kill a champion with 3 or less Power.
cards.textHtml: Kill a follower with 3 or less Power, or spend 3 mana to kill a champion with 3 or less Power.
cards.flavor: It is but a whisper upon the air, barely heard but sorely felt, that trades one life for another.

cards.name: Soul Harvest
cards.text: Kill a follower with 3 or less Power.
cards.textHtml: Kill a follower with 3 or less Power.
cards.flavor: It is but a whisper upon the air, barely heard but sorely felt, that trades one life for another.

cards.name: Soul Harvest
cards.text: Kill a champion with 3 or less Power.
cards.textHtml: Kill a champion with 3 or less Power.
cards.flavor: It is but a whisper upon the air, barely heard but sorely felt, that trades one life for another.

cards.name: Grave Companion
cards.text: Each round, the first time another ally dies, draw 1.
cards.textHtml: Each round, the first time another ally dies, draw 1.
cards.flavor: "I just taught him a new trick! Wanna see it?" - Phantom Prankster

cards.name: Ferocious Fluffs
cards.text: When I'm summoned, grant other allies that have subtypes +1|+1 and Impact.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, grant other allies that have subtypes +1|+1 and <link=keyword.Impact><sprite name=Impact><style=Keyword>Impact</style></link>.
cards.flavor: Unfortunately for this crew of Piltovan poachers, they only look harmless.

cards.name: Return-o Wrench
cards.text: When I'm discarded, Equip me to a random unequipped ally.
cards.textHtml: When I'm discarded, <link=vocab.Equip><style=Vocab>Equip</style></link> me to a random unequipped ally.
cards.flavor: "I can't lie--I'm prone to losing my tools. This one, though, always pops back up right when I need it!" - Safety Inspector

cards.name: Portal Scholar
cards.text:
When I'm summoned, plant a Mysterious Portal in the top 4 cards of your deck.
When you summon a created ally, grant it Impact.
cards.textHtml:
When I'm summoned, plant a <link=card.portal><style=AssociatedCard>Mysterious Portal</style></link> in the top 4 cards of your deck.
When you summon a created ally, grant it <link=keyword.Impact><sprite name=Impact><style=Keyword>Impact</style></link>.
cards.flavor: At the forefront of any research, there are bound to be surprises--luckily, this is a fortunate one.

cards.name: Mister Thrift
cards.text: When one or more of your traps or boons activate, plant 2 of it in that player's deck.
cards.textHtml: When one or more of your traps or boons activate, plant 2 of it in that player's deck.
cards.flavor: Nobody can say how long Mister Thrift has been collecting, or where he came from. He seems friendly enough--never mind that troublesome trail of tripping hazards he leaves in his wake.

cards.name: Siren Song
cards.text:
Summon a random Husk.
Grant 1 cost allies everywhere +1|+1.
cards.textHtml:
Summon a random Husk.
Grant 1 cost allies <link=vocab.Everywhere><style=Vocab>everywhere</style></link> +1|+1.
cards.flavor: Some Bilgewater sailors stuff cotton in their ears on the quietest nights at sea. They know well that music from beneath the waves promises nothing but a watery tomb.

cards.name: The Swindler's Den
cards.text:
Your cards in hand have Fleeting.
When you play a card, draw 1.
cards.textHtml:
Your cards in hand have <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link>.
When you play a card, draw 1.
cards.flavor: "I reckon you ought to know your hand and hold it close, or be prepared to lose it all." - Twisted Fate

cards.name: Dragon Prince Grinzo
cards.text: Each round, the first time you summon a 1 cost ally, refill 1 spell mana.
cards.textHtml: Each round, the first time you summon a 1 cost ally, refill 1 spell mana.
cards.flavor: "Mister Lizard, what are you doing here? You like Poros too!?" - Ingvar the Younger

cards.name: Deck Hunter
cards.text: Play: Manifest a follower that has a different subtype than allies in play.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: <link=vocab.Manifest><style=Vocab>Manifest</style></link> a follower that has a different subtype than allies in play.
cards.flavor: "There's a reason we keep this scruffy little guy around: haven't had a wharf rat problem in years!" - Dreadway Deckhand

cards.name: Tidal Invocation
cards.text: Deal 1 to a unit. Spawn 1 for each damage dealt.
cards.textHtml: Deal 1 to a unit. <link=vocab.Spawn><style=Vocab>Spawn</style></link> 1 for each damage dealt.
cards.flavor: Only the most learned can bend the elements to their will.

cards.name: Mageseeker Junior
cards.text: Spells that cost less than 3 cost 3 instead.
cards.textHtml: Spells that cost less than 3 cost 3 instead.
cards.flavor: "Silence! This is no mere game, as you claim, but the cloak of some insidious arcane engagement. I mean to expose you as a cheat and a mage, you old scoundrel--even if I have to burn this whole establishment down to do it!"

cards.name: Scrutinizing Sergeant
cards.text: Play: Pick a unit from the top 5 cards of your deck that costs 3 or less. Summon it and place the rest into your deck.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Pick a unit from the top 5 cards of your deck that costs 3 or less. Summon it and place the rest into your deck.
cards.flavor: The Demacian draft sergeant carries a weighty responsibility. His recruits will go on to occupy many different posts, all united in their duty to and love for Demacia.

cards.name: Crested Lionhawk
cards.text: Play: If an ally has a different subtype than me, Manifest a Demacian spell.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: If an ally has a different subtype than me, <link=vocab.Manifest><style=Vocab>Manifest</style></link> a Demacian spell.
cards.flavor: "Recording first confirmed sighting of the lionhawk in nearly fifty years. Beautiful blue crest, intelligent eyes. Body is armored, but bones are light enough for at least tree-climbing, if not limited gliding. Wing structures almost reminiscent of Demacian silverwings. Will return with more measurements." - From Anura's field journal, day 12

cards.name: Balen the Benevolent
cards.text: Attack: Grant other Formidable allies everywhere +0|+1.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Grant other <link=keyword.Formidable><sprite name=Formidable><style=Keyword>Formidable</style></link> allies <link=vocab.Everywhere><style=Vocab>everywhere</style></link> +0|+1.
cards.flavor: A long-time companion of the Durand family, Balen's great size belies his gentle precision. Though he began as an assistant, Balen is greatly gifted in the craft and uniquely inspired in its practice--and the Durands are proud to call him their friend.

cards.name: Snowy Razorclaw
cards.text: Plunder: Grow an ally's stats to mine.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Plunder><style=Keyword>Plunder</style></link>: Grow an ally's stats to mine.
cards.flavor: Though the snowy razorclaw primarily hunts small mammals, this Freljordian beast has enough claws to make nearly anything into a meal.

cards.name: Temple to True Ice
cards.text: When you summon an ally, grow its Health to equal its Power.
cards.textHtml: When you summon an ally, grow its Health to equal its Power.
cards.flavor: Though the meaning of this temple has long been lost to time, its stone guardian still stands, unbent by the weight of many avalanches. Rimed with frost, he seems to be imbued with some strange and alluring light...

cards.name: Ingvar the Younger
cards.text: Play: Pick an ally. Grant it and all other allies that share a subtype with it +1|+1 or Manifest a follower that shares a subtype with it.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Pick an ally. Grant it and all other allies that share a subtype with it +1|+1 or <link=vocab.Manifest><style=Vocab>Manifest</style></link> a follower that shares a subtype with it.
cards.flavor: Self-appointed Poro supervisor and explorer of the Freljord, Ingvar is sure that adventure is out there--and she's going to find it.

cards.name: Ingvar the Younger
cards.text: Play: Grant an ally and all other allies that share a subtype with it +1|+1.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Grant an ally and all other allies that share a subtype with it +1|+1.
cards.flavor: Self-appointed Poro supervisor and explorer of the Freljord, Ingvar is sure that adventure is out there--and she's going to find it.

cards.name: Ingvar the Younger
cards.text: Play: Manifest a follower that shares a subtype with an ally.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: <link=vocab.Manifest><style=Vocab>Manifest</style></link> a follower that shares a subtype with an ally.
cards.flavor: Self-appointed Poro supervisor and explorer of the Freljord, Ingvar is sure that adventure is out there--and she's going to find it.

cards.name: Glacial Saurian
cards.text: When I'm summoned, grant the top 3 units in your deck +1|+1. If an ally has a different subtype than me, draw 1 of those units.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, grant the top 3 units in your deck +1|+1. If an ally has a different subtype than me, draw 1 of those units.
cards.flavor: With a bony exterior belying its big heart, these reliable steeds are vital for clearing icy mountain passes.

cards.name: Crystalline Stormraptor
cards.text: Play: Deal 2 to ALL other units.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Elemental Skill><sprite name=ElementalSkill><style=Keyword>Play</style></link>: Deal 2 to ALL other units.
cards.flavor: The violence of the crystalline stormraptor is indiscriminate and instantaneous, turning the tide of battle within moments. The bird is considered by many to the first omen of a great and terrible storm--one meant to reshape the bones of the earth itself.

cards.name: Piercing Lightning
cards.text: Deal 2 to ALL other units.
cards.textHtml: Deal 2 to ALL other units.
cards.flavor: "You want to know how to survive the shriek of the stormraptor? Ha. When you hear the bird's call, the only thing left to do is pray." - Avarosan Outrider

cards.name: Rejuvenating Breeze
cards.text: Heal your Nexus 3 and draw 2 spells.
cards.textHtml: Heal your Nexus 3 and draw 2 spells.
cards.flavor: "The wind is the wanderer's only ally." - Yasuo

cards.name: All-Seeing Oracle
cards.text: Play: Pick 1 of 3 Fast or Slow spells in the enemy's hand or deck. Create a Carvings of Divination for it.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Pick 1 of 3 <link=keyword.Fast><sprite name=Fast><style=Keyword>Fast</style></link> or <link=keyword.Slow><sprite name=Slow><style=Keyword>Slow</style></link> spells in the enemy's hand or deck. Create a <link=card.cardref><style=AssociatedCard>Carvings of Divination</style></link> for it.
cards.flavor: The eye unbound from the material world sees all. Blind though he may seem, those who mistake the oracle for an easy target are rebuked swiftly and without mercy.

cards.name: Carvings of Divination
cards.text: Stop the chosen spell.
cards.textHtml: <style=Variable>Stop the chosen spell.</style>
cards.flavor: "Watch how the sticks fall. Only when you look beyond what you see will you understand your fate." - All-Seeing Oracle

cards.name: Airis
cards.text: Nexus Strike: Summon a random Husk.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.NexusStrike><style=Vocab>Nexus Strike</style></link>: Summon a random Husk.
cards.flavor: "Hush, we're nearly there. You said you wanted to meet my friend, didn't you? Trust me--she's going to love you."

cards.name: Star-Crossed Lovers
cards.text: Play: Recall an ally and grant it my stats.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: <link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recall</style></link> an ally and grant it my stats.
cards.flavor: "There are few sights more splendid than the meeting of the sun and the moon." - Diana

cards.name: Age of Dragons
cards.text: For the top 9 cards in your deck, draw each Dragon and reduce their costs to 0 this round, then shuffle the rest into your deck.
cards.textHtml: For the top 9 cards in your deck, draw each Dragon and reduce their costs to 0 this round, then shuffle the rest into your deck.
cards.flavor: "To know one dragon is to master the self. To know many is to master the world." - Ottrani Dragon-Worshiper

cards.name: Cosmic Call
cards.text: Invoke a Celestial that costs 7 or more, or pay 8 to reduce the cost of your Celestials everywhere by half, rounded up.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Invoke><style=Keyword>Invoke</style></link> a Celestial that costs 7 or more, or pay 8 to reduce the cost of your Celestials <link=vocab.Everywhere><style=Vocab>everywhere</style></link> by half, rounded up.
cards.flavor: The Arbiter stands perennial watch as blessings of the heavens descend.

cards.name: Cosmic Call
cards.text: Reduce the cost of your Celestials everywhere by half, rounded up.
cards.textHtml: Reduce the cost of your Celestials <link=vocab.Everywhere><style=Vocab>everywhere</style></link> by half, rounded up.
cards.flavor: The Arbiter stands perennial watch as blessings of the heavens descend.

cards.name: Cosmic Call
cards.text: Invoke a Celestial that costs 7 or more.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Invoke><style=Keyword>Invoke</style></link> a Celestial that costs 7 or more.
cards.flavor: The Arbiter stands perennial watch as blessings of the heavens descend.

cards.name: Captain Kalrix
cards.text: Nexus Strike: Deal damage to the enemy Nexus equal to half its Health, rounded up.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.NexusStrike><style=Vocab>Nexus Strike</style></link>: Deal damage to the enemy Nexus equal to half its Health, rounded up.
cards.flavor: Noxus is an empire built for expansion above all. Wood, stone or steel--nothing can stop the advance of a Noxian battering ram.

cards.name: Ravenborn Tome
cards.text: When my bearer plays a Skill, copy it.
cards.textHtml: When my bearer plays a <link=keyword.Skill><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Skill</style></link>, copy it.
cards.flavor: The Ravenbloom Conservatory was especially renowned for its collection of texts, many of which ultimately became fuel for the roaring fire set by one notoriously difficult pupil...

cards.name: Bonehide Tri-tail
cards.text: When I'm summoned, grant me +1|+1 for each different subtype other allies have.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, grant me +1|+1 for each different subtype other allies have. <style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor: "Be careful, you imbeciles! Noxians only buy fighting beasts in perfect condition. So much as a scratch, and it's coming out of your pay!" - Big Game Tycoon

cards.name: Crimson Banquet Hall
cards.text: Allies cost 1 less. When you play an ally, deal 2 to it.
cards.textHtml: Allies cost 1 less. When you play an ally, deal 2 to it.
cards.flavor: "Come, my friends, sit! The company is good and the drinks are flowing. I simply cannot wait to show you what's for supper." - Vladimir

cards.name: Sump Monument
cards.text: If your Nexus would take non-Poison Puffcap damage, your opponent plants 5 Poison Puffcaps in your deck for each damage instead.
cards.textHtml: If your Nexus would take non-<link=card.cardref><style=AssociatedCard>Poison Puffcap</style></link> damage, your opponent plants 5 <link=card.cardref><style=AssociatedCard>Poison Puffcaps</style></link> in your deck for each damage instead.
cards.flavor: Deep beneath the streets of Zaun, you are what you eat.

cards.name: Epic Scraptraption
cards.text: To play, spend all your mana. Summon a Runaway Scraptrap and grow its stats to that amount.
cards.textHtml: To play, spend all your mana. Summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Runaway Scraptrap</style></link> and grow its stats to that amount.
cards.flavor: "A scientist's primary responsibility is to control variables. The consequences of accidents, in a field of study such as ours--oh, I shudder to think of it!" - Professor Heimerdinger

cards.name: Runaway Scraptrap
cards.flavor: "Now, let me see--perhaps if we added... Oh, dear! Someone get after that contraption!" - Professor Heimerdinger

cards.name: Chemtech Catermobile
cards.text: I have +1|+0 for each 1 cost ally you've summoned this game.
cards.textHtml: I have +1|+0 for each 1 cost ally you've summoned this game.
cards.flavor: "I have to draw da horse LOTS of legs, Mister Lizard, 'cause we gotta get to da castle FAST. Uh oh, he came out a lil'... oopy goopy. And a lil' gween." - Ingvar the Younger

cards.name: Anura & Froop
cards.text: Allies that have a different subtype than other allies in play cost 1 less.
cards.textHtml: Allies that have a different subtype than other allies in play cost 1 less.
cards.flavor: "I won't hurt you, friend! I came to this jungle for science, not destruction."

cards.name: Divine Draft
cards.text: Deal 1 to an enemy or the enemy Nexus, and 1 to another.
cards.textHtml: Deal 1 to an enemy or the enemy Nexus, and 1 to another.
cards.flavor: Most Piltovans could care less about the patterns of the wind. But for many Zaunites, even a stray breeze smells of salvation.

cards.name: Neeko
cards.text:
Origin: Many-Shaped Jungle Friends!
Play: You may disguise me as 1 of 3 two cost followers from my Origin.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Origin><style=Vocab>Origin</style></link>: <link=card.origin><style=AssociatedCard>Many-Shaped Jungle Friends!</style></link>
<link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: You may <link=vocab.Disguise><style=Vocab>disguise</style></link> me as 1 of 3 two cost followers from my <link=vocab.Origin><style=Vocab>Origin</style></link>.
cards.levelup: Attack: You've attacked with allies that have 6+ different subtypes.
cards.flavor: Neeko can take many shapes, but her heart never changes--always leading her back to her family and her forest.

cards.name: Neeko's Shapesplitter
cards.text:
Summon an exact Ephemeral copy of an ally, then swap them.
Create a Neeko in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
Summon an exact <link=keyword.Ephemeral><sprite name=Ephemeral><style=Keyword>Ephemeral</style></link> copy of an ally, then swap them.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Neeko</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "Neeko is here, Neeko is there--Neeko could be anywhere!" - Neeko

cards.name: Neeko
cards.text: When I level up or Attack: Grant allies that have a subtype everywhere +1|+1.
cards.textHtml: When I level up or <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Grant allies that have a subtype <link=vocab.Everywhere><style=Vocab>everywhere</style></link> +1|+1.
cards.flavor: "Shapes and colors, colors and shapes--Neeko can be them all!"

cards.name: Many-Shaped Jungle Friends!
cards.text: You may put Bird, Cat, Dog, Elnuk, Fae, Reptile, and Spider followers into your deck during deckbuilding.
cards.textHtml: You may put Bird, Cat, Dog, Elnuk, Fae, Reptile, and Spider followers into your deck during deckbuilding.
cards.flavor: "Neeko will lead us to protect the jungle! Well... Neeko will lead us to Nidalee--and then we will all protect the jungle together!" - Neeko

cards.name: The Poro King
cards.text:
Origin: The Poro King's Decree.
Each round, the first time you summon another Poro, create a Poro Snax in hand.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Origin><style=Vocab>Origin</style></link>: <link=card.origin><style=AssociatedCard>The Poro King's Decree</style></link>.
Each round, the first time you summon another Poro, create a <link=card.baseSnax><style=AssociatedCard>Poro Snax</style></link> in hand.
cards.levelup: You've summoned 6+ other new Poros. When I level up, create a random Special Snax in hand.
cards.flavor: Ingvar knows potential when she sees it. Homemade appearance aside, this beloved companion could easily be the ruler of a gajillion trillion Poros--with the right amount of imagination.

cards.name: The Poro King's Decree
cards.text: You may put any non-champion cards with the word "Poro" on them into your deck during deckbuilding.
cards.textHtml: You may put any non-champion cards with the word "Poro" on them into your deck during deckbuilding.
cards.flavor: "Dis is His Super-Highness Poro King's Dee-cree, for pwotection of all da peoples..." - Ingvar the Younger

cards.name: Pepper Snax
cards.text: Grant Poro allies everywhere +1|+1. Give Poro allies Impact this round.
cards.textHtml: Grant Poro allies <link=vocab.Everywhere><style=Vocab>everywhere</style></link> +1|+1. Give Poro allies <link=keyword.Impact><sprite name=Impact><style=Keyword>Impact</style></link> this round.
cards.flavor: With hot sausage, flaky dough, and a triple simmered spicy sauce, this treat comes in at a solid ten on Ingvar's Super Spicy Scale, and is one of her all-time favorites.

cards.name: The Poro King's Council Call
cards.text:
Draw 2 different Poro followers and grant them +1|+1.
Create a The Poro King in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
Draw 2 different Poro followers and grant them +1|+1.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>The Poro King</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: They may be small, but there's strength in numbers. Round, fuzzy, terrifyingly plentiful numbers.

cards.name: The Poro King
cards.text: Each round, the first time you summon another Poro, create a random Special Snax in hand.
cards.textHtml: Each round, the first time you summon another Poro, create a random Special Snax in hand.
cards.flavor: "MOOOM, come look! Mister Highness Poro King is comin' to liiiiife! Look, he really is! I'm not makin' it up this time, I pinky pwomise!" - Ingvar the Younger

cards.name: Frosted Snax
cards.text: Grant Poro allies everywhere +1|+1. Frostbite an enemy.
cards.textHtml: Grant Poro allies <link=vocab.Everywhere><style=Vocab>everywhere</style></link> +1|+1. <link=keyword.Frostbite><sprite name=Frostbite><style=Keyword>Frostbite</style></link> an enemy.
cards.flavor: This pastry boasts frosting hand-made with all the flavors of the Freljord: powder snow, packed snow, and--you guessed it--snowfall!

cards.name: Espresso Snax
cards.text: Grant Poro allies everywhere +1|+1. Give 2 Poro allies Challenger this round.
cards.textHtml: Grant Poro allies <link=vocab.Everywhere><style=Vocab>everywhere</style></link> +1|+1. Give 2 Poro allies <link=keyword.Challenger><sprite name=Challenger><style=Keyword>Challenger</style></link> this round.
cards.flavor: Served piping hot and bursting with bold, roasty flavors, an early morning pick-me-up will do any Poro some good.

cards.name: Colorful Snax
cards.text: Grant Poro allies everywhere +1|+1. Grant allied champions everywhere +1|+1 and a random keyword.
cards.textHtml: Grant Poro allies <link=vocab.Everywhere><style=Vocab>everywhere</style></link> +1|+1. Grant allied champions <link=vocab.Everywhere><style=Vocab>everywhere</style></link> +1|+1 and a random keyword.
cards.flavor: "All da colors DO taste different, if you tink reaaaaaallly hard about it." - Ingvar the Younger

cards.name: Council Call
cards.text: Draw 2 different Poro followers and grant them +1|+1.
cards.textHtml: Draw 2 different Poro followers and grant them +1|+1.
cards.flavor: They may be small, but there's strength in numbers--round, fuzzy, terrifingly plentiful numbers.

cards.name: Shapesplitter
cards.text: Summon an exact Ephemeral copy of an ally, then swap them.
cards.textHtml: Summon an exact <link=keyword.Ephemeral><sprite name=Ephemeral><style=Keyword>Ephemeral</style></link> copy of an ally, then swap them.
cards.flavor: "Neeko is here, Neeko is there--Neeko could be anywhere!" -Neeko

cards.name: Blimp-Pack Poacher
cards.text:
Ambush 3
When I transform from Blimp-Pack Poacher's Ambush, the next time I block or am blocked this round, Capture my enemy.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Ambush><style=Vocab>Ambush 3</style></link>
When I transform from <link=card.ambush><style=AssociatedCard>Blimp-Pack Poacher's Ambush</style></link>, the next time I block or am blocked this round, <link=keyword.Capture><sprite name=Capture><style=Keyword>Capture</style></link> my enemy.
cards.flavor: "Ha! Try and get me now, silly beasts. Even gravity can't defeat the superior species!"

cards.name: Secure the Goods
cards.text: Capture my enemy.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Capture><sprite name=Capture><style=Keyword>Capture</style></link> my enemy.
cards.flavor: "A positively resplendid find! Rowain is sure to reward me for this." - Blimp-Pack Poacher

cards.name: Blimp-Pack Poacher's Ambush
cards.text:
Transform my Shadow in the Brush into a Blimp-Pack Poacher. 
If my Shadow in the Brush leaves play, Obliterate me.
cards.textHtml:
Transform my <link=card.shadow><style=AssociatedCard>Shadow in the Brush</style></link> into a <link=card.parent><style=AssociatedCard>Blimp-Pack Poacher</style></link>. 
If my <link=card.shadow><style=AssociatedCard>Shadow in the Brush</style></link> leaves play, <link=vocab.Obliterate><style=Vocab>Obliterate</style></link> me.
cards.flavor: Make them pay.

cards.name: Prowl
cards.text: Give an ally +2|+0 this round. If it is a Shadow in the Brush, give it +2|+2 instead.
cards.textHtml: Give an ally +2|+0 this round. If it is a <link=card.shadow><style=AssociatedCard>Shadow in the Brush</style></link>, give it +2|+2 instead.
cards.flavor: "Walk softly, pakiti. Strike true." - Nidalee

cards.name: Big Game Tycoon
cards.text:
Play: Manifest a card with Ambush.
When an ally transforms, double its Power and Health.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: <link=vocab.Manifest><style=Vocab>Manifest</style></link> a card with <link=vocab.Ambush><style=Vocab>Ambush</style></link>.
When an ally transforms, double its Power and Health.
cards.flavor: "You lost everything to WHAT? A scientist and a reptile freak? Well, what are you standing around for, you buffoons? Go out there and get my money back!"

cards.name: Avenging Vastaya
cards.text:
Ambush 3
When I transform from Avenging Vastaya's Ambush, stop all enemy Fast spells, Slow spells, and Skills.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Ambush><style=Vocab>Ambush 3</style></link>
When I transform from <link=card.ambush><style=AssociatedCard>Avenging Vastaya's Ambush</style></link>, stop all enemy <link=keyword.Fast><sprite name=Fast><style=Keyword>Fast</style></link> spells, <link=keyword.Slow><sprite name=Slow><style=Keyword>Slow</style></link> spells, and <link=keyword.Skill><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Skills</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "Do not fear, little ones. I will protect you--and see my debt to Nidalee repaid."

cards.name: Enough!
cards.text: Stop all enemy Fast spells, Slow spells, and Skills.
cards.textHtml: Stop all enemy <link=keyword.Fast><sprite name=Fast><style=Keyword>Fast</style></link> spells, <link=keyword.Slow><sprite name=Slow><style=Keyword>Slow</style></link> spells, and <link=keyword.Skill><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Skills</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "Last time, your cowardly tricks took me by surprise. That will not happen again." -Kuulcan

cards.name: Avenging Vastaya's Ambush
cards.text:
Transform my Shadow in the Brush into an Avenging Vastaya. 
If my Shadow in the Brush leaves play, Obliterate me.
cards.textHtml:
Transform my <link=card.shadow><style=AssociatedCard>Shadow in the Brush</style></link> into an <link=card.parent><style=AssociatedCard>Avenging Vastaya</style></link>. 
If my <link=card.shadow><style=AssociatedCard>Shadow in the Brush</style></link> leaves play, <link=vocab.Obliterate><style=Vocab>Obliterate</style></link> me.
cards.flavor: Make them pay.

cards.name: Bushwhack Trap
cards.text: When I'm summoned or the first time an ally transforms each round, grant the weakest enemy Vulnerable.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned or the first time an ally transforms each round, grant the <link=keyword.Weakest><style=Keyword>weakest</style></link> enemy <link=keyword.Vulnerable><sprite name=Vulnerable><style=Keyword>Vulnerable</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "Blood on the wind." - Nidalee

cards.name: Nidalee
cards.text: Ambush 2
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Ambush><style=Vocab>Ambush 2</style></link>
cards.levelup: I've seen you summon or transform 4 other allies.
cards.flavor: "I will always protect you, lizard girl. We will make these poachers pay. Together." - Nidalee

cards.name: Javelin Toss
cards.text: Deal  4 to an enemy. If there are no enemies when I'm played, I target the enemy Nexus instead.
cards.textHtml: Deal  4 to an enemy. If there are no enemies when I'm played, I target the enemy Nexus instead.
cards.flavor: "You had your chance." - Nidalee

cards.name: Nidalee's Prowl
cards.text:
Give an ally +2|+0 this round. If it is a Shadow in the Brush, give it +2|+2 instead.
Create a Nidalee in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
Give an ally +2|+0 this round. If it is a <link=card.shadow><style=AssociatedCard>Shadow in the Brush</style></link>, give it +2|+2 instead.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Nidalee</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "Walk softly, pakiti. Strike true." - Nidalee

cards.name: Packmother Nidalee
cards.text:
Ambush 2
Nexus Strike: Transform me back into Nidalee and create a Javelin Toss in hand.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Ambush><style=Vocab>Ambush 2</style></link>
<link=vocab.NexusStrike><style=Vocab>Nexus Strike</style></link>: Transform me back into <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Nidalee</style></link> and create a <link=card.javelin><style=AssociatedCard>Javelin Toss</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: "The men call her Kashdaji as an insult. But she commands the jungle--and they cannot hide the fact that they are afraid." -from Anura's field journal, day 32

cards.name: Packmother Nidalee's Ambush
cards.text:
Transform my Shadow in the Brush into a Packmother Nidalee. 
If my Shadow in the Brush leaves play, Obliterate me.
cards.textHtml:
Transform my <link=card.shadow><style=AssociatedCard>Shadow in the Brush</style></link> into a <link=card.parent><style=AssociatedCard>Packmother Nidalee</style></link>. 
If my <link=card.shadow><style=AssociatedCard>Shadow in the Brush</style></link> leaves play, <link=vocab.Obliterate><style=Vocab>Obliterate</style></link> me.
cards.flavor: Make them pay.

cards.name: Shadow in the Brush
cards.text: What could be hiding here?
cards.textHtml: What could be hiding here?
cards.flavor: You never know what could be concealed in the underbrush.

cards.name: Nidalee's Ambush
cards.text:
Transform my Shadow in the Brush into a Nidalee. 
If my Shadow in the Brush leaves play, Obliterate me.
cards.textHtml:
Transform my <link=card.shadow><style=AssociatedCard>Shadow in the Brush</style></link> into a <link=card.parent><style=AssociatedCard>Nidalee</style></link>. 
If my <link=card.shadow><style=AssociatedCard>Shadow in the Brush</style></link> leaves play, <link=vocab.Obliterate><style=Vocab>Obliterate</style></link> me.
cards.flavor: Make them pay.

cards.name: Pakaa Cub
cards.text:
Ambush 1
Nexus Strike: Summon a Pakaa Protector.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Ambush><style=Vocab>Ambush 1</style></link>
<link=vocab.NexusStrike><style=Vocab>Nexus Strike</style></link>: Summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Pakaa Protector</style></link>.
cards.flavor: Cuteness is an appearance, but ferocity is an instinct. Given time and teaching, even the littlest pakiti grow wild and strong.

cards.name: Pakaa Protector
cards.flavor: Pakiti are naturally inquisitive, and prone to jumping four-paws first into unfamiliar situations. With new dangers lurking in the jungle, pack guardians keep a closer eye than ever on their cubs--even if you can't see them.

cards.name: Pakaa Cub's Ambush
cards.text:
Transform my Shadow in the Brush into a Pakaa Cub. 
If my Shadow in the Brush leaves play, Obliterate me.
cards.textHtml:
Transform my <link=card.shadow><style=AssociatedCard>Shadow in the Brush</style></link> into a <link=card.parent><style=AssociatedCard>Pakaa Cub</style></link>. 
If my <link=card.shadow><style=AssociatedCard>Shadow in the Brush</style></link> leaves play, <link=vocab.Obliterate><style=Vocab>Obliterate</style></link> me.
cards.flavor: Make them pay.

cards.name: All-Terrain Trooper
cards.text:
Ambush 0
When I'm summoned or transform, grant the weakest enemy Vulnerable.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Ambush><style=Vocab>Ambush 0</style></link>
When I'm summoned or transform, grant the <link=keyword.Weakest><style=Keyword>weakest</style></link> enemy <link=keyword.Vulnerable><sprite name=Vulnerable><style=Keyword>Vulnerable</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "This here beauty can turn even a novice into a tree-climbing, boulder-jumping professional. Cost me a fortune, but I'm sure I can pay off those loans with the skin of a rare beastie or two..."

cards.name: All-Terrain Trooper's Ambush
cards.text:
Transform my Shadow in the Brush into an All-Terrain Trooper. 
If my Shadow in the Brush leaves play, Obliterate me.
cards.textHtml:
Transform my <link=card.shadow><style=AssociatedCard>Shadow in the Brush</style></link> into an <link=card.parent><style=AssociatedCard>All-Terrain Trooper</style></link>. 
If my <link=card.shadow><style=AssociatedCard>Shadow in the Brush</style></link> leaves play, <link=vocab.Obliterate><style=Vocab>Obliterate</style></link> me.
cards.flavor: Make them pay.

cards.name: Bristlehog
cards.text: The first time an ally transforms, grant me +2|+1.
cards.textHtml: The first time an ally transforms, grant me +2|+1.
cards.flavor: "Small omnivorous mammals covered in bristle-like spikes, which may be released at high velocities when disturbed. Tail is barbed and agile, likely used as a defensive weapon. According to experienced expeditioners, the creatures are notoriously grouchy and difficult to handle..." - From Anura's field journal, day 3

cards.name: Facecheck
cards.text: Manifest a card with Ambush.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Manifest><style=Vocab>Manifest</style></link> a card with <link=vocab.Ambush><style=Vocab>Ambush</style></link>.
cards.flavor: Jungle reconnaissance is the least desirable assignment for one reason above all: it is full of surprises.

cards.name: Towering Pairofant
cards.text: Ambush 5
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Ambush><style=Vocab>Ambush 5</style></link>
cards.flavor: As its oldest residents, some say pairofants hold the memory and heart of the jungle itself. Though normally gentle creatures, they will not hesitate to defend their home against any threat--great or small.

cards.name: Towering Pairofant's Ambush
cards.text:
Transform my Shadow in the Brush into a Towering Pairofant. 
If my Shadow in the Brush leaves play, Obliterate me.
cards.textHtml:
Transform my <link=card.shadow><style=AssociatedCard>Shadow in the Brush</style></link> into a <link=card.parent><style=AssociatedCard>Towering Pairofant</style></link>. 
If my <link=card.shadow><style=AssociatedCard>Shadow in the Brush</style></link> leaves play, <link=vocab.Obliterate><style=Vocab>Obliterate</style></link> me.
cards.flavor: Make them pay.

cards.name: Aurora Hallunatis
cards.text:
Ambush 4
When I transform, summon a Aurora Hallunatis.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Ambush><style=Vocab>Ambush 4</style></link>
When I transform, summon a <link=card.selfRef><style=AssociatedCard>Aurora Hallunatis</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "How I would like to see one myself! Most of the expeditioners believe Aurora Hallunatis is a myth, but one young man swears otherwise. He tells me that the bird is brilliantly colored with a wingspan as long as a man is tall. To look into its eyes, he confides in me one night, is to understand that you are prey." - From Anura's field journal, day 21

cards.name: Aurora Hallunatis's Ambush
cards.text:
Transform my Shadow in the Brush into an Aurora Hallunatis. 
If my Shadow in the Brush leaves play, Obliterate me.
cards.textHtml:
Transform my <link=card.shadow><style=AssociatedCard>Shadow in the Brush</style></link> into an <link=card.parent><style=AssociatedCard>Aurora Hallunatis</style></link>. 
If my <link=card.shadow><style=AssociatedCard>Shadow in the Brush</style></link> leaves play, <link=vocab.Obliterate><style=Vocab>Obliterate</style></link> me.
cards.flavor: Make them pay.

cards.name: Valley of Imitation
cards.text: When you play a follower, transform me into an exact copy of it this round.
cards.textHtml: When you play a follower, transform me into an exact copy of it this round.
cards.flavor: "And dis here is da MOST BE-YOUUU-TI-FUL and favorite stop on da tour. So many people liked my tour dat dey built a BIIIG STRONG CHIP, who will be a stop on da tour forever and ever. Let's go say "HIII BIG CHIP!" Big Chip loves EVERYbody, and ex-speshal-ty all the people who have come along on his tour." - Adventures with Chip, part 6

cards.name: Sacred Shears
cards.text: Attack: When another ally gains Power from Hallowed, so does my bearer.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: When another ally gains Power from <link=keyword.Hallowed><sprite name=Hallowed><style=Keyword>Hallowed</style></link>, so does my bearer.
cards.flavor: "With a good pair of scissors, and quality thread, you can set almost anything aright!" - Gwen

cards.name: Necrotic Arachnoid
cards.text:
When I'm summoned, summon 2 Necrotic Nestlings. 
When another ally dies, drain 1 from the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml:
When I'm summoned, summon 2 <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Necrotic Nestlings</style></link>. 
When another ally dies, <link=keyword.Drain><style=Keyword>drain</style></link> 1 from the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: Found only in the darkest reaches of the Shadow Isles, these spiders secrete a deadly necrovenom, which numbs the skin even as it begins to rot the flesh.

cards.name: Necrotic Nestling
cards.flavor: Where there's one, there's always more... and necrovenom works fast.

cards.name: Tufted Webspinner
cards.text: Play: If an ally has a different subtype than me, give an enemy -2|-0 this round.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: If an ally has a different subtype than me, give an enemy <nobr>-2|-0</nobr> this round.
cards.flavor: Tufted webspinners take great care in crafting their nests. They are especially doting on their spiderlings... but equally vicious when it comes to potential threats.

cards.name: Proliferating Darkwraith
cards.text: Last Breath: Create in deck an exact copy of your strongest Proliferating Darkwraith in deck, then double the stats of Proliferating Darkwraiths in deck.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>Last Breath</style></link>: Create in deck an exact copy of your <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> <link=card.selfref><style=AssociatedCard>Proliferating Darkwraith</style></link> in deck, then double the stats of <link=card.selfref><style=AssociatedCard>Proliferating Darkwraiths</style></link> in deck.
cards.flavor: "This Mist has taught me many things. Most importantly, it has taught me to know when to run." - Ixtali Sentinel

cards.name: Skip, "King of the Reef"
cards.text: Play: Pick 1 of 2 non-champion cards from the enemy hand. I Capture it.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Pick 1 of 2 non-champion cards from the enemy hand. I <link=keyword.Capture><sprite name=Capture><style=Keyword>Capture</style></link> it.
cards.flavor:
"Yeah, I'm handsome, quick--unflappably cool. Don't you know, old man? I'm the king of this reef, and you're trespassing in my kingdom!"
"W-wait! Come back here this instant! I need that specimen for my research!" - Conchologist

cards.name: Portia the Peculiar
cards.text: Play: Manifest a Titanic follower and set its stats to 1|1 and cost to 0.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: <link=vocab.Manifest><style=Vocab>Manifest</style></link> a <link=vocab.Titanic><style=Vocab>Titanic</style></link> follower and set its stats to 1|1 and cost to 0.
cards.flavor: "Of course I know old Portia! A bit out-to-lunch, but she can get you a portal to anywhere, in a pinch. A swirl of the tail, and you're off!" - Portal Pioneer

cards.name: Bursting Backpack
cards.text: For each Bursting Backpack you've played this game, plant 4 Chimes in your deck and 4 Poison Puffcaps in the enemy deck. Create a Bursting Backpack in your deck.
cards.textHtml: For each <link=card.selfref><style=AssociatedCard>Bursting Backpack</style></link> you've played this game, plant 4 <link=card.boon><style=AssociatedCard>Chimes</style></link> in your deck and 4 <link=card.trap><style=AssociatedCard>Poison Puffcaps</style></link> in the enemy deck. Create a <link=card.selfref><style=AssociatedCard>Bursting Backpack</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "Rule 207: A Scout never carries more than she needs!" - Ava Achiever

cards.name: Portal Pioneer
cards.text: Play: Pick an Explorer spell to create in hand.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Pick an Explorer spell to create in hand.
cards.flavor: "I'm worried about Bunches! Oh, he seems more and more nervous these days. Even a short portal hop worries him! I can't understand why." - From the expedition records of the Explorer's Guild Far Reaches Division, allocation: Bandle City

cards.name: Sugary Snare
cards.text: Place an ally on the bottom of your deck to summon the top ally of your deck.
cards.textHtml: Place an ally on the bottom of your deck to summon the top ally of your deck.
cards.flavor: "Rule 571: A Scout should always be vigilant. One never knows what might be a tasty treat, and what might be a trap." - Ava Achiever

cards.name: Early Bird
cards.text: Your opponent discards their highest cost card.
cards.textHtml: Your opponent discards their highest cost card.
cards.flavor: "Imagine being a worm, and the last thing you see before you die are those eyes. Oh, worms can't see? Well, that's probably for the best." - Elle, Aloof Traveler

cards.name: Sneaky Swap
cards.text: Recall an ally to summon a Hungry Owlcat in its place.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recall</style></link> an ally to summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Hungry Owlcat</style></link> in its place.
cards.flavor: "SQWUEA?" - Owlcat

cards.name: Formless Blade
cards.text: Deal 2 damage to a unit. It can't drop below 1 Health from this damage.
cards.textHtml: Deal 2 damage to a unit. It can't drop below 1 Health from this damage.
cards.flavor: "Monsters who call themselves gods have a long way to fall, no matter the land." - Nilah

cards.name: Nilah
cards.text: Attack: Create a Slipstream in the top 6 cards of your deck.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Slipstream</style></link> in the top 6 cards of your deck.
cards.levelup: You've drawn 15+ cards.
cards.flavor: In the north, a new challenger awaits Nilah and her monster-hunting crew: a creature called the Volibear, who threatens to destroy the Freljord that once worshipped him. For Nilah, the chance to test her skills against a monster others call a god is the opportunity of a lifetime. Not to mention the lesser monstrosities she will add to her list of accomplishments along the way.

cards.name: Nilah
cards.text: Attack: Create a Slipstream in the top 6 cards of your deck and deal 2 damage to all enemies and the enemy Nexus. They cannot drop below 1 Health from this damage.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Slipstream</style></link> in the top 6 cards of your deck and deal 2 damage to all enemies and the enemy Nexus. They cannot drop below 1 Health from this damage.
cards.flavor: "Monster! I am called Nilah of the Seventh Layer! It is my name, not yours, which will be remembered by history."

cards.name: Slipstream
cards.text: Draw 2 and grant them Fleeting.
cards.textHtml: Draw 2 and grant them <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "Unfettered exultation!" - Nilah

cards.name: Nilah's Formless Blade
cards.text:
Deal 2 damage to a unit. It can't drop below 1 Health from this damage.
Create a Nilah in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
Deal 2 damage to a unit. It can't drop below 1 Health from this damage.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Nilah</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "By my blade, rejoice!" - Nilah

cards.name: Wizened Helmsman
cards.text: Play: Manifest two different Elemental spells you've played this game. They cost 0 this round.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: <link=vocab.Manifest><style=Vocab>Manifest</style></link> two different Elemental spells you've played this game. They cost 0 this round.
cards.flavor: "The mind is a river. Over time, the dedication of its flow carves the faces of the mountains. And like the mind, with momentum, it may grow ever wider and touch new shores."

cards.name: Deluge
cards.text: For the rest of the game, all of your Elemental spells and Skills deal 1 extra damage.
cards.textHtml: For the rest of the game, all of your Elemental spells and <link=keyword.Elemental Skill><sprite name=ElementalSkill><style=Keyword>Skills</style></link> deal 1 extra damage.
cards.flavor: "In the hands of the wise, water shapes all." - Dedicant of Wisdom

cards.name: The Tidedancer
cards.text:
When I'm summoned, draw a Nilah.
Each round, when you play your third card, give other allies +2|+0 and Brash this round. 
When I would gain Fleeting, reveal me instead.
cards.textHtml:
When I'm summoned, draw a <link=card.champ1><style=AssociatedCard>Nilah</style></link>.
Each round, when you play your third card, give other allies +2|+0 and <link=keyword.Brash><sprite name=Brash><style=Keyword>Brash</style></link> this round. <style=Variable></style>
When I would gain <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link>, reveal me instead.
cards.flavor: "I hear that strange-shaped ship is the fastest Bilgewater's seen. Nimble, too. Got a peculiar captain, but seemed to me like she knows what she's about. Maybe we could stand to learn a thing or two." - Bilgewater bartender

cards.name: Vikrash the Exuberant
cards.text: When I'm summoned, create a Slipstream in the top 6 cards of your deck.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Slipstream</style></link> in the top 6 cards of your deck.
cards.flavor: "Look, my friends, at how the whole world moves with us! The waves dance beneath the hull, the wind in the sails, the birds upon the breeze. Join me in our highest calling, and rejoice!"

cards.name: Master Lookout
cards.text: Once you've drawn 3+ cards in a round this game, grant me +1|+1 and Brash.
cards.textHtml: Once you've drawn 3+ cards in a round this game, grant me +1|+1 and <link=keyword.Brash><sprite name=Brash><style=Keyword>Brash</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "Hey, bud, what's all the fuss about? Relax! There's nothing in the water we can't handle!" - Dedicant of the Challenge

cards.name: Dedicant of the Challenge
cards.text: When I'm summoned, Updraft your hand to grant me +1|+1 for each card Updrafted and draw 2.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, <link=vocab.Updraft><style=Vocab>Updraft</style></link> your hand to grant me +1|+1 for each card <link=vocab.Updraft><style=Vocab>Updrafted</style></link> and draw 2.
cards.flavor: "Oh, c'mon, are you even trying? I feel like I gotta hold back, and man, I hate that!"

cards.name: Octo Adventurer
cards.text: Play: Pick an Explorer spell to create in hand.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Pick an Explorer spell to create in hand.
cards.flavor: "Odd specimen. Very blue. Eyes quite large. Uncomfortably large. Will acquire for further study." - From the expedition records of the Explorer's Guild Far Reaches Division, allocation: Piltover

cards.name: Explorer's Malfunction
cards.text: Destroy a unit's equipment.
cards.textHtml: Destroy a unit's equipment.
cards.flavor: "It seems the Isles have come to enjoy my company." - Spectral Surveyor

cards.name: Explorer's Excavation
cards.text: Destroy a landmark.
cards.textHtml: Destroy a landmark.
cards.flavor: "A little damage to the artifacts is no problem. Makes 'em seem more authentic." - Armed Acquisitioner

cards.name: Explorer's Blunder
cards.text: Disable an enemy's positive keywords this round and again at next Round Start.
cards.textHtml: Disable an enemy's positive keywords this round and again at next <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "Was little crack. Became big one. Now very dried out." - Octo Adventurer

cards.name: Explorer's Refreshments
cards.text: Heal an ally or your Nexus 2.
cards.textHtml: Heal an ally or your Nexus 2.
cards.flavor: "Get me some of that, uh... chocolatey stuff you make. Best chocolatey stuff within two days' travel. Oh, and extra hot, please." - Scholarly Pioneer

cards.name: Sefirsa, Scourge of the Deep
cards.text: When you spend mana to play another unit, create a random card in hand of equal cost. It costs 0 and is Fleeting.
cards.textHtml: When you spend mana to play another unit, create a random card in hand of equal cost. It costs 0 and is <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link>.
cards.flavor: Despite its appetite for even the strangest sea-beasts, there are some monsters even Bilgewater's most experienced captains won't hunt. They speak of Sefirsa in whispered tones, as a hypnotic light moving deep beneath the waves; a monster perched upon a mass grave of sunken ships and drowned men.

cards.name: Joy Unending
cards.text: Give allies +1|+0 this round and heal damaged allies 2.
cards.textHtml: Give allies +1|+0 this round and heal damaged allies 2.
cards.flavor: "Joy, overflowing and everlasting!" - Nilah

cards.name: Marai Reef Spire
cards.text: When you spend mana to play a unit, refill 1 spell mana.
cards.textHtml: When you spend mana to play a unit, refill 1 spell mana.
cards.flavor: "The reef has long been both shelter and ally. It cares for us, as we care for it, so that neither will fall to the darkness of the Murk." - Marai Greatmother

cards.name: Honest Croupier
cards.text: When you play a card with cost equal to my Power, grant me +1|+1.
cards.textHtml: When you play a card with cost equal to my Power, grant me +1|+1.
cards.flavor: "Say, uh, dontcha want to put some more down? No risk, no reward, ya know. This is a lucky table tonight, I'll tell ya. And the house deals fair at this fine establishment--swear it on my mama's tongue."

cards.name: Chakram Dancer
cards.text:
Play: Deal 1 to anything.
Your Skills Drain.
cards.textHtml:
<link=keyword.Elemental Skill><sprite name=ElementalSkill><style=Keyword>Play</style></link>: Deal 1 to anything.
Your <link=keyword.Skill><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Skills</style></link> <link=keyword.Drain><style=Keyword>Drain</style></link>.
cards.flavor: She moves in a dance of water and blades, pulling steel from the roil of foam and spray. She need not see to feel the flow of her weapons--they are water animate, and to water they must always return.

cards.name: Flowing Chakram
cards.text: Deal 1 to anything.
cards.textHtml: Deal 1 to anything.
cards.flavor: "Water takes shapes myriad and wonderful." - Chakram Dancer

cards.name: Scholarly Pioneer
cards.text: Play: Pick an Explorer spell to create in hand.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Pick an Explorer spell to create in hand.
cards.flavor: "It's cold. I'm cold. Everything is cold, all the time. There are some places people just aren't meant to live. Please send me somewhere warm after this." - From the expedition records of the Explorer's Guild Far Reaches Division, allocation: Freljord

cards.name: Gentlemen's Duel
cards.text:
Give an ally +0|+2 this round.
That ally and an enemy strike each other.
cards.textHtml:
Give an ally +0|+2 this round.
That ally and an enemy <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strike</style></link> each other.
cards.flavor: "En garde, my friend! Surely you are not coward enough to refuse a gentleman's duel?" - Laurent Chevalier

cards.name: Dragon Allegiant
cards.text: When I'm summoned, draw a Dragon if you Behold a Dragon.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, draw a Dragon if you <link=vocab.Behold><style=Vocab>Behold</style></link> a Dragon.
cards.flavor: "You know it pains me to admit it, old boy, but we can't tame him alone. We've done what we can already. I'll send word to the general, and with the might of Demacia behind us, we're sure to bring that fantastic beast to its knees."

cards.name: Mageseeker Inquisitor
cards.text: When I'm summoned, Curse your opponent with Suppression.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, <link=keyword.Curse><sprite name=Curse><style=Keyword>Curse</style></link> your opponent with <link=card.curse><style=AssociatedCard>Suppression</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "We cannot allow them to reach the sanctuary of the fallen sister. Her magic is ancient and twisted, far beyond even my ability to suppress. Quickly, take these abominations back to the ship and then up the mountain after the rest of them!"

cards.name: Suppression
cards.text: While I'm in hand, you can't play spells other than curses.
cards.textHtml: While I'm in hand, you can't play spells other than curses.
cards.flavor: No magic moves to your call.

cards.name: Magical Fettering
cards.text: Grant an ally +0|+2. Curse your opponent with Suppression.
cards.textHtml: Grant an ally +0|+2. <link=keyword.Curse><sprite name=Curse><style=Keyword>Curse</style></link> your opponent with <link=card.curse><style=AssociatedCard>Suppression</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "Know the weight of your sins!" - Morgana

cards.name: The Kingfisher
cards.text:
When I'm summoned, draw 1 of each champion from your deck.
Each round, the first time you summon a champion, Rally.
cards.textHtml:
When I'm summoned, draw 1 of each champion from your deck.
Each round, the first time you summon a champion, <link=vocab.Rally><style=Vocab>Rally</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "You must remember, my son, that the chasing of any horizon must be in service to the home we leave behind." - King Jarvan III

cards.name: Cloud Drake
cards.text: When I'm summoned, reduce the cost of all allied units in hand by 1.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, reduce the cost of all allied units in hand by 1.
cards.flavor: With thick tufted fur to insulate against the cold, this drake can reach much higher altitudes than most other dragons. Lively yet elusive, the drakes are usually spotted high overhead, wings cutting through the clouds as they jump from gust to gale.

cards.name: Alatis the Gallant
cards.text: Your Dragon Boons target all Dragon allies.
cards.textHtml: Your Dragon Boons target all Dragon allies.
cards.flavor: "To be clear, I was not always a dragon allegiant. Alatis here convinced me, the first time he saved my life. He's taught me a lot, but the most important thing? There's no finer life than serving Demacia from the back of a dragon." - Dragon Allegiant

cards.name: Taloned Strike
cards.text: Grant allied Birds everywhere +1|+1. An allied Bird strikes an enemy.
cards.textHtml: Grant allied Birds <link=vocab.Everywhere><style=Vocab>everywhere</style></link> +1|+1. An allied Bird <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab>strikes</style></link> an enemy.
cards.flavor: The silverwing's screech signals death from above.

cards.name: Volibear
cards.text: Play: Play Relentless Storm 3 times. Each one targets a different random enemy or the enemy Nexus if none.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Elemental Skill><sprite name=ElementalSkill><style=Keyword>Play</style></link>: Play <link=card.skill><style=AssociatedCard>Relentless Storm</style></link> 3 times. Each one targets a different random enemy or the enemy Nexus if none.
cards.levelup: Round End: You've dealt 50+ damage.
cards.flavor: "Kneel to me, mortal, and I may spare you! Your power is feeble, but perhaps worthy enough to serve mine. Kneel, or be swept from the earth!"

cards.name: Volibear
cards.text:
Play or Attack: Play Relentless Storm 3 times. Each one targets a different random enemy or the enemy Nexus if none.
Other allies have Overwhelm.
cards.textHtml:
<link=keyword.Elemental Skill><sprite name=ElementalSkill><style=Keyword>Play</style></link> or <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Play <link=card.skill><style=AssociatedCard>Relentless Storm</style></link> 3 times. Each one targets a different random enemy or the enemy Nexus if none.
Other allies have <link=keyword.Overwhelm><sprite name=Overwhelm><style=Keyword>Overwhelm</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "You dare to insult me with a challenge? Puny girl from lands far away. I am the heart of the tundra! I am the storm, and to you I promise a forgettable death!"

cards.name: Volibear's Stormbringer
cards.text:
Deal 4 to ALL units except Titanic allies.
Create a Volibear in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
Deal 4 to ALL units except <link=vocab.Titanic><style=Vocab>Titanic</style></link> allies.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Volibear</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "Let the tundra run red!" - Volibear

cards.name: Relentless Storm
cards.text: Deal 4 to a unit. If it's dead or gone, deal 2 to the enemy Nexus instead.
cards.textHtml: Deal 4 to a unit. If it's dead or gone, deal 2 to the enemy Nexus instead.
cards.flavor: "With these claws, I carve the very world!" - Volibear

cards.name: Valhir's Prophet
cards.text: When I'm summoned, summon an Sigil of the Storm.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, summon an <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Sigil of the Storm</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "I see what the others cannot: the storm which will shatter the mountain, the breaking of the bones of the earth. The Freljord of old will be forged anew in blood--it is only a matter of time."

cards.name: Sigil of the Storm
cards.text:
Sigils of the Storm stack.
Titanic allies cost 1 less. Destroy me when you play a Titanic ally.
cards.textHtml:
Sigils of the Storm stack.
<link=vocab.Titanic><style=Vocab>Titanic</style></link> allies cost <style=Variable>1</style> less. Destroy me when you play a <link=vocab.Titanic><style=Vocab>Titanic</style></link> ally.
cards.flavor: In a treacherous mountain pass, a sigil hangs suspended, burning into the night. Much blood was offered to reach this point, and in signs like these the Volibear offers both his approval and his desire for more...

cards.name: Berserker Ursine
cards.text: When you play a spell or Skill, summon an Sigil of the Storm.
cards.textHtml: When you play a spell or <link=keyword.Skill><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Skill</style></link>, summon an <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Sigil of the Storm</style></link>.
cards.flavor: Occasionally, followers of the Volibear lose themselves so totally in their fanaticism that they begin to take on aspects of the bear himself. Nothing will stand in the way of Valhir's will--not even those the Ursine once called countrymen.

cards.name: Stormbringer
cards.text: Deal 4 to ALL units except Titanic allies.
cards.textHtml: Deal 4 to ALL units except <link=vocab.Titanic><style=Vocab>Titanic</style></link> allies.
cards.flavor: "Let the tundra run red!" - Volibear

cards.name: Flamecaller Caprine
cards.text: When you play an Elemental spell or Skill, Forge me.
cards.textHtml: When you play an Elemental spell or <link=keyword.Elemental Skill><sprite name=ElementalSkill><style=Keyword>Skill</style></link>, <link=vocab.Forge><style=Vocab>Forge</style></link> me.
cards.flavor: "The Forgelord promised change and hammered out the chains of inaction instead. Those who worship a weak god are weak themselves. Only by Valhir's might will we be delivered to the glory of old!"

cards.name: Invocation Of Thunder
cards.text:
Draw 1.
Summon a Sigil of the Storm.
cards.textHtml:
Draw 1.
Summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Sigil of the Storm</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "In the name of Valhir, we make this offering..." - Valhir's Prophet

cards.name: Rhond, the Magma Serpent
cards.text: Play: Summon 3 Sigils of the Storm.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Summon 3 <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Sigils of the Storm</style></link>.
cards.flavor: Though few still worship him, all Freljordians know the tale of the Volibear's great battle with Rhond. Long before any mortal stepped foot in the frozen north, this earth-shattering struggle formed the ridges and rivers of the tundra itself.

cards.name: Clash of Giants
cards.text:
Summon 2 random Titanic followers.
I cost 1 less for each Elemental spell or Skill you've played this game (max 10).
cards.textHtml:
Summon 2 random <link=vocab.Titanic><style=Vocab>Titanic</style></link> followers.
I cost 1 less for each Elemental spell or <link=keyword.Elemental Skill><sprite name=ElementalSkill><style=Keyword>Skill</style></link> you've played this game <nobr>(max 10).
cards.flavor: "With his body, I sculpted the mountains. With the fire of his maw, I carved a thousand fjords." - Volibear

cards.name: Sky Splitter
cards.text: Give an ally +1|+3 this round.
cards.textHtml: Give an ally +1|+3 this round.
cards.flavor: Cloaked in clouds and wreathed in lightning, the god-bear stands untouchable at the heart of the storm.

cards.name: Yadulski Snowdog
cards.text: Attack: Grant the top 2 allies in your deck +1|+1.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Grant the top 2 allies in your deck +1|+1.
cards.flavor: Though they originating from Yadulsk, these pups have been domesticated by a number of Freljordian tribes for tracking, hunting, and avalanche recovery. With a hearty constitution and a healthy appetite for fun, they are beloved from tundra to taiga.

cards.name: Handy Harness
cards.text: I have +1|+0 for each different subtype you've summoned this game.
cards.textHtml: I have +1|+0 for each different subtype you've summoned this game. <style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor: "There are beasts up here that even an avalanche won't stop. That's why a good harness is worth every coin." - Avarosan Trapper

cards.name: Boadir of Blackened Ice
cards.text: When I'm summoned, summon 2 Frozen Thralls and advance them to 2.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, summon 2 <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Frozen Thralls</style></link> and <link=vocab.Advance><style=Vocab>advance</style></link> them <nobr>to 2.</nobr>
cards.flavor: "She was v-vicious! Thralls burnt to black ice, avalanches beneath her claws, a roar that knocked snow off the mountains! A warrior queen, I tell you! K-killing thralls is the work of a warrior queen." - Babbling Bjerg

cards.name: Bladebound Berserker
cards.text: When you play a Slow spell that targets a single ally, copy it onto me.
cards.textHtml: When you play a <link=keyword.Slow><sprite name=Slow><style=Keyword>Slow</style></link> spell that targets a single ally, copy it onto me.
cards.flavor: "You think an arrow or two will stop me? Hah! Whatever you throw at me becomes a weapon in my arsenal. Whatever is lost I will reforge in ice!"

cards.name: Capsize
cards.text: Recall an enemy to increase the cost of the next unit your opponent plays this round by 2.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recall</style></link> an enemy to increase the cost of the next unit your opponent plays this round by 2.
cards.flavor: "Those who mean us harm shall find rest at the bottom of the sea." - Rivershaper

cards.name: Ocean Drake
cards.text: When you play a Fast spell, Slow spell, or Skill, heal your Nexus 1.
cards.textHtml: When you play a <link=keyword.Fast><sprite name=Fast><style=Keyword>Fast</style></link> spell, <link=keyword.Slow><sprite name=Slow><style=Keyword>Slow</style></link> spell, or <link=keyword.Skill><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Skill</style></link>, heal your Nexus 1.
cards.flavor: "A grand beast you are! There is joy in the skim of your claws over the waves. Should you ever decide to prey on more than fish and seabirds, I would be delighted to face you." - Nilah

cards.name: Heisho, Shell of the World
cards.text: Each round, the first card you play costs 9 less.
cards.textHtml: Each round, the first card you play costs 9 less.
cards.flavor: For the inhabitants of this Ionian village, Heisho is both honored caretaker and friend. Having carried their homes on his back from time immemorial, they can trust their village bearer to seek peaceful shores in times of trouble.

cards.name: Trusty Adnere
cards.text: When I'm summoned, summon Adnere's Aviarists.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, summon <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Adnere's Aviarists</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "This land is full of lessons. Remember always: the passing of each season is to be celebrated, for only in the ending can a new beginning be born."

cards.name: Adnere's Aviarists
cards.text: Support: Grow me to my supported ally's stats this round.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Support><style=Keyword>Support</style></link>: Grow me to my supported ally's stats this round.
cards.flavor:
"Look! Papa's birds are hatching again!"
"Whoa! Another one! Why are there so many?"
"You ask that EVERY year, Arya."
"Well nobody ever answers!"
"Shhh, don't scare them. And tell me how many there are, cuz we're gonna have to think of a lotta names."

cards.name: Empyrean Dance
cards.text: Stop an enemy Fast spell, Slow spell, or Skill, Recall an enemy, and summon The Empyrean.
cards.textHtml: Stop an enemy <link=keyword.Fast><sprite name=Fast><style=Keyword>Fast</style></link> spell, <link=keyword.Slow><sprite name=Slow><style=Keyword>Slow</style></link> spell, or <link=keyword.Skill><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Skill</style></link>, <link=keyword.Recall><style=Keyword>Recall</style></link> an enemy, and summon <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>The Empyrean</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "This dance is our remembrance." - Irelia

cards.name: Prancing Sea Spirits
cards.text: Play: Summon an exact Ephemeral copy of me.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Summon an exact <link=keyword.Ephemeral><sprite name=Ephemeral><style=Keyword>Ephemeral</style></link> copy of me.
cards.flavor: During the right times of year, when the wind blows in over the sea, some Zaunites swear they can see the faint impressions of two huge finned creatures dancing joyously with the ocean tides.

cards.name: Morgana
cards.text: Play: Curse an enemy with Shackles twice.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: <link=keyword.Curse><sprite name=Curse><style=Keyword>Curse</style></link> an enemy with <link=card.curse><style=AssociatedCard>Shackles</style></link> twice.
cards.levelup: You've targeted units 10+ times.
cards.flavor: "You come to me bruised and bleeding, and yet I've never seen a countenance so jubilant. You are a strange woman indeed--but you are safe here. Please rest, and when you're feeling better, I'd be keen to hear your story."

cards.name: Morgana's Dark Binding
cards.text:
Stun an enemy and Curse it with Shackles.
Create a Morgana in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
<link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> an enemy and <link=keyword.Curse><sprite name=Curse><style=Keyword>Curse</style></link> it with <link=card.curse><style=AssociatedCard>Shackles</style></link>.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Morgana</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "Suffer, as you've made them suffer!" - Morgana

cards.name: Morgana
cards.text:
Play: Curse an enemy with Shackles twice.
Attack: Curse the strongest enemy that isn't Cursed with Shackles and deal 3 to Cursed enemies and 2 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: <link=keyword.Curse><sprite name=Curse><style=Keyword>Curse</style></link> an enemy with <link=card.curse><style=AssociatedCard>Shackles</style></link> twice.
<link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: <link=keyword.Curse><sprite name=Curse><style=Keyword>Curse</style></link> the <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> enemy that isn't <link=keyword.Curse><sprite name=Curse><style=Keyword>Cursed</style></link> with <link=card.curse><style=AssociatedCard>Shackles</style></link> and deal 3 to <link=keyword.Curse><sprite name=Curse><style=Keyword>Cursed</style></link> enemies and 2 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: "You will regret this transgression! Be assured of this if nothing else: you will feel the suffering you have inflicted on others as a vise around your very soul. You will admit your sins, or be suffocated by them."

cards.name: Shackles
cards.text: While I'm in hand, the cursed unit is Immobile.
cards.textHtml: While I'm in hand, <style=Variable>the cursed unit</style> is <link=keyword.Immobile><sprite name=Immobile><sprite name=Reckless><style=Keyword>Immobile</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "Bound by truth!" - Morgana

cards.name: Soul Shackles
cards.text: Deal 3 to Cursed enemies and 2 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml: Deal 3 to <link=keyword.Curse><sprite name=Curse><style=Keyword>Cursed</style></link> enemies and 2 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: "I am your torment, reflected a thousandfold!" - Morgana

cards.name: Mihira, Aspect Ascendant
cards.text: Play: Curse 2 enemies with Shackles twice.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: <link=keyword.Curse><sprite name=Curse><style=Keyword>Curse</style></link> 2 enemies with <link=card.curse><style=AssociatedCard>Shackles</style></link> twice.
cards.flavor: "It was in the names of my daughters that I embraced divinity. It was for my family that I forsook my own humanity, so that by this flaming sword I could forge anew a world of truth and justice."

cards.name: Black Shield
cards.text: Give an ally Spellshield this round and Curse it with Shackles.
cards.textHtml: Give an ally <link=keyword.SpellShield><sprite name=SpellShield><style=Keyword>Spellshield</style></link> this round and <link=keyword.Curse><sprite name=Curse><style=Keyword>Curse</style></link> it with <link=card.curse><style=AssociatedCard>Shackles</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "Shielded from persecution!" - Morgana

cards.name: Veiled Protector
cards.text: When I'm summoned or you summon a Titanic ally, heal your Nexus 3.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned or you summon a <link=vocab.Titanic><style=Vocab>Titanic</style></link> ally, heal your Nexus 3.
cards.flavor: This veiled protector has not forgotten the blessing that elevated it above a mere beast--and repays this debt by ensuring any who seek a certain sanctuary on the slopes of Targon make the journey unscathed.

cards.name: Lisa and Dolly
cards.text: Play: Curse an enemy with Shackles.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: <link=keyword.Curse><sprite name=Curse><style=Keyword>Curse</style></link> an enemy with <link=card.curse><style=AssociatedCard>Shackles</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "Look, Dolly! I'm doing it, just like you taught me! Do you think we'll ever get to show mama how much I've learned? You think she already knows? Really?! I hope you're right." - Lisa

cards.name: Dark Binding
cards.text: Stun an enemy and Curse it with Shackles.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Stun><sprite name=Stunned><style=Keyword>Stun</style></link> an enemy and <link=keyword.Curse><sprite name=Curse><style=Keyword>Curse</style></link> it with <link=card.curse><style=AssociatedCard>Shackles</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "Suffer, as you've made them suffer!" - Morgana

cards.name: Ruby-Eyed Conjurer
cards.text: Play: Grant SpellShield or Overwhelm to an ally in hand.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Grant <link=keyword.SpellShield><sprite name=SpellShield><style=Keyword>SpellShield</style></link> or <link=keyword.Overwhelm><sprite name=Overwhelm><style=Keyword>Overwhelm</style></link> to an ally in hand.
cards.flavor: "Do not be afraid! Go on, and do not look back! We made this journey once, too. Now it is our duty to protect yours. Go quickly to her sanctuary, and the Veiled One will grant you the protection you seek."

cards.name: Ruby-Eyed Conjurer
cards.text: Play: Grant Overwhelm to an ally in hand.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Grant <link=keyword.Overwhelm><sprite name=Overwhelm><style=Keyword>Overwhelm</style></link> to an ally in hand.
cards.flavor: "Do not be afraid! Go on, and do not look back! We made this journey once, too. Now it is our duty to protect yours. Go quickly to her sanctuary, and the Veiled One will grant you the protection you seek."

cards.name: Ruby-Eyed Conjurer
cards.text: Play: Grant SpellShield to an ally in hand.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Grant <link=keyword.SpellShield><sprite name=SpellShield><style=Keyword>SpellShield</style></link> to an ally in hand.
cards.flavor: "Do not be afraid! Go on, and do not look back! We made this journey once, too. Now it is our duty to protect yours. Go quickly to her sanctuary, and the Veiled One will grant you the protection you seek."

cards.name: Seismic Shard
cards.text:
If you Behold a Titanic unit, I cost 3 less.
Deal 7 to a unit.
cards.textHtml:
If you <link=vocab.Behold><style=Vocab>Behold</style></link> a <link=vocab.Titanic><style=Vocab>Titanic</style></link> unit, I cost 3 less.
Deal 7 to a unit.
