cards.flavor: "Oops, uh oh, dontcha worry about dat dere, just a little wipple in the wock, just a accident, not papa NOPE! Movin' on!" - Chip

cards.name: Herald of Celestial Convergence
cards.text:
Play: Activate other allies' Daybreak and Nightfall effects.
Daybreak: Grant me Overwhelm.
Nightfall: Grant me SpellShield.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Activate other allies' <link=keyword.Daybreak><style=Keyword>Daybreak</style></link> and <link=keyword.Nightfall><style=Keyword>Nightfall</style></link> effects.
<link=keyword.Daybreak><style=Keyword>Daybreak</style></link>: Grant me <link=keyword.Overwhelm><sprite name=Overwhelm><style=Keyword>Overwhelm</style></link>.
<link=keyword.Nightfall><style=Keyword>Nightfall</style></link>: Grant me <link=keyword.SpellShield><sprite name=SpellShield><style=Keyword>SpellShield</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "A ring of fire burns above. In the heralded darkness, we are all the same." - Lunari wanespeaker

cards.name: Gentle Gemdragon
cards.text: When you play a Fast spell, Slow spell, or Skill, grant other Dragon allies +1|+1.
cards.textHtml: When you play a <link=keyword.Fast><sprite name=Fast><style=Keyword>Fast</style></link> spell, <link=keyword.Slow><sprite name=Slow><style=Keyword>Slow</style></link> spell, or <link=keyword.Skill><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Skill</style></link>, grant other Dragon allies +1|+1.
cards.flavor: Dragons can vary as greatly in their temperaments as they do in their appearance. For species as prone to all-consuming destruction as infernal drakes, there are those equally protective of their families and environments--like the slow-moving, affectionate gemdragon.

cards.name: Ottrani Dragon-Worshiper
cards.text: When I'm summoned, heal your Nexus 2 and gain an extra mana gem next round.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned, heal your Nexus 2 and gain an extra mana gem next round.
cards.flavor: High on the slopes of Targon, a lone Ottrani has dedicated their life to dragons. They adorn themselves in shed scales and old bones, divining their path forward from the scattering of dragon teeth and the curling of smoke as it is carried up the mountain.

cards.name: Sinner's Vise
cards.text:
Curse an enemy with Shackles.
Increase the cost of enemy Curses everywhere by 1.
cards.textHtml:
<link=keyword.Curse><sprite name=Curse><style=Keyword>Curse</style></link> an enemy with <link=card.curse><style=AssociatedCard>Shackles</style></link>.
Increase the cost of enemy Curses <link=vocab.Everywhere><style=Vocab>everywhere</style></link> by 1.
cards.flavor: "To find your freedom, admit the darkness within." - Morgana

cards.name: Chained Caster
cards.text: Play: Curse me with Shackles.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: <link=keyword.Curse><sprite name=Curse><style=Keyword>Curse</style></link> me with <link=card.curse><style=AssociatedCard>Shackles</style></link>.
cards.flavor: The Mageseekers excelled at breaking people. They had bound his hands and his magic. They had taken his voice. But he had survived them before--and this time, he had the Veiled Lady on his side.

cards.name: Enraged Firespitter
cards.text: Play: Deal 2 to an enemy and 2 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Elemental Skill><sprite name=ElementalSkill><style=Keyword>Play</style></link>: Deal 2 to an enemy and 2 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: Noxian expansion has claimed many different peoples, settlements, and cultures. Frequently, wild creatures are also at the mercy of the war machine--but in the case of this dragon, each brutal step forward by Noxus is met with an equally brutal inferno of rage.

cards.name: Spitfire
cards.text: Deal 2 to an enemy and 2 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml: Deal 2 to an enemy and 2 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: Wood, steel, flesh--all of it melts in proximity to the firespitter's caustic rage.

cards.name: Lord Mallat
cards.flavor: "It took centuries of planning to seal away that dreadful warmonger--and your pathetic friends intend to defeat him with 'joy'? You foolish girl. You will do nothing but incur the Revenant's wrath--and in doing, risk us all."

cards.name: Wildfire
cards.text: Deal 1 to the enemy Nexus, increased by 1 for each other Wildfire you've played. Create a Wildfire in your deck.
cards.textHtml: Deal 1 to the enemy Nexus, increased by 1 for each other <link=card.selfref><style=AssociatedCard>Wildfire</style></link> you've played. Create a <link=card.selfref><style=AssociatedCard>Wildfire</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "Ashes, ashes..." - Annie

cards.name: Armed Acquisitioner
cards.text: Play: Pick an Explorer spell to create in hand.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Pick an Explorer spell to create in hand.
cards.flavor: "You'd think it would be easier to dig in the desert--but no! Given enough time, sand readily turns to stone. Once again requesting funding for replacement tools." - From the expedition records of the Explorer's Guild Far Reaches Division, allocation: Shurima

cards.name: Headmistress Telsi
cards.text: Allied Attack and Support effects activate an additional time.
cards.textHtml: Allied <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link> and <link=keyword.Support><style=Keyword>Support</style></link> effects activate an additional time.
cards.flavor: Headmistress Telsi's class on personal discipline is rife with arduous assignments, wrist-slapping, and detention slips. It has always been mandatory for students at the Ravenbloom Conservatory--otherwise, nobody would enroll.

cards.name: Red-Barbed Razormace
cards.text: Nexus Strike: Curse your opponent with Ichor.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.NexusStrike><style=Vocab>Nexus Strike</style></link>: <link=keyword.Curse><sprite name=Curse><style=Keyword>Curse</style></link> your opponent with <link=card.curse><style=AssociatedCard>Ichor</style></link>.
cards.flavor: While useful to the Noxian war machine, the razormace is also prized in the capitol's fighting pits. Few opponents--human or animal--are willing to take to the arena against this beast, and so the razormace's rare battles draw crowds from across the city.

cards.name: Ichor
cards.text: While I'm in hand, Round Start: Deal 1 to your Nexus.
cards.textHtml: While I'm in hand, <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Deal <style=Variable>1</style> to your Nexus.
cards.flavor: You're bleeding. It's slow... but it shows no signs of stopping.

cards.name: Iron Legionary
cards.text: Play: Deal 3 to an ally to deal 3 to an enemy.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.PlaySkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword>Play</style></link>: Deal 3 to an ally to deal 3 to an enemy.
cards.flavor: "Tear their souls from the cages of their bodies!" - Mordekaiser

cards.name: Soul Cleaver
cards.text: Deal 3 to an ally to deal 3 to an enemy.
cards.textHtml: Deal 3 to an ally to deal 3 to an enemy.
cards.flavor: "It cuts... it hurts... in this realm and the next... and the next..." - Shackled Ghasts

cards.name: Bladepierced Revenant
cards.text: When an ally is revived, grant it Challenger.
cards.textHtml: When an ally is revived, grant it <link=keyword.Challenger><sprite name=Challenger><style=Keyword>Challenger</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "You smile, but I know the truth of your traitorous heart! They smiled to my face and ate from my table, even as they meant to put a sword through my back. I won't be taken for a fool again. You will die like the rest of them: screaming your apology!"

cards.name: Indestructible
cards.text: Grant an ally Deathless.
cards.textHtml: Grant an ally <link=keyword.Deathless><sprite name=Deathless><style=Keyword>Deathless</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "Eternal iron." - Mordekaiser

cards.name: Kashuri Swipe
cards.text: Kill a unit if it's damaged, otherwise deal 2 to it instead.
cards.textHtml: Kill a unit if it's damaged, otherwise deal 2 to it instead.
cards.flavor: "This is in your best interest. Trust me." - Lord Broadmane

cards.name: Janna
cards.text:
Play: Updraft 2 to draw 2 at the next Round Start.
Each round, the first 3 times you draw a card, reduce its cost by 1 this round.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: <link=vocab.Updraft><style=Vocab>Updraft</style></link> 2 to draw 2 at the next <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>.
Each round, the first 3 times you draw a card, reduce its cost by 1 this round. <style=Variable></style>
cards.levelup: I've seen you play 8 cost reduced cards.
cards.flavor: "Zaun is closer to Janna than pretty much anywhere else. After all, she's the one who saved the poor souls Piltover left to die. Yeah--if there's answers to be had, I'll get 'em here." - Windborne Mariner

cards.name: Janna's Eye Of The Storm
cards.text:
Give an ally +2|+0 this round.
Draw 2.
Create a Janna in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
Give an ally +2|+0 this round.
Draw 2.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Janna</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "Be at peace! The storm may rage around you, but it shall not harm you." - Janna

cards.name: Janna
cards.text:
Round Start: Draw 1.
When you draw a card, reduce its cost by 1 this round.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Draw 1.
When you draw a card, reduce its cost by 1 this round.
cards.flavor: "Go no further! Violate my protection and you shall see the breath torn from your lungs, and your very self scattered by the winds!"

cards.name: Howling Gale
cards.text:
Deal 2 to a unit.
Increase my damage by 1 for each other card you've played this round, up to 3 times.
cards.textHtml:
Deal 2 to a unit.
Increase my damage by 1 for each other card you've played this round, up to 3 times. <style=Variable></style>
cards.flavor: "My fury upon howling winds!" - Janna

cards.name: Eye Of The Storm
cards.text:
Give an ally +2|+0 this round.
Draw 2.
cards.textHtml:
Give an ally +2|+0 this round.
Draw 2.
cards.flavor: "Be at peace! The storm may rage around you, but it shall not harm you." - Janna

cards.name: Iascylla, Figurehead of the Deep
cards.text: When you play an Elemental spell or Skill, copy it with the same targets.
cards.textHtml: When you play an Elemental spell or <link=keyword.Elemental Skill><sprite name=ElementalSkill><style=Keyword>Skill</style></link>, copy it with the same targets.
cards.flavor: "Come, Iascylla! You are old indeed, if Ashlesh knows your name. But old or young, pretty or ugly, no matter. There is no higher honor for any monster than to fall to my blade upon the open sea." - Nilah

cards.name: Galesong Flock
cards.text:
Summon a Galesong Swallow and grant it +1|+1 for each other Elemental spell and Skill you've played this game. 
Draw 1.
cards.textHtml:
Summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Galesong Swallow</style></link> and grant it +1|+1 for each other Elemental spell and <link=keyword.Elemental Skill><sprite name=ElementalSkill><style=Keyword>Skill</style></link> you've played this game. <style=Variable></style>
Draw 1.
cards.flavor: When galesong swallows gather in numbers, a storm is never far off.

cards.name: Maryam, Temple Caretaker
cards.text: Play: Updraft 1 to either draw 1 or refill your spell mana.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: <link=vocab.Updraft><style=Vocab>Updraft</style></link> 1 to either draw 1 or refill your spell mana.
cards.flavor: Convinced that she was saved by the wind spirit as a young girl, Maryam has preached Janna's virtues from her home country of Shurima all the way to Zaun. Now serving as the Zaun temple matriarch, she is dedicated to passing forward Janna's kindness to the young and downtrodden.

cards.name: Maryam, Temple Caretaker
cards.text: Play: Updraft 1 to draw 1.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: <link=vocab.Updraft><style=Vocab>Updraft</style></link> 1 to draw 1.
cards.flavor: Convinced that she was saved by the wind spirit as a young girl, Maryam has preached Janna's virtues from her home country of Shurima all the way to Zaun. Now serving as the Zaun temple matriarch, she is dedicated to passing forward Janna's kindness to the young and downtrodden.

cards.name: Maryam, Temple Caretaker
cards.text: Play: Updraft 1 to refill your spell mana.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: <link=vocab.Updraft><style=Vocab>Updraft</style></link> 1 to refill your spell mana.
cards.flavor: Convinced that she was saved by the wind spirit as a young girl, Maryam has preached Janna's virtues from her home country of Shurima all the way to Zaun. Now serving as the Zaun temple matriarch, she is dedicated to passing forward Janna's kindness to the young and downtrodden.

cards.name: Sunken Temple
cards.text:
Round End: Updraft your hand. 
Round Start: Draw that many cards plus 1.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.RoundEnd><style=Vocab>Round End</style></link>: <link=vocab.Updraft><style=Vocab>Updraft</style></link> your hand. 
<link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: Draw that many cards plus 1.
cards.flavor: Much was lost in the disastrous collapse that ultimately delineated Zaun from Piltover. Janna may have lost her temple to the waves, but she saved the people who worshipped in it.

cards.name: Windborne Mariner
cards.text: If you've drawn 3+ cards this round, I cost 2 less.
cards.textHtml: If you've drawn 3+ cards this round, I cost 2 less.
cards.flavor: "Yeah, I had what I wanted. But I got it all by taking, and taking leaves a man empty. First thing I found to follow was the wind, so now I'm here, hoping she'll push me onto a better path."

cards.name: Divine Whirlwind
cards.text:
If you've drawn 3+ cards this round, I cost 2 less.
Deal 3 to a unit and 2 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml:
If you've drawn 3+ cards this round, I cost 2 less.
Deal 3 to a unit and 2 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: "The tempest is at my command." - Janna

cards.name: Exalted Cloudwinder
cards.text:
If you've drawn 3+ cards this round, I cost 2 less.
When I'm summoned, draw 2 at the next Round Start.
cards.textHtml:
If you've drawn 3+ cards this round, I cost 2 less.
When I'm summoned, draw 2 at the next <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "My dear Zephyr. Come down from your clouds and perch on my shoulder awhile, won't you?" - Janna

cards.name: Charlatan Fishmonger
cards.text: Round Start: ALL players draw 1, then grant your opponent's card Fleeting.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: ALL players draw 1, then grant your opponent's card <link=keyword.Fleeting><sprite name=Fleeting><style=Keyword>Fleeting</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "It's two for one today, and today only! Fresh fish, caught just this...uh, month? Two for one! What do you mean you don't want the second one? It's free!"

cards.name: Prototype Porobot
cards.text: Last Breath: Grant a random 6+ cost spell in hand "When I'm played, summon a Prototype Porobot."
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>Last Breath</style></link>: Grant a random 6+ cost spell in hand "When I'm played, summon a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Prototype Porobot</style></link>."
cards.flavor: "It's just a prototype," the apprentice cried as flames engulfed the lab. "I didn't program it to eat every gear in sight! I don't even know where all that metal is GOING!"

cards.name: Galesong Call
cards.text: Summon a Galesong Swallow.
cards.textHtml: Summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Galesong Swallow</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "All children of the wind answer my call." - Janna

cards.name: Galesong Swallow
cards.flavor: "These galesong swallows are flighty creatures. Half the time they seem to be made up entirely of water! Still, I've learned the hard way to avoid upsetting them..." - Intrepid Mariner

cards.name: Chemtech Drake
cards.text: When you play a spell, draw 1. When you draw while you have a full hand, deal 1 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml: When you play a spell, draw 1. When you draw while you have a full hand, deal 1 to the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: Zaun demands adaptation--and the chemtech drake is no exception, cast in the sickly green light of augmentation as it clings to the underbelly of the city. The twin shadows of the drake's ruined wings loom along darkened passageways, harbingers of a fury born from anguish at its own corruption.

cards.name: Shady Spectacles
cards.text: Pick an allied follower. Transform my bearer into an exact copy of it while I'm equipped.
cards.textHtml: Pick an allied follower. Transform my bearer into an exact copy of it while I'm equipped.
cards.flavor: Don't ask how these work.

cards.name: Elder Dragon
cards.text:
Origin: Aspect of the Dragon. 
I cost 1 less for each different Dragon Boon you've played this game.
Play: Play every Dragon Boon on me.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Origin><style=Vocab>Origin</style></link>: <link=card.origin><style=AssociatedCard>Aspect of the Dragon</style></link>. <style=Variable></style>
I cost 1 less for each different Dragon Boon you've played this game.
<link=keyword.Elemental Skill><sprite name=ElementalSkill><style=Keyword>Play</style></link>: Play every Dragon Boon on me.
cards.levelup: Your allies have attacked with 75+ total Power.
cards.flavor: "Legend has it that this dragon is the oldest of all--that he is king of all winged beasts. If we tame him... why, Alatis, what else could possibly stand in our way? The world will finally understand that man and dragon are strongest together." - Volix, Dragon Allegiant

cards.name: Mountainous Vigor
cards.text: Grant +1|+0 and Tough.
cards.textHtml: Grant +1|+0 and <link=keyword.Tough><sprite name=Tough><style=Keyword>Tough</style></link>.
cards.flavor: The mountainous hide weathers any storm.

cards.name: Chemtech Blight
cards.text: Grant Deathless.
cards.textHtml: Grant <link=keyword.Deathless><sprite name=Deathless><style=Keyword>Deathless</style></link>.
cards.flavor: What some call poison, others call power.

cards.name: Aspect of the Dragon
cards.text: You may put any followers that cost 6+ into your deck during deckbuilding. When you play a unit with 6+ base cost, pick 1 of 2 Dragon Boons to play on it.
cards.textHtml: You may put any followers that cost 6+ into your deck during deckbuilding. When you play a unit with 6+ base cost, pick 1 of 2 Dragon Boons to play on it.
cards.flavor: Dragons bestow blessings both awesome and terrible.

cards.name: Hextech Prowess
cards.text: Grant +1|+0 and 2 Impact.
cards.textHtml: Grant +1|+0 and 2 <link=keyword.Impact><sprite name=Impact><style=Keyword>Impact</style></link>.
cards.flavor: What nature designs, hextech improves.

cards.name: Infernal Might
cards.text: Grant +1|+0 and Fearsome.
cards.textHtml: Grant +1|+0 and <link=keyword.Fearsome><sprite name=Fearsome><style=Keyword>Fearsome</style></link>.
cards.flavor: The flames of infernal wrath rise ever higher.

cards.name: Oceanic Will
cards.text: Heal allies and your Nexus 2.
cards.textHtml: Heal allies and your Nexus 2.
cards.flavor: These wings of water wash all wounds.

cards.name: Cloudbringer's Grace
cards.text: Grant Challenger.
cards.textHtml: Grant <link=keyword.Challenger><sprite name=Challenger><style=Keyword>Challenger</style></link>.
cards.flavor: Nimble as the breeze, decisive as the gale.

cards.name: Elder Dragon's Primordial Roar
cards.text:
Refill your mana to full. Draw all 6+ cost followers from the top 6 cards of your deck.
Create an Elder Dragon in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
Refill your mana to full. Draw all 6+ cost followers from the top 6 cards of your deck.
Create an <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Elder Dragon</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "This call--it is primeval. I see a kingdom of clouds. I see an awful winged host." - Ottrani Dragon-Worshiper

cards.name: Elder Dragon
cards.text: I CANNOT BE STOPPED
cards.textHtml: I CANNOT BE STOPPED
cards.flavor: Heat without equal poured from the Elder Dragon's maw. Alatis leapt into flight. "Stand fast," Volix cried. "Hold your lines! The world will know us as the men who tamed the king of beasts!"

cards.name: Primordial Roar
cards.text: Refill your mana to full. Draw all 6+ cost followers from the top 6 cards of your deck.
cards.textHtml: Refill your mana to full. Draw all 6+ cost followers from the top 6 cards of your deck.
cards.flavor: "This call--it is primeval. I see a kingdom of clouds. I see an awful winged host." - Ottrani Dragon-Worshiper

cards.name: Dune Swallower
cards.text: To play me, kill an ally or one of your mana gems 3 times.
cards.textHtml: To play me, kill an ally or one of your mana gems 3 times.
cards.flavor: The duneswallower slumbers at much larger depths than its smaller xer'sai cousins. Known to make an easy meal out of other xer'sai predators, it is rarely documented--likely for the fact that it can swallow entire dunes (and any witnesses) whole.

cards.name: General of the Dunes
cards.text: Daybreak or when you activate another Daybreak: Grant the weakest enemy Vulnerable.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Daybreak><style=Keyword>Daybreak</style></link> or when you activate another <link=keyword.Daybreak><style=Keyword>Daybreak</style></link>: Grant the <link=keyword.Weakest><style=Keyword>weakest</style></link> enemy <link=keyword.Vulnerable><sprite name=Vulnerable><style=Keyword>Vulnerable</style></link>.
cards.flavor: The vast armies of Shurima stand ready to prove the might of the desert. When the order is given, they advance without hesitation.

cards.name: Defenders of the Sun Disc
cards.text: Daybreak: Draw a Defenders of the Sun Disc.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Daybreak><style=Keyword>Daybreak</style></link>: Draw a <link=card.me><style=AssociatedCard>Defenders of the Sun Disc</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "We are the keepers of the everlasting desert, the living history, the walkers of the path of radiance. We kneel before the Sun Disc and naught else, so that the world will kneel before Shurima's glory." - Azir

cards.name: Ancient Malediction
cards.text: Curse an enemy with Terror.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Curse><sprite name=Curse><style=Keyword>Curse</style></link> an enemy with <link=card.curse><style=AssociatedCard>Terror</style></link>.
cards.flavor: Some things are best left beneath the sands.

cards.name: Tomb-Raider Barbara
cards.text: Each round, the first time another ally dies, or Last Breath: Create a Lucky Find in hand.
cards.textHtml: Each round, the first time another ally dies, or <link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>Last Breath</style></link>: Create a <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Lucky Find</style></link> in hand.
cards.flavor: "That's a real haul, Barb. Knew I could count on you. Wait--what do you mean they saw you?!" - Vekauran Bruiser

cards.name: Horned Swarmcaller
cards.text: Play: Grant two enemies -1|-0 and disable their positive keywords.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Grant two enemies -1|-0 and disable their positive keywords.
cards.flavor: Despite its intimidating size, this swarmcaller is rarely violent. When its swarm nears a Shuriman settlement, villagers will leave offerings of soft fruit in the nearby desert to distract their visitors from more important crops.

cards.name: Shackled Ghasts
cards.text: Last Breath: The next time you revive an ally, create a copy of me in hand.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>Last Breath</style></link>: The next time you revive an ally, create a copy of me in hand.
cards.flavor: "It was long ago that we were chained. Soon you too will know our suffering, and we will all suffer, forever and ever, until we are granted oblivion at Master's hand..."

cards.name: Realm of Death
cards.text:
An ally starts a free attack Challenging the Strongest enemy.
Kill ALL other units.
cards.textHtml:
An ally starts a free attack <link=keyword.Challenger><sprite name=Challenger><style=Keyword>Challenging</style></link> the <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>Strongest</style></link> enemy.
Kill ALL other units.
cards.flavor: "Death is my dominion." - Mordekaiser

cards.name: Legion of the Severed
cards.text: Play: Grant Deathless to an ally in hand.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Grant <link=keyword.Deathless><sprite name=Deathless><style=Keyword>Deathless</style></link> to an ally in hand.
cards.flavor: It matters not what form souls took before their imprisonment in the Grey Realm. There, individuality has little value. Faceless and fearless, the Legion serves the Iron Revenant all the better for its uniformity.

cards.name: Amalgamation Of Vile Rites
cards.text:
To play me, kill an ally.
Last Breath: Heal your Nexus 2.
cards.textHtml:
To play me, kill an ally.
<link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>Last Breath</style></link>: Heal your Nexus 2.
cards.flavor: Beasts of war have value to any army. In the Grey Realm, they are the tortured amalgamations of souls, each one violently consumptive in its insentience.

cards.name: Spectral Surveyor
cards.text: Play: Pick an Explorer spell to create in hand.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Pick an Explorer spell to create in hand.
cards.flavor: "The terrain is inscrutable. The visibility, close to none. I have encountered enemies at every turn--but strangely, unexpected allies too." - From the expedition records of the Explorer's Guild Far Reaches Division, allocation: Shadow Isles

cards.name: Lonely Chimeslime
cards.text: When another ally dies, or Last Breath: Plant 4 Chimes in your deck.
cards.textHtml: When another ally dies, or <nobr><link=keyword.Last Breath><sprite name=LastBreath><style=Keyword>Last Breath</style></link>:</nobr> Plant 4 <link=card.chime><style=AssociatedCard>Chimes</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: Don't worry about that ominous ringing--it's just old Chimeslime making his rounds. He's always happy to see new arrivals--but they sure aren't happy to see him.

cards.name: Deathgrasp Cultist
cards.text: When I'm summoned or you summon a Titanic ally, Curse the strongest enemy with Terror.
cards.textHtml: When I'm summoned or you summon a <link=vocab.Titanic><style=Vocab>Titanic</style></link> ally, <link=keyword.Curse><sprite name=Curse><style=Keyword>Curse</style></link> the <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> enemy with <link=card.curse><style=AssociatedCard>Terror</style></link>.
cards.flavor: In the eyes of his followers, the Iron Revenant is the only hope for those who seek oblivion. Peace through domination--these cultists welcome it with open arms.

cards.name: Terror
cards.text: While I'm in hand, the cursed unit has  -3|-0.
cards.textHtml: While I'm in hand, <style=Variable>the cursed unit</style> has <nobr> -<style=Variable>3</style>|-0.</nobr>
cards.flavor: You feel an overwhelming sense of dread.

cards.name: Watery Grave
cards.text: Obliterate 6 cards from the bottom of the enemy deck.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Obliterate><style=Vocab>Obliterate</style></link> 6 cards from the bottom of the enemy deck.
cards.flavor: For some of Runeterra's deepest sea monsters, a jaull-ship is a light snack.

cards.name: Threshold of the Grey
cards.text:
Play: Curse an enemy with Terror.
When you summon a Titanic ally, destroy me to draw 2.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: <link=keyword.Curse><sprite name=Curse><style=Keyword>Curse</style></link> an enemy with <link=card.curse><style=AssociatedCard>Terror</style></link>.
When you summon a <link=vocab.Titanic><style=Vocab>Titanic</style></link> ally, destroy me to draw 2.
cards.flavor: "These souls, we offer you. This road, we pave in bone before you. These realms, we rend asunder, to make way for your army of iron everlasting." - Deathgrasp Cultist

cards.name: Spectral Ironhound
cards.text:
To play me, kill an ally.
When I'm summoned, summon a Thousand-Clawed Deathwinder.
cards.textHtml:
To play me, kill an ally.
When I'm summoned, summon a <link=card.summon><style=AssociatedCard>Thousand-Clawed Deathwinder</style></link>.
cards.flavor: These hounds never forget the scent of one who tried to flee--and when the hounds corner their prey, a deathwinder is never far behind.

cards.name: Thousand-Clawed Deathwinder
cards.flavor: The skitter of a thousand iron-clawed hands and the gnashing of spectral teeth promise a nasty end to any who refuse to serve.

cards.name: Erastin, the Disgraced
cards.text:
When I'm summoned, grant me Deathless.
Attack: Give enemies -1|-0 this round.
cards.textHtml:
When I'm summoned, grant me <link=keyword.Deathless><sprite name=Deathless><style=Keyword>Deathless</style></link>.
<link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Give enemies -1|-0 this round.
cards.flavor: Camavor's dragons were once magnificent and respected--but even they were not safe from the all-consuming corruption of the Ruination. Erastin is no exception, his long-lost regality now twisted into the garish appearance of the deathless.

cards.name: Death's Grasp
cards.text: Kill an ally to deal 5 to a unit.
cards.textHtml: Kill an ally to deal 5 to a unit.
cards.flavor: "Darkness is destiny for all but me." - Mordekaiser

cards.name: Mordekaiser
cards.text:
Play: Kill up to 2 allies.
When you slay another ally, revive it.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Kill up to 2 allies.
When you <link=vocab.Slay><style=Vocab>slay</style></link> another ally, revive it.
cards.levelup: 15+ allies have died. Allies with 5+ Power count twice.
cards.flavor: Bound to his armor kept in the heart of the Immortal Bastion, Mordekaiser has forged a throne of his own making in the Grey Realm. For every one who would seek to destroy him, there are more who will serve him in both life and death.

cards.name: Mordekaiser
cards.text:
Play: Kill up to 2 allies.
When you slay another ally, revive it.
Attack: For the rest of the game, when you slay a unit, Drain 1 from the enemy Nexus.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Kill up to 2 allies.
When you <link=vocab.Slay><style=Vocab>slay</style></link> another ally, revive it.
<link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: For the rest of the game, when you <link=vocab.Slay><style=Vocab>slay</style></link> a unit, <link=keyword.Drain><style=Keyword>Drain</style></link> 1 from the enemy Nexus.
cards.flavor: "Serve me! Relinquish your pitiful souls. I will give them iron everlasting. I am oblivion inevitable!"

cards.name: Vex
cards.text: Attack: Grant the Strongest enemy Gloom.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Grant the <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>Strongest</style></link> enemy <link=keyword.Gloom><sprite name=Gloom><style=Keyword>Gloom</style></link>.
cards.levelup: You've granted Gloom 5+ different times.
cards.flavor: "Ugh, stupid pink girl. I already told her I HATE parties, especially when there's cake. Gross. Just... wake me up when she goes away."

cards.name: Vex's Glare
cards.text:
Grant a unit Gloom to draw 1.
Create a Vex in your deck.
cards.textHtml:
Grant a unit <link=keyword.Gloom><sprite name=Gloom><style=Keyword>Gloom</style></link> to draw 1.
Create a <link=card.level1><style=AssociatedCard>Vex</style></link> in your deck.
cards.flavor: "Congratulations. I hate you." - Vex

cards.name: Vex
cards.text:
Attack: Grant the strongest enemy Gloom.
When an enemy gains Gloom, it gains it again.
cards.textHtml:
<link=vocab.Attack><style=Vocab>Attack</style></link>: Grant the <link=vocab.Strongest><style=Vocab>strongest</style></link> enemy <link=keyword.Gloom><sprite name=Gloom><style=Keyword>Gloom</style></link>.
When an enemy gains <link=keyword.Gloom><sprite name=Gloom><style=Keyword>Gloom</style></link>, it gains it again.
cards.flavor: "Well, this is awful. And not in a good way."

cards.name: Uncle Milty
cards.text: Grant me 2 Spirit once you've completed a Story.
cards.textHtml: Grant me 2 <link=keyword.Spirit><sprite name=Spirit><style=Keyword>Spirit</style></link> once you've completed a Story.
cards.flavor: Though he's certainly very different from his gloomy niece, Uncle Milty always does his best to connect with her--especially if it's through a spooky story told by candlelight.

cards.name: Grotesque Gift
cards.text: The first time an enemy is summoned, grant it Gloom.
cards.textHtml: The first time an enemy is summoned, grant it <link=keyword.Gloom><sprite name=Gloom><style=Keyword>Gloom</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "Huh, didn't end up being such a bad gift after all." - Vex

cards.name: Allay
cards.text: Play: Grant me Spirit or Grant a unit Gloom.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Grant me <link=keyword.Spirit><sprite name=Spirit><style=Keyword>Spirit</style></link> or <link=keyword.PlaySkillMark><sprite name=SkillMark><style=Keyword></style></link>Grant a unit <link=keyword.Gloom><sprite name=Gloom><style=Keyword>Gloom</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "Veeeee! Waaait! I have something for you! It's an invitation to your very own BIRTHDAY PARTY! And your gift, a little early! I COULDN'T wait. Aren't you excited? We need to talk about what to wear, and the CAKE, and--Vee?"

cards.name: Irritating Invite
cards.text: Grant a unit Gloom.
cards.textHtml: Grant a unit <link=keyword.Gloom><sprite name=Gloom><style=Keyword>Gloom</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "It's still not my birthday." - Vex

cards.name: Beefcake Mayor
cards.text: Round Start: Boost me.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.RoundStart><style=Vocab>Round Start</style></link>: <link=vocab.Boost><style=Vocab>Boost</style></link> me.
cards.flavor:
Time slowed down as the weirdly muscular mayor burst out of the impossibly tall cake. "A very HAAAAPPYYYY BIRTHDAY," the mayor said with a flex, "from Bandle's best--and buffest--elected official!"

Out of all her dreams, Vex hated this one the most.

cards.name: Gloomsprites
cards.text: Strike: Grant me Impact.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Strike><style=Vocab> Strike</style></link>: Grant me <link=keyword.Impact><sprite name=Impact><style=Keyword>Impact</style></link>.
cards.flavor: "Dreams have a funny way of changin' the sprites. These ones seem to be... oh, is that cake?" - Lillia

cards.name: The Family Reunion
cards.text:
I: Grant a unit Gloom.
II: Grant an ally Impact.
III: Boost 2 units.
cards.textHtml:

III: <link=vocab.Boost><style=Vocab>Boost</style></link> 2 units.
cards.flavor: Absence doesn't make this heart grow any fonder. But at least family dinners are quiet around here--just the way Vex likes it.

cards.text:
I-II: Pick an ally, then pick 1 of 3 followers that costs 1 more to transform it into.
III: Pick an ally, then pick 1 of 3 followers that costs 2 more to transform it into.

III: Pick an ally, then pick 1 of 3 followers that costs 2 more to transform it into.

cards.text:
I: An ally and an enemy Strike each other. They can't drop below 1 Health from this Strike.
II: Fully heal an ally.
III: Create 3 Coins in hand.
cards.textHtml:

cards.flavor: Angel has spent years angling to win the fight to end all fights. Every night, she dreams of a coin pile big enough to fill Bilgewater Bay. That's potato farm money, that is.

cards.textHtml: I have +1|+0 for each card you've drawn this round.

cards.flavor: "Come on, Mister Sprite. Let's burn away these creepy shadows!" - Dreamlight Alina

cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Boost><style=Vocab>Boost</style></link> all units.
cards.flavor: "Our radiance is unbound!" - Lux: Illuminated

cards.name: Jarro Lightfeather
cards.text: Play: Grant an ally in hand Spirit.
cards.textHtml: <link=vocab.Play><style=Vocab>Play</style></link>: Grant an ally in hand <link=keyword.Spirit><sprite name=Spirit><style=Keyword>Spirit</style></link>.
cards.flavor: A young man in a masquerade mask manifested before her with a flourish of rose petals and luminescent creatures. "The name's Lightfeather. Jarro Lightfeather," he said. "I was told you might be in need of some assistance, my lady?"

cards.name: Spritelings
cards.flavor: "Spritelings are marvelous creatures. Given enough time, and the right dreamer, their potential is simply limitless!" - Sprite Mother

cards.name: Lux: Illuminated
cards.text: Support: Grant my supported ally Spirit and give me Barrier this round.
cards.textHtml: <link=keyword.Support><style=Keyword>Support</style></link>: Grant my supported ally <link=keyword.Spirit><sprite name=Spirit><style=Keyword>Spirit</style></link> and give me <link=keyword.Barrier><sprite name=Barrier><style=Keyword>Barrier</style></link> this round.
cards.levelup: Allies have attacked with or have gained while attacking 20+ total positive keywords.
cards.flavor: Light swirled and arced around Luxanna as the city folk looked on in wonder. Here, she was Demacia's Lady of Light, an upstanding young Crownguard and a talented mage. Here, Demacia was everything she had always wanted it to be.

cards.name: Lux: Illuminated
cards.text:
Support: Grant my supported ally Spirit and give me Barrier this round.
When an ally gains Spirit, it gains it again.

<link=keyword.Support><style=Keyword>Support</style></link>: Grant my supported ally <link=keyword.Spirit><sprite name=Spirit><style=Keyword>Spirit</style></link> and give me <link=keyword.Barrier><sprite name=Barrier><style=Keyword>Barrier</style></link> this round.

cards.flavor: "I am Luxanna, Lady of Light, and I am not afraid! You may try to twist my Demacia into nightmare and drown it in darkness, but there is no shadow I cannot outshine!"

I-II: Give an ally +2|+0 this round.

cards.name: Yeti Handler

To play me, discard 1. 
When I'm summoned, summon an Enraged Yeti.

To play me, discard 1. 
When I'm summoned, summon an <link=card.create><style=AssociatedCard>Enraged Yeti</style></link>.
cards.flavor: The Noxian war machine's success is due in part to its flexibility. When challenging terrain or difficult conditions demand adaptation, the military will take advantage of even the most unlikely local resources.

III: Draw 1.
cards.textHtml:

cards.flavor: This temple to Janna has few solid walls, so as to be better in tune with its goddess' powers. Nevertheless, the many candles seem always to be lit, even when a howling storm settles over the rest of Zaun.

cards.flavor: The rise of the Emperor has inspired hope across Shurima. Determined to see Azir's vision fulfilled, this mage calls herself the 'Empire's Reconstructor' and travels the desert for the purpose of restoring buried ruins to their former splendor.
